verses.textZh: 大卫的子孙，亚伯拉罕的后裔，耶稣基督的家谱：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的子孙，亚伯拉罕的后裔，耶稣基督的家谱：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕的后裔，大卫的子孙 ，耶稣基督的家谱：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham:
verses.textEnEsv: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the Son of David, the Son of Abraham:
verses.textEnNlt: This is a record of the ancestors of Jesus the Messiah, a descendant of David and of Abraham :
verses.textEnNasb: The record of the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
verses.textEn: This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham:

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒，以撒生雅各，雅各生犹大和他的兄弟，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕生以撒，以撒生雅各，雅各生犹大和他的兄弟，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生犹大和他的弟兄；
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham was the father of Isaac, and Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,
verses.textEnNkjv: Abraham begot Isaac, Isaac begot Jacob, and Jacob begot Judah and his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was the father of Isaac. Isaac was the father of Jacob. Jacob was the father of Judah and his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham fathered Isaac, Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.
verses.textEn: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,

verses.textZh: 他玛给犹大生了法勒斯和谢拉，法勒斯生希斯仑，希斯仑生亚兰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛给犹大生了法勒斯和谢拉，法勒斯生希斯仑，希斯仑生亚兰，
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大从她玛氏生法勒斯和谢拉；法勒斯生希斯仑；希斯仑生亚兰；
verses.textEnNiv: Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, Hezron the father of Ram,
verses.textEnEsv: and Judah the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, and Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram,
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah begot Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez begot Hezron, and Hezron begot Ram.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah (whose mother was Tamar). Perez was the father of Hezron. Hezron was the father of Ram.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez fathered Hezron, and Hezron fathered Ram.
verses.textEn: Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, Hezron the father of Ram,

verses.textZh: 亚兰生亚米拿达，亚米拿达生拿顺，拿顺生撒门，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰生亚米拿达，亚米拿达生拿顺，拿顺生撒门，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺生撒门；
verses.textEnNiv: Ram the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
verses.textEnEsv: and Ram the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ram begot Amminadab, Amminadab begot Nahshon, and Nahshon begot Salmon.
verses.textEnNlt: Ram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Salmon.
verses.textEnNasb: Ram fathered Amminadab, Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon.
verses.textEn: Ram the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,

verses.textZh: 喇合给撒门生了波阿斯，路得给波阿斯生了俄备得，俄备得生耶西，
verses.textZhCnvs: 喇合给撒门生了波阿斯，路得给波阿斯生了俄备得，俄备得生耶西，
verses.textZhCuv: 撒门从喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯从路得氏生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；
verses.textEnNiv: Salmon the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
verses.textEnEsv: and Salmon the father of Boaz by Rahab, and Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, and Obed the father of Jesse,
verses.textEnNkjv: Salmon begot Boaz by Rahab, Boaz begot Obed by Ruth, Obed begot Jesse,
verses.textEnNlt: Salmon was the father of Boaz (whose mother was Rahab). Boaz was the father of Obed (whose mother was Ruth). Obed was the father of Jesse.
verses.textEnNasb: Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab, Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth, and Obed fathered Jesse.
verses.textEn: Salmon the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,

verses.textZh: 耶西生大卫王。 乌利亚的妻子给大卫生了所罗门，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西生大卫王。 乌利亚的妻子给大卫生了所罗门，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西生大卫王。 大卫从乌利亚的妻子生所罗门；
verses.textEnNiv: and Jesse the father of King David. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother had been Uriah’s wife,
verses.textEnEsv: and Jesse the father of David the king. And David was the father of Solomon by the wife of Uriah,
verses.textEnNkjv: and Jesse begot David the king. David the king begot Solomon by her whohadbeenthewife of Uriah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesse was the father of King David. David was the father of Solomon (whose mother was Bathsheba, the widow of Uriah).
verses.textEnNasb: Jesse fathered David the king. David fathered Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.
verses.textEn: and Jesse the father of King David. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother had been Uriah’s wife,

verses.textZh: 所罗门生罗波安，罗波安生亚比雅，亚比雅生亚撒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门生罗波安，罗波安生亚比雅，亚比雅生亚撒，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门生罗波安；罗波安生亚比雅；亚比雅生亚撒；
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, Abijah the father of Asa,
verses.textEnEsv: and Solomon the father of Rehoboam, and Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asaph,
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon begot Rehoboam, Rehoboam begot Abijah, and Abijah begot Asa.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon was the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam was the father of Abijah. Abijah was the father of Asa.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon fathered Rehoboam, Rehoboam fathered Abijah, and Abijah fathered Asa.
verses.textEn: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, Abijah the father of Asa,

verses.textZh: 亚撒生约沙法，约沙法生约兰，约兰生乌西雅，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒生约沙法，约沙法生约兰，约兰生乌西雅，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒生约沙法；约沙法生约兰； 约兰生乌西雅；
verses.textEnNiv: Asa the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Jehoram, Jehoram the father of Uzziah,
verses.textEnEsv: and Asaph the father of Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Asa begot Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat begot Joram, and Joram begot Uzziah.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehoram. Jehoram was the father of Uzziah.
verses.textEnNasb: Asa fathered Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat fathered Joram, and Joram fathered Uzziah.
verses.textEn: Asa the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Jehoram, Jehoram the father of Uzziah,

verses.textZh: 乌西雅生约坦，约坦生亚哈斯，亚哈斯生希西家，
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅生约坦，约坦生亚哈斯，亚哈斯生希西家，
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅生约坦；约坦生亚哈斯；亚哈斯生希西家；
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,
verses.textEnEsv: and Uzziah the father of Jotham, and Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Uzziah begot Jotham, Jotham begot Ahaz, and Ahaz begot Hezekiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah was the father of Jotham. Jotham was the father of Ahaz. Ahaz was the father of Hezekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Uzziah fathered Jotham, Jotham fathered Ahaz, and Ahaz fathered Hezekiah.
verses.textEn: Uzziah the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,

verses.textZh: 希西家生玛拿西，玛拿西生亚们，亚们生约西亚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家生玛拿西，玛拿西生亚们，亚们生约西亚，
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家生玛拿西；玛拿西生亚们；亚们生约西亚；
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
verses.textEnEsv: and Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, and Manasseh the father of Amos, and Amos the father of Josiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hezekiah begot Manasseh, Manasseh begot Amon, and Amon begot Josiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amon. Amon was the father of Josiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Hezekiah fathered Manasseh, Manasseh fathered Amon, and Amon fathered Josiah.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,

verses.textZh: 犹太人被掳到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人被掳到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓被迁到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: and Josiah the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the deportation to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Josiah begot Jeconiah and his brothers about the time they were carried away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah was the father of Jehoiachin and his brothers (born at the time of the exile to Babylon).
verses.textEnNasb: Josiah fathered Jeconiah and his brothers, at the time of the deportation to Babylon.
verses.textEn: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 被掳到巴比伦以后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁，撒拉铁生所罗巴伯，
verses.textZhCnvs: 被掳到巴比伦以后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁，撒拉铁生所罗巴伯，
verses.textZhCuv: 迁到巴比伦之后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁；撒拉铁生所罗巴伯；
verses.textEnNiv: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
verses.textEnEsv: And after the deportation to Babylon: Jechoniah was the father of Shealtiel, and Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
verses.textEnNkjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jeconiah begot Shealtiel, and Shealtiel begot Zerubbabel.
verses.textEnNlt: After the Babylonian exile: Jehoiachin was the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the father of Zerubbabel.
verses.textEnNasb: After the deportation to Babylon: Jeconiah fathered Shealtiel, and Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.
verses.textEn: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,

verses.textZh: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉，亚比玉生以利亚敬，以利亚敬生亚所，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉，亚比玉生以利亚敬，以利亚敬生亚所，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉；亚比玉生以利亚敬；以利亚敬生亚所；
verses.textEnNiv: Zerubbabel the father of Abihud, Abihud the father of Eliakim, Eliakim the father of Azor,
verses.textEnEsv: and Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, and Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor,
verses.textEnNkjv: Zerubbabel begot Abiud, Abiud begot Eliakim, and Eliakim begot Azor.
verses.textEnNlt: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abiud was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.
verses.textEnNasb: Zerubbabel fathered Abihud, Abihud fathered Eliakim, and Eliakim fathered Azor.
verses.textEn: Zerubbabel the father of Abihud, Abihud the father of Eliakim, Eliakim the father of Azor,

verses.textZh: 亚所生撒督，撒督生亚金，亚金生以律，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚所生撒督，撒督生亚金，亚金生以律，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚所生撒督；撒督生亚金；亚金生以律；
verses.textEnNiv: Azor the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Akim, Akim the father of Elihud,
verses.textEnEsv: and Azor the father of Zadok, and Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud,
verses.textEnNkjv: Azor begot Zadok, Zadok begot Achim, and Achim begot Eliud.
verses.textEnNlt: Azor was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Akim. Akim was the father of Eliud.
verses.textEnNasb: Azor fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Achim, and Achim fathered Eliud.
verses.textEn: Azor the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Akim, Akim the father of Elihud,

verses.textZh: 以律生以利亚撒，以利亚撒生马但，马但生雅各，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以律生以利亚撒，以利亚撒生马但，马但生雅各，
verses.textZhCuv: 以律生以利亚撒；以利亚撒生马但；马但生雅各；
verses.textEnNiv: Elihud the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
verses.textEnEsv: and Eliud the father of Eleazar, and Eleazar the father of Matthan, and Matthan the father of Jacob,
verses.textEnNkjv: Eliud begot Eleazar, Eleazar begot Matthan, and Matthan begot Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the father of Matthan. Matthan was the father of Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Eliud fathered Eleazar, Eleazar fathered Matthan, and Matthan fathered Jacob.
verses.textEn: Elihud the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,

verses.textZh: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫；那称为基督的耶稣，是马利亚所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫；那称为基督的耶稣，是马利亚所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫。那称为基督的耶稣是从马利亚生的。
verses.textEnNiv: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, and Mary was the mother of Jesus who is called the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jacob the father of Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob begot Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus who is called Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary. Mary gave birth to Jesus, who is called the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob fathered Joseph the husband of Mary, by whom Jesus was born, who is called the Messiah.
verses.textEn: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, and Mary was the mother of Jesus who is called the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫，一共是十四代；从大卫到被掳到巴比伦的时候，也是十四代；从被掳到巴比伦的时候到基督，又是十四代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫，一共是十四代；从大卫到被掳到巴比伦的时候，也是十四代；从被掳到巴比伦的时候到基督，又是十四代。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫共有十四代；从大卫到迁至巴比伦的时候也有十四代；从迁至巴比伦的时候到基督又有十四代。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus there were fourteen generations in all from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the generations from Abraham to David were fourteen generations, and from David to the deportation to Babylon fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon to the Christ fourteen generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations, from David until the captivity in Babylon are fourteen generations, and from the captivity in Babylon until the Christ are fourteen generations.
verses.textEnNlt: All those listed above include fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the Babylonian exile, and fourteen from the Babylonian exile to the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the deportation to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the deportation to Babylon to the Messiah, fourteen generations.
verses.textEn: Thus there were fourteen generations in all from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 耶稣基督的降生是这样的：耶稣的母亲马利亚许配了约瑟，他们还没有成亲，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣基督的降生是这样的：耶稣的母亲马利亚许配了约瑟，他们还没有成亲，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣基督降生的事记在下面：他母亲马利亚已经许配了约瑟，还没有迎娶，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah came about : His mother Mary was pledged to be married to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ took place in this way. When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found to be with child from the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was as follows: After His mother Mary was betrothed to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: This is how Jesus the Messiah was born. His mother, Mary, was engaged to be married to Joseph. But before the marriage took place, while she was still a virgin, she became pregnant through the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the birth of Jesus the Messiah was as follows: when His mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found to be pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah came about : His mother Mary was pledged to be married to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿张扬使她受辱，就打算暗中与她解除婚约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿张扬使她受辱，就打算暗中与她解除婚约。
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。
verses.textEnNiv: Because Joseph her husband was faithful to the law, and yet did not want to expose her to public disgrace, he had in mind to divorce her quietly.
verses.textEnEsv: And her husband Joseph, being a just man and unwilling to put her to shame, resolved to divorce her quietly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not wanting to make her a public example, was minded to put her away secretly.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph, to whom she was engaged, was a righteous man and did not want to disgrace her publicly, so he decided to break the engagement quietly.
verses.textEnNasb: And her husband Joseph, since he was a righteous man and did not want to disgrace her, planned to send her away secretly.
verses.textEn: Because Joseph her husband was faithful to the law, and yet did not want to expose her to public disgrace, he had in mind to divorce her quietly.

verses.textZh: 他一直想着这些事，主的使者就在梦中向他显现，说："大卫的子孙约瑟，只管放胆把你的妻子马利亚迎娶过来，因为她怀的孕是从圣灵来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一直想着这些事，主的使者就在梦中向他显现，说："大卫的子孙约瑟，只管放胆把你的妻子马利亚迎娶过来，因为她怀的孕是从圣灵来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 正思念这事的时候，有主的使者向他梦中显现，说：「大卫的子孙约瑟，不要怕！只管娶过你的妻子马利亚来，因她所怀的孕是从圣灵来的。
verses.textEnNiv: But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, "Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: But as he considered these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, do not fear to take Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But while he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take to you Mary your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: As he considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream. "Joseph, son of David," the angel said, "do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife. For the child within her was conceived by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he had thought this over, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife; for the Child who has been conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, "Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 她必生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因为他要把自己的子民从罪恶中拯救出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她必生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因为他要把自己的子民从罪恶中拯救出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她将要生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因他要将自己的百姓从罪恶里救出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins."
verses.textEnEsv: She will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she will bring forth a Son, and you shall call His name Jesus, for He will save His people from their sins."
verses.textEnNlt: And she will have a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."
verses.textEnNasb: She will give birth to a Son; and you shall name Him Jesus, for He will save His people from their sins."
verses.textEn: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins."

verses.textZh: 这整件事的发生，是要应验主借着先知所说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这整件事的发生，是要应验主借着先知所说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切的事成就是要应验主藉先知所说的话，
verses.textEnNiv: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
verses.textEnEsv: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had spoken by the prophet:
verses.textEnNkjv: So all this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: All of this occurred to fulfill the Lord’s message through his prophet:
verses.textEnNasb: Now all this took place so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet would be fulfilled:
verses.textEn: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

verses.textZh: "必有童女怀孕生子， 他的名要叫以马内利。" 以马内利就是"神与我们同在"的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: "必有童女怀孕生子， 他的名要叫以马内利。" 以马内利就是"神与我们同在"的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 必有童女怀孕生子； 人要称他的名为以马内利。 （以马内利翻出来就是「神与我们同在」。）
verses.textEnNiv: "The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel" (which means "God with us").
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall call his name Immanuel" (which means, God with us).
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and bear a Son, and they shall call His name Immanuel," which is translated, "God with us."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look! The virgin will conceive a child! She will give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel, which means ‘God is with us.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the virgin will conceive and give birth to a Son, and they shall name Him Immanuel," which translated means, "God with us."
verses.textEn: "The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel" (which means "God with us").

verses.textZh: 约瑟睡醒了，就照着主的使者所吩咐的，把妻子迎娶过来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟睡醒了，就照着主的使者所吩咐的，把妻子迎娶过来；
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟醒了，起来，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶过来；
verses.textEnNiv: When Joseph woke up, he did what the angel of the Lord had commanded him and took Mary home as his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joseph woke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him: he took his wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph, being aroused from sleep, did as the angel of the Lord commanded him and took to him his wife,
verses.textEnNlt: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded and took Mary as his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph awoke from his sleep and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took Mary as his wife,
verses.textEn: When Joseph woke up, he did what the angel of the Lord had commanded him and took Mary home as his wife.

verses.textZh: 只是在孩子出生以前，并没有与她同房。约瑟给孩子起名叫耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是在孩子出生以前，并没有与她同房。约瑟给孩子起名叫耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是没有和她同房，等她生了儿子 ，就给他起名叫耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: But he did not consummate their marriage until she gave birth to a son. And he gave him the name Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: but knew her not until she had given birth to a son. And he called his name Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: and did not know her till she had brought forth her firstborn Son. And he called His name Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did not have sexual relations with her until her son was born. And Joseph named him Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: but kept her a virgin until she gave birth to a Son; and he named Him Jesus.
verses.textEn: But he did not consummate their marriage until she gave birth to a son. And he gave him the name Jesus.

verses.textZh: 希律王执政的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。那时，有几个星象家 从东方来到耶路撒冷，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律王执政的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。那时，有几个星象家 从东方来到耶路撒冷，
verses.textZhCuv: 当希律王的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。有几个博士从东方来到耶路撒冷，说：
verses.textEnNiv: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem
verses.textEnEsv: Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, wise men from the East came to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the reign of King Herod. About that time some wise men from eastern lands arrived in Jerusalem, asking,
verses.textEnNasb: Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem, saying,
verses.textEn: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem

verses.textZh: 说："那生下来作犹太人的王的在哪里？我们看见他的星出现，特来朝拜他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："那生下来作犹太人的王的在哪里？我们看见他的星出现，特来朝拜他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「那生下来作犹太人之王的在哪里？我们在东方看见他的星，特来拜他。」
verses.textEnNiv: and asked, "Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Where is he who has been born king of the Jews? For we saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Where is He who has been born King of the Jews? For we have seen His star in the East and have come to worship Him."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where is the newborn king of the Jews? We saw his star as it rose, and we have come to worship him."
verses.textEnNasb: "Where is He who has been born King of the Jews? For we saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him."
verses.textEn: and asked, "Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him."

verses.textZh: 希律王听见了就心里不安，全耶路撒冷的居民也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律王听见了就心里不安，全耶路撒冷的居民也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律王听见了，就心里不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
verses.textEnNiv: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.textEnEsv: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him;
verses.textEnNkjv: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.textEnNlt: King Herod was deeply disturbed when he heard this, as was everyone in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.textEn: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

verses.textZh: 他就召集所有的祭司长和民间的经学家，问他们基督应该生在哪里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就召集所有的祭司长和民间的经学家，问他们基督应该生在哪里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就召齐了祭司长和民间的文士，问他们说：「基督当生在何处？」
verses.textEnNiv: When he had called together all the people’s chief priests and teachers of the law, he asked them where the Messiah was to be born.
verses.textEnEsv: and assembling all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born.
verses.textEnNlt: He called a meeting of the leading priests and teachers of religious law and asked, "Where is the Messiah supposed to be born?"
verses.textEnNasb: And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Messiah was to be born.
verses.textEn: When he had called together all the people’s chief priests and teachers of the law, he asked them where the Messiah was to be born.

verses.textZh: 他们回答："在犹太的伯利恒。因为有先知在经上这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："在犹太的伯利恒。因为有先知在经上这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「在犹太的伯利恒。因为有先知记着，说：
verses.textEnNiv: "In Bethlehem in Judea," they replied, "for this is what the prophet has written:
verses.textEnEsv: They told him, "In Bethlehem of Judea, for so it is written by the prophet:
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to him, "In Bethlehem of Judea, for thus it is written by the prophet:
verses.textEnNlt: "In Bethlehem in Judea," they said, "for this is what the prophet wrote:
verses.textEnNasb: They said to him, "In Bethlehem of Judea; for this is what has been written by the prophet:
verses.textEn: "In Bethlehem in Judea," they replied, "for this is what the prophet has written:

verses.textZh: ‘犹大地的伯利恒啊！ 你在犹大的领袖中，并不是最小的， 因为必有一位领袖从你那里出来， 牧养我的子民以色列。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘犹大地的伯利恒啊！ 你在犹大的领袖中，并不是最小的， 因为必有一位领袖从你那里出来， 牧养我的子民以色列。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大地的伯利恒啊， 你在犹大诸城中并不是最小的； 因为将来有一位君王要从你那里出来， 牧养我以色列民。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for out of you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And you, O Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for from you shall come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, Are not the least among the rulers of Judah; For out of you shall come a Ruler Who will shepherd My people Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: ‘And you, O Bethlehem in the land of Judah, are not least among the ruling cities of Judah, for a ruler will come from you who will be the shepherd for my people Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And you, Bethlehem, land of Judah, Are by no means least among the leaders of Judah; For from you will come forth a Ruler Who will shepherd My people Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for out of you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’ "

verses.textZh: 希律暗中把星象家召来，仔细查问他们，那颗星甚么时候出现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律暗中把星象家召来，仔细查问他们，那颗星甚么时候出现，
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，希律暗暗地召了博士来，细问那星是什么时候出现的，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Herod summoned the wise men secretly and ascertained from them what time the star had appeared.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Herod, when he had secretly called the wise men, determined from them what time the star appeared.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Herod called for a private meeting with the wise men, and he learned from them the time when the star first appeared.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Herod secretly called for the magi and determined from them the exact time the star appeared.
verses.textEn: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.

verses.textZh: 然后派他们到伯利恒去，说："你们去细心寻访那小孩，找到了就向我报告，好叫我也去拜他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后派他们到伯利恒去，说："你们去细心寻访那小孩，找到了就向我报告，好叫我也去拜他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就差他们往伯利恒去，说：「你们去仔细寻访那小孩子，寻到了就来报信，我也好去拜他。」
verses.textEnNiv: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship him."
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, saying, "Go and search diligently for the child, and when you have found him, bring me word, that I too may come and worship him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and search carefully for the young Child, and when you have found Him, bring back word to me, that I may come and worship Him also."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he told them, "Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. And when you find him, come back and tell me so that I can go and worship him, too!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and search carefully for the Child; and when you have found Him, report to me, so that I too may come and worship Him."
verses.textEn: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship him."

verses.textZh: 他们听命去了。他们在东方看见的那颗星，忽然在他们前头，领他们到那小孩所在的地方，就在上头停住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听命去了。他们在东方看见的那颗星，忽然在他们前头，领他们到那小孩所在的地方，就在上头停住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见王的话就去了。在东方所看见的那星忽然在他们前头行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上头停住了。
verses.textEnNiv: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen when it rose went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
verses.textEnEsv: After listening to the king, they went on their way. And behold, the star that they had seen when it rose went before them until it came to rest over the place where the child was.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they heard the king, they departed; and behold, the star which they had seen in the East went before them, till it came and stood over where the young Child was.
verses.textEnNlt: After this interview the wise men went their way. And the star they had seen in the east guided them to Bethlehem. It went ahead of them and stopped over the place where the child was.
verses.textEnNasb: After hearing the king, they went on their way; and behold, the star, which they had seen in the east, went on ahead of them until it came to a stop over the place where the Child was to be found.
verses.textEn: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen when it rose went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.

verses.textZh: 他们看见那颗星，欢喜极了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见那颗星，欢喜极了；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们看见那星，就大大地欢喜；
verses.textEnNiv: When they saw the star, they were overjoyed.
verses.textEnEsv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced exceedingly with great joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
verses.textEnNlt: When they saw the star, they were filled with joy!
verses.textEnNasb: When they saw the star, they rejoiced exceedingly with great joy.
verses.textEn: When they saw the star, they were overjoyed.

verses.textZh: 进了房子，看见小孩和他母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜他，并且打开宝盒，把黄金、乳香、没药作礼物献给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 进了房子，看见小孩和他母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜他，并且打开宝盒，把黄金、乳香、没药作礼物献给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 进了房子，看见小孩子和他母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭开宝盒，拿黄金、乳香、没药为礼物献给他。
verses.textEnNiv: On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.
verses.textEnEsv: And going into the house, they saw the child with Mary his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Then, opening their treasures, they offered him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had come into the house, they saw the young Child with Mary His mother, and fell down and worshiped Him. And when they had opened their treasures, they presented gifts to Him: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.textEnNlt: They entered the house and saw the child with his mother, Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasure chests and gave him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.textEnNasb: And after they came into the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary; and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented to Him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.textEn: On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.

verses.textZh: 后来他们在梦中得着指示不要回到希律那里去，就从别的路回乡去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他们在梦中得着指示不要回到希律那里去，就从别的路回乡去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 博士因为在梦中被主指示不要回去见希律，就从别的路回本地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.
verses.textEnEsv: And being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their own country by another way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, being divinely warned in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed for their own country another way.
verses.textEnNlt: When it was time to leave, they returned to their own country by another route, for God had warned them in a dream not to return to Herod.
verses.textEnNasb: And after being warned by God in a dream not to return to Herod, the magi left for their own country by another way.
verses.textEn: And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.

verses.textZh: 他们走了以后，主的使者在梦中向约瑟显现，说："起来，带着孩子和他母亲逃到埃及去，留在那里，直到我再指示你，因为希律要寻找这孩子，把他杀掉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走了以后，主的使者在梦中向约瑟显现，说："起来，带着孩子和他母亲逃到埃及去，留在那里，直到我再指示你，因为希律要寻找这孩子，把他杀掉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们去后，有主的使者向约瑟梦中显现，说：「起来！带着小孩子同他母亲逃往埃及，住在那里，等我吩咐你；因为希律必寻找小孩子，要除灭他。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Get up," he said, "take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the child to kill him."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, "Rise, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and remain there until I tell you, for Herod is about to search for the child, to destroy him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, "Arise, take the young Child and His mother, flee to Egypt, and stay there until I bring you word; for Herod will seek the young Child to destroy Him."
verses.textEnNlt: After the wise men were gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Get up! Flee to Egypt with the child and his mother," the angel said. "Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is going to search for the child to kill him."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they had gone, behold, an angel of the Lord *appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, "Get up! Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt, and stay there until I tell you; for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him."
verses.textEn: When they had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Get up," he said, "take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the child to kill him."

verses.textZh: 约瑟就起来，连夜带着孩子和他母亲往埃及去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟就起来，连夜带着孩子和他母亲往埃及去，
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟就起来，夜间带着小孩子和他母亲往埃及去，
verses.textEnNiv: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: And he rose and took the child and his mother by night and departed to Egypt
verses.textEnNkjv: When he arose, he took the young Child and His mother by night and departed for Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: That night Joseph left for Egypt with the child and Mary, his mother,
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph got up and took the Child and His mother while it was still night, and left for Egypt.
verses.textEn: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,

verses.textZh: 住在那里，直到希律死了，为的是要应验主藉先知所说的："我从埃及召我的儿子出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在那里，直到希律死了，为的是要应验主藉先知所说的："我从埃及召我的儿子出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 住在那里，直到希律死了。这是要应验主藉先知所说的话，说：「我从埃及召出我的儿子来。」
verses.textEnNiv: where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: "Out of Egypt I called my son."
verses.textEnEsv: and remained there until the death of Herod. This was to fulfill what the Lord had spoken by the prophet, "Out of Egypt I called my son."
verses.textEnNkjv: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, "Out of Egypt I called My Son."
verses.textEnNlt: and they stayed there until Herod’s death. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: "I called my Son out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: He stayed there until the death of Herod; this happened so that what had been spoken by the Lord through the prophet would be fulfilled: "Out of Egypt I called My Son."
verses.textEn: where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: "Out of Egypt I called my son."

verses.textZh: 希律见自己被星象家愚弄了，就大怒，于是照着他从星象家所问得的日子，下令把伯利恒和附近地方，两岁及以下的小孩全都杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律见自己被星象家愚弄了，就大怒，于是照着他从星象家所问得的日子，下令把伯利恒和附近地方，两岁及以下的小孩全都杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律见自己被博士愚弄，就大大发怒，差人将伯利恒城里并四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔细查问的时候，凡两岁以里的，都杀尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, in accordance with the time he had learned from the Magi.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, became furious, and he sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that region who were two years old or under, according to the time that he had ascertained from the wise men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was deceived by the wise men, was exceedingly angry; and he sent forth and put to death all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all its districts, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had determined from the wise men.
verses.textEnNlt: Herod was furious when he realized that the wise men had outwitted him. He sent soldiers to kill all the boys in and around Bethlehem who were two years old and under, based on the wise men’s report of the star’s first appearance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then when Herod saw that he had been tricked by the magi, he became very enraged, and sent men and killed all the boys who were in Bethlehem and all its vicinity who were two years old or under, according to the time which he had determined from the magi.
verses.textEn: When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, in accordance with the time he had learned from the Magi.

verses.textZh: 这就应验了耶利米先知所说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就应验了耶利米先知所说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
verses.textEnEsv: Then was fulfilled what was spoken by the prophet Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then was fulfilled what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Herod’s brutal action fulfilled what God had spoken through the prophet Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNasb: Then what had been spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled:
verses.textEn: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

verses.textZh: "在拉玛听见有声音， 是痛哭、极大哀号的声音； 拉结为她的儿女哀哭， 不肯受安慰，因为他们都不在了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "在拉玛听见有声音， 是痛哭、极大哀号的声音； 拉结为她的儿女哀哭， 不肯受安慰，因为他们都不在了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在拉玛听见号咷大哭的声音， 是拉结哭她儿女， 不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。
verses.textEnNiv: "A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more."
verses.textEnEsv: "A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and loud lamentation, Rachel weeping for her children; she refused to be comforted, because they are no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: "A voice was heard in Ramah, Lamentation, weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, Refusing to be comforted, Because they are no more."
verses.textEnNlt: "A cry was heard in Ramah— weeping and great mourning. Rachel weeps for her children, refusing to be comforted, for they are dead."
verses.textEnNasb: "A voice was heard in Ramah, Weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; And she refused to be comforted, Because they were no more."
verses.textEn: "A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more."

verses.textZh: 希律死后，在埃及，主的使者在梦中向约瑟显现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律死后，在埃及，主的使者在梦中向约瑟显现，
verses.textZhCuv: 希律死了以后，有主的使者在埃及向约瑟梦中显现，说：
verses.textEnNiv: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt
verses.textEnEsv: But when Herod died, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: When Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Herod died, behold, an angel of the Lord *appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, and said,
verses.textEn: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt

verses.textZh: 说："那些要杀害这孩子的人已经死了。起来，带着孩子和他母亲回以色列地去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："那些要杀害这孩子的人已经死了。起来，带着孩子和他母亲回以色列地去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「起来！带着小孩子和他母亲往以色列地去，因为要害小孩子性命的人已经死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "Get up, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who were trying to take the child’s life are dead."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Rise, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who sought the child’s life are dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Arise, take the young Child and His mother, and go to the land of Israel, for those who sought the young Child’s life are dead."
verses.textEnNlt: "Get up!" the angel said. "Take the child and his mother back to the land of Israel, because those who were trying to kill the child are dead."
verses.textEnNasb: "Get up, take the Child and His mother, and go to the land of Israel; for those who sought the Child’s life are dead."
verses.textEn: and said, "Get up, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who were trying to take the child’s life are dead."

verses.textZh: 约瑟就起来，带着小孩子和他母亲回到以色列地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟就起来，带着小孩子和他母亲回到以色列地。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟就起来，把小孩子和他母亲带到以色列地去；
verses.textEnNiv: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And he rose and took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he arose, took the young Child and His mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph got up and returned to the land of Israel with Jesus and his mother.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.textEn: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.

verses.textZh: 只是听见亚基老接续他父亲希律作了犹太王，他就不敢到犹太地去；又在梦中得了指示，于是往加利利境去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是听见亚基老接续他父亲希律作了犹太王，他就不敢到犹太地去；又在梦中得了指示，于是往加利利境去，
verses.textZhCuv: 只因听见亚基老接着他父亲希律作了犹太王，就怕往那里去，又在梦中被主指示，便往加利利境内去了，
verses.textEnNiv: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
verses.textEnEsv: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there, and being warned in a dream he withdrew to the district of Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea instead of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And being warned by God in a dream, he turned aside into the region of Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: But when he learned that the new ruler of Judea was Herod’s son Archelaus, he was afraid to go there. Then, after being warned in a dream, he left for the region of Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Then after being warned by God in a dream, he left for the regions of Galilee,
verses.textEn: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,

verses.textZh: 来到拿撒勒城住下，这样就应验了先知所说的："他必称为拿撒勒人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 来到拿撒勒城住下，这样就应验了先知所说的："他必称为拿撒勒人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那里。这是要应验先知所说，他将称为拿撒勒人的话了。
verses.textEnNiv: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was said through the prophets, that he would be called a Nazarene.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went and lived in a city called Nazareth, so that what was spoken by the prophets might be fulfilled, that he would be called a Nazarene.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, "He shall be called a Nazarene."
verses.textEnNlt: So the family went and lived in a town called Nazareth. This fulfilled what the prophets had said: "He will be called a Nazarene."
verses.textEnNasb: and came and settled in a city called Nazareth. This happened so that what was spoken through the prophets would be fulfilled: "He will be called a Nazarene."
verses.textEn: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was said through the prophets, that he would be called a Nazarene.

verses.textZh: 那时，施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，说：
verses.textEnNiv: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
verses.textEnEsv: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
verses.textEnNlt: In those days John the Baptist came to the Judean wilderness and began preaching. His message was,
verses.textEnNasb: Now in those days John the Baptist * came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
verses.textEn: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

verses.textZh: 说："天国近了，你们应当悔改。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："天国近了，你们应当悔改。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「天国近了，你们应当悔改！」
verses.textEnNiv: and saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near."
verses.textEnEsv: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Repent of your sins and turn to God, for the Kingdom of Heaven is near. "
verses.textEnNasb: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near."
verses.textEn: and saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚先知所说： "在旷野有呼喊者的声音： ‘预备主的道， 修直他的路！’" 就是指着这约翰说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚先知所说： "在旷野有呼喊者的声音： ‘预备主的道， 修直他的路！’" 就是指着这约翰说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人就是先知以赛亚所说的。他说：「在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路！」
verses.textEnNiv: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: "A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For this is he who was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah when he said, "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make his paths straight.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is he who was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah, saying: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; Make His paths straight.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet Isaiah was speaking about John when he said, "He is a voice shouting in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord ’s coming! Clear the road for him!’"
verses.textEnNasb: For this is the one referred to by Isaiah the prophet when he said, "The voice of one calling out in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, Make His paths straight!’ "
verses.textEn: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: "A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ "

verses.textZh: 约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫和野蜜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫和野蜜。
verses.textZhCuv: 这约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。
verses.textEnNiv: John’s clothes were made of camel’s hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnEsv: Now John wore a garment of camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now John himself was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnNlt: John’s clothes were woven from coarse camel hair, and he wore a leather belt around his waist. For food he ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnNasb: Now John himself had a garment of camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEn: John’s clothes were made of camel’s hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷、犹太全地和约旦河一带的人都出来到他那里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷、犹太全地和约旦河一带的人都出来到他那里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶路撒冷和犹太全地，并约旦河一带地方的人，都出去到约翰那里，
verses.textEnNiv: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region of the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jerusalem and all Judea and all the region about the Jordan were going out to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jerusalem, all Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him
verses.textEnNlt: People from Jerusalem and from all of Judea and all over the Jordan Valley went out to see and hear John.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Jerusalem was going out to him, and all Judea and all the region around the Jordan;
verses.textEn: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region of the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 承认自己的罪，在约旦河里受了他的洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 承认自己的罪，在约旦河里受了他的洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。
verses.textEnNiv: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
verses.textEnEsv: and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: and were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.textEnNlt: And when they confessed their sins, he baptized them in the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, as they confessed their sins.
verses.textEn: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

verses.textZh: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人来到他施洗的地方，就对他们说："毒蛇所生的啊，谁指示你们逃避那将要来的忿怒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人来到他施洗的地方，就对他们说："毒蛇所生的啊，谁指示你们逃避那将要来的忿怒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人也来受洗，就对他们说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的忿怒呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to where he was baptizing, he said to them: "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
verses.textEnEsv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, "Brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.textEnNlt: But when he saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming to watch him baptize, he denounced them. "You brood of snakes!" he exclaimed. "Who warned you to flee the coming wrath?
verses.textEnNasb: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he said to them, "You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.textEn: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to where he was baptizing, he said to them: "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

verses.textZh: 应当结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应当结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。
verses.textEnNiv: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.
verses.textEnEsv: Bear fruit in keeping with repentance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore bear fruits worthy of repentance,
verses.textEnNlt: Prove by the way you live that you have repented of your sins and turned to God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore produce fruit consistent with repentance;
verses.textEn: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.

verses.textZh: 你们心里不要以为：‘我们有亚伯拉罕作我们的祖宗。’我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起后裔来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们心里不要以为：‘我们有亚伯拉罕作我们的祖宗。’我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起后裔来。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。
verses.textEnNiv: And do not think you can say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father,’ for I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: and do not think to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t just say to each other, ‘We’re safe, for we are descendants of Abraham.’ That means nothing, for I tell you, God can create children of Abraham from these very stones.
verses.textEnNasb: and do not assume that you can say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father’; for I tell you that God is able, from these stones, to raise up children for Abraham.
verses.textEn: And do not think you can say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

verses.textZh: 现在斧头已经放在树根上，所有不结好果子的树，就砍下来，丢在火里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在斧头已经放在树根上，所有不结好果子的树，就砍下来，丢在火里。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。
verses.textEnNiv: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: And even now the ax is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Even now the ax of God’s judgment is poised, ready to sever the roots of the trees. Yes, every tree that does not produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: And the axe is already laid at the root of the trees; therefore, every tree that does not bear good fruit is being cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEn: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.textZh: 我用水给你们施洗，表示你们悔改；但在我以后要来的那一位，能力比我更大，我就是替他提鞋也没有资格。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用水给你们施洗，表示你们悔改；但在我以后要来的那一位，能力比我更大，我就是替他提鞋也没有资格。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是用水给你们施洗，叫你们悔改。但那在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是给他提鞋也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.textEnNiv: "I baptize you with water for repentance. But after me comes one who is more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEnEsv: "I baptize you with water for repentance, but he who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance, but He who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEnNlt: "I baptize with water those who repent of their sins and turn to God. But someone is coming soon who is greater than I am—so much greater that I’m not worthy even to be his slave and carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for me, I baptize you with water for repentance, but He who is coming after me is mightier than I, and I am not fit to remove His sandals; He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEn: "I baptize you with water for repentance. But after me comes one who is more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

verses.textZh: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净麦场，把麦子收进仓里，却用不灭的火把糠秕烧尽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净麦场，把麦子收进仓里，却用不灭的火把糠秕烧尽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」
verses.textEnNiv: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor, gathering his wheat into the barn and burning up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEnEsv: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor and gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: His winnowing fan is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clean out His threshing floor, and gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEnNlt: He is ready to separate the chaff from the wheat with his winnowing fork. Then he will clean up the threshing area, gathering the wheat into his barn but burning the chaff with never-ending fire."
verses.textEnNasb: His winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clear His threshing floor; and He will gather His wheat into the barn, but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEn: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor, gathering his wheat into the barn and burning up the chaff with unquenchable fire."

verses.textZh: 那时，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河约翰那里，要受他的洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河约翰那里，要受他的洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河，见了约翰，要受他的洗。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus came from Galilee to John at the Jordan to be baptized by him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus went from Galilee to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus *arrived from Galilee at the Jordan, coming to John to be baptized by him.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

verses.textZh: 约翰想要阻止他，说："我应该受你的洗，你却到我这里来吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰想要阻止他，说："我应该受你的洗，你却到我这里来吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰想要拦住他，说：「我当受你的洗，你反倒上我这里来吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But John tried to deter him, saying, "I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: John would have prevented him, saying, "I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And John triedto prevent Him, saying, "I need to be baptized by You, and are You coming to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: But John tried to talk him out of it. "I am the one who needs to be baptized by you," he said, "so why are you coming to me?"
verses.textEnNasb: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, "I have the need to be baptized by You, and yet You are coming to me?"
verses.textEn: But John tried to deter him, saying, "I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>暂且这样作吧。我们理当这样履行全部的义。</red>"于是约翰答应了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>暂且这样作吧。我们理当这样履行全部的义。</red>"于是约翰答应了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>你暂且许我，因为我们理当这样尽诸般的义 。</red>」于是约翰许了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.”</red> Then John consented.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus answered him, "Let it be so now, for thus it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he consented.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered and said to him, "Permit it to be so now, for thus it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he allowed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "It should be done, for we must carry out all that God requires. " So John agreed to baptize him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, answering, said to him, "Allow it at this time; for in this way it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he *allowed Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.”</red> Then John consented.

verses.textZh: 耶稣受了洗，立刻从水中上来；忽然，天为他开了，他看见神的灵，好象鸽子降下来，落在他身上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣受了洗，立刻从水中上来；忽然，天为他开了，他看见神的灵，好象鸽子降下来，落在他身上；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣受了洗，随即从水里上来。天忽然为他开了，他就看见神的灵仿佛鸽子降下，落在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus was baptized, immediately he went up from the water, and behold, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on him;
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had been baptized, Jesus came up immediately from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened to Him, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting upon Him.
verses.textEnNlt: After his baptism, as Jesus came up out of the water, the heavens were opened and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and settling on him.
verses.textEnNasb: After He was baptized, Jesus came up immediately from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove and settling on Him,
verses.textEn: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting on him.

verses.textZh: 又有声音从天上来，说："这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有声音从天上来，说："这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从天上有声音说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。」
verses.textEnNiv: And a voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."
verses.textEnEsv: and behold, a voice from heaven said, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNkjv: And suddenly a voice came from heaven, saying, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNlt: And a voice from heaven said, "This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy."
verses.textEnNasb: and behold, a voice from the heavens said, "This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."
verses.textEn: And a voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."

verses.textZh: 随后，耶稣被圣灵带到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后，耶稣被圣灵带到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，耶稣被圣灵引到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted there by the devil.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

verses.textZh: 耶稣禁食了四十昼夜，就饿了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣禁食了四十昼夜，就饿了，
verses.textZhCuv: 他禁食四十昼夜，后来就饿了。
verses.textEnNiv: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.
verses.textEnEsv: And after fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had fasted forty days and forty nights, afterward He was hungry.
verses.textEnNlt: For forty days and forty nights he fasted and became very hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: And after He had fasted for forty days and forty nights, He then became hungry.
verses.textEn: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.

verses.textZh: 试探者前来对他说："你若是神的儿子，就吩咐这些石头变成食物吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 试探者前来对他说："你若是神的儿子，就吩咐这些石头变成食物吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那试探人的进前来，对他说：「你若是神的儿子，可以吩咐这些石头变成食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: The tempter came to him and said, "If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread."
verses.textEnEsv: And the tempter came and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become loaves of bread."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the tempter came to Him, he said, "If You are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread."
verses.textEnNlt: During that time the devil came and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become loaves of bread."
verses.textEnNasb: And the tempter came and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread."
verses.textEn: The tempter came to him and said, "If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>经上记着： ‘人活着，不是单靠食物， 更要靠神口里所出的一切话。’</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>经上记着： ‘人活着，不是单靠食物， 更要靠神口里所出的一切话。’</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣却回答说：「<red>经上记着说： 人活着，不是单靠食物， 乃是靠神口里所出的一切话。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered, "It is written, "‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said, "It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus told him, "No! The Scriptures say, ‘People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: But He answered and said, "It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes out of the mouth of God.’ "
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 随后，魔鬼带耶稣进了圣城，使他站在殿的最高处，
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后，魔鬼带耶稣进了圣城，使他站在殿的最高处，
verses.textZhCuv: 魔鬼就带他进了圣城，叫他站在殿顶 上，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the devil took him to the holy city and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the devil took him to the holy city and set him on the pinnacle of the temple
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the devil took Him up into the holy city, set Him on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the devil took him to the holy city, Jerusalem, to the highest point of the Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the devil *took Him along into the holy city and had Him stand on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.textEn: Then the devil took him to the holy city and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.

verses.textZh: 对他说："你若是神的儿子，就跳下去吧！因为经上记着： ‘神为了你， 会吩咐自己的使者用手托住你， 免得你的脚碰到石头。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："你若是神的儿子，就跳下去吧！因为经上记着： ‘神为了你， 会吩咐自己的使者用手托住你， 免得你的脚碰到石头。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「你若是神的儿子，可以跳下去，因为经上记着说： 主要为你吩咐他的使者 用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。」
verses.textEnNiv: "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down. For it is written: " ‘He will command his angels concerning you, and they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, "‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and "‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He shall give His angels charge over you,’ and, ‘In their hands they shall bear you up, Lest you dash your foot against a stone.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and said, "If you are the Son of God, jump off! For the Scriptures say, ‘He will order his angels to protect you. And they will hold you up with their hands so you won’t even hurt your foot on a stone.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: and he *said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down; for it is written: ‘He will give His angels orders concerning You’; and ‘On their hands they will lift You up, So that You do not strike Your foot against a stone.’ "
verses.textEn: "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down. For it is written: " ‘He will command his angels concerning you, and they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>经上又记着：‘不可试探主你的神。’</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>经上又记着：‘不可试探主你的神。’</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>经上又记着说：『不可试探主－你的神。』</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered him, <red>“It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Again it is written, ‘You shall not put the Lord your God to the test.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "It is written again, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "The Scriptures also say, ‘You must not test the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to him, " On the other hand, it is written: ‘You shall not put the Lord your God to the test.’ "
verses.textEn: Jesus answered him, <red>“It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 最后，魔鬼带耶稣上了一座极高的山，把世界各国和各国的荣华都指给他看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后，魔鬼带耶稣上了一座极高的山，把世界各国和各国的荣华都指给他看。
verses.textZhCuv: 魔鬼又带他上了一座最高的山，将世上的万国与万国的荣华都指给他看，
verses.textEnNiv: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, the devil took Him up on an exceedingly high mountain, and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Next the devil took him to the peak of a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
verses.textEnNasb: Again, the devil *took Him along to a very high mountain and *showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory;
verses.textEn: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor.

verses.textZh: 并且对他说："你只要跪下来拜我，我就把这一切都给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且对他说："你只要跪下来拜我，我就把这一切都给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把这一切都赐给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "All this I will give you," he said, "if you will bow down and worship me."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "All these I will give you, if you will fall down and worship me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to Him, "All these things I will give You if You will fall down and worship me."
verses.textEnNlt: "I will give it all to you," he said, "if you will kneel down and worship me."
verses.textEnNasb: and he said to Him, "All these things I will give You, if You fall down and worship me."
verses.textEn: "All this I will give you," he said, "if you will bow down and worship me."

verses.textZh: 但耶稣说："<red>撒但，走开！经上记着： ‘当拜主你的神， 单要事奉他。’</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶稣说："<red>撒但，走开！经上记着： ‘当拜主你的神， 单要事奉他。’</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>撒但 ，退去吧！因为经上记着说： 当拜主－你的神， 单要事奉他。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to him, <red>“Away from me, Satan! For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God, and serve him only.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus said to him, "Be gone, Satan! For it is written, "‘You shall worship the Lord your God and him only shall you serve.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Away with you, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and Him only you shall serve.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Get out of here, Satan," Jesus told him. "For the Scriptures say, ‘You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus *said to him, "Go away, Satan! For it is written: ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and serve Him only.’ "
verses.textEn: Jesus said to him, <red>“Away from me, Satan! For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God, and serve him only.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是魔鬼离开了耶稣，有天使前来服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是魔鬼离开了耶稣，有天使前来服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，魔鬼离了耶稣，有天使来伺候他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and were ministering to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the devil left Him, and behold, angels came and ministered to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the devil went away, and angels came and took care of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the devil *left Him; and behold, angels came and began to serve Him.
verses.textEn: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见约翰被捕，就往加利利去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见约翰被捕，就往加利利去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见约翰下了监，就退到加利利去；
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he withdrew to Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when he heard that John had been arrested, he withdrew into Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, He departed to Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard that John had been arrested, he left Judea and returned to Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus heard that John had been taken into custody, He withdrew into Galilee;
verses.textEn: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he withdrew to Galilee.

verses.textZh: 他又离开拿撒勒，往西布伦和拿弗他利境内近海的迦百农去，住在那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又离开拿撒勒，往西布伦和拿弗他利境内近海的迦百农去，住在那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 后又离开拿撒勒，往迦百农去，就住在那里。那地方靠海，在西布伦和拿弗他利的边界上。
verses.textEnNiv: Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum, which was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali—
verses.textEnEsv: And leaving Nazareth he went and lived in Capernaum by the sea, in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali,
verses.textEnNkjv: And leaving Nazareth, He came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the regions of Zebulun and Naphtali,
verses.textEnNlt: He went first to Nazareth, then left there and moved to Capernaum, beside the Sea of Galilee, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: and leaving Nazareth, He came and settled in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali.
verses.textEn: Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum, which was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali—

verses.textZh: 为了要应验以赛亚先知所说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了要应验以赛亚先知所说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，
verses.textEnNiv: to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:
verses.textEnEsv: so that what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled:
verses.textEnNkjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: This fulfilled what God said through the prophet Isaiah:
verses.textEnNasb: This happened so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet would be fulfilled:
verses.textEn: to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:

verses.textZh: "西布伦地、拿弗他利地， 沿海之路，约旦河外， 外族人的加利利啊！
verses.textZhCnvs: "西布伦地、拿弗他利地， 沿海之路，约旦河外， 外族人的加利利啊！
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 西布伦地，拿弗他利地， 就是沿海的路，约旦河外， 外邦人的加利利地－
verses.textEnNiv: "Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
verses.textEnEsv: "The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
verses.textEnNkjv: "The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, By the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles:
verses.textEnNlt: "In the land of Zebulun and of Naphtali, beside the sea, beyond the Jordan River, in Galilee where so many Gentiles live,
verses.textEnNasb: "The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, By the way of the sea, on the other side of the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
verses.textEn: "Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—

verses.textZh: 住在黑暗中的人民， 看见了大光； 死亡幽暗之地的居民， 有光照亮他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在黑暗中的人民， 看见了大光； 死亡幽暗之地的居民， 有光照亮他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那坐在黑暗里的百姓看见了大光； 坐在死荫之地的人有光发现照着他们。
verses.textEnNiv: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned."
verses.textEnEsv: the people dwelling in darkness have seen a great light, and for those dwelling in the region and shadow of death, on them a light has dawned."
verses.textEnNkjv: The people who sat in darkness have seen a great light, And upon those who sat in the region and shadow of death Light has dawned."
verses.textEnNlt: the people who sat in darkness have seen a great light. And for those who lived in the land where death casts its shadow, a light has shined."
verses.textEnNasb: The people who were sitting in darkness saw a great Light, And those who were sitting in the land and shadow of death, Upon them a Light dawned."
verses.textEn: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned."

verses.textZh: 从那时起，耶稣就开始传道，说："<red>天国近了，你们应当悔改。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那时起，耶稣就开始传道，说："<red>天国近了，你们应当悔改。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 从那时候，耶稣就传起道来，说：「<red>天国近了，你们应当悔改！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: From that time on Jesus began to preach, <red>“Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: From that time Jesus began to preach, saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: From that time Jesus began to preach and to say, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
verses.textEnNlt: From then on Jesus began to preach, "Repent of your sins and turn to God, for the Kingdom of Heaven is near. "
verses.textEnNasb: From that time Jesus began to preach and say, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near."
verses.textEn: From that time on Jesus began to preach, <red>“Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣在加利利海边行走的时候，看见兄弟二人，就是名叫彼得的西门和他的弟弟安得烈，正在把网撒到海里去；他们是渔夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在加利利海边行走的时候，看见兄弟二人，就是名叫彼得的西门和他的弟弟安得烈，正在把网撒到海里去；他们是渔夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在加利利海边行走，看见弟兄二人，就是那称呼彼得的西门和他兄弟安得烈，在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.
