verses.textEnEsv: While walking by the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon (who is called Peter) and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus, walking by the Sea of Galilee, saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.textEnNlt: One day as Jesus was walking along the shore of the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers—Simon, also called Peter, and Andrew—throwing a net into the water, for they fished for a living.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as Jesus was walking by the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon, who was called Peter, and his brother Andrew, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.textEn: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣就对他们说："来跟从我，我要使你们作得人的渔夫。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣就对他们说："来跟从我，我要使你们作得人的渔夫。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Come, follow me,”</red> Jesus said, <red>“and I will send you out to fish for people.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus called out to them, "Come, follow me, and I will show you how to fish for people!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, " Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of people."
verses.textEn: <red>“Come, follow me,”</red> Jesus said, <red>“and I will send you out to fish for people.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们立刻撇下网，跟从了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们立刻撇下网，跟从了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。
verses.textEnNiv: At once they left their nets and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately they left their nets and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: They immediately left their nets and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And they left their nets at once and followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.
verses.textEn: At once they left their nets and followed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又往前走，看见另一对兄弟，就是西庇太的儿子雅各和他的兄弟约翰，正和父亲西庇太在船上整理鱼网，他就呼召他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又往前走，看见另一对兄弟，就是西庇太的儿子雅各和他的兄弟约翰，正和父亲西庇太在船上整理鱼网，他就呼召他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里往前走，又看见弟兄二人，就是西庇太的儿子雅各和他兄弟约翰，同他们的父亲西庇太在船上补网，耶稣就招呼他们，
verses.textEnNiv: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, preparing their nets. Jesus called them,
verses.textEnEsv: And going on from there he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets, and he called them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James theson of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them,
verses.textEnNlt: A little farther up the shore he saw two other brothers, James and John, sitting in a boat with their father, Zebedee, repairing their nets. And he called them to come, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Going on from there He saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and his brother John, in the boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets; and He called them.
verses.textEn: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, preparing their nets. Jesus called them,

verses.textZh: 他们立刻离了船，别了父亲，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们立刻离了船，别了父亲，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们立刻舍了船，别了父亲，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They immediately followed him, leaving the boat and their father behind.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed Him.
verses.textEn: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教导人，宣扬天国的福音，医治民间各种疾病、各种病症。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教导人，宣扬天国的福音，医治民间各种疾病、各种病症。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教训人，传天国的福音，医治百姓各样的病症。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom and healing every disease and every affliction among the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus traveled throughout the region of Galilee, teaching in the synagogues and announcing the Good News about the Kingdom. And he healed every kind of disease and illness.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus was going about in all of Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.textEn: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

verses.textZh: 他的名声传遍了叙利亚全地，人们就把一切患病的，就是患各种疾病、疼痛、鬼附、癫痫、瘫痪的，都带到他面前，他就医好他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的名声传遍了叙利亚全地，人们就把一切患病的，就是患各种疾病、疼痛、鬼附、癫痫、瘫痪的，都带到他面前，他就医好他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的名声就传遍了叙利亚。那里的人把一切害病的，就是害各样疾病、各样疼痛的和被鬼附的、癫痫的、瘫痪的，都带了来，耶稣就治好了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: News about him spread all over Syria, and people brought to him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering severe pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed; and he healed them.
verses.textEnEsv: So his fame spread throughout all Syria, and they brought him all the sick, those afflicted with various diseases and pains, those oppressed by demons, those having seizures, and paralytics, and he healed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His fame went throughout all Syria; and they brought to Him all sick people who were afflicted with various diseases and torments, and those who were demon-possessed, epileptics, and paralytics; and He healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: News about him spread as far as Syria, and people soon began bringing to him all who were sick. And whatever their sickness or disease, or if they were demon possessed or epileptic or paralyzed—he healed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And the news about Him spread throughout Syria; and they brought to Him all who were ill, those suffering with various diseases and severe pain, demon-possessed, people with epilepsy, and people who were paralyzed; and He healed them.
verses.textEn: News about him spread all over Syria, and people brought to him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering severe pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed; and he healed them.

verses.textZh: 于是有许多人从加利利、低加波利、耶路撒冷、犹太和约旦河东来跟从耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有许多人从加利利、低加波利、耶路撒冷、犹太和约旦河东来跟从耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，有许多人从加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、犹太、约旦河外来跟着他。
verses.textEnNiv: Large crowds from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and the region across the Jordan followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And great crowds followed him from Galilee and the Decapolis, and from Jerusalem and Judea, and from beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great multitudes followed Him—from Galilee, and from Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: Large crowds followed him wherever he went—people from Galilee, the Ten Towns, Jerusalem, from all over Judea, and from east of the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Large crowds followed Him from Galilee and the Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judea, and from beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Large crowds from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and the region across the Jordan followed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见群众，就上了山；他坐下之后，门徒来到他跟前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见群众，就上了山；他坐下之后，门徒来到他跟前，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见这许多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，门徒到他跟前来，
verses.textEnNiv: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on a mountainside and sat down. His disciples came to him,
verses.textEnEsv: Seeing the crowds, he went up on the mountain, and when he sat down, his disciples came to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seeing the multitudes, He went up on a mountain, and when He was seated His disciples came to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: One day as he saw the crowds gathering, Jesus went up on the mountainside and sat down. His disciples gathered around him,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain; and after He sat down, His disciples came to Him.
verses.textEn: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on a mountainside and sat down. His disciples came to him,

verses.textEnEsv: And he opened his mouth and taught them, saying:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He opened His mouth and taught them, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: and he began to teach them.
verses.textEnNasb: And He opened His mouth and began to teach them, saying,
verses.textEn: and he began to teach them. He said:

verses.textZh: <red>"心灵贫乏的人有福了， 因为天国是他们的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"心灵贫乏的人有福了， 因为天国是他们的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>虚心的人有福了！ 因为天国是他们的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Blessedpn are the poor in spirit, forld theirs is the kingdom of heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, For theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: "God blesses those who are poor and realize their need for him, for the Kingdom of Heaven is theirs.
verses.textEnNasb: " Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>“Blessedpn are the poor in spirit, forld theirs is the kingdom of heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>哀痛的人有福了， 因为他们必得安慰。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>哀痛的人有福了， 因为他们必得安慰。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>哀恸的人有福了！ 因为他们必得安慰。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are those who mourn, forld they will be comforted.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who mourn, For they shall be comforted.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are those who mourn, forld they will be comforted.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>温柔的人有福了， 因为他们必承受地土。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>温柔的人有福了， 因为他们必承受地土。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>温柔的人有福了！ 因为他们必承受地土。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are the meek, forld they will inherit the earth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are the meek, For they shall inherit the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who are humble, for they will inherit the whole earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are the gentle, for they will inherit the earth.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are the meek, forld they will inherit the earth.</red>

verses.textZhCnvs: <red>爱慕公义如饥如渴的人有福了， 因为他们必得饱足。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>饥渴慕义的人有福了！ 因为他们必得饱足。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, forld they will be filled.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, For they shall be filled.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who hunger and thirst for justice, for they will be satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be satisfied.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, forld they will be filled.</red>

verses.textZhCnvs: <red>怜悯人的人有福了， 因为他们必蒙怜悯。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>怜恤人的人有福了！ 因为他们必蒙怜恤。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are the merciful, forld they will be shown mercy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are the merciful, for they shall receive mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are the merciful, For they shall obtain mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who are merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are the merciful, for they will receive mercy.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are the merciful, forld they will be shown mercy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>内心清洁的人有福了， 因为他们必看见神。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>内心清洁的人有福了， 因为他们必看见神。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>清心的人有福了！ 因为他们必得见神。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are the pure in heart, forld they will see God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are the pure in heart, For they shall see God.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those whose hearts are pure, for they will see God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are the pure in heart, forld they will see God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>使人和平的人有福了， 因为他们必称为神的儿子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>使人和平的人有福了， 因为他们必称为神的儿子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>使人和睦的人有福了！ 因为他们必称为神的儿子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are the peacemakers, forld they will be called children of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are the peacemakers, For they shall be called sons of God.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who work for peace, for they will be called the children of God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are the peacemakers, forld they will be called children of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>为义遭受迫害的人有福了， 因为天国是他们的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>为义遭受迫害的人有福了， 因为天国是他们的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为义受逼迫的人有福了！ 因为天国是他们的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, forld theirs is the kingdom of heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, For theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who are persecuted for doing right, for the Kingdom of Heaven is theirs.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are those who have been persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, forld theirs is the kingdom of heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若因我的缘故辱骂你们，迫害你们，并且捏造各样坏话毁谤你们，你们就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若因我的缘故辱骂你们，迫害你们，并且捏造各样坏话毁谤你们，你们就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「人若因我辱骂你们，逼迫你们，捏造各样坏话毁谤你们，你们就有福了！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Blessedp are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are you when others revile you and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on my account.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed are you when they revile and persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely for My sake.
verses.textEnNlt: "God blesses you when people mock you and persecute you and lie about you and say all sorts of evil things against you because you are my followers.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are you when people insult you and persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
verses.textEn: <red>“Blessedp are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们应该欢喜快乐，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的；在你们以前的先知，他们也曾这样迫害。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们应该欢喜快乐，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的；在你们以前的先知，他们也曾这样迫害。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>应当欢喜快乐，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的。在你们以前的先知，人也是这样逼迫他们。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven, for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven, for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.textEnNlt: Be happy about it! Be very glad! For a great reward awaits you in heaven. And remember, the ancient prophets were persecuted in the same way.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward in heaven is great; for in this same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.textEn: <red>Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们是地上的盐；如果盐失了味，怎能使它再咸呢？结果毫无用处，唯有丢在外面任人践踏。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们是地上的盐；如果盐失了味，怎能使它再咸呢？结果毫无用处，唯有丢在外面任人践踏。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们是世上的盐。盐若失了味，怎能叫它再咸呢？以后无用，不过丢在外面，被人践踏了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You are the salt of the earth, but if salt has lost its taste, how shall its saltiness be restored? It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trampled under people’s feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt loses its flavor, how shall it be seasoned? It is then good for nothing but to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by men.
verses.textEnNlt: "You are the salt of the earth. But what good is salt if it has lost its flavor? Can you make it salty again? It will be thrown out and trampled underfoot as worthless.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt has become tasteless, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by people.
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们是世上的光。建在山上的城是无法隐藏的；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们是世上的光。建在山上的城是无法隐藏的；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隐藏的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden.
verses.textEnNlt: "You are the light of the world—like a city on a hilltop that cannot be hidden.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden;
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人点了灯，不会放在量器底下，而是放在灯台上，就照亮一家人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人点了灯，不会放在量器底下，而是放在灯台上，就照亮一家人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人点灯，不放在斗底下，是放在灯台上，就照亮一家的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Nor do people light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on a stand, and it gives light to all in the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor do they light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on a lampstand, and it gives light to all who are in the house.
verses.textEnNlt: No one lights a lamp and then puts it under a basket. Instead, a lamp is placed on a stand, where it gives light to everyone in the house.
verses.textEnNasb: nor do people light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on the lampstand, and it gives light to all who are in the house.
verses.textEn: <red>Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>照样，你们的光也应当照在人前，让他们看见你们的好行为，又颂赞你们在天上的父。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>照样，你们的光也应当照在人前，让他们看见你们的好行为，又颂赞你们在天上的父。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们的光也当这样照在人前，叫他们看见你们的好行为，便将荣耀归给你们在天上的父。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, let your good deeds shine out for all to see, so that everyone will praise your heavenly Father.
verses.textEnNasb: Your light must shine before people in such a way that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们不要以为我来是要废除律法和先知；我来不是要废除，而是要完成。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们不要以为我来是要废除律法和先知；我来不是要废除，而是要完成。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「莫想我来要废掉律法和先知。我来不是要废掉，乃是要成全。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not think that I came to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I did not come to destroy but to fulfill.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t misunderstand why I have come. I did not come to abolish the law of Moses or the writings of the prophets. No, I came to accomplish their purpose.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not presume that I came to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I did not come to abolish, but to fulfill.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，就算天地过去，律法的一点一画也不会废去，全部都要成就。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，就算天地过去，律法的一点一画也不会废去，全部都要成就。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，就是到天地都废去了，律法的一点一画也不能废去，都要成全。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For truly I tell you, until heaven and earth disappear, not the smallest letter, not the least stroke of a pen, will by any means disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For truly, I say to you, until heaven and earth pass away, not an iota, not a dot, will pass from the Law until all is accomplished.
verses.textEnNkjv: For assuredly, I say to you, till heaven and earth pass away, one jot or one tittle will by no means pass from the law till all is fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, until heaven and earth disappear, not even the smallest detail of God’s law will disappear until its purpose is achieved.
verses.textEnNasb: For truly I say to you, until heaven and earth pass away, not the smallest letter or stroke of a letter shall pass from the Law, until all is accomplished!
verses.textEn: <red>For truly I tell you, until heaven and earth disappear, not the smallest letter, not the least stroke of a pen, will by any means disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此，无论谁废除诫命中最小的一条，又这样教导人，他在天国中必称为最小的；但若有人遵行这些诫命，并且教导人遵行，他在天国中必称为大。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此，无论谁废除诫命中最小的一条，又这样教导人，他在天国中必称为最小的；但若有人遵行这些诫命，并且教导人遵行，他在天国中必称为大。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，无论何人废掉这诫命中最小的一条，又教训人这样做，他在天国要称为最小的。但无论何人遵行这诫命，又教训人遵行，他在天国要称为大的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore anyone who sets aside one of the least of these commands and teaches others accordingly will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever practices and teaches these commands will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore whoever relaxes one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever does them and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever therefore breaks one of the least of these commandments, and teaches men so, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever does and teaches them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: So if you ignore the least commandment and teach others to do the same, you will be called the least in the Kingdom of Heaven. But anyone who obeys God’s laws and teaches them will be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, whoever nullifies one of the least of these commandments, and teaches others to do the same, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever keeps and teaches them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore anyone who sets aside one of the least of these commands and teaches others accordingly will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever practices and teaches these commands will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，你们的义若不胜过经学家和法利赛人的义，就必不能进天国。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，你们的义若不胜过经学家和法利赛人的义，就必不能进天国。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，你们的义若不胜于文士和法利赛人的义，断不能进天国。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I tell you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the Pharisees and the teachers of the law, you will certainly not enter the kingdom of heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you, unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I say to you, that unless your righteousness exceeds the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you will by no means enter the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I warn you—unless your righteousness is better than the righteousness of the teachers of religious law and the Pharisees, you will never enter the Kingdom of Heaven!
verses.textEnNasb: "For I say to you that unless your righteousness far surpasses that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>For I tell you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the Pharisees and the teachers of the law, you will certainly not enter the kingdom of heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们听过有这样吩咐古人的话：‘不可杀人，杀人的必被判罪。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们听过有这样吩咐古人的话：‘不可杀人，杀人的必被判罪。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们听见有吩咐古人的话，说：『不可杀人』；又说：『凡杀人的难免受审判。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘You shall not murder, and anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You have heard that it was said to those of old, ‘You shall not murder; and whoever murders will be liable to judgment.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have heard that it was said to those of old, ‘You shall not murder, and whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You have heard that our ancestors were told, ‘You must not murder. If you commit murder, you are subject to judgment.’
verses.textEnNasb: "You have heard that the ancients were told, ‘You shall not murder,’ and ‘Whoever commits murder shall be answerable to the court.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘You shall not murder, and anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是我告诉你们，凡是向弟兄发怒的，必被判罪。人若说弟兄是‘拉加’，必被公议会审判；人若说弟兄是‘摩利’，必难逃地狱的火。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是我告诉你们，凡是向弟兄发怒的，必被判罪。人若说弟兄是‘拉加’，必被公议会审判；人若说弟兄是‘摩利’，必难逃地狱的火。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我告诉你们，凡 向弟兄动怒的，难免受审判；凡骂弟兄是拉加的，难免公会的审判；凡骂弟兄是魔利的，难免地狱的火。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you that anyone who is angry with a brother or sister will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to a brother or sister,</red> ‘Raca,’*ir <red>is answerable to the court. And anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of hell.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be liable to judgment; whoever insults his brother will be liable to the council; and whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be liable to the hell of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that whoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment. And whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ shall be in danger of the council. But whoever says, ‘You fool!’ shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.textEnNlt: But I say, if you are even angry with someone, you are subject to judgment! If you call someone an idiot, you are in danger of being brought before the court. And if you curse someone, you are in danger of the fires of hell.
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother shall be answerable to the court; and whoever says to his brother, ‘ You good-for-nothing,’ shall be answerable to the supreme court; and whoever says, ‘You fool,’ shall be guilty enough to go into the fiery hell.
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you that anyone who is angry with a brother or sister will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to a brother or sister,</red> ‘Raca,’*ir <red>is answerable to the court. And anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of hell.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你在祭坛上献供物的时候，如果在那里想起你的弟兄对你不满，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你在祭坛上献供物的时候，如果在那里想起你的弟兄对你不满，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你在祭坛上献礼物的时候，若想起弟兄向你怀怨，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Therefore,p if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore if you bring your gift to the altar, and there remember that your brother has something against you,
verses.textEnNlt: "So if you are presenting a sacrifice at the altar in the Temple and you suddenly remember that someone has something against you,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, if you are presenting your offering at the altar, and there you remember that your brother has something against you,
verses.textEn: <red>“Therefore,p if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>就当在坛前放下供物，先去与弟兄和好，然后才来献你的供物。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>就当在坛前放下供物，先去与弟兄和好，然后才来献你的供物。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就把礼物留在坛前，先去同弟兄和好，然后来献礼物。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled to them; then come and offer your gift.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: leave your gift there before the altar and go. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.textEnNkjv: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.textEnNlt: leave your sacrifice there at the altar. Go and be reconciled to that person. Then come and offer your sacrifice to God.
verses.textEnNasb: leave your offering there before the altar and go; first be reconciled to your brother, and then come and present your offering.
verses.textEn: <red>leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled to them; then come and offer your gift.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>趁着你和你的对头还在路上的时候，要赶快与他和解，免得他抓你去见法官，法官把你交给狱警，关在监里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>趁着你和你的对头还在路上的时候，要赶快与他和解，免得他抓你去见法官，法官把你交给狱警，关在监里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你同告你的对头还在路上，就赶紧与他和息，恐怕他把你送给审判官，审判官交付衙役，你就下在监里了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Settlep matters quickly with your adversary who is taking you to court. Do it while you are still together on the way, or your adversary may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Come to terms quickly with your accuser while you are going with him to court, lest your accuser hand you over to the judge, and the judge to the guard, and you be put in prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are on the way with him, lest your adversary deliver you to the judge, the judge hand you over to the officer, and you be thrown into prison.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you are on the way to court with your adversary, settle your differences quickly. Otherwise, your accuser may hand you over to the judge, who will hand you over to an officer, and you will be thrown into prison.
verses.textEnNasb: Come to good terms with your accuser quickly, while you are with him on the way to court, so that your accuser will not hand you over to the judge, and the judge to the officer, and you will not be thrown into prison.
verses.textEn: <red>“Settlep matters quickly with your adversary who is taking you to court. Do it while you are still together on the way, or your adversary may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你，除非你还清最后一分钱，否则决不能从那里出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你，除非你还清最后一分钱，否则决不能从那里出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你，若有一文钱没有还清，你断不能从那里出来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, you will never get out until you have paid the last penny.
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, you will by no means get out of there till you have paid the last penny.
verses.textEnNlt: And if that happens, you surely won’t be free again until you have paid the last penny.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, you will not come out of there until you have paid up the last quadrans.
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们听过有这样的吩咐：‘不可奸淫。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们听过有这样的吩咐：‘不可奸淫。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们听见有话说：『不可奸淫。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have heard that it was said to those of old, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You have heard the commandment that says, ‘You must not commit adultery.’
verses.textEnNasb: "You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery’;
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是我告诉你们，凡是看见妇女就动淫念的，心里已经犯了奸淫。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是我告诉你们，凡是看见妇女就动淫念的，心里已经犯了奸淫。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我告诉你们，凡看见妇女就动淫念的，这人心里已经与她犯奸淫了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman with lustful intent has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that whoever looks at a woman to lust for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: But I say, anyone who even looks at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verses.textEnNasb: but I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman with lust for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你的右眼使你犯罪，就把它挖出来丢掉；宁可失去身体的一部分，胜过全身被丢进地狱里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你的右眼使你犯罪，就把它挖出来丢掉；宁可失去身体的一部分，胜过全身被丢进地狱里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若是你的右眼叫你跌倒，就剜出来丢掉，宁可失去百体中的一体，不叫全身丢在地狱里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If your right eye causes you to stumble, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If your right eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away. For it is better that you lose one of your members than that your whole body be thrown into hell.
verses.textEnNkjv: If your right eye causes you to sin, pluck it out and cast it from you; for it is more profitable for you that one of your members perish, than for your whole body to be cast into hell.
verses.textEnNlt: So if your eye—even your good eye —causes you to lust, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if your right eye is causing you to sin, tear it out and throw it away from you; for it is better for you to lose one of the parts of your body, than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
verses.textEn: <red>If your right eye causes you to stumble, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你的右手使你犯罪，就把它砍下来丢掉；宁可失去身体的一部分，胜过全身进到地狱里去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你的右手使你犯罪，就把它砍下来丢掉；宁可失去身体的一部分，胜过全身进到地狱里去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若是右手叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉，宁可失去百体中的一体，不叫全身下入地狱。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to go into hell.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. For it is better that you lose one of your members than that your whole body go into hell.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and cast it from you; for it is more profitable for you that one of your members perish, than for your whole body to be cast into hell.
verses.textEnNlt: And if your hand—even your stronger hand —causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
verses.textEnNasb: And if your right hand is causing you to sin, cut it off and throw it away from you; for it is better for you to lose one of the parts of your body, than for your whole body to go into hell.
verses.textEn: <red>And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to go into hell.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"又有这样的吩咐：‘人若休妻，就应当给她休书。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"又有这样的吩咐：‘人若休妻，就应当给她休书。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「又有话说：『人若休妻，就当给她休书。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Itp has been said, ‘Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "It was also said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife, let him give her a certificate of divorce.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Furthermore it has been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife, let him give her a certificate of divorce.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You have heard the law that says, ‘A man can divorce his wife by merely giving her a written notice of divorce.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Now it was said, ‘Whoever sends his wife away is to give her a certificate of divorce’;
verses.textEn: <red>“Itp has been said, ‘Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是我告诉你们，凡休妻的，如果不是因她不贞，就是促使她犯奸淫；无论谁娶了被休的妇人，也就是犯奸淫了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是我告诉你们，凡休妻的，如果不是因她不贞，就是促使她犯奸淫；无论谁娶了被休的妇人，也就是犯奸淫了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我告诉你们，凡休妻的，若不是为淫乱的缘故，就是叫她作淫妇了；人若娶这被休的妇人，也是犯奸淫了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, makes her the victim of adultery, and anyone who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I say to you that everyone who divorces his wife, except on the ground of sexual immorality, makes her commit adultery, and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that whoever divorces his wife for any reason except sexual immorality causes her to commit adultery; and whoever marries a woman who is divorced commits adultery.
verses.textEnNlt: But I say that a man who divorces his wife, unless she has been unfaithful, causes her to commit adultery. And anyone who marries a divorced woman also commits adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: but I say to you that everyone who divorces his wife, except for the reason of sexual immorality, makes her commit adultery; and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, makes her the victim of adultery, and anyone who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们又听过有这样吩咐古人的话：‘不可背约，向主许的愿都要偿还。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们又听过有这样吩咐古人的话：‘不可背约，向主许的愿都要偿还。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们又听见有吩咐古人的话，说：『不可背誓，所起的誓总要向主谨守。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Again,p you have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill to the Lord the vows you have made.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Again you have heard that it was said to those of old, ‘You shall not swear falsely, but shall perform to the Lord what you have sworn.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again you have heard that it was said to those of old, ‘You shall not swear falsely, but shall perform your oaths to the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You have also heard that our ancestors were told, ‘You must not break your vows; you must carry out the vows you make to the Lord .’
verses.textEnNasb: "Again, you have heard that the ancients were told, ‘ You shall not make false vows, but shall fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Again,p you have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill to the Lord the vows you have made.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是我告诉你们，总不可发誓，不可指着天发誓，因为天是神的宝座；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是我告诉你们，总不可发誓，不可指着天发誓，因为天是神的宝座；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我告诉你们，什么誓都不可起。不可指着天起誓，因为天是神的座位；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you, do not swear an oath at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I say to you, Do not take an oath at all, either by heaven, for it is the throne of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you, do not swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
verses.textEnNlt: But I say, do not make any vows! Do not say, ‘By heaven!’ because heaven is God’s throne.
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you, take no oath at all, neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God,
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you, do not swear an oath at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不可指着地发誓，因为地是神的脚凳；不可指着耶路撒冷发誓，因为它是大君王的京城；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不可指着地发誓，因为地是神的脚凳；不可指着耶路撒冷发誓，因为它是大君王的京城；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不可指着地起誓，因为地是他的脚凳；也不可指着耶路撒冷起誓，因为耶路撒冷是大君的京城；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>or by the earth, for it is his footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the Great King.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: or by the earth, for it is his footstool, or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor by the earth, for it is His footstool; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.textEnNlt: And do not say, ‘By the earth!’ because the earth is his footstool. And do not say, ‘By Jerusalem!’ for Jerusalem is the city of the great King.
verses.textEnNasb: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of His feet, nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.textEn: <red>or by the earth, for it is his footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the Great King.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>也不可指着自己的头发誓，因为你不能使一根头发变白或变黑。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>也不可指着自己的头发誓，因为你不能使一根头发变白或变黑。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又不可指着你的头起誓，因为你不能使一根头发变黑变白了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make even one hair white or black.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And do not take an oath by your head, for you cannot make one hair white or black.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall you swear by your head, because you cannot make one hair white or black.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not even say, ‘By my head!’ for you can’t turn one hair white or black.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor shall you take an oath by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
verses.textEn: <red>And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make even one hair white or black.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们的话，是就说‘是’，不是就说‘不是’；如果再多说，就是出于那恶者。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们的话，是就说‘是’，不是就说‘不是’；如果再多说，就是出于那恶者。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们的话，是，就说是；不是，就说不是；若再多说就是出于那恶者 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All you need to say is simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything beyond this comes from the evil one.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Let what you say be simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything more than this comes from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ For whatever is more than these is from the evil one.
verses.textEnNlt: Just say a simple, ‘Yes, I will,’ or ‘No, I won’t.’ Anything beyond this is from the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: But make sure your statement is, ‘ Yes, yes’ or ‘No, no’; anything beyond these is of evil origin.
verses.textEn: <red>All you need to say is simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything beyond this comes from the evil one.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们听过有这样的吩咐：‘以眼还眼，以牙还牙。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们听过有这样的吩咐：‘以眼还眼，以牙还牙。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们听见有话说：『以眼还眼，以牙还牙。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You have heard the law that says the punishment must match the injury: ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.textEnNasb: "You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是我告诉你们，不要与恶人对抗，有人打你的右脸，把另一边也转过来让他打；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是我告诉你们，不要与恶人对抗，有人打你的右脸，把另一边也转过来让他打；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我告诉你们，不要与恶人作对。有人打你的右脸，连左脸也转过来由他打；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you, do not resist an evil person. If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to them the other cheek also.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I say to you, Do not resist the one who is evil. But if anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. But whoever slaps you on your right cheek, turn the other to him also.
verses.textEnNlt: But I say, do not resist an evil person! If someone slaps you on the right cheek, offer the other cheek also.
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you, do not show opposition against an evil person; but whoever slaps you on your right cheek, turn the other toward him also.
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you, do not resist an evil person. If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to them the other cheek also.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有人要告你，想拿你的衬衫，就连外套也让他拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有人要告你，想拿你的衬衫，就连外套也让他拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有人想要告你，要拿你的里衣，连外衣也由他拿去；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if anyone wants to sue you and take your shirt, hand over your coat as well.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone would sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone wants to sue you and take away your tunic, let him have your cloak also.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are sued in court and your shirt is taken from you, give your coat, too.
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak also.
verses.textEn: <red>And if anyone wants to sue you and take your shirt, hand over your coat as well.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有人要强迫你走一里路，就陪他走两里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有人要强迫你走一里路，就陪他走两里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有人强逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
verses.textEnNlt: If a soldier demands that you carry his gear for a mile, carry it two miles.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever forces you to go one mile, go with him two.
verses.textEn: <red>If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有求你的，就给他；想借贷的，也不可拒绝。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有求你的，就给他；想借贷的，也不可拒绝。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有求你的，就给他；有向你借贷的，不可推辞。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Give to the one who begs from you, and do not refuse the one who would borrow from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give to him who asks you, and from him who wants to borrow from you do not turn away.
verses.textEnNlt: Give to those who ask, and don’t turn away from those who want to borrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Give to him who asks of you, and do not turn away from him who wants to borrow from you.
verses.textEn: <red>Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们听过有这样的吩咐：‘当爱你的邻舍，恨你的仇敌。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们听过有这样的吩咐：‘当爱你的邻舍，恨你的仇敌。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们听见有话说：『当爱你的邻舍，恨你的仇敌。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You have heard the law that says, ‘Love your neighbor’ and hate your enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是我告诉你们，当爱你们的仇敌，为迫害你们的祈祷，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是我告诉你们，当爱你们的仇敌，为迫害你们的祈祷，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我告诉你们，要爱你们的仇敌，为那逼迫你们的祷告。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who spitefully use you and persecute you,
verses.textEnNlt: But I say, love your enemies! Pray for those who persecute you!
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>好叫你们成为你们天父的儿子；因为他使太阳照恶人，也照好人；降雨给义人，也给不义的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>好叫你们成为你们天父的儿子；因为他使太阳照恶人，也照好人；降雨给义人，也给不义的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样就可以作你们天父的儿子；因为他叫日头照好人，也照歹人；降雨给义人，也给不义的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>that you may be children of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so that you may be sons of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven; for He makes His sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.textEnNlt: In that way, you will be acting as true children of your Father in heaven. For he gives his sunlight to both the evil and the good, and he sends rain on the just and the unjust alike.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you may prove yourselves to be sons of your Father who is in heaven; for He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
verses.textEn: <red>that you may be children of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们只爱那些爱你们的人，有甚么赏赐呢？税吏不也是这样作吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们只爱那些爱你们的人，有甚么赏赐呢？税吏不也是这样作吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若单爱那爱你们的人，有什么赏赐呢？就是税吏不也是这样行吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Are not even the tax collectors doing that?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Do not even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you love those who love you, what reward have you? Do not even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.textEnNlt: If you love only those who love you, what reward is there for that? Even corrupt tax collectors do that much.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even the tax collectors, do they not do the same?
verses.textEn: <red>If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Are not even the tax collectors doing that?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们单问候你们的弟兄，有甚么特别呢？教外人不也是这样作吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们单问候你们的弟兄，有甚么特别呢？教外人不也是这样作吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若单请你弟兄的安，比人有什么长处呢？就是外邦人不也是这样行吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if you greet only your own people, what are you doing more than others? Do not even pagans do that?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if you greet only your brothers, what more are you doing than others? Do not even the Gentiles do the same?
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you greet your brethren only, what do you do more than others? Do not even the tax collectors do so?
verses.textEnNlt: If you are kind only to your friends, how are you different from anyone else? Even pagans do that.
verses.textEnNasb: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing than others? Even the Gentiles, do they not do the same?
verses.textEn: <red>And if you greet only your own people, what are you doing more than others? Do not even pagans do that?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你们要完全，正如你们的天父是完全的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你们要完全，正如你们的天父是完全的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们要完全，像你们的天父完全一样。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You therefore must be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are to be perfect, even as your Father in heaven is perfect.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
verses.textEn: <red>Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们小心，不要在众人面前行你们的义，让他们看见；如果这样，就得不到你们天父的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们小心，不要在众人面前行你们的义，让他们看见；如果这样，就得不到你们天父的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们要小心，不可将善事行在人的面前，故意叫他们看见，若是这样，就不能得你们天父的赏赐了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Bep careful not to practice your righteousness in front of others to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Beware of practicing your righteousness before other people in order to be seen by them, for then you will have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take heed that you do not do your charitable deeds before men, to be seen by them. Otherwise you have no reward from your Father in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: "Watch out! Don’t do your good deeds publicly, to be admired by others, for you will lose the reward from your Father in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take care not to practice your righteousness in the sight of people, to be noticed by them; otherwise you have no reward with your Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>“Bep careful not to practice your righteousness in front of others to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此你施舍的时候，不可到处张扬，好象伪君子在会堂和街上所作的一样，以博取众人的称赞。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此你施舍的时候，不可到处张扬，好象伪君子在会堂和街上所作的一样，以博取众人的称赞。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你施舍的时候，不可在你前面吹号，像那假冒为善的人在会堂里和街道上所行的，故意要得人的荣耀。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Sop when you give to the needy, do not announce it with trumpets, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus, when you give to the needy, sound no trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may be praised by others. Truly, I say to you, they have received their reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when you do a charitable deed, do not sound a trumpet before you as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory from men. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward.
verses.textEnNlt: When you give to someone in need, don’t do as the hypocrites do—blowing trumpets in the synagogues and streets to call attention to their acts of charity! I tell you the truth, they have received all the reward they will ever get.
verses.textEnNasb: "So when you give to the poor, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, so that they will be praised by people. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.
verses.textEn: <red>“Sop when you give to the needy, do not announce it with trumpets, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你施舍的时候，不要让左手知道右手所作的，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你施舍的时候，不要让左手知道右手所作的，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你施舍的时候，不要叫左手知道右手所做的，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when you do a charitable deed, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
verses.textEnNlt: But when you give to someone in need, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.
verses.textEnNasb: But when you give to the poor, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
verses.textEn: <red>But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>好使你的施舍是在隐密中行的。你父在隐密中察看，必定报答你。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>好使你的施舍是在隐密中行的。你父在隐密中察看，必定报答你。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>要叫你施舍的事行在暗中。你父在暗中察看，必然报答你 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: that your charitable deed may be in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will Himself reward you openly.
verses.textEnNlt: Give your gifts in private, and your Father, who sees everything, will reward you.
verses.textEnNasb: so that your charitable giving will be in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.
verses.textEn: <red>so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们祈祷的时候，不可像伪君子；他们喜欢在会堂和路口站着祈祷，好让人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们祈祷的时候，不可像伪君子；他们喜欢在会堂和路口站着祈祷，好让人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们祷告的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，爱站在会堂里和十字路口上祷告，故意叫人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Andp when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And when you pray, you must not be like the hypocrites. For they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and at the street corners, that they may be seen by others. Truly, I say to you, they have received their reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you pray, don’t be like the hypocrites who love to pray publicly on street corners and in the synagogues where everyone can see them. I tell you the truth, that is all the reward they will ever get.
verses.textEnNasb: "And when you pray, you are not to be like the hypocrites; for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners so that they will be seen by people. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.
verses.textEn: <red>“Andp when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但你祈祷的时候，要进到密室里去，关上门，向在隐密中的父祈祷。你父在隐密中察看，必定报答你。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但你祈祷的时候，要进到密室里去，关上门，向在隐密中的父祈祷。你父在隐密中察看，必定报答你。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你祷告的时候，要进你的内屋，关上门，祷告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, when you pray, go into your room, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father who is in the secret place; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you pray, go away by yourself, shut the door behind you, and pray to your Father in private. Then your Father, who sees everything, will reward you.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, when you pray, go into your inner room, close your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.
verses.textEn: <red>But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们祈祷的时候，不可重复无意义的话，像教外人一样，他们以为话多了就蒙垂听。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们祈祷的时候，不可重复无意义的话，像教外人一样，他们以为话多了就蒙垂听。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们祷告，不可像外邦人，用许多重复话，他们以为话多了必蒙垂听。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And when you pray, do not heap up empty phrases as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard for their many words.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you pray, do not use vain repetitions as the heathen do. For they think that they will be heard for their many words.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you pray, don’t babble on and on as the Gentiles do. They think their prayers are answered merely by repeating their words again and again.
verses.textEnNasb: "And when you are praying, do not use thoughtless repetition as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard because of their many words.
verses.textEn: <red>And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们不可像他们，因为在你们祈求以先，你们的父已经知道你们的需要了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们不可像他们，因为在你们祈求以先，你们的父已经知道你们的需要了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们不可效法他们；因为你们没有祈求以先，你们所需用的，你们的父早已知道了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore do not be like them. For your Father knows the things you have need of before you ask Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be like them, for your Father knows exactly what you need even before you ask him!
verses.textEnNasb: So do not be like them; for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
verses.textEn: <red>Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你们要这样祈祷： ‘我们在天上的父， 愿你的名被尊为圣，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你们要这样祈祷： ‘我们在天上的父， 愿你的名被尊为圣，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们祷告要这样说： 我们在天上的父： 愿人都尊你的名为圣。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“This,p then, is how you should pray: “ ‘Ourpn Father in heaven, hallowedln be your name,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Pray then like this: "Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: In this manner, therefore, pray: Our Father in heaven, Hallowed be Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Pray like this: Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Pray, then, in this way: ‘Our Father, who is in heaven, Hallowed be Your name.
verses.textEn: <red>“This,p then, is how you should pray: “ ‘Ourpn Father in heaven, hallowedln be your name,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>愿你的国降临， 愿你的旨意成就在地上， 如同在天上一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>愿你的国降临， 愿你的旨意成就在地上， 如同在天上一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>愿你的国降临； 愿你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>yourln kingdom come, yourln will be done, onld earth as it is in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your kingdom come. Your will be done On earth as it is in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: May your Kingdom come soon. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ Your kingdom come. Your will be done, On earth as it is in heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>yourln kingdom come, yourln will be done, onld earth as it is in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我们每天所需的食物， 求你今天赐给我们；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我们每天所需的食物， 求你今天赐给我们；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我们日用的饮食，今日赐给我们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Giveln us today our daily bread.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Give us this day our daily bread,
verses.textEnNkjv: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Give us today the food we need,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.textEn: <red>Giveln us today our daily bread.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>赦免我们的罪债， 好象我们饶恕了得罪我们的人；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>赦免我们的罪债， 好象我们饶恕了得罪我们的人；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>免我们的债， 如同我们免了人的债。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Andln forgive us our debts, asld we also have forgiven our debtors.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
verses.textEnNkjv: And forgive us our debts, As we forgive our debtors.
verses.textEnNlt: and forgive us our sins, as we have forgiven those who sin against us.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
verses.textEn: <red>Andln forgive us our debts, asld we also have forgiven our debtors.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要让我们陷入试探， 救我们脱离那恶者。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要让我们陷入试探， 救我们脱离那恶者。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不叫我们遇见试探； 救我们脱离凶恶 。 因为国度、权柄、荣耀，全是你的， 直到永远。阿们 ！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Andln lead us not into temptation, butld deliver us from the evil one.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not lead us into temptation, But deliver us from the evil one. For Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t let us yield to temptation, but rescue us from the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from evil. ’
verses.textEn: <red>Andln lead us not into temptation, butld deliver us from the evil one.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们饶恕别人的过犯，你们的天父也必饶恕你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们饶恕别人的过犯，你们的天父也必饶恕你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们饶恕人的过犯，你们的天父也必饶恕你们的过犯；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Forp if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you forgive those who sin against you, your heavenly Father will forgive you.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you forgive other people for their offenses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
verses.textEn: <red>Forp if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们不饶恕别人，你们的父也必不饶恕你们的过犯。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们不饶恕别人，你们的父也必不饶恕你们的过犯。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们不饶恕人的过犯，你们的天父也必不饶恕你们的过犯。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but if you do not forgive others their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you refuse to forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not forgive other people, then your Father will not forgive your offenses.
verses.textEn: <red>But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们禁食的时候，不可像伪君子那样愁眉苦脸，他们装成难看的样子，叫人看出他们在禁食。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们禁食的时候，不可像伪君子那样愁眉苦脸，他们装成难看的样子，叫人看出他们在禁食。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们禁食的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，脸上带着愁容；因为他们把脸弄得难看，故意叫人看出他们是禁食。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp you fast, do not look somber as the hypocrites do, for they disfigure their faces to show others they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And when you fast, do not look gloomy like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces that their fasting may be seen by others. Truly, I say to you, they have received their reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover, when you fast, do not be like the hypocrites, with a sad countenance. For they disfigure their faces that they may appear to men to be fasting. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward.
verses.textEnNlt: "And when you fast, don’t make it obvious, as the hypocrites do, for they try to look miserable and disheveled so people will admire them for their fasting. I tell you the truth, that is the only reward they will ever get.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now whenever you fast, do not make a gloomy face as the hypocrites do, for they distort their faces so that they will be noticed by people when they are fasting. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp you fast, do not look somber as the hypocrites do, for they disfigure their faces to show others they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是你禁食的时候，要梳头洗脸，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是你禁食的时候，要梳头洗脸，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你禁食的时候，要梳头洗脸，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.textEnNlt: But when you fast, comb your hair and wash your face.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.textEn: <red>But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要叫人看出你在禁食，只让在隐密中的父看见。你父在隐密中察看，必定报答你。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要叫人看出你在禁食，只让在隐密中的父看见。你父在隐密中察看，必定报答你。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不叫人看出你禁食来，只叫你暗中的父看见；你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>so that it will not be obvious to others that you are fasting, but only to your Father, who is unseen; and your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: that your fasting may not be seen by others but by your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that you do not appear to men to be fasting, but to your Father who is in the secret place; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
verses.textEnNlt: Then no one will notice that you are fasting, except your Father, who knows what you do in private. And your Father, who sees everything, will reward you.
verses.textEnNasb: so that your fasting will not be noticed by people but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.
verses.textEn: <red>so that it will not be obvious to others that you are fasting, but only to your Father, who is unseen; and your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"不可为自己在地上积聚财宝，因为地上有虫蛀，有锈侵蚀，也有贼挖洞来偷。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"不可为自己在地上积聚财宝，因为地上有虫蛀，有锈侵蚀，也有贼挖洞来偷。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏，也有贼挖窟窿来偷。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal;
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t store up treasures here on earth, where moths eat them and rust destroys them, and where thieves break in and steal.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>要为自己积聚财宝在天上，那里没有虫蛀锈蚀，也没有贼挖洞来偷。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>要为自己积聚财宝在天上，那里没有虫蛀锈蚀，也没有贼挖洞来偷。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只要积攒财宝在天上；天上没有虫子咬，不能锈坏，也没有贼挖窟窿来偷。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal.
verses.textEnNkjv: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal.
verses.textEnNlt: Store your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy, and thieves do not break in and steal.
verses.textEnNasb: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves do not break in or steal;
verses.textEn: <red>But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.textEnNkjv: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever your treasure is, there the desires of your heart will also be.
verses.textEnNasb: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.textEn: <red>For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"眼睛就是身体的灯。如果你的眼睛健全，全身就都明亮；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"眼睛就是身体的灯。如果你的眼睛健全，全身就都明亮；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「眼睛就是身上的灯。你的眼睛若了亮，全身就光明；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "The eye is the lamp of the body. So, if your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light,
verses.textEnNkjv: "The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is good, your whole body will be full of light.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your eye is like a lamp that provides light for your body. When your eye is healthy, your whole body is filled with light.
verses.textEnNasb: "The eye is the lamp of the body; so then, if your eye is clear, your whole body will be full of light.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你的眼睛有毛病，全身就都黑暗。如果你里面的光变成黑暗，这是多么的黑暗！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你的眼睛有毛病，全身就都黑暗。如果你里面的光变成黑暗，这是多么的黑暗！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你的眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。你里头的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等大呢！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But if your eyes are unhealthy, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.textEnNkjv: But if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.textEnNlt: But when your eye is unhealthy, your whole body is filled with darkness. And if the light you think you have is actually darkness, how deep that darkness is!
verses.textEnNasb: But if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. So if the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.textEn: <red>But if your eyes are unhealthy, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"一个人不能服事两个主人；他若不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能服事神，又服事金钱 。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"一个人不能服事两个主人；他若不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能服事神，又服事金钱 。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>一个人不能事奉两个主；不是恶这个、爱那个，就是重这个、轻那个。你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门 。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nop one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and money.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be loyal to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.textEnNlt: "No one can serve two masters. For you will hate one and love the other; you will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and be enslaved to money.
verses.textEnNasb: "No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.
verses.textEn: <red>“Nop one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃甚么喝甚么，也不要为身体忧虑穿甚么。难道生命不比食物重要吗？身体不比衣服重要吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃甚么喝甚么，也不要为身体忧虑穿甚么。难道生命不比食物重要吗？身体不比衣服重要吗？</red>
