verses.textZhCuv: <red>「所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃什么，喝什么；为身体忧虑穿什么。生命不胜于饮食吗？身体不胜于衣裳吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thereforep I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore I tell you, do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink, nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food and the body more than clothing?
verses.textEnNlt: "That is why I tell you not to worry about everyday life—whether you have enough food and drink, or enough clothes to wear. Isn’t life more than food, and your body more than clothing?
verses.textEnNasb: "For this reason I say to you, do not be worried about your life, as to what you will eat or what you will drink; nor for your body, as to what you will put on. Is life not more than food, and the body more than clothing?
verses.textEn: <red>“Thereforep I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们看天空的飞鸟：牠们不撒种，不收割，也不收进仓里，你们的天父尚且养活牠们；难道你们不比牠们更宝贵吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们看天空的飞鸟：牠们不撒种，不收割，也不收进仓里，你们的天父尚且养活牠们；难道你们不比牠们更宝贵吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们看那天上的飞鸟，也不种，也不收，也不积蓄在仓里，你们的天父尚且养活它。你们不比飞鸟贵重得多吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Look at the birds of the air; they do not sow or reap or store away in barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Look at the birds of the air: they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they?
verses.textEnNkjv: Look at the birds of the air, for they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they?
verses.textEnNlt: Look at the birds. They don’t plant or harvest or store food in barns, for your heavenly Father feeds them. And aren’t you far more valuable to him than they are?
verses.textEnNasb: Look at the birds of the sky, that they do not sow, nor reap, nor gather crops into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more important than they?
verses.textEn: <red>Look at the birds of the air; they do not sow or reap or store away in barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们中间谁能用忧虑使自己的寿命延长一刻呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们中间谁能用忧虑使自己的寿命延长一刻呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们哪一个能用思虑使寿数多加一刻呢 ？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And which of you by being anxious can add a single hour to his span of life?
verses.textEnNkjv: Which of you by worrying can add one cubit to his stature?
verses.textEnNlt: Can all your worries add a single moment to your life?
verses.textEnNasb: And which of you by worrying can add a single day to his life’s span?
verses.textEn: <red>Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>何必为衣服忧虑呢？试想田野的百合花怎样生长，它们不劳苦，也不纺织。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>何必为衣服忧虑呢？试想田野的百合花怎样生长，它们不劳苦，也不纺织。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>何必为衣裳忧虑呢？你想野地里的百合花怎么长起来；它也不劳苦，也不纺线。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Andp why do you worry about clothes? See how the flowers of the field grow. They do not labor or spin.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin,
verses.textEnNkjv: "So why do you worry about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin;
verses.textEnNlt: "And why worry about your clothing? Look at the lilies of the field and how they grow. They don’t work or make their clothing,
verses.textEnNasb: And why are you worried about clothing? Notice how the lilies of the field grow; they do not labor nor do they spin thread for cloth,
verses.textEn: <red>“Andp why do you worry about clothes? See how the flowers of the field grow. They do not labor or spin.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我告诉你们，就是所罗门最威荣的时候所穿的，也比不上这花中的一朵。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我告诉你们，就是所罗门最威荣的时候所穿的，也比不上这花中的一朵。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而我告诉你们，就是所罗门极荣华的时候，他所穿戴的，还不如这花一朵呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.textEnNkjv: and yet I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.textEnNlt: yet Solomon in all his glory was not dressed as beautifully as they are.
verses.textEnNasb: yet I say to you that not even Solomon in all his glory clothed himself like one of these.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>田野的草，今天还在，明天就投进炉里，神尚且这样妆扮它们；小信的人哪，何况你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>田野的草，今天还在，明天就投进炉里，神尚且这样妆扮它们；小信的人哪，何况你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这小信的人哪！野地里的草今天还在，明天就丢在炉里，神还给它这样的妆饰，何况你们呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, will he not much more clothe you—you of little faith?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is alive and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.textEnNlt: And if God cares so wonderfully for wildflowers that are here today and thrown into the fire tomorrow, he will certainly care for you. Why do you have so little faith?
verses.textEnNasb: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you? You of little faith!
verses.textEn: <red>If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, will he not much more clothe you—you of little faith?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以不要忧虑，说：‘我们该吃甚么？喝甚么？穿甚么？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以不要忧虑，说：‘我们该吃甚么？喝甚么？穿甚么？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，不要忧虑说，吃什么？喝什么？穿什么？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
verses.textEnNlt: "So don’t worry about these things, saying, ‘What will we eat? What will we drink? What will we wear?’
verses.textEnNasb: Do not worry then, saying, ‘What are we to eat?’ or ‘What are we to drink?’ or ‘What are we to wear for clothing?’
verses.textEn: <red>So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这些都是教外人所寻求的，你们的天父原知道你们需要这一切。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这些都是教外人所寻求的，你们的天父原知道你们需要这一切。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这都是外邦人所求的。你们需用的这一切东西，你们的天父是知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Gentiles seek after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: For after all these things the Gentiles seek. For your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
verses.textEnNlt: These things dominate the thoughts of unbelievers, but your heavenly Father already knows all your needs.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Gentiles eagerly seek all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
verses.textEn: <red>For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要先求他的国和他的义，这一切都必加给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要先求他的国和他的义，这一切都必加给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要先求他的国和他的义，这些东西都要加给你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things shall be added to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Seek the Kingdom of God above all else, and live righteously, and he will give you everything you need.
verses.textEnNasb: But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be provided to you.
verses.textEn: <red>But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑，一天的难处一天当就够了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑，一天的难处一天当就够了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑；一天的难处一天当就够了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about its own things. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: "So don’t worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will bring its own worries. Today’s trouble is enough for today.
verses.textEnNasb: "So do not worry about tomorrow; for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"不可判断人，免得你们被判断。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"不可判断人，免得你们被判断。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们不要论断人，免得你们被论断。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not judge, or you too will be judged.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Judge not, that you be not judged.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Judge not, that you be not judged.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not judge others, and you will not be judged.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not judge, so that you will not be judged.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not judge, or you too will be judged.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们怎样判断人，也必怎样被判断；你们用甚么标准衡量人，也必照样被衡量。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们怎样判断人，也必怎样被判断；你们用甚么标准衡量人，也必照样被衡量。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为你们怎样论断人，也必怎样被论断；你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For with the judgment you pronounce you will be judged, and with the measure you use it will be measured to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For with what judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will be treated as you treat others. The standard you use in judging is the standard by which you will be judged.
verses.textEnNasb: For in the way you judge, you will be judged; and by your standard of measure, it will be measured to you.
verses.textEn: <red>For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>为甚么看见你弟兄眼中的木屑，却不理会自己眼中的梁木呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>为甚么看见你弟兄眼中的木屑，却不理会自己眼中的梁木呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为什么看见你弟兄眼中有刺，却不想自己眼中有梁木呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?
verses.textEnNkjv: And why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but do not consider the plank in your own eye?
verses.textEnNlt: "And why worry about a speck in your friend’s eye when you have a log in your own?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do you look at the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你自己眼中有梁木，怎能对弟兄说：‘让我除掉你眼中的木屑’呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你自己眼中有梁木，怎能对弟兄说：‘让我除掉你眼中的木屑’呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你自己眼中有梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when all the time there is a plank in your own eye?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when there is the log in your own eye?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye’; and look, a plank is in your own eye?
verses.textEnNlt: How can you think of saying to your friend, ‘Let me help you get rid of that speck in your eye,’ when you can’t see past the log in your own eye?
verses.textEnNasb: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ and look, the log is in your own eye?
verses.textEn: <red>How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when all the time there is a plank in your own eye?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>伪君子啊！先除掉你眼中的梁木，才可以看得清楚，去除掉弟兄眼中的木屑。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>伪君子啊！先除掉你眼中的梁木，才可以看得清楚，去除掉弟兄眼中的木屑。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你这假冒为善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然后才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother’s eye.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hypocrite! First remove the plank from your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
verses.textEnNlt: Hypocrite! First get rid of the log in your own eye; then you will see well enough to deal with the speck in your friend’s eye.
verses.textEnNasb: You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother’s eye!
verses.textEn: <red>You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，免得牠们用脚把珍珠践踏，又转过来猛噬你们。 祈求就必得着</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，免得牠们用脚把珍珠践踏，又转过来猛噬你们。 祈求就必得着</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，恐怕它践踏了珍珠，转过来咬你们。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not give dogs what is sacred; do not throw your pearls to pigs. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not give dogs what is holy, and do not throw your pearls before pigs, lest they trample them underfoot and turn to attack you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not give what is holy to the dogs; nor cast your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t waste what is holy on people who are unholy. Don’t throw your pearls to pigs! They will trample the pearls, then turn and attack you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not give what is holy to dogs, and do not throw your pearls before pigs, or they will trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not give dogs what is sacred; do not throw your pearls to pigs. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Askp and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Keep on asking, and you will receive what you ask for. Keep on seeking, and you will find. Keep on knocking, and the door will be opened to you.
verses.textEnNasb: " Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.textEn: <red>“Askp and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为凡祈求的就得着，寻找的就寻见，叩门的就给他开门。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为凡祈求的就得着，寻找的就寻见，叩门的就给他开门。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为凡祈求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened.
verses.textEnNkjv: For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.textEnNlt: For everyone who asks, receives. Everyone who seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door will be opened.
verses.textEnNasb: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened.
verses.textEn: <red>For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们中间哪一个人，儿子向他要饼，反给他石头；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们中间哪一个人，儿子向他要饼，反给他石头；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们中间谁有儿子求饼，反给他石头呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whichp of you, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or which one of you, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or what man is there among you who, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
verses.textEnNlt: "You parents—if your children ask for a loaf of bread, do you give them a stone instead?
verses.textEnNasb: Or what person is there among you who, when his son asks for a loaf of bread, will give him a stone?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whichp of you, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>要鱼，反给他蛇呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>要鱼，反给他蛇呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>求鱼，反给他蛇呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a serpent?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.textEnNlt: Or if they ask for a fish, do you give them a snake? Of course not!
verses.textEnNasb: Or if he asks for a fish, he will not give him a snake, will he?
verses.textEn: <red>Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们虽然邪恶，尚且知道把好东西给儿女，何况你们在天上的父，难道不更把好东西赐给求他的人吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们虽然邪恶，尚且知道把好东西给儿女，何况你们在天上的父，难道不更把好东西赐给求他的人吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们虽然不好，尚且知道拿好东西给儿女，何况你们在天上的父，岂不更把好东西给求他的人吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you, then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good gifts to those who ask him!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
verses.textEnNkjv: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
verses.textEnNlt: So if you sinful people know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give good gifts to those who ask him.
verses.textEnNasb: So if you, despite being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
verses.textEn: <red>If you, then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good gifts to those who ask him!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人，这是律法和先知的总纲。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人，这是律法和先知的总纲。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，无论何事，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人，因为这就是律法和先知的道理。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you, for this sums up the Law and the Prophets.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "So whatever you wish that others would do to you, do also to them, for this is the Law and the Prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, whatever you want men to do to you, do also to them, for this is the Law and the Prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do to others whatever you would like them to do to you. This is the essence of all that is taught in the law and the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: "In everything, therefore, treat people the same way you want them to treat you, for this is the Law and the Prophets.
verses.textEn: <red>So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you, for this sums up the Law and the Prophets.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们当进窄门，因为引到灭亡的门是宽的，路是大的，进去的人也多；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们当进窄门，因为引到灭亡的门是宽的，路是大的，进去的人也多；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们要进窄门。因为引到灭亡，那门是宽的，路是大的，进去的人也多；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Enterp through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Enter by the narrow gate. For the gate is wide and the way is easy that leads to destruction, and those who enter by it are many.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Enter by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and there are many who go in by it.
verses.textEnNlt: "You can enter God’s Kingdom only through the narrow gate. The highway to hell is broad, and its gate is wide for the many who choose that way.
verses.textEnNasb: "Enter through the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter through it.
verses.textEn: <red>“Enterp through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但引到生命的门是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但引到生命的门是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>引到永生，那门是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the gate is narrow and the way is hard that leads to life, and those who find it are few.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because narrow is the gate and difficult is the way which leads to life, and there are few who find it.
verses.textEnNlt: But the gateway to life is very narrow and the road is difficult, and only a few ever find it.
verses.textEnNasb: For the gate is narrow and the way is constricted that leads to life, and there are few who find it.
verses.textEn: <red>But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"提防假先知！他们披着羊皮到你们当中，里面却是残暴的狼。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"提防假先知！他们披着羊皮到你们当中，里面却是残暴的狼。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们要防备假先知。他们到你们这里来，外面披着羊皮，里面却是残暴的狼。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Watchp out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ferocious wolves.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
verses.textEnNlt: "Beware of false prophets who come disguised as harmless sheep but are really vicious wolves.
verses.textEnNasb: "Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
verses.textEn: <red>“Watchp out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ferocious wolves.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来：荆棘里怎能摘到葡萄？蒺藜里怎能摘到无花果呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来：荆棘里怎能摘到葡萄？蒺藜里怎能摘到无花果呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凭着他们的果子，就可以认出他们来。荆棘上岂能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜里岂能摘无花果呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You will recognize them by their fruits. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
verses.textEnNkjv: You will know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes from thornbushes or figs from thistles?
verses.textEnNlt: You can identify them by their fruit, that is, by the way they act. Can you pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
verses.textEnNasb: You will know them by their fruits. Grapes are not gathered from thorn bushes, nor figs from thistles, are they?
verses.textEn: <red>By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>照样，好树结好果子，坏树结坏果子；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>照样，好树结好果子，坏树结坏果子；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，凡好树都结好果子，惟独坏树结坏果子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So, every healthy tree bears good fruit, but the diseased tree bears bad fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: So every good tree bears good fruit, but the bad tree bears bad fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>好树不能结坏果子，坏树也不能结好果子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>好树不能结坏果子，坏树也不能结好果子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>好树不能结坏果子；坏树不能结好果子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: A healthy tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a diseased tree bear good fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: A good tree can’t produce bad fruit, and a bad tree can’t produce good fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是不结好果子的树，就被砍下来，丢在火中。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是不结好果子的树，就被砍下来，丢在火中。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: So every tree that does not produce good fruit is chopped down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.textEn: <red>Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此你们凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此你们凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Thus, by their fruit you will recognize them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Thus you will recognize them by their fruits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, just as you can identify a tree by its fruit, so you can identify people by their actions.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, you will know them by their fruits.
verses.textEn: <red>Thus, by their fruit you will recognize them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"不是每一个对我说：‘主啊，主啊！’的人，都能进入天国，唯有遵行我天父旨意的人，才能进去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"不是每一个对我说：‘主啊，主啊！’的人，都能进入天国，唯有遵行我天父旨意的人，才能进去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「凡称呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都进天国；惟独遵行我天父旨意的人才能进去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Notp everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ shall enter the kingdom of heaven, but he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: "Not everyone who calls out to me, ‘Lord! Lord!’ will enter the Kingdom of Heaven. Only those who actually do the will of my Father in heaven will enter.
verses.textEnNasb: "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven will enter.
verses.textEn: <red>“Notp everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到那日，必有许多人对我说：‘主啊，主啊！难道我们没有奉你的名讲道，奉你的名赶鬼，奉你的名行过许多神迹吗？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到那日，必有许多人对我说：‘主啊，主啊！难道我们没有奉你的名讲道，奉你的名赶鬼，奉你的名行过许多神迹吗？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当那日必有许多人对我说：『主啊，主啊，我们不是奉你的名传道，奉你的名赶鬼，奉你的名行许多异能吗？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Many will say to me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name and in your name drive out demons and in your name perform many miracles?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: On that day many will say to me, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name, and cast out demons in your name, and do many mighty works in your name?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Many will say to Me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in Your name, cast out demons in Your name, and done many wonders in Your name?’
verses.textEnNlt: On judgment day many will say to me, ‘Lord! Lord! We prophesied in your name and cast out demons in your name and performed many miracles in your name.’
verses.textEnNasb: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name cast out demons, and in Your name perform many miracles?’
verses.textEn: <red>Many will say to me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name and in your name drive out demons and in your name perform many miracles?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我必向他们声明：‘我从来不认识你们；你们这些作恶的人，离开我去吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我必向他们声明：‘我从来不认识你们；你们这些作恶的人，离开我去吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我就明明地告诉他们说：『我从来不认识你们，你们这些作恶的人，离开我去吧！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And then will I declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from me, you workers of lawlessness.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you who practice lawlessness!’
verses.textEnNlt: But I will reply, ‘I never knew you. Get away from me, you who break God’s laws.’
verses.textEnNasb: And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; leave Me, you who practice lawlessness.’
verses.textEn: <red>Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"所以，凡听见我这些话又遵行的，就像聪明的人，把自己的房子盖在盘石上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"所以，凡听见我这些话又遵行的，就像聪明的人，把自己的房子盖在盘石上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「所以，凡听见我这话就去行的，好比一个聪明人，把房子盖在磐石上；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thereforep everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Everyone then who hears these words of mine and does them will be like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore whoever hears these sayings of Mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock:
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who listens to my teaching and follows it is wise, like a person who builds a house on solid rock.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, everyone who hears these words of Mine, and acts on them, will be like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thereforep everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>雨淋、水冲、风吹，摇撼那房子，房子却不倒塌，因为建基在盘石上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>雨淋、水冲、风吹，摇撼那房子，房子却不倒塌，因为建基在盘石上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不倒塌，因为根基立在磐石上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house, but it did not fall, because it had been founded on the rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the rain descended, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it did not fall, for it was founded on the rock.
verses.textEnNlt: Though the rain comes in torrents and the floodwaters rise and the winds beat against that house, it won’t collapse because it is built on bedrock.
verses.textEnNasb: And the rain fell and the floods came, and the winds blew and slammed against that house; and yet it did not fall, for it had been founded on the rock.
verses.textEn: <red>The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡听见我这些话却不遵行的，就像愚蠢的人，把自己的房子盖在沙土上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡听见我这些话却不遵行的，就像愚蠢的人，把自己的房子盖在沙土上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡听见我这话不去行的，好比一个无知的人，把房子盖在沙土上；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But everyone who hears these words of mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And everyone who hears these words of mine and does not do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But everyone who hears these sayings of Mine, and does not do them, will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand:
verses.textEnNlt: But anyone who hears my teaching and doesn’t obey it is foolish, like a person who builds a house on sand.
verses.textEnNasb: And everyone who hears these words of Mine, and does not act on them, will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
verses.textEn: <red>But everyone who hears these words of mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>雨淋、水冲、风吹，摇撼那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很厉害。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>雨淋、水冲、风吹，摇撼那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很厉害。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很大。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell, and great was the fall of it."
verses.textEnNkjv: and the rain descended, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell. And great was its fall."
verses.textEnNlt: When the rains and floods come and the winds beat against that house, it will collapse with a mighty crash."
verses.textEnNasb: And the rain fell and the floods came, and the winds blew and slammed against that house; and it fell—and its collapse was great."
verses.textEn: <red>The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣讲完了这些话，群众都惊奇他的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣讲完了这些话，群众都惊奇他的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣讲完了这些话，众人都希奇他的教训；
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus finished these sayings, the crowds were astonished at his teaching,
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when Jesus had ended these sayings, that the people were astonished at His teaching,
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus had finished these words, the crowds were amazed at His teaching;
verses.textEn: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,

verses.textZh: 因为耶稣教导他们，像一个有权柄的人，不像他们的经学家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶稣教导他们，像一个有权柄的人，不像他们的经学家。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像他们的文士。
verses.textEnNiv: because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.
verses.textEnEsv: for he was teaching them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: for He taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.textEnNlt: for he taught with real authority—quite unlike their teachers of religious law.
verses.textEnNasb: for He was teaching them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
verses.textEn: because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.

verses.textZh: 耶稣下了山，许多人跟随着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣下了山，许多人跟随着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣下了山，有许多人跟着他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: When he came down from the mountain, great crowds followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Large crowds followed Jesus as he came down the mountainside.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
verses.textEn: When Jesus came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.

verses.textZh: 有一个患痲风的人前来向他跪拜，说："主啊！如果你肯，必能使我洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个患痲风的人前来向他跪拜，说："主啊！如果你肯，必能使我洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个长大麻风的来拜他，说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
verses.textEnNiv: A man with leprosy came and knelt before him and said, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a leper came to him and knelt before him, saying, "Lord, if you will, you can make me clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, a leper came and worshiped Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, a man with leprosy approached him and knelt before him. "Lord," the man said, "if you are willing, you can heal me and make me clean."
verses.textEnNasb: And a man with leprosy came to Him and bowed down before Him, and said, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
verses.textEn: A man with leprosy came and knelt before him and said, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."

verses.textZh: 耶稣伸手摸他，说："<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>"他的痲风立刻洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣伸手摸他，说："<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>"他的痲风立刻洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>」他的大麻风立刻就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. <red>“I am willing,”</red> he said. <red>“Be clean!”</red> Immediately he was cleansed of his leprosy.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, "I will; be clean." And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus put out His hand and touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus reached out and touched him. "I am willing," he said. "Be healed!" And instantly the leprosy disappeared.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus reached out with His hand and touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.textEn: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. <red>“I am willing,”</red> he said. <red>“Be clean!”</red> Immediately he was cleansed of his leprosy.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>你千万不可告诉别人，只要去给祭司检查，并且照着摩西所规定的献上供物，好向大家作证。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>你千万不可告诉别人，只要去给祭司检查，并且照着摩西所规定的献上供物，好向大家作证。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>你切不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to him, <red>“See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a proof to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "See that you tell no one; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to him, "Don’t tell anyone about this. Instead, go to the priest and let him examine you. Take along the offering required in the law of Moses for those who have been healed of leprosy. This will be a public testimony that you have been cleansed."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus *said to him, "See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to him, <red>“See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣到了迦百农，有一个百夫长前来恳求他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣到了迦百农，有一个百夫长前来恳求他，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了迦百农，有一个百夫长进前来，求他说：
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking for help.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had entered Capernaum, a centurion came forward to him, appealing to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, pleading with Him,
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus returned to Capernaum, a Roman officer came and pleaded with him,
verses.textEnNasb: And when Jesus entered Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, begging Him,
verses.textEn: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking for help.

verses.textZh: 说："主啊！我的仆人瘫痪了，躺在家里非常痛苦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："主啊！我的仆人瘫痪了，躺在家里非常痛苦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「主啊，我的仆人害瘫痪病，躺在家里，甚是疼苦。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord," he said, "my servant lies at home paralyzed, suffering terribly."
verses.textEnEsv: "Lord, my servant is lying paralyzed at home, suffering terribly."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Lord, my servant is lying at home paralyzed, dreadfully tormented."
verses.textEnNlt: "Lord, my young servant lies in bed, paralyzed and in terrible pain."
verses.textEnNasb: and saying, " Lord, my servant is lying paralyzed at home, terribly tormented."
verses.textEn: "Lord," he said, "my servant lies at home paralyzed, suffering terribly."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>我去医治他。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>我去医治他。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我去医治他。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to him, <red>“Shall I come and heal him?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "I will come and heal him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "I will come and heal him."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "I will come and heal him."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "I will come and heal him."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to him, <red>“Shall I come and heal him?”</red>

verses.textZh: 百夫长回答："主啊，要你到舍下来，实在不敢当。只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 百夫长回答："主啊，要你到舍下来，实在不敢当。只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 百夫长回答说：「主啊，你到我舍下，我不敢当；只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.textEnNiv: The centurion replied, "Lord, I do not deserve to have you come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnEsv: But the centurion replied, "Lord, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof, but only say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The centurion answered and said, "Lord, I am not worthy that You should come under my roof. But only speak a word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnNlt: But the officer said, "Lord, I am not worthy to have you come into my home. Just say the word from where you are, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnNasb: But the centurion replied, " Lord, I am not worthy for You to come under my roof, but just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEn: The centurion replied, "Lord, I do not deserve to have you come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.textZh: 我自己是在别人的权下，也有兵在我以下；我对这个说‘去！’他就去，对另一个说‘来！’他就来；对仆人说‘作这个！’他就作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我自己是在别人的权下，也有兵在我以下；我对这个说‘去！’他就去，对另一个说‘来！’他就来；对仆人说‘作这个！’他就作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我在人的权下，也有兵在我以下；对这个说『去！』他就去；对那个说『来！』他就来；对我的仆人说：『你做这事！』他就去做。」
verses.textEnNiv: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
verses.textEnEsv: For I too am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. And I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes, and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I also am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
verses.textEnNlt: I know this because I am under the authority of my superior officers, and I have authority over my soldiers. I only need to say, ‘Go,’ and they go, or ‘Come,’ and they come. And if I say to my slaves, ‘Do this,’ they do it."
verses.textEnNasb: For I also am a man under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this!’ and he does it."
verses.textEn: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."

verses.textZh: 耶稣听了，就很惊奇，对跟随的人说："<red>我实在告诉你们，这样的信心，我在以色列中从来没有见过。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听了，就很惊奇，对跟随的人说："<red>我实在告诉你们，这样的信心，我在以色列中从来没有见过。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣听见就希奇，对跟从的人说：「我实在告诉你们，这么大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也没有遇见过。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and said to those following him, <red>“Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus heard this, he marveled and said to those who followed him, "Truly, I tell you, with no one in Israel have I found such faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus heard it, He marveled, and said to those who followed, "Assuredly, I say to you, I have not found such great faith, not even in Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. Turning to those who were following him, he said, "I tell you the truth, I haven’t seen faith like this in all Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus heard this, He was amazed and said to those who were following, "Truly I say to you, I have not found such great faith with anyone in Israel.
verses.textEn: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and said to those following him, <red>“Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，必有许多人从东从西来到，和亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各在天国里一起吃饭。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，必有许多人从东从西来到，和亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各在天国里一起吃饭。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又告诉你们，从东从西，将有许多人来，在天国里与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I say to you that many will come from the east and the west, and will take their places at the feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, many will come from east and west and recline at table with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I say to you that many will come from east and west, and sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: And I tell you this, that many Gentiles will come from all over the world—from east and west—and sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob at the feast in the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And I say to you that many will come from east and west, and recline at the table with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven;
verses.textEn: <red>I say to you that many will come from the east and the west, and will take their places at the feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但本来要承受天国的人，反被丢在外面黑暗里，在那里必要哀哭切齿。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但本来要承受天国的人，反被丢在外面黑暗里，在那里必要哀哭切齿。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>惟有本国的子民竟被赶到外边黑暗里去，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the subjects of the kingdom will be thrown outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: while the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the sons of the kingdom will be cast out into outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
verses.textEnNlt: But many Israelites—those for whom the Kingdom was prepared—will be thrown into outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
verses.textEnNasb: but the sons of the kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
verses.textEn: <red>But the subjects of the kingdom will be thrown outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣对百夫长说："<red>回去吧！事情必照你所信的给你成就。</red>"他的仆人就在那时痊愈了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣对百夫长说："<red>回去吧！事情必照你所信的给你成就。</red>"他的仆人就在那时痊愈了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对百夫长说：「<red>你回去吧！照你的信心，给你成全了。</red>」那时，他的仆人就好了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to the centurion, <red>“Go! Let it be done just as you believed it would.”</red> And his servant was healed at that moment.
verses.textEnEsv: And to the centurion Jesus said, "Go; let it be done for you as you have believed." And the servant was healed at that very moment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to the centurion, "Go your way; and as you have believed, so let it be done for you." And his servant was healed that same hour.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to the Roman officer, "Go back home. Because you believed, it has happened." And the young servant was healed that same hour.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to the centurion, "Go; it shall be done for you as you have believed." And the servant was healed at that very moment.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to the centurion, <red>“Go! Let it be done just as you believed it would.”</red> And his servant was healed at that moment.

verses.textZh: 耶稣来到彼得家里，看见他的岳母发烧，病在床上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣来到彼得家里，看见他的岳母发烧，病在床上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣到了彼得家里，见彼得的岳母害热病躺着。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus entered Peter’s house, he saw his mother-in-law lying sick with a fever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Jesus had come into Peter’s house, He saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, Peter’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a high fever.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus came into Peter’s home, He saw his mother-in-law lying sick in bed with a fever.
verses.textEn: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.

verses.textZh: 耶稣一摸她的手，热就退了；她就起来服事耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一摸她的手，热就退了；她就起来服事耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣把她的手一摸，热就退了；她就起来服事耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.
verses.textEnEsv: He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she rose and began to serve him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her. And she arose and served them.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jesus touched her hand, the fever left her. Then she got up and prepared a meal for him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she got up and waited on Him.
verses.textEn: He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.

verses.textZh: 到了黄昏，有些人带了许多被鬼附的人来见耶稣，他只用一句话就把污灵赶出去，并且医好了所有患病的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了黄昏，有些人带了许多被鬼附的人来见耶稣，他只用一句话就把污灵赶出去，并且医好了所有患病的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，有人带着许多被鬼附的来到耶稣跟前，他只用一句话就把鬼都赶出去，并且治好了一切有病的人。
verses.textEnNiv: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to him, and he drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
verses.textEnEsv: That evening they brought to him many who were oppressed by demons, and he cast out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: When evening had come, they brought to Him many who were demon-possessed. And He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
verses.textEnNlt: That evening many demon-possessed people were brought to Jesus. He cast out the evil spirits with a simple command, and he healed all the sick.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when evening came, they brought to Him many who were demon-possessed; and He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were ill.
verses.textEn: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to him, and he drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

verses.textZh: 这样正应验了以赛亚先知所说的： "他亲自除去我们的软弱， 担当我们的疾病。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样正应验了以赛亚先知所说的： "他亲自除去我们的软弱， 担当我们的疾病。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说： 他代替我们的软弱， 担当我们的疾病。
verses.textEnNiv: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: "He took up our infirmities and bore our diseases."
verses.textEnEsv: This was to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah: "He took our illnesses and bore our diseases."
verses.textEnNkjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying: "He Himself took our infirmities And bore our sicknesses."
verses.textEnNlt: This fulfilled the word of the Lord through the prophet Isaiah, who said, "He took our sicknesses and removed our diseases."
verses.textEnNasb: This happened so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet would be fulfilled: "He Himself took our illnesses and carried away our diseases."
verses.textEn: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: "He took up our infirmities and bore our diseases."

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见许多人围着他，就吩咐往对岸去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见许多人围着他，就吩咐往对岸去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣见许多人围着他，就吩咐渡到那边去。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the lake.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Jesus saw a crowd around him, he gave orders to go over to the other side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Jesus saw great multitudes about Him, He gave a command to depart to the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he instructed his disciples to cross to the other side of the lake.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus saw a crowd around Him, He gave orders to depart to the other side of the sea.
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the lake.

verses.textZh: 有一位经学家前来对他说："老师，你无论往哪里去，我都要跟从你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位经学家前来对他说："老师，你无论往哪里去，我都要跟从你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个文士来，对他说：「夫子，你无论往哪里去，我要跟从你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."
verses.textEnEsv: And a scribe came up and said to him, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a certain scribe came and said to Him, "Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go."
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the teachers of religious law said to him, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNasb: Then a scribe came and said to Him, "Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go."
verses.textEn: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，但人子却没有栖身 的地方。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，但人子却没有栖身 的地方。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有枕头的地方。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "Foxes have dens to live in, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place even to lay his head."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus *said to him, "The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”</red>

verses.textZh: 另一个门徒对他说："主啊！请准我先回去安葬我的父亲吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一个门徒对他说："主啊！请准我先回去安葬我的父亲吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一个门徒对耶稣说：「主啊，容我先回去埋葬我的父亲。」
verses.textEnNiv: Another disciple said to him, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."
verses.textEnEsv: Another of the disciples said to him, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then another of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."
verses.textEnNlt: Another of his disciples said, "Lord, first let me return home and bury my father."
verses.textEnNasb: And another of the disciples said to Him, "Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father."
verses.textEn: Another disciple said to him, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>跟从我吧！让死人去埋葬他们的死人。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>跟从我吧！让死人去埋葬他们的死人。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>任凭死人埋葬他们的死人；你跟从我吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus told him, <red>“Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus told him, "Follow me now. Let the spiritually dead bury their own dead. "
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus *said to him, "Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead."
verses.textEn: But Jesus told him, <red>“Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he got into the boat and his disciples followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he got into the boat, his disciples followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He got into a boat, His disciples followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus got into the boat and started across the lake with his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
verses.textEn: Then he got into the boat and his disciples followed him.

verses.textZh: 忽然海上起了狂风，甚至船都被波涛掩盖，但耶稣却睡着了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然海上起了狂风，甚至船都被波涛掩盖，但耶稣却睡着了。
verses.textZhCuv: 海里忽然起了暴风，甚至船被波浪掩盖；耶稣却睡着了。
verses.textEnNiv: Suddenly a furious storm came up on the lake, so that the waves swept over the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there arose a great storm on the sea, so that the boat was being swamped by the waves; but he was asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: And suddenly a great tempest arose on the sea, so that the boat was covered with the waves. But He was asleep.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, a fierce storm struck the lake, with waves breaking into the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, a violent storm developed on the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves; but Jesus Himself was asleep.
verses.textEn: Suddenly a furious storm came up on the lake, so that the waves swept over the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.

verses.textZh: 他们走来把他叫醒，说："主啊！救命啊！我们没命了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走来把他叫醒，说："主啊！救命啊！我们没命了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒来叫醒了他，说：「主啊，救我们，我们丧命啦！」
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Lord, save us! We’re going to drown!"
verses.textEnEsv: And they went and woke him, saying, "Save us, Lord; we are perishing."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His disciples came to Him and awoke Him, saying, "Lord, save us! We are perishing!"
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples went and woke him up, shouting, "Lord, save us! We’re going to drown!"
verses.textEnNasb: And they came to Him and woke Him, saying, "Save us, Lord; we are perishing!"
verses.textEn: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Lord, save us! We’re going to drown!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣却对他们说："<red>小信的人哪！为甚么害怕呢？</red>"他就起来斥责风和海，风浪就完全平静了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却对他们说："<red>小信的人哪！为甚么害怕呢？</red>"他就起来斥责风和海，风浪就完全平静了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们这小信的人哪，为什么胆怯呢？</red>」于是起来，斥责风和海，风和海就大大地平静了。
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“You of little faith, why are you so afraid?”</red> Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the waves, and it was completely calm.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Why are you afraid, O you of little faith?" Then he rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?" Then He arose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "Why are you afraid? You have so little faith!" Then he got up and rebuked the wind and waves, and suddenly there was a great calm.
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to them, "Why are you afraid, you men of little faith?" Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it became perfectly calm.
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“You of little faith, why are you so afraid?”</red> Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the waves, and it was completely calm.

verses.textZh: 众人都惊奇，说："这是甚么人，连风和海也听从他？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都惊奇，说："这是甚么人，连风和海也听从他？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人希奇，说：「这是怎样的人？连风和海也听从他了！」
verses.textEnNiv: The men were amazed and asked, "What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the waves obey him!"
verses.textEnEsv: And the men marveled, saying, "What sort of man is this, that even winds and sea obey him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men marveled, saying, "Who can this be, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples were amazed. "Who is this man?" they asked. "Even the winds and waves obey him!"
verses.textEnNasb: The men were amazed, and said, "What kind of a man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?"
verses.textEn: The men were amazed and asked, "What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the waves obey him!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣过到对岸加大拉人的地区，遇见两个被鬼附着的人从墓地出来；他们十分凶暴，甚至没有人敢从那条路经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣过到对岸加大拉人的地区，遇见两个被鬼附着的人从墓地出来；他们十分凶暴，甚至没有人敢从那条路经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣既渡到那边去，来到加大拉人的地方，就有两个被鬼附的人从坟茔里出来迎着他，极其凶猛，甚至没有人能从那条路上经过。
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived at the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs met him. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came to the other side, to the country of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men met him, coming out of the tombs, so fierce that no one could pass that way.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had come to the other side, to the country of the Gergesenes, there met Him two demon-possessed men, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that no one could pass that way.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus arrived on the other side of the lake, in the region of the Gadarenes, two men who were possessed by demons met him. They came out of the tombs and were so violent that no one could go through that area.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He came to the other side into the country of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men confronted Him as they were coming out of the tombs. They were so extremely violent that no one could pass by that way.
verses.textEn: When he arrived at the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs met him. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

verses.textZh: 他们喊叫："神的儿子，我们跟你有甚么关系呢？时候还没有到，你就来这里叫我们受苦吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们喊叫："神的儿子，我们跟你有甚么关系呢？时候还没有到，你就来这里叫我们受苦吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们喊着说：「神的儿子，我们与你有什么相干？时候还没有到，你就上这里来叫我们受苦吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "What do you want with us, Son of God?" they shouted. "Have you come here to torture us before the appointed time?"
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, they cried out, "What have you to do with us, O Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And suddenly they cried out, saying, "What have we to do with You, Jesus, You Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before the time?"
verses.textEnNlt: They began screaming at him, "Why are you interfering with us, Son of God? Have you come here to torture us before God’s appointed time?"
verses.textEnNasb: And they cried out, saying, " What business do You have with us, Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before the time?"
verses.textEn: "What do you want with us, Son of God?" they shouted. "Have you come here to torture us before the appointed time?"

verses.textZh: 那时远远有一大群猪正在吃东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时远远有一大群猪正在吃东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 离他们很远，有一大群猪吃食。
verses.textEnNiv: Some distance from them a large herd of pigs was feeding.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a herd of many pigs was feeding at some distance from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a good way off from them there was a herd of many swine feeding.
verses.textEnNlt: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding in the distance.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding at a distance from them.
verses.textEn: Some distance from them a large herd of pigs was feeding.

verses.textZh: 那些鬼就求耶稣，说："如果要赶我们出来，就准我们进到猪群里去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些鬼就求耶稣，说："如果要赶我们出来，就准我们进到猪群里去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 鬼就央求耶稣，说：「若把我们赶出去，就打发我们进入猪群吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: The demons begged Jesus, "If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs."
verses.textEnEsv: And the demons begged him, saying, "If you cast us out, send us away into the herd of pigs."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the demons begged Him, saying, "If You cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of swine."
verses.textEnNlt: So the demons begged, "If you cast us out, send us into that herd of pigs."
verses.textEnNasb: And the demons begged Him, saying, "If You are going to cast us out, send us into the herd of pigs."
verses.textEn: The demons begged Jesus, "If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>出去吧！</red>"他们就出来，进了猪群。那一群猪忽然闯下山崖，掉在海里淹死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>出去吧！</red>"他们就出来，进了猪群。那一群猪忽然闯下山崖，掉在海里淹死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>去吧！</red>」鬼就出来，进入猪群。全群忽然闯下山崖，投在海里淹死了。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“Go!”</red> So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and died in the water.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Go." So they came out and went into the pigs, and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Go." So when they had come out, they went into the herd of swine. And suddenly the whole herd of swine ran violently down the steep place into the sea, and perished in the water.
verses.textEnNlt: "All right, go!" Jesus commanded them. So the demons came out of the men and entered the pigs, and the whole herd plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned in the water.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Go!" And they came out and went into the pigs; and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the waters.
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“Go!”</red> So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and died in the water.

verses.textZh: 放猪的人逃进城里，把被鬼附的人的遭遇和一切事情，都报告出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 放猪的人逃进城里，把被鬼附的人的遭遇和一切事情，都报告出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 放猪的就逃跑进城，将这一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告诉人。
verses.textEnNiv: Those tending the pigs ran off, went into the town and reported all this, including what had happened to the demon-possessed men.
verses.textEnEsv: The herdsmen fled, and going into the city they told everything, especially what had happened to the demon-possessed men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those who kept them fled; and they went away into the city and told everything, including what hadhappened to the demon-possessed men.
verses.textEnNlt: The herdsmen fled to the nearby town, telling everyone what happened to the demon-possessed men.
verses.textEnNasb: And the herdsmen ran away, and went to the city and reported everything, including what had happened to the demon-possessed men.
verses.textEn: Those tending the pigs ran off, went into the town and reported all this, including what had happened to the demon-possessed men.

verses.textZh: 全城的居民都出来要见耶稣，看见了他，就求他离开他们的地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全城的居民都出来要见耶稣，看见了他，就求他离开他们的地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 合城的人都出来迎见耶稣，既见了就央求他离开他们的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus, and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their region.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to depart from their region.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the entire town came out to meet Jesus, but they begged him to go away and leave them alone.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus; and when they saw Him, they pleaded with Him to leave their region.
verses.textEn: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.

verses.textZh: 耶稣上了船，过到自己的城来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上了船，过到自己的城来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣上了船，渡过海，来到自己的城里。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus stepped into a boat, crossed over and came to his own town.
verses.textEnEsv: And getting into a boat he crossed over and came to his own city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own city.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus climbed into a boat and went back across the lake to his own town.
verses.textEnNasb: Getting into a boat, Jesus crossed over the Sea of Galilee and came to His own city.
verses.textEn: Jesus stepped into a boat, crossed over and came to his own town.

verses.textZh: 有人把一个躺在床上的瘫子带到他那里。耶稣看见他们的信心，就对瘫子说："<red>孩子，放心！你的罪赦了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人把一个躺在床上的瘫子带到他那里。耶稣看见他们的信心，就对瘫子说："<red>孩子，放心！你的罪赦了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人用褥子抬着一个瘫子到耶稣跟前来。耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「<red>小子，放心吧！你的罪赦了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Some men brought to him a paralyzed man, lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man, <red>“Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, some people brought to him a paralytic, lying on a bed. And when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, "Take heart, my son; your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, they brought to Him a paralytic lying on a bed. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, "Son, be of good cheer; your sins are forgiven you."
verses.textEnNlt: Some people brought to him a paralyzed man on a mat. Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, "Be encouraged, my child! Your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought to Him a paralyzed man lying on a stretcher. And seeing their faith, Jesus said to the man who was paralyzed, "Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEn: Some men brought to him a paralyzed man, lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man, <red>“Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有几位经学家彼此说："这个人在说僭妄的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几位经学家彼此说："这个人在说僭妄的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个文士心里说：「这个人说僭妄的话了。」
verses.textEnNiv: At this, some of the teachers of the law said to themselves, "This fellow is blaspheming!"
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, "This man is blaspheming."
verses.textEnNkjv: And at once some of the scribes said within themselves, "This Man blasphemes!"
verses.textEnNlt: But some of the teachers of religious law said to themselves, "That’s blasphemy! Does he think he’s God?"
verses.textEnNasb: And some of the scribes said to themselves, "This man is blaspheming!"
verses.textEn: At this, some of the teachers of the law said to themselves, "This fellow is blaspheming!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣看出他们所想的，就说："<red>你们心里为甚么存着恶念呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看出他们所想的，就说："<red>你们心里为甚么存着恶念呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣知道他们的心意，就说：「你们为什么心里怀着恶念呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said, <red>“Why do you entertain evil thoughts in your hearts?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, "Why do you think evil in your hearts?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, "Why do you think evil in your hearts?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he asked them, "Why do you have such evil thoughts in your hearts?
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, said, "Why are you thinking evil in your hearts?
verses.textEn: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said, <red>“Why do you entertain evil thoughts in your hearts?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>说‘你的罪赦了’，或说‘起来行走’，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说‘你的罪赦了’，或说‘起来行走’，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>或说『你的罪赦了』，或说『你起来行走』，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Rise and walk’?
verses.textEnNkjv: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
verses.textEnNlt: Is it easier to say ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or ‘Stand up and walk’?
verses.textEnNasb: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
verses.textEn: <red>Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而为了要使你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄， 起来，拿起你的床，回家去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而为了要使你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄， 起来，拿起你的床，回家去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄」；就对瘫子说：「<red>起来！拿你的褥子回家去吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.”</red> So he said to the paralyzed man, <red>“Get up, take your mat and go home.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—he then said to the paralytic—"Rise, pick up your bed and go home."
verses.textEnNkjv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins"—then He said to the paralytic, "Arise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
verses.textEnNlt: So I will prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins." Then Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said, "Stand up, pick up your mat, and go home!"
verses.textEnNasb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—then He *said to the paralyzed man, "Get up, pick up your stretcher and go home."
verses.textEn: <red>But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.”</red> So he said to the paralyzed man, <red>“Get up, take your mat and go home.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他就起来回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就起来回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就起来，回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man got up and went home.
verses.textEnEsv: And he rose and went home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he arose and departed to his house.
verses.textEnNlt: And the man jumped up and went home!
verses.textEnNasb: And he got up and went home.
verses.textEn: Then the man got up and went home.

verses.textZh: 群众看见，就起了敬畏的心，颂赞那把这样的权柄赐给人的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众看见，就起了敬畏的心，颂赞那把这样的权柄赐给人的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人看见都惊奇，就归荣耀与神，因为他将这样的权柄赐给人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the crowd saw this, they were filled with awe; and they praised God, who had given such authority to man.
verses.textEnEsv: When the crowds saw it, they were afraid, and they glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such power to men.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear swept through the crowd as they saw this happen. And they praised God for giving humans such authority.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the crowds saw this, they were awestruck, and they glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.textEn: When the crowd saw this, they were filled with awe; and they praised God, who had given such authority to man.

verses.textZh: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人，名叫马太，坐在税关那里，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"他就起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人，名叫马太，坐在税关那里，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"他就起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说：「<red>你跟从我来。</red>」他就起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus went on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax collector’s booth. <red>“Follow me,”</red> he told him, and Matthew got up and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: As Jesus passed on from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax booth, and he said to him, "Follow me." And he rose and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me." So he arose and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was walking along, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at his tax collector’s booth. "Follow me and be my disciple," Jesus said to him. So Matthew got up and followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man called Matthew sitting in the tax collector’s office; and He *said to him, "Follow Me!" And he got up and followed Him.
verses.textEn: As Jesus went on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax collector’s booth. <red>“Follow me,”</red> he told him, and Matthew got up and followed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣在屋里吃饭的时候，有很多税吏和罪人来与他和门徒一起吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在屋里吃饭的时候，有很多税吏和罪人来与他和门徒一起吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在屋里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人来，与耶稣和他的门徒一同坐席。
verses.textEnNiv: While Jesus was having dinner at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with him and his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: And as Jesus reclined at table in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and were reclining with Jesus and his disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as Jesus sat at the table in the house, that behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Him and His disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, Matthew invited Jesus and his disciples to his home as dinner guests, along with many tax collectors and other disreputable sinners.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened that as Jesus was reclining at the table in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and began dining with Jesus and His disciples.
verses.textEn: While Jesus was having dinner at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with him and his disciples.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人看见了，就对他的门徒说："你们的老师为甚么跟税吏和罪人一起吃饭呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人看见了，就对他的门徒说："你们的老师为甚么跟税吏和罪人一起吃饭呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣的门徒说：「你们的先生为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃饭呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked his disciples, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to His disciples, "Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
