verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: Were you looking for a prophet? Yes, and he is more than a prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and one who is more than a prophet.
verses.textEn: <red>Then what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>经上所记： ‘看哪，我差遣我的使者在你面前， 他必在你前头预备你的道路。’ 这句话是指着他说的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>经上所记： ‘看哪，我差遣我的使者在你面前， 他必在你前头预备你的道路。’ 这句话是指着他说的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>经上记着说：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面预备道路』，所说的就是这个人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is the one about whom it is written: “ ‘Ipn will send my messenger ahead of you, whold will prepare your way before you.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This is he of whom it is written, "‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is he of whom it is written: ‘Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, Who will prepare Your way before You.’
verses.textEnNlt: John is the man to whom the Scriptures refer when they say, ‘Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, and he will prepare your way before you.’
verses.textEnNasb: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I am sending My messenger ahead of You, Who will prepare Your way before You.’
verses.textEn: <red>This is the one about whom it is written: “ ‘Ipn will send my messenger ahead of you, whold will prepare your way before you.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，妇人所生的，没有一个比施洗的约翰更大；然而天国里最小的比他还大。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，妇人所生的，没有一个比施洗的约翰更大；然而天国里最小的比他还大。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡妇人所生的，没有一个兴起来大过施洗约翰的；然而天国里最小的比他还大。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Trulyp I tell you, among those born of women there has not risen anyone greater than John the Baptist; yet whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, among those born of women there has arisen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet the one who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Assuredly, I say to you, among those born of women there has not risen one greater than John the Baptist; but he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, of all who have ever lived, none is greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least person in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he is!
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, among those born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptist! Yet the one who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.textEn: <red>Trulyp I tell you, among those born of women there has not risen anyone greater than John the Baptist; yet whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>从施洗的约翰的时候直到现在，天国不断遭受猛烈的攻击，强暴的人企图把它夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>从施洗的约翰的时候直到现在，天国不断遭受猛烈的攻击，强暴的人企图把它夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从施洗约翰的时候到如今，天国是努力进入的，努力的人就得着了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subjected to violence, and violent people have been raiding it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven has suffered violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.textEnNlt: And from the time John the Baptist began preaching until now, the Kingdom of Heaven has been forcefully advancing, and violent people are attacking it.
verses.textEnNasb: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven has been treated violently, and violent men take it by force.
verses.textEn: <red>From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subjected to violence, and violent people have been raiding it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所有的先知和律法，直到约翰为止，都说了预言。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所有的先知和律法，直到约翰为止，都说了预言。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为众先知和律法说预言，到约翰为止。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John,
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.textEnNlt: For before John came, all the prophets and the law of Moses looked forward to this present time.
verses.textEnNasb: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
verses.textEn: <red>For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们肯接受，约翰就是那要来的以利亚。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们肯接受，约翰就是那要来的以利亚。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若肯领受，这人就是那应当来的以利亚。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and if you are willing to accept it, he is Elijah who is to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you are willing to receive it, he is Elijah who is to come.
verses.textEnNlt: And if you are willing to accept what I say, he is Elijah, the one the prophets said would come.
verses.textEnNasb: And if you are willing to accept it, John himself is Elijah who was to come.
verses.textEn: <red>And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有耳的，就应当听。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有耳的，就应当听。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有耳可听的，就应当听！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has ears to hear, let him hear!
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand!
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear.</red>

verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我要把这世代比作甚么呢？它好象一些小孩子坐在市中心，呼叫别的小孩子，</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Top what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: "But to what shall I liken this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling to their companions,

verses.textEnNasb: "But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call out to the other children,

verses.textZh: <red>说： ‘我们给你们吹笛子，你们却不跳舞； 我们唱哀歌，你们也不捶胸。’</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: and saying: ‘We played the flute for you, And you did not dance; We mourned to you, And you did not lament.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘We played wedding songs, and you didn’t dance, so we played funeral songs, and you didn’t mourn.’
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a song of mourning, and you did not mourn.’

verses.textEnEsv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.textEnNlt: For John didn’t spend his time eating and drinking, and you say, ‘He’s possessed by a demon.’

verses.textZh: <red>人子来了，又吃又喝，人却说：‘你看，这人贪食好酒，与税吏和罪人为友。’但智慧借着它所作的，就证实是公义的了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人子来了，又吃又喝，人却说：‘你看，这人贪食好酒，与税吏和罪人为友。’但智慧借着它所作的，就证实是公义的了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子来了，也吃也喝，人又说他是贪食好酒的人，是税吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子总以智慧为是 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’ But wisdom is proved right by her deeds.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at him! A glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ Yet wisdom is justified by her deeds."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look, a glutton and a winebibber, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children."
verses.textEnNlt: The Son of Man, on the other hand, feasts and drinks, and you say, ‘He’s a glutton and a drunkard, and a friend of tax collectors and other sinners!’ But wisdom is shown to be right by its results."
verses.textEnNasb: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a heavy drinker, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ And yet wisdom is vindicated by her deeds."
verses.textEn: <red>The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’ But wisdom is proved right by her deeds.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那时，耶稣开始责备那些他曾在那里行过许多神迹的城，因为它们不肯悔改：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶稣开始责备那些他曾在那里行过许多神迹的城，因为它们不肯悔改：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在诸城中行了许多异能，那些城的人终不悔改，就在那时候责备他们，说：

verses.textEnEsv: Then he began to denounce the cities where most of his mighty works had been done, because they did not repent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He began to rebuke the cities in which most of His mighty works had been done, because they did not repent:

verses.textEnNasb: Then He began to reprimand the cities in which most of His miracles were done, because they did not repent.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus began to denounce the towns in which most of his miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.

verses.textZh: <red>"哥拉逊啊，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！在你们那里行过的神迹，如果行在推罗和西顿，它们早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"哥拉逊啊，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！在你们那里行过的神迹，如果行在推罗和西顿，它们早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「哥拉汛哪，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们中间所行的异能，若行在泰尔、西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you, Korazin and Bethsaida! For if the miracles I did in you had been done in wicked Tyre and Sidon, their people would have repented of their sins long ago, clothing themselves in burlap and throwing ashes on their heads to show their remorse.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that occurred in you had occurred in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我告诉你们，在审判的日子，推罗和西顿所受的，比你们还轻呢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我告诉你们，在审判的日子，推罗和西顿所受的，比你们还轻呢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我告诉你们，当审判的日子，泰尔、西顿所受的，比你们还容易受呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I tell you, it will be more bearable on the day of judgment for Tyre and Sidon than for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judgment than for you.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, Tyre and Sidon will be better off on judgment day than you.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless I say to you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>迦百农啊！ 你会被高举到天上吗？ 你必降到阴间。 在你那里行过的神迹，如果行在所多玛，那城还会存留到今天。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>迦百农啊！ 你会被高举到天上吗？ 你必降到阴间。 在你那里行过的神迹，如果行在所多玛，那城还会存留到今天。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>迦百农啊，你已经升到天上 ，将来必坠落阴间；因为在你那里所行的异能，若行在所多玛，它还可以存到今日。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades. For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: And you, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades; for if the mighty works which were done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "And you people of Capernaum, will you be honored in heaven? No, you will go down to the place of the dead. For if the miracles I did for you had been done in wicked Sodom, it would still be here today.
verses.textEnNasb: And you, Capernaum, will not be exalted to heaven, will you? You will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that occurred in you had occurred in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
verses.textEn: <red>And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades. For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛所受的，比你还容易受呢！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable on the day of judgment for the land of Sodom than for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment than for you."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, even Sodom will be better off on judgment day than you."
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless I say to you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you."
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 就在那时候，耶稣说："<red>父啊，天地的主，我赞美你，因为你把这些事向智慧和聪明的人隐藏起来，却向婴孩显明。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时候，耶稣说："<red>父啊，天地的主，我赞美你，因为你把这些事向智慧和聪明的人隐藏起来，却向婴孩显明。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，耶稣说：「父啊，天地的主，我感谢你！因为你将这些事向聪明通达人就藏起来，向婴孩就显出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Jesus said, <red>“I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Jesus declared, "I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding and revealed them to little children;
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and have revealed them to babes.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time Jesus prayed this prayer: "O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, thank you for hiding these things from those who think themselves wise and clever, and for revealing them to the childlike.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Jesus said, "I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and intelligent, and have revealed them to infants.
verses.textEn: At that time Jesus said, <red>“I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父啊，是的，这就是你的美意。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父啊，是的，这就是你的美意。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父啊，是的，因为你的美意本是如此。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: yes, Father, for such was your gracious will.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, Father, it pleased you to do it this way!
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, Father, for this way was well pleasing in Your sight.
verses.textEn: <red>Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我父已经把一切交给我；除了父没有人认识子，除了子和子所愿意启示的人，没有人认识父。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我父已经把一切交给我；除了父没有人认识子，除了子和子所愿意启示的人，没有人认识父。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，没有人知道子；除了子和子所愿意指示的，没有人知道父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Allp things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All things have been handed over to me by my Father, and no one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and anyone to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.
verses.textEnNkjv: All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and no one knows the Son except the Father. Nor does anyone know the Father except the Son, and the one to whom the Son wills to reveal Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "My Father has entrusted everything to me. No one truly knows the Son except the Father, and no one truly knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."
verses.textEnNasb: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father; and no one knows the Son except the Father; nor does anyone know the Father except the Son, and anyone to whom the Son determines to reveal Him.
verses.textEn: <red>“Allp things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们所有劳苦担重担的人哪，到我这里来吧！我必使你们得安息。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们所有劳苦担重担的人哪，到我这里来吧！我必使你们得安息。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡劳苦担重担的人可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Comep to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said, "Come to me, all of you who are weary and carry heavy burdens, and I will give you rest.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come to Me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
verses.textEn: <red>“Comep to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我心里柔和谦卑，你们应当负我的轭，向我学习，你们就必得着心灵的安息；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我心里柔和谦卑，你们应当负我的轭，向我学习，你们就必得着心灵的安息；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我心里柔和谦卑，你们当负我的轭，学我的样式；这样，你们心里就必得享安息。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.textEnNlt: Take my yoke upon you. Let me teach you, because I am humble and gentle at heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.textEnNasb: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.textEn: <red>Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我的轭是容易负的，我的担子是轻省的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我的轭是容易负的，我的担子是轻省的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我的轭是容易的，我的担子是轻省的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light."
verses.textEnNkjv: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light."
verses.textEnNlt: For my yoke is easy to bear, and the burden I give you is light."
verses.textEnNasb: For My yoke is comfortable, and My burden is light."
verses.textEn: <red>For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”</red>

verses.textZh: 安息日那天，耶稣从麦田经过；他的门徒饿了，就摘了些麦穗来吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 安息日那天，耶稣从麦田经过；他的门徒饿了，就摘了些麦穗来吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶稣在安息日从麦地经过。他的门徒饿了，就掐起麦穗来吃。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. And His disciples were hungry, and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: At about that time Jesus was walking through some grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, so they began breaking off some heads of grain and eating them.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath, and His disciples became hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat.
verses.textEn: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人看见了，就对他说："你看，你的门徒作了安息日不可作的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人看见了，就对他说："你看，你的门徒作了安息日不可作的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣说：「看哪，你的门徒做安息日不可做的事了！」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, "Look! Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said to him, "Look, your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to Him, "Look, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath!"
verses.textEnNlt: But some Pharisees saw them do it and protested, "Look, your disciples are breaking the law by harvesting grain on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, "Look, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on a Sabbath!"
verses.textEn: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, "Look! Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>大卫和跟他在一起的人，在饥饿的时候所作的，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>大卫和跟他在一起的人，在饥饿的时候所作的，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「经上记着大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, <red>“Haven’t you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him:
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said to them, "Haven’t you read in the Scriptures what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "Have you not read what David did when he became hungry, he and his companions—
verses.textEn: He answered, <red>“Haven’t you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他不是进了神的殿，吃了他和跟他在一起的人不可以吃，只有祭司才可以吃的陈设饼吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他不是进了神的殿，吃了他和跟他在一起的人不可以吃，只有祭司才可以吃的陈设饼吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他怎么进了神的殿，吃了陈设饼，这饼不是他和跟从他的人可以吃得，惟独祭司才可以吃。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread—which was not lawful for them to do, but only for the priests.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: how he entered the house of God and ate the bread of the Presence, which it was not lawful for him to eat nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.textEnNkjv: how he entered the house of God and ate the showbread which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.textEnNlt: He went into the house of God, and he and his companions broke the law by eating the sacred loaves of bread that only the priests are allowed to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: how he entered the house of God, and they ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for him to eat nor for those with him, but for the priests alone?
verses.textEn: <red>He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread—which was not lawful for them to do, but only for the priests.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>律法书上记着：安息日，祭司在殿里供职，触犯了安息日，也不算有罪；你们也没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>律法书上记着：安息日，祭司在殿里供职，触犯了安息日，也不算有罪；你们也没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>再者，律法上所记的，当安息日，祭司在殿里犯了安息日还是没有罪，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Or haven’t you read in the Law that the priests on Sabbath duty in the temple desecrate the Sabbath and yet are innocent?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or have you not read in the Law how on the Sabbath the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.textEnNlt: And haven’t you read in the law of Moses that the priests on duty in the Temple may work on the Sabbath?
verses.textEnNasb: Or have you not read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple violate the Sabbath, and yet are innocent?
verses.textEn: <red>Or haven’t you read in the Law that the priests on Sabbath duty in the temple desecrate the Sabbath and yet are innocent?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，这里有一位是比圣殿更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，这里有一位是比圣殿更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我告诉你们，在这里有一人比殿更大。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, something greater than the temple is here.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I say to you that in this place there is One greater than the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, there is one here who is even greater than the Temple!
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you that something greater than the temple is here.
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们明白‘我喜爱怜悯，不喜爱祭祀’这句话的意思，就不会把无罪的定罪了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们明白‘我喜爱怜悯，不喜爱祭祀’这句话的意思，就不会把无罪的定罪了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>『我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀。』你们若明白这话的意思，就不将无罪的当作有罪的了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you had known what these words mean, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy and not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.textEnNlt: But you would not have condemned my innocent disciples if you knew the meaning of this Scripture: ‘I want you to show mercy, not offer sacrifices.’
verses.textEnNasb: But if you had known what this means: ‘I desire compassion, rather than sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
verses.textEn: <red>If you had known what these words mean, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为人子是安息日的主。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为人子是安息日的主。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为人子是安息日的主。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Son of Man is Lord, even over the Sabbath!"
verses.textEnNasb: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
verses.textEn: <red>For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣离开那里，来到他们的会堂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣离开那里，来到他们的会堂。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣离开那地方，进了一个会堂。
verses.textEnNiv: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,
verses.textEnEsv: He went on from there and entered their synagogue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He had departed from there, He went into their synagogue.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus went over to their synagogue,
verses.textEnNasb: Departing from there, He went into their synagogue.
verses.textEn: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,

verses.textZh: 会堂里有一个人，他的一只手枯干了。有人问耶稣："在安息日治病，可以吗？"目的是要控告耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会堂里有一个人，他的一只手枯干了。有人问耶稣："在安息日治病，可以吗？"目的是要控告耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 那里有一个人枯干了一只手。有人问耶稣说：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。
verses.textEnNiv: and a man with a shriveled hand was there. Looking for a reason to bring charges against Jesus, they asked him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnEsv: And a man was there with a withered hand. And they asked him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"— so that they might accuse him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, there was a man who had a withered hand. And they asked Him, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"—that they might accuse Him.
verses.textEnNlt: where he noticed a man with a deformed hand. The Pharisees asked Jesus, "Does the law permit a person to work by healing on the Sabbath?" (They were hoping he would say yes, so they could bring charges against him.)
verses.textEnNasb: And a man was there whose hand was withered. And they questioned Jesus, asking, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"—so that they might bring charges against Him.
verses.textEn: and a man with a shriveled hand was there. Looking for a reason to bring charges against Jesus, they asked him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："你们当中有哪一个，他仅有的一只羊在安息日跌进坑里，会不把羊抓住拉上来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："你们当中有哪一个，他仅有的一只羊在安息日跌进坑里，会不把羊抓住拉上来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们中间谁有一只羊，当安息日掉在坑里，不把它抓住、拉上来呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Which one of you who has a sheep, if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not take hold of it and lift it out?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not lay hold of it and lift it out?
verses.textEnNlt: And he answered, "If you had a sheep that fell into a well on the Sabbath, wouldn’t you work to pull it out? Of course you would.
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "What man is there among you who has a sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人比羊贵重得多了！所以，在安息日行善是可以的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人比羊贵重得多了！所以，在安息日行善是可以的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人比羊何等贵重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Of how much more value is a man than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep? Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNlt: And how much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Yes, the law permits a person to do good on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNasb: How much more valuable then is a person than a sheep! So then, it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
verses.textEn: <red>How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是对那人说："<red>伸出手来！</red>"他把手一伸，就复原了，好象另一只手一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是对那人说："<red>伸出手来！</red>"他把手一伸，就复原了，好象另一只手一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是对那人说：「<red>伸出手来！</red>」他把手一伸，手就复了原，和那只手一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to the man, <red>“Stretch out your hand.”</red> So he stretched it out and it was completely restored, just as sound as the other.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And the man stretched it out, and it was restored, healthy like the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched it out, and it was restored as whole as the other.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to the man, "Hold out your hand." So the man held out his hand, and it was restored, just like the other one!
verses.textEnNasb: Then He *said to the man, "Stretch out your hand!" He stretched it out, and it was restored to normal, like the other.
verses.textEn: Then he said to the man, <red>“Stretch out your hand.”</red> So he stretched it out and it was completely restored, just as sound as the other.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人出去，商议怎样对付耶稣，好杀掉他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人出去，商议怎样对付耶稣，好杀掉他。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人出去，商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how to destroy him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees went out and plotted against Him, how they might destroy Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Pharisees called a meeting to plot how to kill Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against Him, as to how they might destroy Him.
verses.textEn: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里。有很多人跟随他，他医好他们所有的病人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里。有很多人跟随他，他医好他们所有的病人，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里，有许多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；
verses.textEnNiv: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. A large crowd followed him, and he healed all who were ill.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus, aware of this, withdrew from there. And many followed him, and he healed them all
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Jesus knew it, He withdrew from there. And great multitudes followed Him, and He healed them all.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus knew what they were planning. So he left that area, and many people followed him. He healed all the sick among them,
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, aware of this, withdrew from there. Many followed Him, and He healed them all,
verses.textEn: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. A large crowd followed him, and he healed all who were ill.

verses.textZh: 又嘱咐他们不可替他张扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又嘱咐他们不可替他张扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 又嘱咐他们，不要给他传名。
verses.textEnNiv: He warned them not to tell others about him.
verses.textEnEsv: and ordered them not to make him known.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He warned them not to make Him known,
verses.textEnNlt: but he warned them not to reveal who he was.
verses.textEnNasb: and warned them not to tell who He was.
verses.textEn: He warned them not to tell others about him.

verses.textZh: 这就应验了以赛亚先知所说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就应验了以赛亚先知所说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：
verses.textEnNiv: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
verses.textEnEsv: This was to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: This fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah concerning him:
verses.textEnNasb: This happened so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet would be fulfilled:
verses.textEn: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:

verses.textZh: "看哪！我所拣选的仆人， 我所爱，心里所喜悦的； 我要把我的灵赐给他， 他必向万国宣扬公理。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我所拣选的仆人， 我所爱，心里所喜悦的； 我要把我的灵赐给他， 他必向万国宣扬公理。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪！我的仆人， 我所拣选、所亲爱、心里所喜悦的， 我要将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。
verses.textEnNiv: "Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved with whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit upon him, and he will proclaim justice to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold! My Servant whom I have chosen, My Beloved in whom My soul is well pleased! I will put My Spirit upon Him, And He will declare justice to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at my Servant, whom I have chosen. He is my Beloved, who pleases me. I will put my Spirit upon him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, My Servant whom I have chosen; My Beloved in whom My soul delights; I will put My Spirit upon Him, And He will proclaim justice to the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: "Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.

verses.textZh: 他不争吵，也不喧嚷， 人在街上听不见他的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不争吵，也不喧嚷， 人在街上听不见他的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不争竞，不喧嚷； 街上也没有人听见他的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear his voice in the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: He will not quarrel or cry aloud, nor will anyone hear his voice in the streets;
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not quarrel nor cry out, Nor will anyone hear His voice in the streets.
verses.textEnNlt: He will not fight or shout or raise his voice in public.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not quarrel, nor cry out; Nor will anyone hear His voice in the streets.
verses.textEn: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear his voice in the streets.

verses.textZh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断， 将残的灯火，他不吹灭； 直到他施行公理，使公理得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断， 将残的灯火，他不吹灭； 直到他施行公理，使公理得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭； 等他施行公理，叫公理得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out, till he has brought justice through to victory.
verses.textEnEsv: a bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not quench, until he brings justice to victory;
verses.textEnNkjv: A bruised reed He will not break, And smoking flax He will not quench, Till He sends forth justice to victory;
verses.textEnNlt: He will not crush the weakest reed or put out a flickering candle. Finally he will cause justice to be victorious.
verses.textEnNasb: "A bent reed He will not break off, And a dimly burning wick He will not extinguish, Until He leads justice to victory.
verses.textEn: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out, till he has brought justice through to victory.

verses.textZh: 万民都要寄望于他的名。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民都要寄望于他的名。"
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。
verses.textEnNiv: In his name the nations will put their hope."
verses.textEnEsv: and in his name the Gentiles will hope."
verses.textEnNkjv: And in His name Gentiles will trust."
verses.textEnNlt: And his name will be the hope of all the world."
verses.textEnNasb: "And in His name the Gentiles will hope."
verses.textEn: In his name the nations will put their hope."

verses.textZh: 有人带了一个被鬼附着、又瞎又哑的人到耶稣那里。耶稣医好了他，那哑巴就能说话，也能看见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人带了一个被鬼附着、又瞎又哑的人到耶稣那里。耶稣医好了他，那哑巴就能说话，也能看见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，有人将一个被鬼附着、又瞎又哑的人带到耶稣那里，耶稣就医治他，甚至那哑巴又能说话，又能看见。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.
verses.textEnEsv: Then a demon-oppressed man who was blind and mute was brought to him, and he healed him, so that the man spoke and saw.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one was brought to Him who was demon-possessed, blind and mute; and He healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a demon-possessed man, who was blind and couldn’t speak, was brought to Jesus. He healed the man so that he could both speak and see.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and unable to speak was brought to Jesus, and He healed him so that the man who was unable to speak talked and could see.
verses.textEn: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.

verses.textZh: 群众都很惊奇，说："难道他就是大卫的子孙？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众都很惊奇，说："难道他就是大卫的子孙？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都惊奇，说：「这不是大卫的子孙吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: All the people were astonished and said, "Could this be the Son of David?"
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people were amazed, and said, "Can this be the Son of David?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the multitudes were amazed and said, "Could this be the Son of David?"
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd was amazed and asked, "Could it be that Jesus is the Son of David, the Messiah?"
verses.textEnNasb: And all the crowds were amazed and were saying, "This man cannot be the Son of David, can he?"
verses.textEn: All the people were astonished and said, "Could this be the Son of David?"

verses.textZh: 法利赛人听见了，说："这个人赶鬼，只不过是靠鬼王别西卜罢了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人听见了，说："这个人赶鬼，只不过是靠鬼王别西卜罢了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但法利赛人听见，就说：「这个人赶鬼，无非是靠着鬼王别西卜啊。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, "It is only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, that this fellow drives out demons."
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, "It is only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, that this man casts out demons."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Pharisees heard it they said, "This fellow does not cast out demons except by Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons."
verses.textEnNlt: But when the Pharisees heard about the miracle, they said, "No wonder he can cast out demons. He gets his power from Satan, the prince of demons."
verses.textEnNasb: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, "This man casts out demons only by Beelzebul the ruler of the demons."
verses.textEn: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, "It is only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, that this fellow drives out demons."

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道他们的心思，就对他们说："<red>如果一个国家自相纷争，就必定荒凉；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道他们的心思，就对他们说："<red>如果一个国家自相纷争，就必定荒凉；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣知道他们的意念，就对他们说：「凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒场；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, <red>“Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Knowing their thoughts, he said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and no city or house divided against itself will stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew their thoughts and replied, "Any kingdom divided by civil war is doomed. A town or family splintered by feuding will fall apart.
verses.textEnNasb: And knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste; and no city or house divided against itself will stand.
verses.textEn: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, <red>“Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果撒但赶逐撒但，就会自相纷争。那么，他的国怎能站立得住呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果撒但赶逐撒但，就会自相纷争。那么，他的国怎能站立得住呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若撒但赶逐撒但，就是自相纷争，他的国怎能站得住呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
verses.textEnNkjv: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
verses.textEnNlt: And if Satan is casting out Satan, he is divided and fighting against himself. His own kingdom will not survive.
verses.textEnNasb: And if Satan is casting out Satan, he has become divided against himself; how then will his kingdom stand?
verses.textEn: <red>If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若靠别西卜赶鬼，你们的子孙又靠谁赶鬼呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的不是。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若靠别西卜赶鬼，你们的子孙又靠谁赶鬼呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的不是。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟赶鬼又靠着谁呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的是非。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your people drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.textEnNlt: And if I am empowered by Satan, what about your own exorcists? They cast out demons, too, so they will condemn you for what you have said.
verses.textEnNasb: And if by Beelzebul I cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.
verses.textEn: <red>And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your people drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若靠神的灵赶鬼，神的国就已经临到你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若靠神的灵赶鬼，神的国就已经临到你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若靠着神的灵赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But if it is by the Spirit of God that I drive out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if it is by the Spirit of God that I cast out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I am casting out demons by the Spirit of God, then the Kingdom of God has arrived among you.
verses.textEnNasb: But if I cast out the demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.textEn: <red>But if it is by the Spirit of God that I drive out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果不先把壮汉绑起来，怎能进到他的家里，抢夺财物呢？如果绑起来了，就可以抢劫他的家了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果不先把壮汉绑起来，怎能进到他的家里，抢夺财物呢？如果绑起来了，就可以抢劫他的家了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人怎能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的家财。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Orp again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or how can someone enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man? Then indeed he may plunder his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or how can one enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man? And then he will plunder his house.
verses.textEnNlt: For who is powerful enough to enter the house of a strong man and plunder his goods? Only someone even stronger—someone who could tie him up and then plunder his house.
verses.textEnNasb: Or, how can anyone enter the strong man’s house and carry off his property, unless he first ties up the strong man? And then he will plunder his house.
verses.textEn: <red>“Orp again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不站在我这一边的就是反对我的，不跟我一起收聚的，就是分散的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不站在我这一边的就是反对我的，不跟我一起收聚的，就是分散的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whoeverp is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters abroad.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who isn’t with me opposes me, and anyone who isn’t working with me is actually working against me.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who is not with Me is against Me; and the one who does not gather with Me scatters.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whoeverp is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此，我告诉你们，人的一切罪和亵渎的话，都可以赦免；可是，亵渎圣灵就得不着赦免。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此，我告诉你们，人的一切罪和亵渎的话，都可以赦免；可是，亵渎圣灵就得不着赦免。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以我告诉你们：「人一切的罪和亵渎的话都可得赦免，惟独亵渎圣灵，总不得赦免。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And so I tell you, every kind of sin and slander can be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven people, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I say to you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
verses.textEnNlt: "So I tell you, every sin and blasphemy can be forgiven—except blasphemy against the Holy Spirit, which will never be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I say to you, every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven people, but blasphemy against the Spirit shall not be forgiven.
verses.textEn: <red>And so I tell you, every kind of sin and slander can be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无论谁说话得罪了人子，还可以赦免；但说话得罪了圣灵的，今生来世都得不着赦免。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无论谁说话得罪了人子，还可以赦免；但说话得罪了圣灵的，今生来世都得不着赦免。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡说话干犯人子的，还可得赦免；惟独说话干犯圣灵的，今世来世总不得赦免。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age or in the age to come.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man can be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven, either in this world or in the world to come.
verses.textEnNasb: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it shall be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, either in this age or in the age to come.
verses.textEn: <red>Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们种好树就结好果子，种坏树就结坏果子；凭着果子就能认出树来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们种好树就结好果子，种坏树就结坏果子；凭着果子就能认出树来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们或以为树好，果子也好；树坏，果子也坏；因为看果子就可以知道树。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Makep a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is recognized by its fruit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree bad and its fruit bad, for the tree is known by its fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or else make the tree bad and its fruit bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: "A tree is identified by its fruit. If a tree is good, its fruit will be good. If a tree is bad, its fruit will be bad.
verses.textEnNasb: "Either assume the tree to be good as well as its fruit good, or assume the tree to be bad as well as its fruit bad; for the tree is known by its fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>“Makep a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is recognized by its fruit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>毒蛇所生的啊，你们既然是邪恶的，怎能说出良善的话？因为心中所充满的，口里就说出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>毒蛇所生的啊，你们既然是邪恶的，怎能说出良善的话？因为心中所充满的，口里就说出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>毒蛇的种类！你们既是恶人，怎能说出好话来呢？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You brood of vipers! How can you speak good, when you are evil? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brood of vipers! How can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
verses.textEnNlt: You brood of snakes! How could evil men like you speak what is good and right? For whatever is in your heart determines what you say.
verses.textEnNasb: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, express any good things? For the mouth speaks from that which fills the heart.
verses.textEn: <red>You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>良善的人从他良善的心 发出良善，邪恶的人从他邪恶的心 发出邪恶。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>良善的人从他良善的心 发出良善，邪恶的人从他邪恶的心 发出邪恶。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>善人从他心里所存的善就发出善来；恶人从他心里所存的恶就发出恶来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in him, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The good person out of his good treasure brings forth good, and the evil person out of his evil treasure brings forth evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth good things, and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.
verses.textEnNlt: A good person produces good things from the treasury of a good heart, and an evil person produces evil things from the treasury of an evil heart.
verses.textEnNasb: The good person brings out of his good treasure good things; and the evil person brings out of his evil treasure evil things.
verses.textEn: <red>A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in him, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，人所说的闲话，在审判的日子，句句都要供出来，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，人所说的闲话，在审判的日子，句句都要供出来，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又告诉你们，凡人所说的闲话，当审判的日子，必要句句供出来；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you that everyone will have to give account on the day of judgment for every empty word they have spoken.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, on the day of judgment people will give account for every careless word they speak,
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that for every idle word men may speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: And I tell you this, you must give an account on judgment day for every idle word you speak.
verses.textEnNasb: But I tell you that for every careless word that people speak, they will give an account of it on the day of judgment.
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you that everyone will have to give account on the day of judgment for every empty word they have spoken.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为你要照你的话被称为义，或定为有罪。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为你要照你的话被称为义，或定为有罪。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为要凭你的话定你为义，也要凭你的话定你有罪。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned."
verses.textEnNkjv: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned."
verses.textEnNlt: The words you say will either acquit you or condemn you."
verses.textEnNasb: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned."
verses.textEn: <red>For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”</red>

verses.textZh: 当时，有一些经学家和法利赛人对耶稣说："老师，我们想请你显个神迹看看。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，有一些经学家和法利赛人对耶稣说："老师，我们想请你显个神迹看看。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，有几个文士和法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，我们愿意你显个神迹给我们看。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying, "Teacher, we wish to see a sign from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered, saying, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from You."
verses.textEnNlt: One day some teachers of religious law and Pharisees came to Jesus and said, "Teacher, we want you to show us a miraculous sign to prove your authority."
verses.textEnNasb: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from You."
verses.textEn: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from you."

verses.textZh: 但耶稣说："<red>邪恶和淫乱的世代寻求神迹，除了约拿先知的神迹以外，再没有神迹给你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶稣说："<red>邪恶和淫乱的世代寻求神迹，除了约拿先知的神迹以外，再没有神迹给你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「一个邪恶淫乱的世代求看神迹，除了先知约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们看。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, <red>“A wicked and adulterous generation asks for a sign! But none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered them, "An evil and adulterous generation seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said to them, "An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "Only an evil, adulterous generation would demand a miraculous sign; but the only sign I will give them is the sign of the prophet Jonah.
verses.textEnNasb: But He answered and said to them, "An evil and adulterous generation craves a sign; and so no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet;
verses.textEn: He answered, <red>“A wicked and adulterous generation asks for a sign! But none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约拿怎样三日三夜在大鱼的腹中，人子也要照样三日三夜在地里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约拿怎样三日三夜在大鱼的腹中，人子也要照样三日三夜在地里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约拿三日三夜在大鱼肚腹中，人子也要这样三日三夜在地里头。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish for three days and three nights, so will the Son of Man be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.
verses.textEnNasb: for just as Jonah was in the stomach of the sea monster for three days and three nights, so will the Son of Man be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.
verses.textEn: <red>For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>审判的时候，尼尼微人要和这个世代一同起来，定这个世代的罪，因为他们听了约拿所传的就悔改了。你看，这里有一位是比约拿更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>审判的时候，尼尼微人要和这个世代一同起来，定这个世代的罪，因为他们听了约拿所传的就悔改了。你看，这里有一位是比约拿更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当审判的时候，尼尼微人要起来定这世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。看哪，在这里有一人比约拿更大！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now something greater than Jonah is here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
verses.textEnNkjv: The men of Nineveh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and indeed a greater than Jonah is here.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people of Nineveh will stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for they repented of their sins at the preaching of Jonah. Now someone greater than Jonah is here—but you refuse to repent.
verses.textEnNasb: The men of Nineveh will stand up with this generation at the judgment, and will condemn it because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
verses.textEn: <red>The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now something greater than Jonah is here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>审判的时候，南方的女王要和这个世代一同起来，定这个世代的罪，因为她从地极来到，要听所罗门智慧的话。你看，这里有一位是比所罗门更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>审判的时候，南方的女王要和这个世代一同起来，定这个世代的罪，因为她从地极来到，要听所罗门智慧的话。你看，这里有一位是比所罗门更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当审判的时候，南方的女王要起来定这世代的罪；因为她从地极而来，要听所罗门的智慧话。看哪，在这里有一人比所罗门更大！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, and now something greater than Solomon is here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The queen of the South will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.
verses.textEnNkjv: The queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and indeed a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.textEnNlt: The queen of Sheba will also stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for she came from a distant land to hear the wisdom of Solomon. Now someone greater than Solomon is here—but you refuse to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: The Queen of the South will rise up with this generation at the judgment and will condemn it, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.
verses.textEn: <red>The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, and now something greater than Solomon is here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"有一个污灵离开了一个人，走遍干旱之地，寻找栖身的地方，却没有找到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"有一个污灵离开了一个人，走遍干旱之地，寻找栖身的地方，却没有找到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「污鬼离了人身，就在无水之地过来过去，寻求安歇之处，却寻不着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "When the unclean spirit has gone out of a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, but finds none.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When an unclean spirit goes out of a man, he goes through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.
verses.textEnNlt: "When an evil spirit leaves a person, it goes into the desert, seeking rest but finding none.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now when the unclean spirit comes out of a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and does not find it.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他就说：‘我要回到我从前离开了的那房子。’到了之后，看见里面空着，已经打扫干净，粉饰好了，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他就说：‘我要回到我从前离开了的那房子。’到了之后，看见里面空着，已经打扫干净，粉饰好了，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是说：『我要回到我所出来的屋里去。』到了，就看见里面空闲，打扫干净，修饰好了，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’ And when it comes, it finds the house empty, swept, and put in order.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’ And when he comes, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
verses.textEnNlt: Then it says, ‘I will return to the person I came from.’ So it returns and finds its former home empty, swept, and in order.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came’; and when it comes, it finds it unoccupied, swept, and put in order.
verses.textEn: <red>Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他就去带了另外七个比自己更恶的污灵来，一齐进去住在那里；那人后来的情况，比以前更坏了。这邪恶的世代也会这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他就去带了另外七个比自己更恶的污灵来，一齐进去住在那里；那人后来的情况，比以前更坏了。这邪恶的世代也会这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>便去另带了七个比自己更恶的鬼来，都进去住在那里。那人末后的景况比先前更不好了。这邪恶的世代也要如此。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and dwell there, and the last state of that person is worse than the first. So also will it be with this evil generation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter and dwell there; and the last state of that man is worse than the first. So shall it also be with this wicked generation."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the spirit finds seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they all enter the person and live there. And so that person is worse off than before. That will be the experience of this evil generation."
verses.textEnNasb: Then it goes and brings along with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they come in and live there; and the last condition of that person becomes worse than the first. That is the way it will also be with this evil generation."
verses.textEn: <red>Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣还在对群众讲话的时候，他的母亲和弟弟站在外面，要找他讲话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还在对群众讲话的时候，他的母亲和弟弟站在外面，要找他讲话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣还对众人说话的时候，不料他母亲和他弟兄站在外边，要与他说话。
verses.textEnNiv: While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to him.
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking to the people, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, asking to speak to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: While He was still talking to the multitudes, behold, His mother and brothers stood outside, seeking to speak with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was speaking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, asking to speak to him.
verses.textEnNasb: While He was still speaking to the crowds, behold, His mother and brothers were standing outside, seeking to speak to Him.
verses.textEn: While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to him.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉耶稣："你的母亲和弟弟站在外面，有话要跟你说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉耶稣："你的母亲和弟弟站在外面，有话要跟你说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄站在外边，要与你说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you."
verses.textEnEsv: But he replied to the man who told him, "Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, seeking to speak with You."
verses.textEnNlt: Someone told Jesus, "Your mother and your brothers are standing outside, and they want to speak to you."
verses.textEnNasb: [ Someone said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, seeking to speak to You."]
verses.textEn: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you."

verses.textZh: 他回答那人："<red>谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答那人："<red>谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他却回答那人说：「<red>谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied to him, <red>“Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And stretching out his hand toward his disciples, he said, "Here are my mother and my brothers!
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said to the one who told Him, "Who is My mother and who are My brothers?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus replied to the one who was telling Him and said, "Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?"
verses.textEn: He replied to him, <red>“Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他伸手指着门徒说："<red>你看，我的母亲，我的弟兄！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他伸手指着门徒说："<red>你看，我的母亲，我的弟兄！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就伸手指着门徒，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Pointing to his disciples, he said, <red>“Here are my mother and my brothers.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He stretched out His hand toward His disciples and said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
verses.textEnNlt: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, "Look, these are my mother and brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: And extending His hand toward His disciples, He said, "Behold: My mother and My brothers!
verses.textEn: Pointing to his disciples, he said, <red>“Here are my mother and my brothers.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是遵行我天父旨意的，就是我的弟兄、姊妹和母亲了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是遵行我天父旨意的，就是我的弟兄、姊妹和母亲了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother."
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother!"
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever does the will of My Father who is in heaven, he is My brother, and sister, and mother."
verses.textEn: <red>For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那一天，耶稣从房子里出来，坐在海边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，耶稣从房子里出来，坐在海边。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那一天，耶稣从房子里出来，坐在海边。
verses.textEnNiv: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.
verses.textEnEsv: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat beside the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Later that same day Jesus left the house and sat beside the lake.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day Jesus had gone out of the house and was sitting by the sea.
verses.textEn: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.

verses.textZh: 有很多人聚集到他那里。于是，他上船坐下来，众人都站在岸上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有很多人聚集到他那里。于是，他上船坐下来，众人都站在岸上。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下，众人都站在岸上。
verses.textEnNiv: Such large crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people stood on the shore.
verses.textEnEsv: And great crowds gathered about him, so that he got into a boat and sat down. And the whole crowd stood on the beach.
verses.textEnNkjv: And great multitudes were gathered together to Him, so that He got into a boat and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.textEnNlt: A large crowd soon gathered around him, so he got into a boat. Then he sat there and taught as the people stood on the shore.
verses.textEnNasb: And large crowds gathered to Him, so He got into a boat and sat down, and the whole crowd was standing on the beach.
verses.textEn: Such large crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people stood on the shore.

verses.textZh: 他用比喻对众人讲了许多事，说："<red>有一个撒种的出去撒种。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用比喻对众人讲了许多事，说："<red>有一个撒种的出去撒种。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他用比喻对他们讲许多道理，说：「有一个撒种的出去撒种；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he told them many things in parables, saying: <red>“A farmer went out to sow his seed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he told them many things in parables, saying: "A sower went out to sow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spoke many things to them in parables, saying: "Behold, a sower went out to sow.
verses.textEnNlt: He told many stories in the form of parables, such as this one: "Listen! A farmer went out to plant some seeds.
verses.textEnNasb: And He told them many things in parables, saying, "Behold, the sower went out to sow;
verses.textEn: Then he told them many things in parables, saying: <red>“A farmer went out to sow his seed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>撒的时候，有的落在路旁，小鸟飞来就吃掉了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>撒的时候，有的落在路旁，小鸟飞来就吃掉了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as he sowed, some seeds fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as he sowed, some seed fell by the wayside; and the birds came and devoured them.
verses.textEnNlt: As he scattered them across his field, some seeds fell on a footpath, and the birds came and ate them.
verses.textEnNasb: and as he sowed, some seeds fell beside the road, and the birds came and ate them up.
verses.textEn: <red>As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在泥土不多的石地上，因为泥土不深，很快就长起来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在泥土不多的石地上，因为泥土不深，很快就长起来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Other seeds fell on rocky ground, where they did not have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, since they had no depth of soil,
verses.textEnNkjv: Some fell on stony places, where they did not have much earth; and they immediately sprang up because they had no depth of earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Other seeds fell on shallow soil with underlying rock. The seeds sprouted quickly because the soil was shallow.
verses.textEnNasb: Others fell on the rocky places, where they did not have much soil; and they sprang up immediately, because they had no depth of soil.
verses.textEn: <red>Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但太阳一出来，就把它晒干，又因为没有根就枯萎了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但太阳一出来，就把它晒干，又因为没有根就枯萎了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but when the sun rose they were scorched. And since they had no root, they withered away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the sun was up they were scorched, and because they had no root they withered away.
verses.textEnNlt: But the plants soon wilted under the hot sun, and since they didn’t have deep roots, they died.
verses.textEnNasb: But after the sun rose, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.textEn: <red>But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在荆棘里，荆棘长大了，就把它挤住。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在荆棘里，荆棘长大了，就把它挤住。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Other seeds fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up and choked them.
verses.textEnNlt: Other seeds fell among thorns that grew up and choked out the tender plants.
verses.textEnNasb: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked them out.
verses.textEn: <red>Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在好土里，结出果实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在好土里，结出果实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有落在好土里的，就结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop—a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Other seeds fell on good soil and produced grain, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.textEnNkjv: But others fell on good ground and yielded a crop: some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.textEnNlt: Still other seeds fell on fertile soil, and they produced a crop that was thirty, sixty, and even a hundred times as much as had been planted!
verses.textEnNasb: But others fell on the good soil and yielded a crop, some a hundred, some sixty, and some thirty times as much.
verses.textEn: <red>Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop—a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有耳的，就应当听。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有耳的，就应当听。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有耳可听的，就应当听！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has ears, let him hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has ears, let him hear."
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒上前问耶稣："你对他们讲话，为甚么用比喻呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒上前问耶稣："你对他们讲话，为甚么用比喻呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「对众人讲话，为什么用比喻呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples came to him and asked, "Why do you speak to the people in parables?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the disciples came and said to him, "Why do you speak to them in parables?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the disciples came and said to Him, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"
verses.textEnNlt: His disciples came and asked him, "Why do you use parables when you talk to the people?"
verses.textEnNasb: And the disciples came up and said to Him, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"
verses.textEn: The disciples came to him and asked, "Why do you speak to the people in parables?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："天国的奥秘，只给你们知道，却不给他们知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："天国的奥秘，只给你们知道，却不给他们知道。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「因为天国的奥秘只叫你们知道，不叫他们知道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“Because the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered them, "To you it has been given to know the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been given.
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said to them, "Because it has been given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been given.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "You are permitted to understand the secrets of the Kingdom of Heaven, but others are not.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus answered them, "To you it has been granted to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been granted.
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“Because the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为凡是有的，还要给他，他就充足有余；凡是没有的，就连他有甚么也要拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为凡是有的，还要给他，他就充足有余；凡是没有的，就连他有甚么也要拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；凡没有的，连他所有的，也要夺去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For to the one who has, more will be given, and he will have an abundance, but from the one who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever has, to him more will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
verses.textEnNlt: To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given, and they will have an abundance of knowledge. But for those who are not listening, even what little understanding they have will be taken away from them.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever has, to him more shall be given, and he will have an abundance; but whoever does not have, even what he has shall be taken away from him.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此，我用比喻对他们讲话，因为他们看却看不见，听也听不到，也不明白。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此，我用比喻对他们讲话，因为他们看却看不见，听也听不到，也不明白。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以我用比喻对他们讲，是因他们看也看不见，听也听不见，也不明白。</red>
