verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is why I speak to them in parables: “Thoughpn seeing, they do not see; thoughld hearing, they do not hear or understand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This is why I speak to them in parables, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I use these parables, For they look, but they don’t really see. They hear, but they don’t really listen or understand.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I speak to them in parables; because while seeing they do not see, and while hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.
verses.textEn: <red>This is why I speak to them in parables: “Thoughpn seeing, they do not see; thoughld hearing, they do not hear or understand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>以赛亚的预言，正应验在他们身上，他说： ‘你们听是听见了，总是不明白； 看是看见了，总是不领悟。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>以赛亚的预言，正应验在他们身上，他说： ‘你们听是听见了，总是不明白； 看是看见了，总是不领悟。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在他们身上，正应了以赛亚的预言，说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Inp them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah: “ ‘Youpn will be ever hearing but never understanding; yould will be ever seeing but never perceiving.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, in their case the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled that says: "‘"You will indeed hear but never understand, and you will indeed see but never perceive."
verses.textEnNkjv: And in them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says: ‘Hearing you will hear and shall not understand, And seeing you will see and not perceive;
verses.textEnNlt: This fulfills the prophecy of Isaiah that says, ‘When you hear what I say, you will not understand. When you see what I do, you will not comprehend.
verses.textEnNasb: And in their case the prophecy of Isaiah is being fulfilled, which says, ‘ You shall keep on listening, but shall not understand; And you shall keep on looking, but shall not perceive;
verses.textEn: <red>Inp them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah: “ ‘Youpn will be ever hearing but never understanding; yould will be ever seeing but never perceiving.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为这人民的心思迟钝， 用不灵的耳朵去听， 又闭上了眼睛； 免得自己眼睛看见，耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医好他们。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为这人民的心思迟钝， 用不灵的耳朵去听， 又闭上了眼睛； 免得自己眼睛看见，耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医好他们。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为这百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛闭着， 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Forln this people’s heart has become calloused; theyld hardly hear with their ears, andld they have closed their eyes. Otherwiseln they might see with their eyes, hearld with their ears, understandld with their hearts andln turn, and I would heal them.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For this people’s heart has grown dull, and with their ears they can barely hear, and their eyes they have closed, lest they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears and understand with their heart and turn, and I would heal them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For the hearts of this people have grown dull. Theirears are hard of hearing, And their eyes they have closed, Lest they should see withtheireyes and hear withtheirears, Lest they should understand withtheirhearts and turn, So that I should heal them.’
verses.textEnNlt: For the hearts of these people are hardened, and their ears cannot hear, and they have closed their eyes— so their eyes cannot see, and their ears cannot hear, and their hearts cannot understand, and they cannot turn to me and let me heal them.’
verses.textEnNasb: For the heart of this people has become dull, With their ears they scarcely hear, And they have closed their eyes, Otherwise they might see with their eyes, Hear with their ears, Understand with their heart, and return, And I would heal them.’
verses.textEn: <red>Forln this people’s heart has become calloused; theyld hardly hear with their ears, andld they have closed their eyes. Otherwiseln they might see with their eyes, hearld with their ears, understandld with their hearts andln turn, and I would heal them.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们的眼睛是有福的，因为可以看见；你们的耳朵是有福的，因为可以听见。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们的眼睛是有福的，因为可以看见；你们的耳朵是有福的，因为可以听见。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「但你们的眼睛是有福的，因为看见了；你们的耳朵也是有福的，因为听见了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Butp blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see, and your ears, for they hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: But blessed are your eyes for they see, and your ears for they hear;
verses.textEnNlt: "But blessed are your eyes, because they see; and your ears, because they hear.
verses.textEnNasb: But blessed are your eyes, because they see; and your ears, because they hear.
verses.textEn: <red>Butp blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，曾经有许多先知和义人想看你们所看见的，却没有看到，想听你们所听见的，却没有听到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，曾经有许多先知和义人想看你们所看见的，却没有看到，想听你们所听见的，却没有听到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，从前有许多先知和义人要看你们所看的，却没有看见，要听你们所听的，却没有听见。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For truly, I say to you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, and did not see it, and to hear what you hear, and did not hear it.
verses.textEnNkjv: for assuredly, I say to you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see what you see, and did not see it, and to hear what you hear, and did not hear it.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, but they didn’t see it. And they longed to hear what you hear, but they didn’t hear it.
verses.textEnNasb: For truly I say to you that many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, and did not see it, and to hear what you hear, and did not hear it.
verses.textEn: <red>For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"所以你们要听这撒种人的比喻。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"所以你们要听这撒种人的比喻。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「所以，你们当听这撒种的比喻。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Listenp then to what the parable of the sower means:</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear then the parable of the sower:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore hear the parable of the sower:
verses.textEnNlt: "Now listen to the explanation of the parable about the farmer planting seeds:
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen then to the parable of the sower.
verses.textEn: <red>“Listenp then to what the parable of the sower means:</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是听了天国的道却不明白的，那恶者就来把撒在他心中的夺去。这就是撒在路旁的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是听了天国的道却不明白的，那恶者就来把撒在他心中的夺去。这就是撒在路旁的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡听见天国道理不明白的，那恶者就来，把所撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是撒在路旁的了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When anyone hears the message about the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in their heart. This is the seed sown along the path.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown along the path.
verses.textEnNkjv: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom, and does not understand it, then the wicked one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is he who received seed by the wayside.
verses.textEnNlt: The seed that fell on the footpath represents those who hear the message about the Kingdom and don’t understand it. Then the evil one comes and snatches away the seed that was planted in their hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what has been sown in his heart. This is the one sown with seed beside the road.
verses.textEn: <red>When anyone hears the message about the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in their heart. This is the seed sown along the path.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那撒在石地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢欢喜喜地接受，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那撒在石地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢欢喜喜地接受，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，当下欢喜领受，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The seed falling on rocky ground refers to someone who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As for what was sown on rocky ground, this is the one who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy,
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who received the seed on stony places, this is he who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;
verses.textEnNlt: The seed on the rocky soil represents those who hear the message and immediately receive it with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: The one sown with seed on the rocky places, this is the one who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;
verses.textEn: <red>The seed falling on rocky ground refers to someone who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是他里面没有根，只是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难，受到迫害，就立刻跌倒了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是他里面没有根，只是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难，受到迫害，就立刻跌倒了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只因心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while, and when tribulation or persecution arises on account of the word, immediately he falls away.
verses.textEnNkjv: yet he has no root in himself, but endures only for a while. For when tribulation or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
verses.textEnNlt: But since they don’t have deep roots, they don’t last long. They fall away as soon as they have problems or are persecuted for believing God’s word.
verses.textEnNasb: yet he has no firm root in himself, but is only temporary, and when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately he falls away.
verses.textEn: <red>But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，有今世的忧虑和财富的迷惑把道挤住，结不出果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，有今世的忧虑和财富的迷惑把道挤住，结不出果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑把道挤住了，不能结实。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The seed falling among the thorns refers to someone who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, making it unfruitful.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As for what was sown among thorns, this is the one who hears the word, but the cares of the world and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and it proves unfruitful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he who received seed among the thorns is he who hears the word, and the cares of this world and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
verses.textEnNlt: The seed that fell among the thorns represents those who hear God’s word, but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the worries of this life and the lure of wealth, so no fruit is produced.
verses.textEnNasb: And the one sown with seed among the thorns, this is the one who hears the word, and the anxiety of the world and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.textEn: <red>The seed falling among the thorns refers to someone who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, making it unfruitful.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，又明白了，结出果实来，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，又明白了，结出果实来，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒在好地上的，就是人听道明白了，后来结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the seed falling on good soil refers to someone who hears the word and understands it. This is the one who produces a crop, yielding a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As for what was sown on good soil, this is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and yields, in one case a hundredfold, in another sixty, and in another thirty."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who received seed on the good ground is he who hears the word and understands it, who indeed bears fruit and produces: some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty."
verses.textEnNlt: The seed that fell on good soil represents those who truly hear and understand God’s word and produce a harvest of thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as had been planted!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the one sown with seed on the good soil, this is the one who hears the word and understands it, who indeed bears fruit and produces, some a hundred, some sixty, and some thirty times as much."
verses.textEn: <red>But the seed falling on good soil refers to someone who hears the word and understands it. This is the one who produces a crop, yielding a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们另外讲了一个比喻，说："<red>天国好象人把好的种子撒在田里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们另外讲了一个比喻，说："<red>天国好象人把好的种子撒在田里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像人撒好种在田里，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus told them another parable: <red>“The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He put another parable before them, saying, "The kingdom of heaven may be compared to a man who sowed good seed in his field,
verses.textEnNkjv: Another parable He put forth to them, saying: "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field;
verses.textEnNlt: Here is another story Jesus told: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a farmer who planted good seed in his field.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus presented another parable to them, saying, "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
verses.textEn: Jesus told them another parable: <red>“The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人们睡了的时候，他的仇敌来把稗子撒在麦子中间，就走了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人们睡了的时候，他的仇敌来把稗子撒在麦子中间，就走了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>及至人睡觉的时候，有仇敌来，将稗子撒在麦子里就走了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But while everyone was sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but while his men were sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat and went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat and went his way.
verses.textEnNlt: But that night as the workers slept, his enemy came and planted weeds among the wheat, then slipped away.
verses.textEnNasb: But while his men were sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and left.
verses.textEn: <red>But while everyone was sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了发苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了发苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到长苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When the wheat sprouted and formed heads, then the weeds also appeared.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So when the plants came up and bore grain, then the weeds appeared also.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the grain had sprouted and produced a crop, then the tares also appeared.
verses.textEnNlt: When the crop began to grow and produce grain, the weeds also grew.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the wheat sprouted and produced grain, then the weeds also became evident.
verses.textEn: <red>When the wheat sprouted and formed heads, then the weeds also appeared.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>仆人都前来问家主：‘主人，你不是把好的种子撒在田里吗？那些稗子是从哪里来的呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>仆人都前来问家主：‘主人，你不是把好的种子撒在田里吗？那些稗子是从哪里来的呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>田主的仆人来告诉他说：『主啊，你不是撒好种在田里吗？从哪里来的稗子呢？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the servants of the master of the house came and said to him, ‘Master, did you not sow good seed in your field? How then does it have weeds?’
verses.textEnNkjv: So the servants of the owner came and said to him, ‘Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? How then does it have tares?’
verses.textEnNlt: "The farmer’s workers went to him and said, ‘Sir, the field where you planted that good seed is full of weeds! Where did they come from?’
verses.textEnNasb: And the slaves of the landowner came and said to him, ‘Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? How then does it have weeds?’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他回答：‘这是仇敌所作的。’仆人问他：‘你要我们去拔掉它吗？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他回答：‘这是仇敌所作的。’仆人问他：‘你要我们去拔掉它吗？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人说：『这是仇敌做的。』仆人说：『你要我们去薅出来吗？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Anp enemy did this,’ he replied. “Thep servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ So the servants said to him, ‘Then do you want us to go and gather them?’
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ The servants said to him, ‘Do you want us then to go and gather them up?’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘An enemy has done this!’ the farmer exclaimed. "‘Should we pull out the weeds?’ they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, ‘ An enemy has done this!’ The slaves *said to him, ‘Do you want us, then, to go and gather them up?’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Anp enemy did this,’ he replied. “Thep servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他说：‘不用，因为拔稗子的时候，恐怕也把麦子连根拔出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说：‘不用，因为拔稗子的时候，恐怕也把麦子连根拔出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人说：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，连麦子也拔出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘No,’p he answered, ‘because while you are pulling the weeds, you may uproot the wheat with them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, ‘No, lest in gathering the weeds you root up the wheat along with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, ‘No, lest while you gather up the tares you also uproot the wheat with them.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘No,’ he replied, ‘you’ll uproot the wheat if you do.
verses.textEnNasb: But he *said, ‘No; while you are gathering up the weeds, you may uproot the wheat with them.
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘No,’p he answered, ‘because while you are pulling the weeds, you may uproot the wheat with them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>收割之前，让它们一同生长。到了收割的时候，我会吩咐收割的工人先拔掉稗子，捆起来，留着焚烧，却要把麦子收进我的仓里。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>收割之前，让它们一同生长。到了收割的时候，我会吩咐收割的工人先拔掉稗子，捆起来，留着焚烧，却要把麦子收进我的仓里。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>容这两样一齐长，等着收割。当收割的时候，我要对收割的人说，先将稗子薅出来，捆成捆，留着烧；惟有麦子要收在仓里。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat and bring it into my barn.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Let both grow together until the harvest, and at harvest time I will tell the reapers, "Gather the weeds first and bind them in bundles to be burned, but gather the wheat into my barn."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let both grow together until the harvest, and at the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, "First gather together the tares and bind them in bundles to burn them, but gather the wheat into my barn." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Let both grow together until the harvest. Then I will tell the harvesters to sort out the weeds, tie them into bundles, and burn them, and to put the wheat in the barn.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Allow both to grow together until the harvest; and at the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, "First gather up the weeds and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn." ’ "
verses.textEn: <red>Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat and bring it into my barn.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们讲了另外一个比喻，说："<red>天国好象一粒芥菜种，人拿去把它种在田里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们讲了另外一个比喻，说："<red>天国好象一粒芥菜种，人拿去把它种在田里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在田里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He told them another parable: <red>“The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He put another parable before them, saying, "The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed that a man took and sowed in his field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Another parable He put forth to them, saying: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field,
verses.textEnNlt: Here is another illustration Jesus used: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a mustard seed planted in a field.
verses.textEnNasb: He presented another parable to them, saying, "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a person took and sowed in his field;
verses.textEn: He told them another parable: <red>“The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>它是种子中最小的，但长大了，却比其他的蔬菜都大，成为一棵树，甚至天空的飞鸟也来在它的枝头搭窝。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>它是种子中最小的，但长大了，却比其他的蔬菜都大，成为一棵树，甚至天空的飞鸟也来在它的枝头搭窝。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这原是百种里最小的，等到长起来，却比各样的菜都大，且成了树，天上的飞鸟来宿在它的枝上。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds come and perch in its branches.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is the smallest of all seeds, but when it has grown it is larger than all the garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and make nests in its branches."
verses.textEnNkjv: which indeed is the least of all the seeds; but when it is grown it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches."
verses.textEnNlt: It is the smallest of all seeds, but it becomes the largest of garden plants; it grows into a tree, and birds come and make nests in its branches."
verses.textEnNasb: and this is smaller than all the other seeds, but when it is fully grown, it is larger than the garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the sky come and nest in its branches."
verses.textEn: <red>Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds come and perch in its branches.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他对他们讲了另一个比喻："<red>天国好象面酵，妇女拿去放在三斗面里，直到全团发起来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他们讲了另一个比喻："<red>天国好象面酵，妇女拿去放在三斗面里，直到全团发起来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对他们讲个比喻说：「<red>天国好像面酵，有妇人拿来，藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He told them still another parable: <red>“The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He told them another parable. "The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, till it was all leavened."
verses.textEnNkjv: Another parable He spoke to them: "The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal till it was all leavened."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus also used this illustration: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like the yeast a woman used in making bread. Even though she put only a little yeast in three measures of flour, it permeated every part of the dough."
verses.textEnNasb: He spoke another parable to them: "The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three sata of flour until it was all leavened."
verses.textEn: He told them still another parable: <red>“The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣用比喻向群众讲了这一切，他所讲的，没有不用比喻的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣用比喻向群众讲了这一切，他所讲的，没有不用比喻的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是耶稣用比喻对众人说的话；若不用比喻，就不对他们说什么。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd in parables; he did not say anything to them without using a parable.
verses.textEnEsv: All these things Jesus said to the crowds in parables; indeed, he said nothing to them without a parable.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these things Jesus spoke to the multitude in parables; and without a parable He did not speak to them,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus always used stories and illustrations like these when speaking to the crowds. In fact, he never spoke to them without using such parables.
verses.textEnNasb: All these things Jesus spoke to the crowds in parables, and He did not speak anything to them without a parable.
verses.textEn: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd in parables; he did not say anything to them without using a parable.

verses.textZh: 这就应验了先知所说的： "我要开口用比喻， 把创世以来隐秘的事说出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就应验了先知所说的： "我要开口用比喻， 把创世以来隐秘的事说出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是要应验先知的话，说： 我要开口用比喻， 把创世以来所隐藏的事发明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: "I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter things hidden since the creation of the world."
verses.textEnEsv: This was to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet: "I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter what has been hidden since the foundation of the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying: "I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things kept secret from the foundation of the world."
verses.textEnNlt: This fulfilled what God had spoken through the prophet: "I will speak to you in parables. I will explain things hidden since the creation of the world. "
verses.textEnNasb: This was so that what was spoken through the prophet would be fulfilled: "I will open My mouth in parables; I will proclaim things hidden since the foundation of the world."
verses.textEn: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: "I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter things hidden since the creation of the world."

verses.textZh: 耶稣离开群众，进到屋里，门徒前来问他："请你给我们解释田里稗子的比喻。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣离开群众，进到屋里，门徒前来问他："请你给我们解释田里稗子的比喻。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，耶稣离开众人，进了房子。他的门徒进前来，说：「请把田间稗子的比喻讲给我们听。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he left the crowds and went into the house. And his disciples came to him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away and went into the house. And His disciples came to Him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the tares of the field."
verses.textEnNlt: Then, leaving the crowds outside, Jesus went into the house. His disciples said, "Please explain to us the story of the weeds in the field."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He left the crowds and went into the house. And His disciples came to Him and said, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field."
verses.textEn: Then he left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field."

verses.textZh: 他回答："那撒好种子的是人子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："那撒好种子的是人子，
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他回答说：「那撒好种的就是人子；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, <red>“The one who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "The one who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said to them: "He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "The Son of Man is the farmer who plants the good seed.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "The one who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
verses.textEn: He answered, <red>“The one who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>田就是世界，好种子就是属天国的人，稗子就是属那恶者的人，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>田就是世界，好种子就是属天国的人，稗子就是属那恶者的人，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>田地就是世界；好种就是天国之子；稗子就是那恶者之子；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the people of the kingdom. The weeds are the people of the evil one,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The field is the world, and the good seed is the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
verses.textEnNkjv: The field is the world, the good seeds are the sons of the kingdom, but the tares are the sons of the wicked one.
verses.textEnNlt: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the people of the Kingdom. The weeds are the people who belong to the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: and the field is the world; and as for the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the weeds are the sons of the evil one;
verses.textEn: <red>The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the people of the kingdom. The weeds are the people of the evil one,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>撒稗子的仇敌是魔鬼，收割的时候是这世代的终结，收割的工人是天使。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>撒稗子的仇敌是魔鬼，收割的时候是这世代的终结，收割的工人是天使。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒稗子的仇敌就是魔鬼；收割的时候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
verses.textEnNkjv: The enemy who sowed them is the devil, the harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are the angels.
verses.textEnNlt: The enemy who planted the weeds among the wheat is the devil. The harvest is the end of the world, and the harvesters are the angels.
verses.textEnNasb: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil, and the harvest is the end of the age; and the reapers are angels.
verses.textEn: <red>and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>稗子怎样被拔掉用火焚烧，在这世代终结的时候，也是一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>稗子怎样被拔掉用火焚烧，在这世代终结的时候，也是一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>将稗子薅出来用火焚烧，世界的末了也要如此。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Asp the weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Just as the weeds are gathered and burned with fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore as the tares are gathered and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of this age.
verses.textEnNlt: "Just as the weeds are sorted out and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: So just as the weeds are gathered up and burned with fire, so shall it be at the end of the age.
verses.textEn: <red>“Asp the weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，人子要差派他的使者，把一切使人犯罪的事和不法之徒，从他的国中拔掉，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，人子要差派他的使者，把一切使人犯罪的事和不法之徒，从他的国中拔掉，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作恶的，从他国里挑出来，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will weed out of his kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The Son of Man will send his angels, and they will gather out of his kingdom all causes of sin and all law-breakers,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom all things that offend, and those who practice lawlessness,
verses.textEnNlt: The Son of Man will send his angels, and they will remove from his Kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.
verses.textEnNasb: The Son of Man will send forth His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom all stumbling blocks, and those who commit lawlessness,
verses.textEn: <red>The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will weed out of his kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>丢进火炉，在那里必要哀哭切齿。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>丢进火炉，在那里必要哀哭切齿。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and throw them into the fiery furnace. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: And the angels will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNasb: and they will throw them into the furnace of fire; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEn: <red>They will throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，义人在他们父的国中，要像太阳一样的照耀。有耳的，就应当听。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，义人在他们父的国中，要像太阳一样的照耀。有耳的，就应当听。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，义人在他们父的国里，要发出光来，像太阳一样。有耳可听的，就应当听！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the righteous will shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in their Father’s Kingdom. Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the righteous will shine forth like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. The one who has ears, let him hear.
verses.textEn: <red>Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"天国好象藏在田里的宝贝，有人发现了，就把它藏起来，高高兴兴地离去，变卖了他的一切，来买那田地。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"天国好象藏在田里的宝贝，有人发现了，就把它藏起来，高高兴兴地离去，变卖了他的一切，来买那田地。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「天国好像宝贝藏在地里，人遇见了就把它藏起来，欢欢喜喜地去变卖一切所有的，买这块地。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field, which a man found and covered up. Then in his joy he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field, which a man found and hid; and for joy over it he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure that a man discovered hidden in a field. In his excitement, he hid it again and sold everything he owned to get enough money to buy the field.
verses.textEnNasb: "The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid again; and from joy over it he goes and sells everything that he has, and buys that field.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"天国好象一个商人，搜罗宝贵的珍珠。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"天国好象一个商人，搜罗宝贵的珍珠。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天国又好像买卖人寻找好珠子，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Again,p the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking beautiful pearls,
verses.textEnNlt: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a merchant on the lookout for choice pearls.
verses.textEnNasb: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking fine pearls,
verses.textEn: <red>“Again,p the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他发现了一颗极贵重的珍珠，就离去，变卖了他的一切，来买那颗珍珠。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他发现了一颗极贵重的珍珠，就离去，变卖了他的一切，来买那颗珍珠。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>遇见一颗重价的珠子，就去变卖他一切所有的，买了这颗珠子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When he found one of great value, he went away and sold everything he had and bought it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: who, on finding one pearl of great value, went and sold all that he had and bought it.
verses.textEnNkjv: who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had and bought it.
verses.textEnNlt: When he discovered a pearl of great value, he sold everything he owned and bought it!
verses.textEnNasb: and upon finding one pearl of great value, he went and sold everything that he had and bought it.
verses.textEn: <red>When he found one of great value, he went away and sold everything he had and bought it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"天国又好象一个网，撒在海里，网到各样的鱼。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"天国又好象一个网，撒在海里，网到各样的鱼。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天国又好像网撒在海里，聚拢各样水族，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Oncep again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was let down into the lake and caught all kinds of fish.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was thrown into the sea and gathered fish of every kind.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some of every kind,
verses.textEnNlt: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a fishing net that was thrown into the water and caught fish of every kind.
verses.textEnNasb: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered fish of every kind;
verses.textEn: <red>“Oncep again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was let down into the lake and caught all kinds of fish.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>网满了之后，人就把网拉上岸，坐下来把好的拣出，收藏起来，不好的就丢在外面。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>网满了之后，人就把网拉上岸，坐下来把好的拣出，收藏起来，不好的就丢在外面。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>网既满了，人就拉上岸来，坐下，拣好的收在器具里，将不好的丢弃了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When it was full, the fishermen pulled it up on the shore. Then they sat down and collected the good fish in baskets, but threw the bad away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When it was full, men drew it ashore and sat down and sorted the good into containers but threw away the bad.
verses.textEnNkjv: which, when it was full, they drew to shore; and they sat down and gathered the good into vessels, but threw the bad away.
verses.textEnNlt: When the net was full, they dragged it up onto the shore, sat down, and sorted the good fish into crates, but threw the bad ones away.
verses.textEnNasb: and when it was filled, they pulled it up on the beach; and they sat down and gathered the good fish into containers, but the bad they threw away.
verses.textEn: <red>When it was full, the fishermen pulled it up on the shore. Then they sat down and collected the good fish in baskets, but threw the bad away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这世代终结的时候，也是一样。那时天使要出去，把恶人从义人中分别出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这世代终结的时候，也是一样。那时天使要出去，把恶人从义人中分别出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>世界的末了也要这样。天使要出来，从义人中把恶人分别出来，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is how it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come out and separate the evil from the righteous
verses.textEnNkjv: So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come forth, separate the wicked from among the just,
verses.textEnNlt: That is the way it will be at the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked people from the righteous,
verses.textEnNasb: So it will be at the end of the age: the angels will come forth and remove the wicked from among the righteous,
verses.textEn: <red>This is how it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous</red>

verses.textZh: <red>丢进火炉，在那里必要哀哭切齿。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>丢进火炉，在那里必要哀哭切齿。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and throw them into the fiery furnace. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth."
verses.textEnNlt: throwing the wicked into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNasb: and they will throw them into the furnace of fire; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEn: <red>and throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"这一切你们明白吗？"他们回答："明白。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"这一切你们明白吗？"他们回答："明白。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>这一切的话你们都明白了吗？</red>」他们说：「<red>我们明白了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Havep you understood all these things?”</red> Jesus asked. “Yes,” they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you understood all these things?" They said to him, "Yes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "Have you understood all these things?" They said to Him, "Yes, Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Do you understand all these things?" "Yes," they said, "we do."
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you understood all these things?" They *said to Him, "Yes."
verses.textEn: <red>“Havep you understood all these things?”</red> Jesus asked. “Yes,” they replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>所以，每一个作天国门徒的经学家，就像家主从宝库中拿出新和旧的东西来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>所以，每一个作天国门徒的经学家，就像家主从宝库中拿出新和旧的东西来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「<red>凡文士受教作天国的门徒，就像一个家主从他库里拿出新旧的东西来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“Therefore every teacher of the law who has become a disciple in the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Therefore every scribe who has been trained for the kingdom of heaven is like a master of a house, who brings out of his treasure what is new and what is old."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Therefore every scribe instructed concerning the kingdom of heaven is like a householder who brings out of his treasure things new and old."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he added, "Every teacher of religious law who becomes a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a homeowner who brings from his storeroom new gems of truth as well as old."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "Therefore every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like a head of a household, who brings out of his treasure new things and old."
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“Therefore every teacher of the law who has become a disciple in the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣讲完了这些比喻，就离开那地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣讲完了这些比喻，就离开那地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说完了这些比喻，就离开那里，
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus had finished these parables, he went away from there,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, that He departed from there.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus had finished telling these stories and illustrations, he left that part of the country.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus had finished these parables, He departed from there.
verses.textEn: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.

verses.textZh: 他回到自己的家乡，在会堂里教导人，众人都惊奇，说："这个人的智慧和能力是从哪里来的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回到自己的家乡，在会堂里教导人，众人都惊奇，说："这个人的智慧和能力是从哪里来的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 来到自己的家乡，在会堂里教训人，甚至他们都希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这等智慧和异能呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Coming to his hometown, he began teaching the people in their synagogue, and they were amazed. "Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?" they asked.
verses.textEnEsv: and coming to his hometown he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, "Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had come to His own country, He taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, "Where did this Man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
verses.textEnNlt: He returned to Nazareth, his hometown. When he taught there in the synagogue, everyone was amazed and said, "Where does he get this wisdom and the power to do miracles?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He came to His hometown and began teaching them in their synagogue, with the result that they were astonished, and said, "Where did this man acquire this wisdom and these miraculous powers?
verses.textEn: Coming to his hometown, he began teaching the people in their synagogue, and they were amazed. "Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?" they asked.

verses.textZh: 他不是木匠的儿子吗？他母亲不是马利亚，他弟弟不是雅各、约瑟、西门和犹大吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不是木匠的儿子吗？他母亲不是马利亚，他弟弟不是雅各、约瑟、西门和犹大吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这不是木匠的儿子吗？他母亲不是叫马利亚吗？他弟兄们不是叫雅各、约西 、西门、犹大吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother’s name Mary, and aren’t his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? Is not his mother called Mary? And are not his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is this not the carpenter’s son? Is not His mother called Mary? And His brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
verses.textEnNlt: Then they scoffed, "He’s just the carpenter’s son, and we know Mary, his mother, and his brothers—James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas.
verses.textEnNasb: Is this not the carpenter’s son? Is His mother not called Mary, and His brothers, James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
verses.textEn: "Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother’s name Mary, and aren’t his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas?

verses.textZh: 他妹妹不是都在我们这里吗？他这一切是从哪里来的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他妹妹不是都在我们这里吗？他这一切是从哪里来的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他妹妹们不是都在我们这里吗？这人从哪里有这一切的事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Aren’t all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?"
verses.textEnEsv: And are not all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And His sisters, are they not all with us? Where then did this Man get all these things?"
verses.textEnNlt: All his sisters live right here among us. Where did he learn all these things?"
verses.textEnNasb: And His sisters, are they not all with us? Where then did this Man acquire all these things?"
verses.textEn: Aren’t all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?"

verses.textZh: 他们就厌弃耶稣。耶稣对他们说："<red>先知除了在本乡本家之外，没有不受人尊敬的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就厌弃耶稣。耶稣对他们说："<red>先知除了在本乡本家之外，没有不受人尊敬的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就厌弃他 。耶稣对他们说：「<red>大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, <red>“A prophet is not without honor except in his own town and in his own home.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his hometown and in his own household."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they were offended at Him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own country and in his own house."
verses.textEnNlt: And they were deeply offended and refused to believe in him. Then Jesus told them, "A prophet is honored everywhere except in his own hometown and among his own family."
verses.textEnNasb: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not dishonored except in his hometown and in his own household."
verses.textEn: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, <red>“A prophet is not without honor except in his own town and in his own home.”</red>

verses.textZh: 因为他们不信，他就不在那里多行神迹了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们不信，他就不在那里多行神迹了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣因为他们不信，就在那里不多行异能了。
verses.textEnNiv: And he did not do many miracles there because of their lack of faith.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did not do many mighty works there, because of their unbelief.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He did not do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.textEnNlt: And so he did only a few miracles there because of their unbelief.
verses.textEnNasb: And He did not do many miracles there because of their unbelief.
verses.textEn: And he did not do many miracles there because of their lack of faith.

verses.textZh: 那时，分封王希律听见耶稣的名声，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，分封王希律听见耶稣的名声，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，分封的王希律听见耶稣的名声，
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard about the fame of Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the report about Jesus
verses.textEnNlt: When Herod Antipas, the ruler of Galilee, heard about Jesus,
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the news about Jesus,
verses.textEn: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,

verses.textZh: 就对臣仆说："这人是施洗的约翰，他从死人中复活，所以他身上有行神迹的能力。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对臣仆说："这人是施洗的约翰，他从死人中复活，所以他身上有行神迹的能力。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就对臣仆说：「这是施洗的约翰从死里复活，所以这些异能从他里面发出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: and he said to his attendants, "This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him."
verses.textEnEsv: and he said to his servants, "This is John the Baptist. He has been raised from the dead; that is why these miraculous powers are at work in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to his servants, "This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him."
verses.textEnNlt: he said to his advisers, "This must be John the Baptist raised from the dead! That is why he can do such miracles."
verses.textEnNasb: and said to his servants, "This is John the Baptist; he himself has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him."
verses.textEn: and he said to his attendants, "This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him."

verses.textZh: 原来希律为了他弟弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，拘捕了约翰，把他捆绑，关在监里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来希律为了他弟弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，拘捕了约翰，把他捆绑，关在监里，
verses.textZhCuv: 起先，希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，把约翰拿住，锁在监里。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
verses.textEnEsv: For Herod had seized John and bound him and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: For Herod had laid hold of John and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: For Herod had arrested and imprisoned John as a favor to his wife Herodias (the former wife of Herod’s brother Philip).
verses.textEnNasb: For when Herod had John arrested, he bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip.
verses.textEn: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,

verses.textZh: 因为约翰多次告诉他："你占有她是不合理的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为约翰多次告诉他："你占有她是不合理的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为约翰曾对他说：「你娶这妇人是不合理的。」
verses.textEnNiv: for John had been saying to him: "It is not lawful for you to have her."
verses.textEnEsv: because John had been saying to him, "It is not lawful for you to have her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Because John had said to him, "It is not lawful for you to have her."
verses.textEnNlt: John had been telling Herod, "It is against God’s law for you to marry her."
verses.textEnNasb: For John had been saying to him, "It is not lawful for you to have her."
verses.textEn: for John had been saying to him: "It is not lawful for you to have her."

verses.textZh: 他想杀约翰，但又害怕群众，因为他们都认为约翰是个先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他想杀约翰，但又害怕群众，因为他们都认为约翰是个先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律就想要杀他，只是怕百姓，因为他们以约翰为先知。
verses.textEnNiv: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of the people, because they considered John a prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: And though he wanted to put him to death, he feared the people, because they held him to be a prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And although he wanted to put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of a riot, because all the people believed John was a prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: Although Herod wanted to put him to death, he feared the crowd, because they regarded John as a prophet.
verses.textEn: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of the people, because they considered John a prophet.

verses.textZh: 到了希律生日的那天，希罗底的女儿在众人面前跳舞，希律非常高兴，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了希律生日的那天，希罗底的女儿在众人面前跳舞，希律非常高兴，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了希律的生日，希罗底的女儿在众人面前跳舞，使希律欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: On Herod’s birthday the daughter of Herodias danced for the guests and pleased Herod so much
verses.textEnEsv: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced before the company and pleased Herod,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Herod’s birthday was celebrated, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod.
verses.textEnNlt: But at a birthday party for Herod, Herodias’s daughter performed a dance that greatly pleased him,
verses.textEnNasb: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod,
verses.textEn: On Herod’s birthday the daughter of Herodias danced for the guests and pleased Herod so much

verses.textZh: 就起誓答应她，无论求甚么都给她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就起誓答应她，无论求甚么都给她。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律就起誓，应许随她所求的给她。
verses.textEnNiv: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.
verses.textEnEsv: so that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she might ask.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she might ask.
verses.textEnNlt: so he promised with a vow to give her anything she wanted.
verses.textEnNasb: so much that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.
verses.textEn: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.

verses.textZh: 她在母亲的怂恿之下，说："请把施洗的约翰的头放在盘子上给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她在母亲的怂恿之下，说："请把施洗的约翰的头放在盘子上给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 女儿被母亲所使，就说：「请把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里，拿来给我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Prompted by her mother, she said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist."
verses.textEnEsv: Prompted by her mother, she said, "Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she, having been prompted by her mother, said, "Give me John the Baptist’s head here on a platter."
verses.textEnNlt: At her mother’s urging, the girl said, "I want the head of John the Baptist on a tray!"
verses.textEnNasb: And after being prompted by her mother, she *said, "Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter."
verses.textEn: Prompted by her mother, she said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist."

verses.textZh: 王就忧愁，但因为誓言和在座的宾客，就下令给她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就忧愁，但因为誓言和在座的宾客，就下令给她。
verses.textZhCuv: 王便忧愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐给她；
verses.textEnNiv: The king was distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he ordered that her request be granted
verses.textEnEsv: And the king was sorry, but because of his oaths and his guests he commanded it to be given.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king was sorry; nevertheless, because of the oaths and because of those who sat with him, he commanded it to be given to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king regretted what he had said; but because of the vow he had made in front of his guests, he issued the necessary orders.
verses.textEnNasb: And although he was grieved, the king commanded it to be given because of his oaths and his dinner guests.
verses.textEn: The king was distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he ordered that her request be granted

verses.textZh: 他派人去，在监里斩了约翰的头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他派人去，在监里斩了约翰的头，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是打发人去，在监里斩了约翰，
verses.textEnNiv: and had John beheaded in the prison.
verses.textEnEsv: He sent and had John beheaded in the prison,
verses.textEnNkjv: So he sent and had John beheaded in prison.
verses.textEnNlt: So John was beheaded in the prison,
verses.textEnNasb: He sent word and had John beheaded in the prison.
verses.textEn: and had John beheaded in the prison.

verses.textZh: 把头放在盘子上，拿来给那女孩子，她又带给母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把头放在盘子上，拿来给那女孩子，她又带给母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给了女子；女子拿去给她母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: His head was brought in on a platter and given to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
verses.textEnEsv: and his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.
verses.textEnNlt: and his head was brought on a tray and given to the girl, who took it to her mother.
verses.textEnNasb: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.
verses.textEn: His head was brought in on a platter and given to the girl, who carried it to her mother.

verses.textZh: 约翰的门徒前来，领了尸体，把它埋葬，然后去告诉耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰的门徒前来，领了尸体，把它埋葬，然后去告诉耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰的门徒来，把尸首领去埋葬了，就去告诉耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And his disciples came and took the body and buried it, and they went and told Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his disciples came and took away the body and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, John’s disciples came for his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: John’s disciples came and took away the body and buried it; and they went and reported to Jesus.
verses.textEn: John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见了，就离开那里，独自坐船到旷野去。群众听见了，就从各城步行来跟随他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见了，就离开那里，独自坐船到旷野去。群众听见了，就从各城步行来跟随他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见了，就上船从那里独自退到野地里去。众人听见，就从各城里步行跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus heard what had happened, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. Hearing of this, the crowds followed him on foot from the towns.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a desolate place by himself. But when the crowds heard it, they followed him on foot from the towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus heard it, He departed from there by boat to a deserted place by Himself. But when the multitudes heard it, they followed Him on foot from the cities.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Jesus heard the news, he left in a boat to a remote area to be alone. But the crowds heard where he was headed and followed on foot from many towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus heard about John, He withdrew from there in a boat to a secluded place by Himself; and when the people heard about this, they followed Him on foot from the cities.
verses.textEn: When Jesus heard what had happened, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. Hearing of this, the crowds followed him on foot from the towns.

verses.textZh: 耶稣上了岸，看见一大群人，就怜悯他们，医好了他们的病人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上了岸，看见一大群人，就怜悯他们，医好了他们的病人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，治好了他们的病人。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.
verses.textEnEsv: When he went ashore he saw a great crowd, and he had compassion on them and healed their sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Jesus went out He saw a great multitude; and He was moved with compassion for them, and healed their sick.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus saw the huge crowd as he stepped from the boat, and he had compassion on them and healed their sick.
verses.textEnNasb: When He came ashore, He saw a large crowd, and felt compassion for them and healed their sick.
verses.textEn: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.

verses.textZh: 黄昏的时候，门徒前来对他说："这是旷野的地方，时间也不早了，请叫群众散开，好让他们往村里去，买自己的食物吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 黄昏的时候，门徒前来对他说："这是旷野的地方，时间也不早了，请叫群众散开，好让他们往村里去，买自己的食物吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天将晚的时候，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，时候已经过了，请叫众人散开，他们好往村子里去，自己买吃的。」
verses.textEnNiv: As evening approached, the disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it’s already getting late. Send the crowds away, so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when it was evening, the disciples came to him and said, "This is a desolate place, and the day is now over; send the crowds away to go into the villages and buy food for themselves."
verses.textEnNkjv: When it was evening, His disciples came to Him, saying, "This is a deserted place, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages and buy themselves food."
verses.textEnNlt: That evening the disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it’s already getting late. Send the crowds away so they can go to the villages and buy food for themselves."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when it was evening, the disciples came to Him and said, "This place is secluded and the hour is already past to eat; send the crowds away, so that they may go into the villages and buy food for themselves."
verses.textEn: As evening approached, the disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it’s already getting late. Send the crowds away, so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>他们用不着离开，你们给他们吃吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>他们用不着离开，你们给他们吃吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>不用他们去，你们给他们吃吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus said, "They need not go away; you give them something to eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to them, "They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "That isn’t necessary—you feed them."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to them, "They do not need to go; you give them something to eat!"
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat.”</red>

verses.textZh: 但门徒说："我们这里除了五个饼和两条鱼，甚么也没有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但门徒说："我们这里除了五个饼和两条鱼，甚么也没有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒说：「我们这里只有五个饼，两条鱼。」
verses.textEnNiv: "We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish," they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "We have only five loaves here and two fish."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to Him, "We have here only five loaves and two fish."
verses.textEnNlt: "But we have only five loaves of bread and two fish!" they answered.
verses.textEnNasb: They *said to Him, "We have nothing here except five loaves and two fish."
verses.textEn: "We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish," they answered.

verses.textZh: <red>他说："拿过来给我。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说："拿过来给我。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>拿过来给我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Bringp them here to me,”</red> he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Bring them here to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: He said, "Bring them here to Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Bring them here," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "Bring them here to Me."
verses.textEn: <red>“Bringp them here to me,”</red> he said.

verses.textZh: 于是吩咐群众坐在草地上，拿起那五个饼两条鱼，望着天，祝谢了；然后把饼擘开，递给门徒，门徒又分给群众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是吩咐群众坐在草地上，拿起那五个饼两条鱼，望着天，祝谢了；然后把饼擘开，递给门徒，门徒又分给群众。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是吩咐众人坐在草地上，就拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，门徒又递给众人。
verses.textEnNiv: And he directed the people to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he ordered the crowds to sit down on the grass, and taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven and said a blessing. Then he broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass. And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he told the people to sit down on the grass. Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up toward heaven, and blessed them. Then, breaking the loaves into pieces, he gave the bread to the disciples, who distributed it to the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And ordering the crowds to sit down on the grass, He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looked up toward heaven. He blessed the food and breaking the loaves, He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.
verses.textEn: And he directed the people to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

verses.textZh: 大家都吃了，并且吃饱了，他们把剩下的零碎拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家都吃了，并且吃饱了，他们把剩下的零碎拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了，把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textEnNiv: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.textEnEsv: And they all ate and were satisfied. And they took up twelve baskets full of the broken pieces left over.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they all ate and were filled, and they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments that remained.
verses.textEnNlt: They all ate as much as they wanted, and afterward, the disciples picked up twelve baskets of leftovers.
verses.textEnNasb: And they all ate and were satisfied, and they picked up what was left over of the broken pieces: twelve full baskets.
verses.textEn: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.textZh: 吃的人，除了妇女和孩子，约有五千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃的人，除了妇女和孩子，约有五千。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，约有五千。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of those who ate was about five thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEnNlt: About 5,000 men were fed that day, in addition to all the women and children!
verses.textEnNasb: There were about five thousand men who ate, besides women and children.
verses.textEn: The number of those who ate was about five thousand men, besides women and children.

verses.textZh: 耶稣立刻催门徒上船，叫他们先到对岸去，他却留下来叫群众散开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣立刻催门徒上船，叫他们先到对岸去，他却留下来叫群众散开。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边去，等他叫众人散开。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately he made the disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go before Him to the other side, while He sent the multitudes away.
verses.textEnNlt: Immediately after this, Jesus insisted that his disciples get back into the boat and cross to the other side of the lake, while he sent the people home.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately afterward He compelled the disciples to get into the boat and to go ahead of Him to the other side, while He sent the crowds away.
verses.textEn: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowd.

verses.textZh: 他解散了群众，就独自上山去祷告。到了晚上，他还是独自一人在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他解散了群众，就独自上山去祷告。到了晚上，他还是独自一人在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 散了众人以后，他就独自上山去祷告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: After he had dismissed them, he went up on a mountainside by himself to pray. Later that night, he was there alone,
verses.textEnEsv: And after he had dismissed the crowds, he went up on the mountain by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had sent the multitudes away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. Now when evening came, He was alone there.
verses.textEnNlt: After sending them home, he went up into the hills by himself to pray. Night fell while he was there alone.
verses.textEnNasb: After He had sent the crowds away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray; and when it was evening, He was there alone.
verses.textEn: After he had dismissed them, he went up on a mountainside by himself to pray. Later that night, he was there alone,

verses.textZh: 那时门徒的船已经离岸数公里，因为逆风，被波浪冲击。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时门徒的船已经离岸数公里，因为逆风，被波浪冲击。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时船在海中，因风不顺，被浪摇撼。
verses.textEnNiv: and the boat was already a considerable distance from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
verses.textEnEsv: but the boat by this time was a long way from the land, beaten by the waves, for the wind was against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, tossed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the disciples were in trouble far away from land, for a strong wind had risen, and they were fighting heavy waves.
verses.textEnNasb: But the boat was already a long distance from the land, battered by the waves; for the wind was contrary.
verses.textEn: and the boat was already a considerable distance from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.

verses.textZh: 天快亮的时候 ，耶稣在海面上向他们走过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天快亮的时候 ，耶稣在海面上向他们走过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 夜里四更天，耶稣在海面上走，往门徒那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Shortly before dawn Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went to them, walking on the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: About three o’clock in the morning Jesus came toward them, walking on the water.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the fourth watch of the night He came to them, walking on the sea.
verses.textEn: Shortly before dawn Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake.

verses.textZh: 门徒见他在海面上行走，就很惊慌，说："有鬼啊！"并且恐惧得大叫起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒见他在海面上行走，就很惊慌，说："有鬼啊！"并且恐惧得大叫起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒看见他在海面上走，就惊慌了，说：「是个鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起来。
verses.textEnNiv: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. "It’s a ghost," they said, and cried out in fear.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were terrified, and said, "It is a ghost!" and they cried out in fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, "It is a ghost!" And they cried out for fear.
verses.textEnNlt: When the disciples saw him walking on the water, they were terrified. In their fear, they cried out, "It’s a ghost!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified, and said, "It is a ghost!" And they cried out in fear.
verses.textEn: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. "It’s a ghost," they said, and cried out in fear.

verses.textZh: 耶稣立刻对他们说："<red>放心吧！是我，不要怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣立刻对他们说："<red>放心吧！是我，不要怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣连忙对他们说：「<red>你们放心，是我，不要怕！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus immediately said to them: <red>“Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, "Take heart; it is I. Do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNkjv: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, "Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus spoke to them at once. "Don’t be afraid," he said. "Take courage. I am here! "
verses.textEnNasb: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, "Take courage, it is I; do not be afraid."
verses.textEn: But Jesus immediately said to them: <red>“Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得对他说："主啊，如果是你，让我在水面上到你那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对他说："主啊，如果是你，让我在水面上到你那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「主，如果是你，请叫我从水面上走到你那里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord, if it’s you," Peter replied, "tell me to come to you on the water."
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter answered him, "Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the water."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Peter answered Him and said, "Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter called to him, "Lord, if it’s really you, tell me to come to you, walking on the water."
verses.textEnNasb: Peter responded and said to Him, "Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water."
verses.textEn: "Lord, if it’s you," Peter replied, "tell me to come to you on the water."

verses.textZh: <red>他说："来吧！"彼得就从船上下来，行在水面上，走向耶稣那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说："来吧！"彼得就从船上下来，行在水面上，走向耶稣那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你来吧。</red>」彼得就从船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶稣那里去；
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Come,”p</red> he said. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Come." So Peter got out of the boat and walked on the water and came to Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said, "Come." And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, come," Jesus said. So Peter went over the side of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "Come!" And Peter got out of the boat and walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.
verses.textEn: <red>“Come,”p</red> he said. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.

verses.textZh: 但他一见风浪就害怕，快要沉下去的时候，就呼叫："主啊！救我！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他一见风浪就害怕，快要沉下去的时候，就呼叫："主啊！救我！"
verses.textZhCuv: 只因见风甚大，就害怕，将要沉下去，便喊着说：「主啊，救我！」
verses.textEnNiv: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, "Lord, save me!"
verses.textEnEsv: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink he cried out, "Lord, save me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he saw that the wind was boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink he cried out, saying, "Lord, save me!"
verses.textEnNlt: But when he saw the strong wind and the waves, he was terrified and began to sink. "Save me, Lord!" he shouted.
verses.textEnNasb: But seeing the wind, he became frightened, and when he began to sink, he cried out, saying, "Lord, save me!"
verses.textEn: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, "Lord, save me!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣马上伸手拉住他，对他说："<red>小信的人哪，为甚么疑惑？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣马上伸手拉住他，对他说："<red>小信的人哪，为甚么疑惑？</red>"
