verses.textEnNasb: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and those things defile the person.
verses.textEn: <red>But the things that come out of a person’s mouth come from the heart, and these defile them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为从心里出来的，有恶念、凶杀、奸淫、淫乱、偷盗、假见证和毁谤。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为从心里出来的，有恶念、凶杀、奸淫、淫乱、偷盗、假见证和毁谤。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为从心里发出来的，有恶念、凶杀、奸淫、苟合、偷盗、妄证、谤。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For out of the heart come evil thoughts—murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false witness, slander.
verses.textEnNkjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies.
verses.textEnNlt: For from the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, all sexual immorality, theft, lying, and slander.
verses.textEnNasb: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, acts of adultery, other immoral sexual acts, thefts, false testimonies, and slanderous statements.
verses.textEn: <red>For out of the heart come evil thoughts—murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这些才会使人污秽，不洗手吃饭却不会这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这些才会使人污秽，不洗手吃饭却不会这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这都是污秽人的；至于不洗手吃饭，那却不污秽人。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>These are what defile a person; but eating with unwashed hands does not defile them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: These are what defile a person. But to eat with unwashed hands does not defile anyone."
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the things which defile a man, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man."
verses.textEnNlt: These are what defile you. Eating with unwashed hands will never defile you."
verses.textEnNasb: These are the things that defile the person; but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile the person."
verses.textEn: <red>These are what defile a person; but eating with unwashed hands does not defile them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣离开那里，退到推罗、西顿境内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣离开那里，退到推罗、西顿境内。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣离开那里，退到泰尔、西顿的境内去。
verses.textEnNiv: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus went away from there and withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus went out from there and departed to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus left Galilee and went north to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus went away from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEn: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.textZh: 有一个迦南的妇人从那地区出来，喊着说："主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！我的女儿被鬼附得很苦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个迦南的妇人从那地区出来，喊着说："主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！我的女儿被鬼附得很苦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个迦南妇人，从那地方出来，喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我！我女儿被鬼附得甚苦。」
verses.textEnNiv: A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is demon-possessed and suffering terribly."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a Canaanite woman from that region came out and was crying, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David; my daughter is severely oppressed by a demon."
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, a woman of Canaan came from that region and cried out to Him, saying, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David! My daughter is severely demon-possessed."
verses.textEnNlt: A Gentile woman who lived there came to him, pleading, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David! For my daughter is possessed by a demon that torments her severely."
verses.textEnNasb: And a Canaanite woman from that region came out and began to cry out, saying, "Have mercy on me, Lord, Son of David; my daughter is severely demon-possessed."
verses.textEn: A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is demon-possessed and suffering terribly."

verses.textZh: 耶稣一句话也不回答她。门徒上前求他说："请叫她走吧，她一直跟在我们后面喊叫。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一句话也不回答她。门徒上前求他说："请叫她走吧，她一直跟在我们后面喊叫。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣却一言不答。门徒进前来，求他说：「这妇人在我们后头喊叫，请打发她走吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."
verses.textEnEsv: But he did not answer her a word. And his disciples came and begged him, saying, "Send her away, for she is crying out after us."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered her not a word. And His disciples came and urged Him, saying, "Send her away, for she cries out after us."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus gave her no reply, not even a word. Then his disciples urged him to send her away. "Tell her to go away," they said. "She is bothering us with all her begging."
verses.textEnNasb: But He did not answer her with even a word. And His disciples came up and urged Him, saying, "Send her away, because she keeps shouting at us!"
verses.textEn: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>我被差遣，只是到以色列家的迷羊那里去。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>我被差遣，只是到以色列家的迷羊那里去。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我奉差遣不过是到以色列家迷失的羊那里去。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, <red>“I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said, "I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to the woman, "I was sent only to help God’s lost sheep—the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: But He answered and said, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."
verses.textEn: He answered, <red>“I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel.”</red>

verses.textZh: 她来跪在耶稣面前说："主啊，求你帮助我！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她来跪在耶稣面前说："主啊，求你帮助我！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那妇人来拜他，说：「主啊，帮助我！」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman came and knelt before him. "Lord, help me!" she said.
verses.textEnEsv: But she came and knelt before him, saying, "Lord, help me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she came and worshiped Him, saying, "Lord, help me!"
verses.textEnNlt: But she came and worshiped him, pleading again, "Lord, help me!"
verses.textEnNasb: But she came and began to bow down before Him, saying, "Lord, help me!"
verses.textEn: The woman came and knelt before him. "Lord, help me!" she said.

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>拿儿女的饼丢给小狗吃是不好的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>拿儿女的饼丢给小狗吃是不好的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「<red>不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered, "It is not right to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said, "It is not good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the little dogs."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "It isn’t right to take food from the children and throw it to the dogs."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet He answered and said, "It is not good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs."
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”</red>

verses.textZh: 她说："主啊，是的，不过小狗也吃主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说："主啊，是的，不过小狗也吃主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「主啊，不错；但是狗也吃它主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣儿。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Yes it is, Lord," she said. "Even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table."
verses.textEnEsv: She said, "Yes, Lord, yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters’ table."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, "Yes, Lord, yet even the little dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table."
verses.textEnNlt: She replied, "That’s true, Lord, but even dogs are allowed to eat the scraps that fall beneath their masters’ table."
verses.textEnNasb: And she said, "Yes, Lord; but please help, for even the dogs feed on the crumbs that fall from their masters’ table."
verses.textEn: "Yes it is, Lord," she said. "Even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table."

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣对她说："<red>妇人，你的信心真大，照你所想的给你成就吧！</red>"从那时起，她的女儿就好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣对她说："<red>妇人，你的信心真大，照你所想的给你成就吧！</red>"从那时起，她的女儿就好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>妇人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，给你成全了吧。</red>」从那时候，她女儿就好了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to her, <red>“Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted.”</red> And her daughter was healed at that moment.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus answered her, "O woman, great is your faith! Let it be done for you as you desire." And her daughter was healed instantly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus answered and said to her, "O woman, great is your faith! Let it be to you as you desire." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
verses.textEnNlt: "Dear woman," Jesus said to her, "your faith is great. Your request is granted." And her daughter was instantly healed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus said to her, "O woman, your faith is great; it shall be done for you as you desire." And her daughter was healed at once.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to her, <red>“Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted.”</red> And her daughter was healed at that moment.

verses.textZh: 耶稣离开那里，来到加利利海边，就上山坐下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣离开那里，来到加利利海边，就上山坐下。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣离开那地方，来到靠近加利利的海边，就上山坐下。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus went on from there and walked beside the Sea of Galilee. And he went up on the mountain and sat down there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus departed from there, skirted the Sea of Galilee, and went up on the mountain and sat down there.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus returned to the Sea of Galilee and climbed a hill and sat down.
verses.textEnNasb: Departing from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee, and after going up on the mountain, He was sitting there.
verses.textEn: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.

verses.textZh: 有许多人来到他那里，把瘸腿的、瞎眼的、残废的、哑的和许多别的病人，都带到耶稣跟前，他就医好他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多人来到他那里，把瘸腿的、瞎眼的、残废的、哑的和许多别的病人，都带到耶稣跟前，他就医好他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人到他那里，带着瘸子、瞎子、哑巴、有残疾的，和好些别的病人，都放在他脚前；他就治好了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And great crowds came to him, bringing with them the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and they put them at his feet, and he healed them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then great multitudes came to Him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others; and they laid them down at Jesus’ feet, and He healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: A vast crowd brought to him people who were lame, blind, crippled, those who couldn’t speak, and many others. They laid them before Jesus, and he healed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And large crowds came to Him bringing with them those who were limping, had impaired limbs, were blind, or were unable to speak, and many others, and they laid them down at His feet; and He healed them.
verses.textEn: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.

verses.textZh: 群众看见哑巴说话，残废的复原，瘸腿的行走，瞎眼的看见，就十分惊奇，于是颂赞以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众看见哑巴说话，残废的复原，瘸腿的行走，瞎眼的看见，就十分惊奇，于是颂赞以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至众人都希奇；因为看见哑巴说话，残疾的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看见，他们就归荣耀给以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the crowd wondered, when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled healthy, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the multitude marveled when they saw the mute speaking, the maimed made whole, the lame walking, and the blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd was amazed! Those who hadn’t been able to speak were talking, the crippled were made well, the lame were walking, and the blind could see again! And they praised the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So the crowd was astonished as they saw those who were unable to speak talking, those with impaired limbs restored, those who were limping walking around, and those who were blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶稣叫门徒前来，说："<red>我怜悯这一群人，因为他们跟我在一起已经有三天，也没有甚么吃的；我不想叫他们饿着肚子回去，恐怕他们在路上晕倒。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣叫门徒前来，说："<red>我怜悯这一群人，因为他们跟我在一起已经有三天，也没有甚么吃的；我不想叫他们饿着肚子回去，恐怕他们在路上晕倒。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「<red>我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。我不愿意叫他们饿着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, <red>“I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus called his disciples to him and said, "I have compassion on the crowd because they have been with me now three days and have nothing to eat. And I am unwilling to send them away hungry, lest they faint on the way."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus called His disciples to Himself and said, "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now continued with Me three days and have nothing to eat. And I do not want to send them away hungry, lest they faint on the way."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus called his disciples and told them, "I feel sorry for these people. They have been here with me for three days, and they have nothing left to eat. I don’t want to send them away hungry, or they will faint along the way."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, "I feel compassion for the people, because they have remained with Me now for three days and have nothing to eat; and I do not want to send them away hungry, for they might faint on the way."
verses.textEn: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, <red>“I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒对他说："我们在这旷野地方，哪里有足够的食物给这许多的人吃饱呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒对他说："我们在这旷野地方，哪里有足够的食物给这许多的人吃饱呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒说：「我们在这野地，哪里有这么多的饼叫这许多人吃饱呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples answered, "Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the disciples said to him, "Where are we to get enough bread in such a desolate place to feed so great a crowd?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His disciples said to Him, "Where could we get enough bread in the wilderness to fill such a great multitude?"
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples replied, "Where would we get enough food here in the wilderness for such a huge crowd?"
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples *said to Him, "Where would we get so many loaves in this desolate place to satisfy such a large crowd?"
verses.textEn: His disciples answered, "Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣问他们："你们有多少饼？"他们说："七个饼和几条小鱼。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣问他们："你们有多少饼？"他们说："七个饼和几条小鱼。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们有多少饼？</red>」他们说：「<red>有七个，还有几条小鱼。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Howp many loaves do you have?”</red> Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "How many loaves do you have?" They said, "Seven, and a few small fish."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "How many loaves do you have?" And they said, "Seven, and a few little fish."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked, "How much bread do you have?" They replied, "Seven loaves, and a few small fish."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus *said to them, "How many loaves do you have?" And they said, "Seven, and a few small fish."
verses.textEn: <red>“Howp many loaves do you have?”</red> Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”

verses.textZh: 他就吩咐群众坐在地上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就吩咐群众坐在地上，
verses.textZhCuv: 他就吩咐众人坐在地上，
verses.textEnNiv: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And directing the crowd to sit down on the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: So He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus told all the people to sit down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And He directed the people to sit down on the ground;
verses.textEn: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.

verses.textZh: 拿起那七个饼和那些鱼，祝谢了，擘开递给门徒，门徒又分给众人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿起那七个饼和那些鱼，祝谢了，擘开递给门徒，门徒又分给众人。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿着这七个饼和几条鱼，祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒；门徒又递给众人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.
verses.textEnEsv: he took the seven loaves and the fish, and having given thanks he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took the seven loaves and the fish and gave thanks, broke them and gave them to His disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, thanked God for them, and broke them into pieces. He gave them to the disciples, who distributed the food to the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: and He took the seven loaves and the fish; and after giving thanks, He broke them and started giving them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.
verses.textEn: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.

verses.textZh: 大家都吃了，并且吃饱了。他们把剩下的零碎拾起来，装满了七个大篮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家都吃了，并且吃饱了。他们把剩下的零碎拾起来，装满了七个大篮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，装满了七个筐子。
verses.textEnNiv: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.textEnEsv: And they all ate and were satisfied. And they took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces left over.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they all ate and were filled, and they took up seven large baskets full of the fragments that were left.
verses.textEnNlt: They all ate as much as they wanted. Afterward, the disciples picked up seven large baskets of leftover food.
verses.textEnNasb: And they all ate and were satisfied, and they picked up what was left over of the broken pieces, seven large baskets full.
verses.textEn: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.textZh: 吃的人，除了妇女和孩子，共有四千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃的人，除了妇女和孩子，共有四千。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，共有四千。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of those who ate was four thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 4,000 men who were fed that day, in addition to all the women and children.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.textEn: The number of those who ate was four thousand men, besides women and children.

verses.textZh: 耶稣解散了群众，就上了船，来到马加丹地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣解散了群众，就上了船，来到马加丹地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣叫众人散去，就上船，来到马加丹的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.
verses.textEnEsv: And after sending away the crowds, he got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He sent away the multitude, got into the boat, and came to the region of Magdala.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus sent the people home, and he got into a boat and crossed over to the region of Magadan.
verses.textEnNasb: And sending away the crowds, Jesus got into the boat and came to the region of Magadan.
verses.textEn: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人和撒都该人前来试探耶稣，求他显个从天上来的神迹给他们看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人和撒都该人前来试探耶稣，求他显个从天上来的神迹给他们看。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人和撒都该人来试探耶稣，请他从天上显个神迹给他们看。
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and to test him they asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing Him asked that He would show them a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: One day the Pharisees and Sadducees came to test Jesus, demanding that he show them a miraculous sign from heaven to prove his authority.
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees and Sadducees came up, and putting Jesus to the test, they asked Him to show them a sign from heaven.
verses.textEn: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："黄昏的时候，你们说：‘天色通红，明天一定是晴天。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："黄昏的时候，你们说：‘天色通红，明天一定是晴天。’
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「晚上天发红，你们就说：『天必要晴。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“When evening comes, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He answered them, "When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said to them, "When it is evening you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red’;
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "You know the saying, ‘Red sky at night means fair weather tomorrow;
verses.textEnNasb: But He replied to them, " When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“When evening comes, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>早上的时候，你们说：‘天色又红又暗，今天一定有风雨。’你们知道分辨天色，却不能分辨时代的征兆吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>早上的时候，你们说：‘天色又红又暗，今天一定有风雨。’你们知道分辨天色，却不能分辨时代的征兆吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>早晨天发红，又发黑，你们就说：『今日必有风雨。』你们知道分辨天上的气色，倒不能分辨这时候的神迹。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And in the morning, ‘It will be stormy today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.
verses.textEnNkjv: and in the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the face of the sky, but you cannot discern the signs of the times.
verses.textEnNlt: red sky in the morning means foul weather all day.’ You know how to interpret the weather signs in the sky, but you don’t know how to interpret the signs of the times!
verses.textEnNasb: And in the morning, ‘There will be a storm today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but are you unable to discern the signs of the times?
verses.textEn: <red>and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>邪恶和淫乱的世代要寻求神迹，除了约拿的神迹之外，不会有甚么神迹给它了。"耶稣就离开他们走了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>邪恶和淫乱的世代要寻求神迹，除了约拿的神迹之外，不会有甚么神迹给它了。"耶稣就离开他们走了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>一个邪恶淫乱的世代求神迹，除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他看。」耶稣就离开他们去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.”</red> Jesus then left them and went away.
verses.textEnEsv: An evil and adulterous generation seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah." So he left them and departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and no sign shall be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah." And He left them and departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Only an evil, adulterous generation would demand a miraculous sign, but the only sign I will give them is the sign of the prophet Jonah. " Then Jesus left them and went away.
verses.textEnNasb: An evil and adulterous generation wants a sign; and so a sign will not be given to it, except the sign of Jonah." And He left them and went away.
verses.textEn: <red>A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.”</red> Jesus then left them and went away.

verses.textZh: 门徒到了对岸，忘记了带饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒到了对岸，忘记了带饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒渡到那边去，忘了带饼。
verses.textEnNiv: When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.
verses.textEnEsv: When the disciples reached the other side, they had forgotten to bring any bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when His disciples had come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, after they crossed to the other side of the lake, the disciples discovered they had forgotten to bring any bread.
verses.textEnNasb: And the disciples came to the other side of the sea, but they had forgotten to bring any bread.
verses.textEn: When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他们说："你们要小心，提防法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他们说："你们要小心，提防法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Be careful,”</red> Jesus said to them. <red>“Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Watch and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the Sadducees."
verses.textEnNlt: "Watch out!" Jesus warned them. "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "Watch out and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
verses.textEn: <red>“Be careful,”</red> Jesus said to them. <red>“Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就彼此议论说："这是因为我们没有带饼吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就彼此议论说："这是因为我们没有带饼吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒彼此议论说：「这是因为我们没有带饼吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: They discussed this among themselves and said, "It is because we didn’t bring any bread."
verses.textEnEsv: And they began discussing it among themselves, saying, "We brought no bread."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "Itis because we have taken no bread."
verses.textEnNlt: At this they began to argue with each other because they hadn’t brought any bread.
verses.textEnNasb: They began to discuss this among themselves, saying, "He said that because we did not bring any bread."
verses.textEn: They discussed this among themselves and said, "It is because we didn’t bring any bread."

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道了，就说："<red>小信的人，为甚么议论没有饼这件事呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道了，就说："<red>小信的人，为甚么议论没有饼这件事呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看出来，就说：「你们这小信的人，为什么因为没有饼彼此议论呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, <red>“You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus, aware of this, said, "O you of little faith, why are you discussing among yourselves the fact that you have no bread?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus, being aware of it, said to them, "O you of little faith, why do you reason among yourselves because you have brought no bread?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said, "You have so little faith! Why are you arguing with each other about having no bread?
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, aware of this, said, "You men of little faith, why are you discussing among yourselves the fact that you have no bread?
verses.textEn: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, <red>“You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们还不明白吗？你们是不是忘记了那五个饼分给五千人，又装满了多少个篮子呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们还不明白吗？你们是不是忘记了那五个饼分给五千人，又装满了多少个篮子呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们还不明白吗？不记得那五个饼分给五千人、又收拾了多少篮子的零碎吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do you still not understand? Don’t you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not yet perceive? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you gathered?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not yet understand, or remember the five loaves of the five thousand and how many baskets you took up?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you understand even yet? Don’t you remember the 5,000 I fed with five loaves, and the baskets of leftovers you picked up?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not yet understand nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets you picked up?
verses.textEn: <red>Do you still not understand? Don’t you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>还是忘记了那七个饼分给四千人，又装满了多少个大篮子呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>还是忘记了那七个饼分给四千人，又装满了多少个大篮子呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>也不记得那七个饼分给四千人、又收拾了多少筐子的零碎吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you gathered?
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand and how many large baskets you took up?
verses.textEnNlt: Or the 4,000 I fed with seven loaves, and the large baskets of leftovers you picked up?
verses.textEnNasb: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many large baskets you picked up?
verses.textEn: <red>Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我对你们讲的不是饼的事，你们为甚么不明白？你们要提防法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我对你们讲的不是饼的事，你们为甚么不明白？你们要提防法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我对你们说：『要防备法利赛人和撒都该人的酵』，这话不是指着饼说的，你们怎么不明白呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How is it you don’t understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: How is it that you fail to understand that I did not speak about bread? Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
verses.textEnNkjv: How is it you do not understand that I did not speak to you concerning bread?—but to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
verses.textEnNlt: Why can’t you understand that I’m not talking about bread? So again I say, ‘Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.’"
verses.textEnNasb: How is it that you do not understand that I did not speak to you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
verses.textEn: <red>How is it you don’t understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这时他们才领会耶稣说的不是要提防饼酵，而是要提防法利赛人和撒都该人的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这时他们才领会耶稣说的不是要提防饼酵，而是要提防法利赛人和撒都该人的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒这才晓得他说的不是叫他们防备饼的酵，乃是防备法利赛人和撒都该人的教训。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they understood that he did not tell them to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they understood that He did not tell them to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last they understood that he wasn’t speaking about the yeast in bread, but about the deceptive teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they understood that He did not say to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
verses.textEn: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

verses.textZh: 耶稣来到该撒利亚．腓立比的地区，就问自己的门徒："<red>人说人子是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣来到该撒利亚．腓立比的地区，就问自己的门徒："<red>人说人子是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣到了凯撒利亚‧腓立比的境内，就问门徒说：「<red>人说我 －人子是谁？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, <red>“Who do people say the Son of Man is?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Jesus came into the district of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, He asked His disciples, saying, "Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, He was asking His disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"
verses.textEn: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, <red>“Who do people say the Son of Man is?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们回答："有人说是施洗的约翰，有人说是以利亚，也有人说是耶利米，或是先知里的一位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："有人说是施洗的约翰，有人说是以利亚，也有人说是耶利米，或是先知里的一位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是耶利米或是先知里的一位。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "Some say John the Baptist, others say Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "Some say John the Baptist, some Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," they replied, "some say John the Baptist, some say Elijah, and others say Jeremiah or one of the other prophets."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "Some say John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah, or one of the other prophets."
verses.textEn: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."

verses.textZh: <red>他问他们："你们说我是谁？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他问他们："你们说我是谁？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们说我是谁？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp what about you?”</red> he asked. <red>“Who do you say I am?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?"
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he asked them, "But who do you say I am?"
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to them, "But who do you yourselves say that I am?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp what about you?”</red> he asked. <red>“Who do you say I am?”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得回答："你是基督，是永生神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得回答："你是基督，是永生神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得回答说：「你是基督，是永生神的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter replied, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter answered and said, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
verses.textEn: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>约拿的儿子西门，你是有福的，因为这不是人 指示你的，而是我在天上的父启示你的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>约拿的儿子西门，你是有福的，因为这不是人 指示你的，而是我在天上的父启示你的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「西门‧巴‧约拿，你是有福的！因为这不是属血肉的指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by my Father in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answered him, "Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah! For flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but My Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "You are blessed, Simon son of John, because my Father in heaven has revealed this to you. You did not learn this from any human being.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to him, "Blessed are you, Simon Barjona, because flesh and blood did not reveal this to you, but My Father who is in heaven.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by my Father in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你，你是彼得，我要在这盘石上建立我的教会，死亡的权势 不能胜过他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你，你是彼得，我要在这盘石上建立我的教会，死亡的权势 不能胜过他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我还告诉你，你是彼得，我要把我的教会建造在这磐石上；阴间的权柄 不能胜过他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I say to you that you are Peter (which means ‘rock’), and upon this rock I will build my church, and all the powers of hell will not conquer it.
verses.textEnNasb: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church; and the gates of Hades will not overpower it.
verses.textEn: <red>And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我要把天国的钥匙给你，你在地上捆绑的，在天上也被捆绑；你在地上释放的，在天上也被释放。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我要把天国的钥匙给你，你在地上捆绑的，在天上也被捆绑；你在地上释放的，在天上也被释放。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我要把天国的钥匙给你，凡你在地上所捆绑的，在天上也要捆绑；凡你在地上所释放的，在天上也要释放。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven. Whatever you forbid on earth will be forbidden in heaven, and whatever you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven."
verses.textEnNasb: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; and whatever you bind on earth shall have been bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth shall have been loosed in heaven."
verses.textEn: <red>I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣吩咐门徒不可对人说他就是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣吩咐门徒不可对人说他就是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，耶稣嘱咐门徒，不可对人说他是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he ordered his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he strictly charged the disciples to tell no one that he was the Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He commanded His disciples that they should tell no one that He was Jesus the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sternly warned the disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He gave the disciples strict orders that they were to tell no one that He was the Christ.
verses.textEn: Then he ordered his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 从那时起，耶稣开始向门徒指出，他必须往耶路撒冷去，受长老、祭司长和经学家许多的苦害，并且被杀，第三天复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那时起，耶稣开始向门徒指出，他必须往耶路撒冷去，受长老、祭司长和经学家许多的苦害，并且被杀，第三天复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，耶稣才指示门徒，他必须上耶路撒冷去，受长老、祭司长、文士许多的苦，并且被杀，第三日复活。
verses.textEnNiv: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
verses.textEnEsv: From that time Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and on the third day be raised.
verses.textEnNkjv: From that time Jesus began to show to His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day.
verses.textEnNlt: From then on Jesus began to tell his disciples plainly that it was necessary for him to go to Jerusalem, and that he would suffer many terrible things at the hands of the elders, the leading priests, and the teachers of religious law. He would be killed, but on the third day he would be raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: From that time Jesus began to point out to His disciples that it was necessary for Him to go to Jerusalem and to suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and to be raised up on the third day.
verses.textEn: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.

verses.textZh: 彼得就把他拉到一边，责怪他说："主啊，千万不可这样，这事一定不会发生在你身上的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就把他拉到一边，责怪他说："主啊，千万不可这样，这事一定不会发生在你身上的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就拉着他，劝他说：「主啊，万不可如此！这事必不临到你身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This shall never happen to you!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, "Far be it from you, Lord! This shall never happen to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, "Far be it from You, Lord; this shall not happen to You!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter took him aside and began to reprimand him for saying such things. "Heaven forbid, Lord," he said. "This will never happen to you!"
verses.textEnNasb: And yet Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, " God forbid it, Lord! This shall never happen to You!"
verses.textEn: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This shall never happen to you!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣转过来对彼得说："<red>撒但！退到我后面去！你是绊脚石，因为你不思念神的事，只思念人的事。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣转过来对彼得说："<red>撒但！退到我后面去！你是绊脚石，因为你不思念神的事，只思念人的事。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣转过来，对彼得说：「<red>撒但，退我后边去吧！你是绊我脚的；因为你不体贴神的意思，只体贴人的意思。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus turned and said to Peter, <red>“Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he turned and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a hindrance to me. For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He turned and said to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you are not mindful of the things of God, but the things of men."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus turned to Peter and said, "Get away from me, Satan! You are a dangerous trap to me. You are seeing things merely from a human point of view, not from God’s."
verses.textEnNasb: But He turned and said to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me; for you are not setting your mind on God’s purposes, but men’s."
verses.textEn: Jesus turned and said to Peter, <red>“Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣对门徒说："<red>如果有人愿意跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣对门徒说："<red>如果有人愿意跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是耶稣对门徒说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, <red>“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus told his disciples, "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If any of you wants to be my follower, you must give up your own way, take up your cross, and follow me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to his disciples, <red>“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是想救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；但为我牺牲生命的，必得着生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是想救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；但为我牺牲生命的，必得着生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为，凡要救自己生命 的，必丧掉生命；凡为我丧掉生命的，必得着生命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever would save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you try to hang on to your life, you will lose it. But if you give up your life for my sake, you will save it.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
verses.textEn: <red>For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若赚得全世界，却赔上自己的生命，有甚么好处呢？人还能用甚么换回自己的生命呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若赚得全世界，却赔上自己的生命，有甚么好处呢？人还能用甚么换回自己的生命呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人若赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？人还能拿什么换生命呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>What good will it be for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his soul? Or what shall a man give in return for his soul?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.textEnNlt: And what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but lose your own soul? Is anything worth more than your soul?
verses.textEnNasb: For what good will it do a person if he gains the whole world, but forfeits his soul? Or what will a person give in exchange for his soul?
verses.textEn: <red>What good will it be for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人子要在父的荣耀里和众天使一同降临，那时他要照各人的行为报应各人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人子要在父的荣耀里和众天使一同降临，那时他要照各人的行为报应各人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子要在他父的荣耀里，同着众使者降临；那时候，他要照各人的行为报应各人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father’s glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what they have done.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Son of Man is going to come with his angels in the glory of his Father, and then he will repay each person according to what he has done.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He will reward each according to his works.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Son of Man will come with his angels in the glory of his Father and will judge all people according to their deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Son of Man is going to come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and will then repay every person according to his deeds.
verses.textEn: <red>For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father’s glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what they have done.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没有尝过死味以前，必要看见人子带着他的国降临。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没有尝过死味以前，必要看见人子带着他的国降临。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前必看见人子降临在他的国里。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Trulyp I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Assuredly, I say to you, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom."
verses.textEnNlt: And I tell you the truth, some standing here right now will not die before they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom."
verses.textEnNasb: "Truly I say to you, there are some of those who are standing here who will not taste death until they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom."
verses.textEn: <red>“Trulyp I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom.”</red>

verses.textZh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各和雅各的弟弟约翰，领他们悄悄地上了高山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各和雅各的弟弟约翰，领他们悄悄地上了高山。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，暗暗地上了高山，
verses.textEnNiv: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: And after six days Jesus took with him Peter and James, and John his brother, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John his brother, led them up on a high mountain by themselves;
verses.textEnNlt: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the two brothers, James and John, and led them up a high mountain to be alone.
verses.textEnNasb: Six days later, Jesus *took with Him Peter and James, and his brother John, and *led them up on a high mountain by themselves.
verses.textEn: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

verses.textZh: 耶稣在他们面前改变了形象，脸好象太阳一样照耀，衣服洁白像光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在他们面前改变了形象，脸好象太阳一样照耀，衣服洁白像光。
verses.textZhCuv: 就在他们面前变了形象，脸面明亮如日头，衣裳洁白如光。
verses.textEnNiv: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.
verses.textEnEsv: And he was transfigured before them, and his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
verses.textEnNkjv: and He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
verses.textEnNlt: As the men watched, Jesus’ appearance was transformed so that his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as light.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was transfigured before them; and His face shone like the sun, and His garments became as white as light.
verses.textEn: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.

verses.textZh: 忽然，摩西和以利亚向他们显现，跟耶稣谈话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然，摩西和以利亚向他们显现，跟耶稣谈话。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，有摩西、以利亚向他们显现，同耶稣说话。
verses.textEnNiv: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah, talking with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, Moses and Elijah appeared and began talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Him.
verses.textEn: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.

verses.textZh: 彼得对耶稣说："主啊，我们在这里真好。如果你愿意，我就在这里搭三个帐棚，一个为你，一个为摩西，一个为以利亚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对耶稣说："主啊，我们在这里真好。如果你愿意，我就在这里搭三个帐棚，一个为你，一个为摩西，一个为以利亚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得对耶稣说：「主啊，我们在这里真好！你若愿意，我就在这里搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good that we are here. If you wish, I will make three tents here, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter answered and said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here; if You wish, let us make here three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter exclaimed, "Lord, it’s wonderful for us to be here! If you want, I’ll make three shelters as memorials —one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnNasb: Peter responded and said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good that we are here. If You want, I will make three tabernacles here: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.textEn: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."

verses.textZh: 彼得还说话的时候，有一朵明亮的云彩笼罩他们，云中有声音说："这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的，你们要听他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得还说话的时候，有一朵明亮的云彩笼罩他们，云中有声音说："这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的，你们要听他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说话之间，忽然有一朵光明的云彩遮盖他们，且有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。你们要听他！」
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud covered them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!"
verses.textEnEsv: He was still speaking when, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them; and suddenly a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Hear Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: But even as he spoke, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy. Listen to him."
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and behold, a voice from the cloud said, "This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to Him!"
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud covered them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!"

verses.textZh: 门徒听见了，就俯伏在地上，非常害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒听见了，就俯伏在地上，非常害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒听见，就俯伏在地，极其害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.
verses.textEnEsv: When the disciples heard this, they fell on their faces and were terrified.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces and were greatly afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples were terrified and fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: When the disciples heard this, they fell face down to the ground and were terrified.
verses.textEn: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.

verses.textZh: 耶稣前来，摸着他们说："<red>起来，不用怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣前来，摸着他们说："<red>起来，不用怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进前来，摸他们，说：「<red>起来，不要害怕！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus came and touched them. <red>“Get up,”</red> he said. <red>“Don’t be afraid.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus came and touched them, saying, "Rise, and have no fear."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus came and touched them and said, "Arise, and do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus came over and touched them. "Get up," he said. "Don’t be afraid."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus came to them and touched them and said, "Get up, and do not be afraid."
verses.textEn: But Jesus came and touched them. <red>“Get up,”</red> he said. <red>“Don’t be afraid.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们抬起头来，看见只有耶稣自己，没有别的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们抬起头来，看见只有耶稣自己，没有别的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们举目不见一人，只见耶稣在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they lifted up their eyes, they saw no one but Jesus only.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no one but Jesus only.
verses.textEnNlt: And when they looked up, Moses and Elijah were gone, and they saw only Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And raising their eyes, they saw no one except Jesus Himself alone.
verses.textEn: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们："<red>人子从死人中复活以前，你们不要把所看见的异象告诉人。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们："<red>人子从死人中复活以前，你们不要把所看见的异象告诉人。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们说：「<red>人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, <red>“Don’t tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, "Tell no one the vision, until the Son of Man is raised from the dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they came down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, "Tell the vision to no one until the Son of Man is risen from the dead."
verses.textEnNlt: As they went back down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, "Don’t tell anyone what you have seen until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: When they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, "Tell the vision to no one until the Son of Man has risen from the dead."
verses.textEn: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, <red>“Don’t tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒就问他："那么经学家为甚么说，以利亚必须先来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒就问他："那么经学家为甚么说，以利亚必须先来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples asked him, "Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the disciples asked him, "Then why do the scribes say that first Elijah must come?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And His disciples asked Him, saying, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then his disciples asked him, "Why do the teachers of religious law insist that Elijah must return before the Messiah comes? "
verses.textEnNasb: And His disciples asked Him, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.textEn: The disciples asked him, "Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："以利亚当然要来，并且复兴一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："以利亚当然要来，并且复兴一切。

verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>因为你们的信心太小了。我实在告诉你们，只要你们的信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这山说：‘从这里移到那里’，它也必移开。没有甚么是你们不能作的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「是因你们的信心小。我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，像一粒芥菜种，就是对这座山说：『你从这边挪到那边』，它也必挪去；并且你们没有一件不能做的事了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Because of your little faith. For truly, I say to you, if you have faith like a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move, and nothing will be impossible for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus said to them, "Because of your unbelief; for assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith as a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You don’t have enough faith," Jesus told them. "I tell you the truth, if you had faith even as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it would move. Nothing would be impossible. "
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Because of your meager faith; for truly I say to you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you. "
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说："纳。"他进到屋子里，耶稣先问他："西门，你认为怎样？地上的君王向谁征收关税和丁税？向自己的儿子还是外人呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："纳。"他进到屋子里，耶稣先问他："西门，你认为怎样？地上的君王向谁征收关税和丁税？向自己的儿子还是外人呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了迦百农，有收丁税的人来见彼得，说：「你们的先生不纳丁税 吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Yes, he does," he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. "What do you think, Simon?" he asked. "From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes—from their own children or from others?"
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Yes." And when he came into the house, Jesus spoke to him first, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do kings of the earth take toll or tax? From their sons or from others?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had come to Capernaum, those who received the temple tax came to Peter and said, "Does your Teacher not pay the temple tax?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, he does," Peter replied. Then he went into the house. But before he had a chance to speak, Jesus asked him, "What do you think, Peter? Do kings tax their own people or the people they have conquered? "
verses.textEnNasb: He *said, "Yes." And when he came into the house, Jesus spoke to him first, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs or poll-tax, from their sons or from strangers?"
verses.textEn: "Yes, he does," he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. "What do you think, Simon?" he asked. "From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes—from their own children or from others?"
