verses.textZhCuv: <red>「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交给祭司长和文士。他们要定他死罪，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "See, we are going up to Jerusalem. And the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes; and they will condemn Him to death,
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen," he said, "we’re going up to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be betrayed to the leading priests and the teachers of religious law. They will sentence him to die.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn Him to death,
verses.textEn: <red>“We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death</red>

verses.textZh: <red>把他交给外族人凌辱、鞭打，并且钉在十字架上。然而第三天他要复活。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>把他交给外族人凌辱、鞭打，并且钉在十字架上。然而第三天他要复活。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又交给外邦人，将他戏弄，鞭打，钉在十字架上；第三日他要复活。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and deliver him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified, and he will be raised on the third day."
verses.textEnNkjv: and deliver Him to the Gentiles to mock and to scourge and to crucify. And the third day He will rise again."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will hand him over to the Romans to be mocked, flogged with a whip, and crucified. But on the third day he will be raised from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: and they will hand Him over to the Gentiles to mock and flog and crucify, and on the third day He will be raised up."
verses.textEn: <red>and will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!”</red>

verses.textZh: 那时，西庇太的儿子的母亲，带着她的两个儿子前来见耶稣。她跪在耶稣面前求他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，西庇太的儿子的母亲，带着她的两个儿子前来见耶稣。她跪在耶稣面前求他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，西庇太儿子的母亲同她两个儿子上前来拜耶稣，求他一件事。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came up to him with her sons, and kneeling before him she asked him for something.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Him with her sons, kneeling down and asking something from Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus with her sons. She knelt respectfully to ask a favor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to Jesus with her sons, bowing down and making a request of Him.
verses.textEn: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣问她："你想要甚么？"她说："求你下令，使我这两个儿子在你的国里，一个坐在你的右边，一个坐在你的左边。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣问她："你想要甚么？"她说："求你下令，使我这两个儿子在你的国里，一个坐在你的右边，一个坐在你的左边。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你要什么呢？</red>」她说：「<red>愿你叫我这两个儿子在你国里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp is it you want?”</red> he asked. She said, “Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom.”
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "What do you want?" She said to him, "Say that these two sons of mine are to sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your kingdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to her, "What do you wish?" She said to Him, "Grant that these two sons of mine may sit, one on Your right hand and the other on the left, in Your kingdom."
verses.textEnNlt: "What is your request?" he asked. She replied, "In your Kingdom, please let my two sons sit in places of honor next to you, one on your right and the other on your left."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to her, "What do you desire?" She *said to Him, "Say that in Your kingdom these two sons of mine shall sit, one at Your right, and one at Your left."
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp is it you want?”</red> he asked. She said, “Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom.”

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："你们不知道你们求的是甚么。我将要喝的杯，你们能喝吗？"他们说："能。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："你们不知道你们求的是甚么。我将要喝的杯，你们能喝吗？"他们说："能。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>你们不知道所求的是什么；我将要喝的杯，你们能喝吗？</red>」他们说：「<red>我们能。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp don’t know what you are asking,”</red> Jesus said to them. <red>“Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?”</red> “We can,” they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am to drink?" They said to him, "We are able."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered and said, "You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?" They said to Him, "We are able."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus answered by saying to them, "You don’t know what you are asking! Are you able to drink from the bitter cup of suffering I am about to drink?" "Oh yes," they replied, "we are able!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus replied, "You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?" They *said to Him, "We are able."
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp don’t know what you are asking,”</red> Jesus said to them. <red>“Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?”</red> “We can,” they answered.

verses.textZh: 他对他们说："<red>我的杯你们固然要喝，只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的；我父预备赐给谁，就赐给谁。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他们说："<red>我的杯你们固然要喝，只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的；我父预备赐给谁，就赐给谁。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我所喝的杯，你们必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是我父为谁预备的，就赐给谁。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "You will drink my cup, but to sit at my right hand and at my left is not mine to grant, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared by my Father."
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to them, "You will indeed drink My cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it is prepared by My Father."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told them, "You will indeed drink from my bitter cup. But I have no right to say who will sit on my right or my left. My Father has prepared those places for the ones he has chosen."
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to them, "My cup you shall drink; but to sit at My right and at My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared by My Father."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father.”</red>

verses.textZh: 其他十个门徒听见了，就向他们兄弟二人生气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其他十个门徒听见了，就向他们兄弟二人生气。
verses.textZhCuv: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒他们弟兄二人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the ten heard it, they were indignant at the two brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the ten heard it, they were greatly displeased with the two brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: When the ten other disciples heard what James and John had asked, they were indignant.
verses.textEnNasb: And after hearing this, the other ten disciples became indignant with the two brothers.
verses.textEn: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

verses.textZh: 耶稣把他们叫过来，说："<red>你们知道各国都有元首统治他们，也有官长管辖他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣把他们叫过来，说："<red>你们知道各国都有元首统治他们，也有官长管辖他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣叫了他们来，说：「你们知道外邦人有君王为主治理他们，有大臣操权管束他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus called them together and said, <red>“You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus called them to him and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus called them to Himself and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who are great exercise authority over them.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers in this world lord it over their people, and officials flaunt their authority over those under them.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus called them to Himself and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles domineer over them, and those in high position exercise authority over them.
verses.textEn: Jesus called them together and said, <red>“You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但你们中间却不要这样；谁想在你们中间成为大的，就要作你们的仆役；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但你们中间却不要这样；谁想在你们中间成为大的，就要作你们的仆役；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是在你们中间，不可这样；你们中间谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It shall not be so among you. But whoever would be great among you must be your servant,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet it shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you, let him be your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: But among you it will be different. Whoever wants to be a leader among you must be your servant,
verses.textEnNasb: It is not this way among you, but whoever wants to become prominent among you shall be your servant,
verses.textEn: <red>Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>谁想在你们中间为首的，就要作你们的奴仆。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>谁想在你们中间为首的，就要作你们的奴仆。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>谁愿为首，就必作你们的仆人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and whoever would be first among you must be your slave,
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever desires to be first among you, let him be your slave—
verses.textEnNlt: and whoever wants to be first among you must become your slave.
verses.textEnNasb: and whoever desires to be first among you shall be your slave;
verses.textEn: <red>and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，而是要服事人，并且要舍命，作许多人的赎价。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，而是要服事人，并且要舍命，作许多人的赎价。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: even as the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
verses.textEnNkjv: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many."
verses.textEnNlt: For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve others and to give his life as a ransom for many."
verses.textEnNasb: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many."
verses.textEn: <red>just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们从耶利哥出来的时候，有许多人跟着耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从耶利哥出来的时候，有许多人跟着耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们出耶利哥的时候，有极多的人跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they went out of Jericho, a great crowd followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they went out of Jericho, a great multitude followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus and the disciples left the town of Jericho, a large crowd followed behind.
verses.textEnNasb: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
verses.textEn: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

verses.textZh: 有两个瞎眼的人坐在路旁，听说耶稣经过，就喊叫："主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有两个瞎眼的人坐在路旁，听说耶稣经过，就喊叫："主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有两个瞎子坐在路旁，听说是耶稣经过，就喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there were two blind men sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, "Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, saying, "Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David!"
verses.textEnNlt: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was coming that way, they began shouting, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEnNasb: And two people who were blind, sitting by the road, hearing that Jesus was passing by, cried out, "Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!"
verses.textEn: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.textZh: 群众责备他们，叫他们不要出声，他们却更加放声喊叫："主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众责备他们，叫他们不要出声，他们却更加放声喊叫："主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人责备他们，不许他们作声；他们却越发喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEnEsv: The crowd rebuked them, telling them to be silent, but they cried out all the more, "Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the multitude warned them that they should be quiet; but they cried out all the more, saying, "Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Be quiet!" the crowd yelled at them. But they only shouted louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the crowd sternly warned them to be quiet; yet they cried out all the more, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEn: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣就站住，叫他们过来，说："<red>要我为你们作甚么呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就站住，叫他们过来，说："<red>要我为你们作甚么呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就站住，叫他们来，说：「<red>要我为你们做什么？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus stopped and called them. <red>“What do you want me to do for you?”</red> he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: And stopping, Jesus called them and said, "What do you want me to do for you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus stood still and called them, and said, "What do you want Me to do for you?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and called, "What do you want me to do for you?"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus stopped and called them, and said, "What do you want Me to do for you?"
verses.textEn: Jesus stopped and called them. <red>“What do you want me to do for you?”</red> he asked.

verses.textZh: 他们说："主啊，求你开我们的眼睛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："主啊，求你开我们的眼睛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「主啊，要我们的眼睛能看见！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord," they answered, "we want our sight."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Lord, let our eyes be opened."
verses.textEnNkjv: They said to Him, "Lord, that our eyes may be opened."
verses.textEnNlt: "Lord," they said, "we want to see!"
verses.textEnNasb: They *said to Him, "Lord, we want our eyes to be opened."
verses.textEn: "Lord," they answered, "we want our sight."

verses.textZh: 耶稣就怜悯他们，摸他们的眼睛。他们立刻能看见，就跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就怜悯他们，摸他们的眼睛。他们立刻能看见，就跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就动了慈心，把他们的眼睛一摸，他们立刻看见，就跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus in pity touched their eyes, and immediately they recovered their sight and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus had compassion and touched their eyes. And immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. Instantly they could see! Then they followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes; and immediately they regained their sight and followed Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣和门徒走近耶路撒冷，来到橄榄山的伯法其那里。耶稣派了两个门徒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和门徒走近耶路撒冷，来到橄榄山的伯法其那里。耶稣派了两个门徒，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄榄山那里。
verses.textEnNiv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they drew near to Jerusalem and came to Bethphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they drew near Jerusalem, and came to Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus and the disciples approached Jerusalem, they came to the town of Bethphage on the Mount of Olives. Jesus sent two of them on ahead.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had approached Jerusalem and had come to Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, Jesus then sent two disciples,
verses.textEn: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,

verses.textZh: 对他们说："<red>你们往对面的村子里去，立刻就会看见一头驴拴在那里，还有小驴跟牠在一起。把牠们解开，牵来给我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："<red>你们往对面的村子里去，立刻就会看见一头驴拴在那里，还有小驴跟牠在一起。把牠们解开，牵来给我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：「你们往对面村子里去，必看见一匹驴拴在那里，还有驴驹同在一处；你们解开，牵到我这里来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: saying to them, <red>“Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying to them, "Go into the village in front of you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying to them, "Go into the village opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Loose them and bring them to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go into the village over there," he said. "As soon as you enter it, you will see a donkey tied there, with its colt beside it. Untie them and bring them to me.
verses.textEnNasb: saying to them, "Go into the village opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied there and a colt with it. Untie them and bring them to Me.
verses.textEn: saying to them, <red>“Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果有人问你们，就要说：‘主需要牠们。’他会立刻让你们牵走。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果有人问你们，就要说：‘主需要牠们。’他会立刻让你们牵走。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若有人对你们说什么，你们就说：『主要用它。』那人必立时让你们牵来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and he will send them at once."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord has need of them,’ and immediately he will send them."
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone asks what you are doing, just say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and he will immediately let you take them."
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and he will send them on immediately."
verses.textEn: <red>If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这件事应验了先知所说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这件事应验了先知所说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这事成就是要应验先知的话，说：
verses.textEnNiv: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
verses.textEnEsv: This took place to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: This took place to fulfill the prophecy that said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now this took place so that what was spoken through the prophet would be fulfilled:
verses.textEn: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

verses.textZh: "要对锡安的居民 说： ‘看哪，你的王来到你这里了； 他是温柔的，他骑着驴，骑的是小驴。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "要对锡安的居民 说： ‘看哪，你的王来到你这里了； 他是温柔的，他骑着驴，骑的是小驴。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 要对锡安的居民 说： 看哪，你的王来到你这里， 是温柔的，又骑着驴， 就是骑着驴驹子。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your king is coming to you, humble, and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Tell the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your King is coming to you, Lowly, and sitting on a donkey, A colt, the foal of a donkey.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell the people of Jerusalem, ‘Look, your King is coming to you. He is humble, riding on a donkey— riding on a donkey’s colt.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold your King is coming to you, Humble, and mounted on a donkey, Even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ "
verses.textEn: "Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ "

verses.textZh: 门徒照着耶稣的吩咐去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒照着耶稣的吩咐去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就照耶稣所吩咐的去行，
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.
verses.textEnEsv: The disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the disciples went and did as Jesus commanded them.
verses.textEnNlt: The two disciples did as Jesus commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples went and did just as Jesus had instructed them,
verses.textEn: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.

verses.textZh: 牵了驴和小驴来，把衣服搭在牠们上面，耶稣就骑上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牵了驴和小驴来，把衣服搭在牠们上面，耶稣就骑上。
verses.textZhCuv: 牵了驴和驴驹来，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。
verses.textEnNiv: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.
verses.textEnEsv: They brought the donkey and the colt and put on them their cloaks, and he sat on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They brought the donkey and the colt, laid their clothes on them, and set Him on them.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought the donkey and the colt to him and threw their garments over the colt, and he sat on it.
verses.textEnNasb: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their cloaks on them; and He sat on the cloaks.
verses.textEn: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.

verses.textZh: 有一大群人把自己的衣服铺在路上，也有人从树上把树枝砍下来，铺在路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一大群人把自己的衣服铺在路上，也有人从树上把树枝砍下来，铺在路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人多半把衣服铺在路上；还有人砍下树枝来铺在路上。
verses.textEnNiv: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.textEnEsv: Most of the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, and others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a very great multitude spread their clothes on the road; others cut down branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.textEnNlt: Most of the crowd spread their garments on the road ahead of him, and others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.textEnNasb: Most of the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, and others were cutting branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
verses.textEn: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

verses.textZh: 前呼后拥的群众喊叫着： "‘和散那’归于大卫的子孙， 奉主名来的是应当称颂的，高天之上当唱‘和散那’。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 前呼后拥的群众喊叫着： "‘和散那’归于大卫的子孙， 奉主名来的是应当称颂的，高天之上当唱‘和散那’。"
verses.textZhCuv: 前行后随的众人喊着说： 和散那 归于大卫的子孙！ 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！ 高高在上和散那！
verses.textEnNiv: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"
verses.textEnEsv: And the crowds that went before him and that followed him were shouting, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the multitudes who went before and those who followed cried out, saying: "Hosanna to the Son of David! ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!’ Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was in the center of the procession, and the people all around him were shouting, "Praise God for the Son of David! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord ! Praise God in highest heaven!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the crowds going ahead of Him, and those who followed, were shouting, " Hosanna to the Son of David; Blessed is the One who comes in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.textEn: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，全城都震动起来，他们问："这人是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，全城都震动起来，他们问："这人是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣既进了耶路撒冷，合城都惊动了，说：「这是谁？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, "Who is this?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when he entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred up, saying, "Who is this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, "Who is this?"
verses.textEnNlt: The entire city of Jerusalem was in an uproar as he entered. "Who is this?" they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had entered Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, "Who is this?"
verses.textEn: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, "Who is this?"

verses.textZh: 大家都说："这就是那先知耶稣，是从加利利的拿撒勒来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家都说："这就是那先知耶稣，是从加利利的拿撒勒来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人说：「这是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶稣。」
verses.textEnNiv: The crowds answered, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."
verses.textEnEsv: And the crowds said, "This is the prophet Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the multitudes said, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth of Galilee."
verses.textEnNlt: And the crowds replied, "It’s Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."
verses.textEnNasb: And the crowds were saying, "This is Jesus the prophet, from Nazareth in Galilee."
verses.textEn: The crowds answered, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了圣殿，把殿里所有作买卖的人赶走，并推倒找换银钱的人的桌子，和卖鸽子的人的凳子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了圣殿，把殿里所有作买卖的人赶走，并推倒找换银钱的人的桌子，和卖鸽子的人的凳子；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了神的殿，赶出殿里一切做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子，和卖鸽子之人的凳子，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus entered the temple and drove out all who sold and bought in the temple, and he overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus went into the temple of God and drove out all those who bought and sold in the temple, and overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus entered the Temple and began to drive out all the people buying and selling animals for sacrifice. He knocked over the tables of the money changers and the chairs of those selling doves.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus entered the temple area and drove out all those who were selling and buying on the temple grounds, and He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling doves.
verses.textEn: Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

verses.textZh: <red>又对他们说："经上记着： ‘我的殿要称为祷告的殿。’ 你们竟把它弄成贼窝了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又对他们说："经上记着： ‘我的殿要称为祷告的殿。’ 你们竟把它弄成贼窝了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「<red>经上记着说： 我的殿必称为祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“It is written,”</red> he said to them, <red>“ ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you make it a den of robbers."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "The Scriptures declare, ‘My Temple will be called a house of prayer,’ but you have turned it into a den of thieves!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer’; but you are making it a den of robbers."
verses.textEn: <red>“It is written,”</red> he said to them, <red>“ ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 殿里的瞎子和瘸腿的都走过来，耶稣就医好他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿里的瞎子和瘸腿的都走过来，耶稣就医好他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在殿里有瞎子、瘸子到耶稣跟前，他就治好了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the blind and the lame came to Him in the temple, and He healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: The blind and the lame came to him in the Temple, and he healed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who were blind and those who limped came to Him in the temple area, and He healed them.
verses.textEn: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.

verses.textZh: 祭司长和经学家看见耶稣所行的奇事，又看见小孩子在殿中喊叫"‘和散那’归于大卫的子孙"，就很忿怒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和经学家看见耶稣所行的奇事，又看见小孩子在殿中喊叫"‘和散那’归于大卫的子孙"，就很忿怒，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和文士看见耶稣所行的奇事，又见小孩子在殿里喊着说：「和散那归于大卫的子孙！」就甚恼怒，
verses.textEnNiv: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple courts, "Hosanna to the Son of David," they were indignant.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying out in the temple, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" they were indignant,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that He did, and the children crying out in the temple and saying, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" they were indignant
verses.textEnNlt: The leading priests and the teachers of religious law saw these wonderful miracles and heard even the children in the Temple shouting, "Praise God for the Son of David." But the leaders were indignant.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that He had done, and the children who were shouting in the temple area, " Hosanna to the Son of David," they became indignant,
verses.textEn: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple courts, "Hosanna to the Son of David," they were indignant.

verses.textZh: 对耶稣说："<red>你听见他们说甚么吗？</red>"耶稣说："<red>我听见了。 ‘你从小孩和婴儿的口中， 得着了赞美。’ 这话你们没有念过吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对耶稣说："<red>你听见他们说甚么吗？</red>"耶稣说："<red>我听见了。 ‘你从小孩和婴儿的口中， 得着了赞美。’ 这话你们没有念过吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「<red>这些人所说的，你听见了吗？</red>」耶稣说：「<red>是的。经上说『你从婴孩和吃奶的口中完全了赞美』的话，你们没有念过吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked him. <red>“Yes,”p</red> replied Jesus, <red>“have you never read, “ ‘Frompn the lips of children and infants you,ld Lord, have called forth your praise’?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and they said to him, "Do you hear what these are saying?" And Jesus said to them, "Yes; have you never read, "‘Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies you have prepared praise’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to Him, "Do You hear what these are saying?" And Jesus said to them, "Yes. Have you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of babes and nursing infants You have perfected praise’?"
verses.textEnNlt: They asked Jesus, "Do you hear what these children are saying?" "Yes," Jesus replied. "Haven’t you ever read the Scriptures? For they say, ‘You have taught children and infants to give you praise.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: and they said to Him, "Do You hear what these children are saying?" And Jesus *said to them, "Yes. Have you never read, ‘From the mouths of infants and nursing babies You have prepared praise for Yourself’?"
verses.textEn: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked him. <red>“Yes,”p</red> replied Jesus, <red>“have you never read, “ ‘Frompn the lips of children and infants you,ld Lord, have called forth your praise’?”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是离开他们，出了城，来到伯大尼，在那里过了一夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是离开他们，出了城，来到伯大尼，在那里过了一夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是离开他们，出城到伯大尼去，在那里住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.
verses.textEnEsv: And leaving them, he went out of the city to Bethany and lodged there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and He lodged there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he returned to Bethany, where he stayed overnight.
verses.textEnNasb: And He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.
verses.textEn: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

verses.textZh: 耶稣清早回城的时候，觉得饿了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣清早回城的时候，觉得饿了。
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨回城的时候，他饿了，
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning, as he was returning to the city, he became hungry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the morning, as He returned to the city, He was hungry.
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to Jerusalem, he was hungry,
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the early morning, when He was returning to the city, He became hungry.
verses.textEn: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.

verses.textZh: 他看见路旁有一棵无花果树，就走过去；但他在树上甚么也找不到，只有叶子，就对树说："<red>你永远不再结果子了。</red>"那棵树就立刻枯萎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见路旁有一棵无花果树，就走过去；但他在树上甚么也找不到，只有叶子，就对树说："<red>你永远不再结果子了。</red>"那棵树就立刻枯萎。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见路旁有一棵无花果树，就走到跟前，在树上找不着什么，不过有叶子，就对树说：「<red>从今以后，你永不结果子。</red>」那无花果树就立刻枯干了。
verses.textEnNiv: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, <red>“May you never bear fruit again!”</red> Immediately the tree withered.
verses.textEnEsv: And seeing a fig tree by the wayside, he went to it and found nothing on it but only leaves. And he said to it, "May no fruit ever come from you again!" And the fig tree withered at once.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seeing a fig tree by the road, He came to it and found nothing on it but leaves, and said to it, "Let no fruit grow on you ever again." Immediately the fig tree withered away.
verses.textEnNlt: and he noticed a fig tree beside the road. He went over to see if there were any figs, but there were only leaves. Then he said to it, "May you never bear fruit again!" And immediately the fig tree withered up.
verses.textEnNasb: And seeing a lone fig tree by the road, He came to it and found nothing on it except leaves alone; and He *said to it, "No longer shall there ever be any fruit from you." And at once the fig tree withered.
verses.textEn: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, <red>“May you never bear fruit again!”</red> Immediately the tree withered.

verses.textZh: 门徒看见了，十分惊奇，说："这棵无花果树是怎样立刻枯萎的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒看见了，十分惊奇，说："这棵无花果树是怎样立刻枯萎的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒看见了，便希奇说：「无花果树怎么立刻枯干了呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?" they asked.
verses.textEnEsv: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, "How did the fig tree wither at once?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, "How did the fig tree wither away so soon?"
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples were amazed when they saw this and asked, "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?"
verses.textEnNasb: Seeing this, the disciples were amazed and asked, "How did the fig tree wither all at once?"
verses.textEn: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?" they asked.

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答他们："我实在告诉你们，如果你们有信心，不怀疑，不但能作我对无花果树所作的，就是对这座山说‘移开，投到海里去’，也必成就。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答他们："我实在告诉你们，如果你们有信心，不怀疑，不但能作我对无花果树所作的，就是对这座山说‘移开，投到海里去’，也必成就。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行无花果树上所行的事，就是对这座山说：『你挪开此地，投在海里！』也必成就。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and it will be done.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answered them, "Truly, I say to you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what has been done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus answered and said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but also if you say to this mountain, ‘Be removed and be cast into the sea,’ it will be done.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told them, "I tell you the truth, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you can do things like this and much more. You can even say to this mountain, ‘May you be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and it will happen.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Truly I say to you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it will happen.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and it will be done.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们祷告，无论求甚么，只要相信，都必得着。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们祷告，无论求甚么，只要相信，都必得着。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever you ask in prayer, you will receive, if you have faith."
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever things you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive."
verses.textEnNlt: You can pray for anything, and if you have faith, you will receive it."
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive it all."
verses.textEn: <red>If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了圣殿，正在教导人的时候，祭司长和民间的长老前来问他："你凭甚么权柄作这些事？谁给你这权柄？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了圣殿，正在教导人的时候，祭司长和民间的长老前来问他："你凭甚么权柄作这些事？谁给你这权柄？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了殿，正教训人的时候，祭司长和民间的长老来问他说：「你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you this authority?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when he entered the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came up to him as he was teaching, and said, "By what authority are you doing these things, and who gave you this authority?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He came into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people confronted Him as He was teaching, and said, "By what authority are You doing these things? And who gave You this authority?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus returned to the Temple and began teaching, the leading priests and elders came up to him. They demanded, "By what authority are you doing all these things? Who gave you the right?"
verses.textEnNasb: When He entered the temple area, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to Him while He was teaching, and said, "By what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?"
verses.textEn: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you this authority?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答他们："我也要问你们一句话，如果你们告诉我，我就告诉你们我凭甚么权柄作这些事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答他们："我也要问你们一句话，如果你们告诉我，我就告诉你们我凭甚么权柄作这些事。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我也要问你们一句话，你们若告诉我，我就告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "I also will ask you one question, and if you tell me the answer, then I also will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell Me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things:
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ll tell you by what authority I do these things if you answer one question," Jesus replied.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus responded and said to them, "I will also ask you one question, which, if you tell Me, I will also tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约翰的洗礼是从哪里来的呢？是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？"他们就彼此议论："如果我们说‘是从天上来的’，他会问我们‘那你们为甚么不信他呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约翰的洗礼是从哪里来的呢？是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？"他们就彼此议论："如果我们说‘是从天上来的’，他会问我们‘那你们为甚么不信他呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约翰的洗礼是从哪里来的？是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？」他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必对我们说：『这样，你们为什么不信他呢？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>John’s baptism—where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or of human origin?”</red> They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’
verses.textEnEsv: The baptism of John, from where did it come? From heaven or from man?" And they discussed it among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say to us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.textEnNkjv: The baptism of John—where was it from? From heaven or from men?" And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say to us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.textEnNlt: "Did John’s authority to baptize come from heaven, or was it merely human?" They talked it over among themselves. "If we say it was from heaven, he will ask us why we didn’t believe John.
verses.textEnNasb: The baptism of John was from what source: from heaven or from men?" And they began considering the implications among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say to us, ‘Then why did you not believe him?’
verses.textEn: <red>John’s baptism—where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or of human origin?”</red> They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’

verses.textZh: 如果我们说‘是从人来的’，我们又怕群众，因为他们都认为约翰是先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们说‘是从人来的’，我们又怕群众，因为他们都认为约翰是先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若说『从人间来』，我们又怕百姓，因为他们都以约翰为先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet."
verses.textEnEsv: But if we say, ‘From man,’ we are afraid of the crowd, for they all hold that John was a prophet."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all count John as a prophet."
verses.textEnNlt: But if we say it was merely human, we’ll be mobbed because the people believe John was a prophet."
verses.textEnNasb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the people; for they all regard John as a prophet."
verses.textEn: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet."

verses.textZh: 于是回答耶稣："我们不知道。"耶稣也对他们说："<red>我也不告诉你们，我凭甚么权柄作这些事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是回答耶稣："我们不知道。"耶稣也对他们说："<red>我也不告诉你们，我凭甚么权柄作这些事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 于是回答耶稣说：「<red>我们不知道。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Then he said, <red>“Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know." And he said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered Jesus and said, "We do not know." And He said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEnNlt: So they finally replied, "We don’t know." And Jesus responded, "Then I won’t tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEnNasb: And answering Jesus, they said, "We do not know." He also said to them, "Neither am I telling you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEn: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Then he said, <red>“Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们认为怎样？有一个人，他有两个儿子。他去对大儿子说：‘孩子，你今天到葡萄园去工作吧。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们认为怎样？有一个人，他有两个儿子。他去对大儿子说：‘孩子，你今天到葡萄园去工作吧。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又说：「一个人有两个儿子。他来对大儿子说：『我儿，你今天到葡萄园里去做工。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "What do you think? A man had two sons. And he went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work in the vineyard today.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first and said, ‘Son, go, work today in my vineyard.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But what do you think about this? A man with two sons told the older boy, ‘Son, go out and work in the vineyard today.’
verses.textEnNasb: "But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first and said, ‘ Son, go work today in the vineyard.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他说：‘我不想去。’但后来他改变主意，就去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说：‘我不想去。’但后来他改变主意，就去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他回答说：『我不去』，以后自己懊悔，就去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Ip will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind and went.
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he regretted it and went.
verses.textEnNlt: The son answered, ‘No, I won’t go,’ but later he changed his mind and went anyway.
verses.textEnNasb: But he replied, ‘I do not want to.’ Yet afterward he regretted it and went.
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Ip will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父亲又照样去吩咐小儿子。小儿子说：‘父亲，我会去的。’后来却没有去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父亲又照样去吩咐小儿子。小儿子说：‘父亲，我会去的。’后来却没有去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又来对小儿子也是这样说。他回答说：『父啊，我去』，他却不去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he went to the other son and said the same. And he answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but did not go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came to the second and said likewise. And he answered and said, ‘I go, sir,’ but he did not go.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the father told the other son, ‘You go,’ and he said, ‘Yes, sir, I will.’ But he didn’t go.
verses.textEnNasb: And the man came to his second son and said the same thing; and he replied, ‘I will, sir’; and yet he did not go.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这两个儿子，哪一个听父亲的话呢？"他们说："大儿子。"耶稣对他们说："我实在告诉你们：税吏和娼妓比你们先进神的国。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这两个儿子，哪一个听父亲的话呢？"他们说："大儿子。"耶稣对他们说："我实在告诉你们：税吏和娼妓比你们先进神的国。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 你们想，这两个儿子是哪一个遵行父命呢？」他们说：「<red>大儿子。</red>」耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，税吏和娼妓倒比你们先进神的国。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whichp of the two did what his father wanted?”</red> “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, <red>“Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Which of the two did the will of his father?" They said, "The first." Jesus said to them, "Truly, I say to you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which of the two did the will of his father?" They said to Him, "The first." Jesus said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you that tax collectors and harlots enter the kingdom of God before you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Which of the two obeyed his father?" They replied, "The first." Then Jesus explained his meaning: "I tell you the truth, corrupt tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the Kingdom of God before you do.
verses.textEnNasb: Which of the two did the will of his father?" They *said, "The first." Jesus *said to them, "Truly I say to you that the tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whichp of the two did what his father wanted?”</red> “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, <red>“Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约翰来到你们那里，指示你们行义路 ，你们不信他；税吏和娼妓却信了他。你们看见了之后，还是没有改变心意去信他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约翰来到你们那里，指示你们行义路 ，你们不信他；税吏和娼妓却信了他。你们看见了之后，还是没有改变心意去信他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为约翰遵着义路到你们这里来，你们却不信他；税吏和娼妓倒信他。你们看见了，后来还是不懊悔去信他。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. And even when you saw it, you did not afterward change your minds and believe him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him; but tax collectors and harlots believed him; and when you saw it, you did not afterward relent and believe him.
verses.textEnNlt: For John the Baptist came and showed you the right way to live, but you didn’t believe him, while tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even when you saw this happening, you refused to believe him and repent of your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For John came to you in the way of righteousness and you did not believe him; but the tax collectors and prostitutes did believe him; and you, seeing this, did not even have second thoughts afterward so as to believe him.
verses.textEn: <red>For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们再听一个比喻：有一个家主，栽种了一个葡萄园，四面围上篱笆，在园子里挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座瞭望台，然后把园子租给佃户，就远行去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们再听一个比喻：有一个家主，栽种了一个葡萄园，四面围上篱笆，在园子里挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座瞭望台，然后把园子租给佃户，就远行去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们再听一个比喻：有个家主栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，里面挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Listenp to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear another parable. There was a master of a house who planted a vineyard and put a fence around it and dug a winepress in it and built a tower and leased it to tenants, and went into another country.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear another parable: There was a certain landowner who planted a vineyard and set a hedge around it, dug a winepress in it and built a tower. And he leased it to vinedressers and went into a far country.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now listen to another story. A certain landowner planted a vineyard, built a wall around it, dug a pit for pressing out the grape juice, and built a lookout tower. Then he leased the vineyard to tenant farmers and moved to another country.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to another parable. There was a landowner who planted a vineyard and put a fence around it, and dug a wine press in it, and built a tower, and he leased it to vine-growers and went on a journey.
verses.textEn: <red>“Listenp to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了收成的时候，园主派了仆人到佃户那里，收取应该纳给他的果子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了收成的时候，园主派了仆人到佃户那里，收取应该纳给他的果子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>收果子的时候近了，就打发仆人到园户那里去收果子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When the season for fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to get his fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when vintage-time drew near, he sent his servants to the vinedressers, that they might receive its fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: At the time of the grape harvest, he sent his servants to collect his share of the crop.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the harvest time approached, he sent his slaves to the vine-growers to receive his fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>佃户却抓住他的仆人，打伤一个，杀了一个，又用石头打死一个。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>佃户却抓住他的仆人，打伤一个，杀了一个，又用石头打死一个。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>园户拿住仆人，打了一个，杀了一个，用石头打死一个。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the tenants took his servants and beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the vinedressers took his servants, beat one, killed one, and stoned another.
verses.textEnNlt: But the farmers grabbed his servants, beat one, killed one, and stoned another.
verses.textEnNasb: And the vine-growers took his slaves and beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是园主再派其他的仆人去，人数比前一次更多，但佃户也是同样对付他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是园主再派其他的仆人去，人数比前一次更多，但佃户也是同样对付他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人又打发别的仆人去，比先前更多；园户还是照样待他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Again he sent other servants, more than the first. And they did the same to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again he sent other servants, more than the first, and they did likewise to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So the landowner sent a larger group of his servants to collect for him, but the results were the same.
verses.textEnNasb: Again, he sent other slaves, more than the first; and they did the same things to them.
verses.textEn: <red>Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>最后，他派了自己的儿子去，说：‘他们必尊敬我的儿子。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>最后，他派了自己的儿子去，说：‘他们必尊敬我的儿子。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>后来打发他的儿子到他们那里去，意思说：『他们必尊敬我的儿子。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Finally he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then last of all he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Finally, the owner sent his son, thinking, ‘Surely they will respect my son.’
verses.textEnNasb: But afterward he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.textEn: <red>Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>佃户看见他的儿子，就彼此说：‘这是继承产业的；来，我们杀了他，占有他的产业吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>佃户看见他的儿子，就彼此说：‘这是继承产业的；来，我们杀了他，占有他的产业吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不料，园户看见他儿子，就彼此说：『这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，占他的产业！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and have his inheritance.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the vinedressers saw the son, they said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and seize his inheritance.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But when the tenant farmers saw his son coming, they said to one another, ‘Here comes the heir to this estate. Come on, let’s kill him and get the estate for ourselves!’
verses.textEnNasb: But when the vine-growers saw the son, they said among themselves, ‘This is the heir; come, let’s kill him and take possession of his inheritance!’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是他们抓住他，把他推出葡萄园外杀了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是他们抓住他，把他推出葡萄园外杀了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们就拿住他，推出葡萄园外，杀了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took him and cast him out of the vineyard and killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: So they grabbed him, dragged him out of the vineyard, and murdered him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
verses.textEn: <red>So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那么，葡萄园的主人来到的时候，会怎样对待那些佃户呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那么，葡萄园的主人来到的时候，会怎样对待那些佃户呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>园主来的时候要怎样处治这些园户呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Therefore,p when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When therefore the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?"

verses.textEnNiv: "He will bring those wretches to a wretched end," they replied, "and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time."

verses.textEnNkjv: They said to Him, "He will destroy those wicked men miserably, and lease his vineyard to other vinedressers who will render to him the fruits in their seasons."
verses.textEnNlt: The religious leaders replied, "He will put the wicked men to a horrible death and lease the vineyard to others who will give him his share of the crop after each harvest."
verses.textEnNasb: They *said to Him, "He will bring those wretches to a wretched end and lease the vineyard to other vine-growers, who will pay him the fruit in the proper seasons."
verses.textEn: "He will bring those wretches to a wretched end," they replied, "and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time."

verses.textEnNiv: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Pharisees went and plotted how to entangle him in his words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees went and plotted how they might entangle Him in His talk.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Pharisees met together to plot how to trap Jesus into saying something for which he could be arrested.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Pharisees went and plotted together how they might trap Him in what He said.
verses.textEn: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.

verses.textZh: 他们派了自己的门徒和希律党的人一同去问耶稣："老师，我们知道你为人诚实，照着真理把神的道教导人，不顾忌任何人，因为你不徇情面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们派了自己的门徒和希律党的人一同去问耶稣："老师，我们知道你为人诚实，照着真理把神的道教导人，不顾忌任何人，因为你不徇情面。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发他们的门徒同希律党的人去见耶稣，说：「夫子，我们知道你是诚实人，并且诚诚实实传神的道，什么人你都不徇情面，因为你不看人的外貌。
verses.textEnNiv: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know that you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are.
verses.textEnEsv: And they sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, "Teacher, we know that you are true and teach the way of God truthfully, and you do not care about anyone’s opinion, for you are not swayed by appearances.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they sent to Him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, "Teacher, we know that You are true, and teach the way of God in truth; nor do You care about anyone, for You do not regard the person of men.
verses.textEnNlt: They sent some of their disciples, along with the supporters of Herod, to meet with him. "Teacher," they said, "we know how honest you are. You teach the way of God truthfully. You are impartial and don’t play favorites.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *sent their disciples to Him, along with the Herodians, saying, "Teacher, we know that You are truthful and teach the way of God in truth, and do not care what anyone thinks; for You are not partial to anyone.
verses.textEn: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know that you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are.

verses.textZh: 请把你的意见告诉我们，纳税给凯撒，可不可以呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请把你的意见告诉我们，纳税给凯撒，可不可以呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 请告诉我们，你的意见如何？纳税给凯撒可以不可以？」
verses.textEnNiv: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?"
verses.textEnEsv: Tell us, then, what you think. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell us, therefore, what do You think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"
verses.textEnNlt: Now tell us what you think about this: Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
verses.textEnNasb: Tell us then, what do You think? Is it permissible to pay a poll-tax to Caesar, or not?"
verses.textEn: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣看出他们的恶意，就说："<red>虚伪的人，为甚么试探我呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看出他们的恶意，就说："<red>虚伪的人，为甚么试探我呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看出他们的恶意，就说：「假冒为善的人哪，为什么试探我？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, <red>“You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus, aware of their malice, said, "Why put me to the test, you hypocrites?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, "Why do you test Me, you hypocrites?
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus knew their evil motives. "You hypocrites!" he said. "Why are you trying to trap me?
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus perceived their malice, and said, "Why are you testing Me, you hypocrites?
verses.textEn: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, <red>“You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>拿纳税的钱币给我看看。"他们就拿了一个银币给他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>拿纳税的钱币给我看看。"他们就拿了一个银币给他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>拿一个上税的钱给我看！」他们就拿一个银钱来给他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Show me the coin used for paying the tax.”</red> They brought him a denarius,
verses.textEnEsv: Show me the coin for the tax." And they brought him a denarius.
verses.textEnNkjv: Show Me the tax money." So they brought Him a denarius.
verses.textEnNlt: Here, show me the coin used for the tax." When they handed him a Roman coin,
verses.textEnNasb: Show Me the coin used for the poll-tax." And they brought Him a denarius.
verses.textEn: <red>Show me the coin used for paying the tax.”</red> They brought him a denarius,

verses.textZh: 耶稣问他们："<red>这是谁的像，谁的名号？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣问他们："<red>这是谁的像，谁的名号？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>这像和这号是谁的？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: and he asked them, <red>“Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Whose likeness and inscription is this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Whose image and inscription is this?"
verses.textEnNlt: he asked, "Whose picture and title are stamped on it?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Whose image and inscription is this?"
verses.textEn: and he asked them, <red>“Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们回答："凯撒的。"他就对他们说："<red>凯撒的应当归给凯撒，神的应当归给神。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："凯撒的。"他就对他们说："<red>凯撒的应当归给凯撒，神的应当归给神。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「<red>是凯撒的。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>这样，凯撒的物当归给凯撒；神的物当归给神。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “Caesar’s,” they replied. Then he said to them, <red>“So give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "Caesar’s." Then he said to them, "Therefore render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
verses.textEnNkjv: They said to Him, "Caesar’s." And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
verses.textEnNlt: "Caesar’s," they replied. "Well, then," he said, "give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God."
verses.textEnNasb: They *said to Him, "Caesar’s." Then He *said to them, "Then pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s; and to God the things that are God’s."
verses.textEn: “Caesar’s,” they replied. Then he said to them, <red>“So give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们听了，十分惊奇，就离开他走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听了，十分惊奇，就离开他走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见就希奇，离开他走了。
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.
verses.textEnEsv: When they heard it, they marveled. And they left him and went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had heard thesewords, they marveled, and left Him and went their way.
verses.textEnNlt: His reply amazed them, and they went away.
verses.textEnNasb: And hearing this, they were amazed; and they left Him and went away.
verses.textEn: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.

verses.textZh: 撒都该人向来认为没有复活的事。那一天，他们前来问耶稣：
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒都该人向来认为没有复活的事。那一天，他们前来问耶稣：
verses.textZhCuv: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。那天，他们来问耶稣说：
verses.textEnNiv: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
verses.textEnEsv: The same day Sadducees came to him, who say that there is no resurrection, and they asked him a question,
verses.textEnNkjv: The same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him and asked Him,
verses.textEnNlt: That same day Jesus was approached by some Sadducees—religious leaders who say there is no resurrection from the dead. They posed this question:
verses.textEnNasb: On that day some Sadducees (who say there is no resurrection) came to Jesus and questioned Him,
verses.textEn: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

verses.textZh: "老师，摩西说：‘如果一个人死了，没有儿女，他的弟弟应该娶他的妻子，为哥哥立后。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "老师，摩西说：‘如果一个人死了，没有儿女，他的弟弟应该娶他的妻子，为哥哥立后。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「夫子，摩西说：『人若死了，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Teacher," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies having no children, his brother must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.’
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: "Teacher, Moses said that if a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies without children, his brother should marry the widow and have a child who will carry on the brother’s name.’
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies having no children, his brother as next of kin shall marry his wife, and raise up children for his brother.’
verses.textEn: "Teacher," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.

verses.textZh: 从前我们这里有兄弟七人，头一个结了婚，没有孩子就死了，留下妻子给他的弟弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前我们这里有兄弟七人，头一个结了婚，没有孩子就死了，留下妻子给他的弟弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前，在我们这里有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有孩子，撇下妻子给兄弟。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first died after he had married, and having no offspring, left his wife to his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Well, suppose there were seven brothers. The oldest one married and then died without children, so his brother married the widow.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there were seven brothers among us; and the first married and died, and having no children, he left his wife to his brother.
verses.textEn: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

verses.textZh: 第二个、第三个直到第七个都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二个、第三个直到第七个都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二、第三，直到第七个，都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.
verses.textEnEsv: So too the second and third, down to the seventh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, even to the seventh.
verses.textEnNlt: But the second brother also died, and the third brother married her. This continued with all seven of them.
verses.textEnNasb: It was the same also with the second brother, and the third, down to the seventh.
verses.textEn: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.

verses.textZh: 最后，那女人也死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后，那女人也死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 末后，妇人也死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, the woman died.
verses.textEnEsv: After them all, the woman died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.textEnNlt: Last of all, the woman also died.
verses.textEnNasb: Last of all, the woman died.
verses.textEn: Finally, the woman died.

verses.textZh: 那么，复活的时候，她是这七个人中哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们都娶过她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，复活的时候，她是这七个人中哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们都娶过她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，当复活的时候，她是七个人中哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们都娶过她。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?"
verses.textEnEsv: In the resurrection, therefore, of the seven, whose wife will she be? For they all had her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife of the seven will she be? For they all had her."
verses.textEnNlt: So tell us, whose wife will she be in the resurrection? For all seven were married to her."
verses.textEnNasb: In the resurrection, therefore, whose wife of the seven will she be? For they all had her in marriage."
verses.textEn: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答他们："你们错了，因为你们不明白圣经，也不晓得神的能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答他们："你们错了，因为你们不明白圣经，也不晓得神的能力。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「你们错了；因为不明白圣经，也不晓得神的大能。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus answered them, "You are wrong, because you know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Your mistake is that you don’t know the Scriptures, and you don’t know the power of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus answered and said to them, "You are mistaken, since you do not understand the Scriptures nor the power of God.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>复活的时候，人们也不娶也不嫁，而是像天上的使者一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>复活的时候，人们也不娶也不嫁，而是像天上的使者一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当复活的时候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels of God in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: For when the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. In this respect they will be like the angels in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>群众听了他的教训，就十分诧异。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>群众听了他的教训，就十分诧异。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>论到死人复活，神在经上向你们所说的，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was said to you by God:
verses.textEnNkjv: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "But now, as to whether there will be a resurrection of the dead—haven’t you ever read about this in the Scriptures? Long after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, God said,
verses.textEnNasb: But regarding the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God:
verses.textEn: <red>But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,</red>

verses.textZhCnvs: <red>法利赛人听见耶稣使撒都该人无话可说，就聚集在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他说：『我是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not God of the dead, but of the living."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."
verses.textEnNlt: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ So he is the God of the living, not the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living."
verses.textEn: <red>‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们中间有一个律法家，试探耶稣说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间有一个律法家，试探耶稣说：
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见这话，就希奇他的教训。
verses.textEnNiv: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the crowd heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the multitudes heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
verses.textEnNlt: When the crowds heard him, they were astounded at his teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
verses.textEn: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

verses.textZh: "老师，律法中哪一条诫命是最重要的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "老师，律法中哪一条诫命是最重要的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人听见耶稣堵住了撒都该人的口，他们就聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Pharisees heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the Pharisees heard that He had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the Pharisees heard that he had silenced the Sadducees with his reply, they met together to question him again.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.
verses.textEn: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

verses.textZh: 他回答："你要全心、全性、全意爱主你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："你要全心、全性、全意爱主你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有一个人是律法师，要试探耶稣，就问他说：

verses.textEnEsv: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question to test him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of them, a lawyer, asked Himaquestion, testing Him, and saying,

verses.textZh: 这是最重要的第一条诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是最重要的第一条诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 「夫子，律法上的诫命，哪一条是最大的呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Teacher, which is the great commandment in the Law?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Teacher, which is the great commandment in the law?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher, which is the most important commandment in the law of Moses?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Teacher, which is the great commandment in the Law?"
verses.textEn: "Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"

verses.textZh: <red>第二条也和它相似，就是要爱人如己。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>第二条也和它相似，就是要爱人如己。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「你要尽心、尽性、尽意爱主－你的神。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied: <red>“ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "‘You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.’
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to him, " ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
verses.textEn: Jesus replied: <red>“ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>全部律法和先知书，都以这两条诫命作为根据。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>全部律法和先知书，都以这两条诫命作为根据。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这是诫命中的第一，且是最大的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is the first and greatest commandment.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This is the great and first commandment.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the first and great commandment.

verses.textZh: <red>"经学家和法利赛人坐在摩西的座位上，</red>

verses.textEnNlt: "The teachers of religious law and the Pharisees are the official interpreters of the law of Moses.
