verses.textEn: <red>“The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以凡他们吩咐你们的，你们都要遵行和谨守，但不可效法他们的行为，因为他们只会说而不去作。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以凡他们吩咐你们的，你们都要遵行和谨守，但不可效法他们的行为，因为他们只会说而不去作。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡他们所吩咐你们的，你们都要谨守遵行。但不要效法他们的行为；因为他们能说，不能行。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So you must be careful to do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so do and observe whatever they tell you, but not the works they do. For they preach, but do not practice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore whatever they tell you to observe,that observe and do, but do not do according to their works; for they say, and do not do.
verses.textEnNlt: So practice and obey whatever they tell you, but don’t follow their example. For they don’t practice what they teach.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, whatever they tell you, do and comply with it all, but do not do as they do; for they say things and do not do them.
verses.textEn: <red>So you must be careful to do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们把重担捆起来，压在人的肩头上，但自己连一个指头也不肯动。</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们把难担的重担捆起来，搁在人的肩上，但自己一个指头也不肯动。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They tie up heavy burdens, hard to bear, and lay them on people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to move them with their finger.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they bind heavy burdens, hard to bear, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.textEnNlt: They crush people with unbearable religious demands and never lift a finger to ease the burden.
verses.textEnNasb: And they tie up heavy burdens and lay them on people’s shoulders, but they themselves are unwilling to move them with so much as their finger.
verses.textEn: <red>They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们所作的一切，都是要作给人看：他们把经文的匣子做大了，衣服的繸子做长了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们所作的一切，都是要作给人看：他们把经文的匣子做大了，衣服的繸子做长了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们一切所做的事都是要叫人看见，所以将佩戴的经文做宽了，衣裳的䍁子做长了，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Everythingp they do is done for people to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the borders of their garments.
verses.textEnNlt: "Everything they do is for show. On their arms they wear extra wide prayer boxes with Scripture verses inside, and they wear robes with extra long tassels.
verses.textEnNasb: And they do all their deeds to be noticed by other people; for they broaden their phylacteries and lengthen the tassels of their garments.
verses.textEn: <red>“Everythingp they do is done for people to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;</red>

verses.textEnNlt: They love to receive respectful greetings as they walk in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi.’
verses.textEnNasb: and personal greetings in the marketplaces, and being called Rabbi by the people.
verses.textEn: <red>they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by others.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而你们不要被人称为‘拉比’，因为只有一位是你们的老师，你们都是弟兄。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而你们不要被人称为‘拉比’，因为只有一位是你们的老师，你们都是弟兄。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但你们不要受拉比的称呼，因为只有一位是你们的夫子；你们都是弟兄。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But you are not to be called rabbi, for you have one teacher, and you are all brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, do not be called ‘Rabbi’; for One is your Teacher, the Christ, and you are all brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t let anyone call you ‘Rabbi,’ for you have only one teacher, and all of you are equal as brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, do not be called Rabbi; for only One is your Teacher, and you are all brothers and sisters.
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要称呼地上的人为父，因为只有一位是你们的父，就是天父。</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>也不要称呼地上的人为父，因为只有一位是你们的父，就是在天上的父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And call no man your father on earth, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not call anyone on earth your father; for One is your Father, He who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t address anyone here on earth as ‘Father,’ for only God in heaven is your Father.
verses.textEnNasb: And do not call anyone on earth your father; for only One is your Father, He who is in heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们也不要被人称为师傅，因为只有一位是你们的师傅，就是基督。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们也不要被人称为师傅，因为只有一位是你们的师傅，就是基督。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>也不要受师尊的称呼，因为只有一位是你们的师尊，就是基督。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Neither be called instructors, for you have one instructor, the Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not be called teachers; for One is your Teacher, the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t let anyone call you ‘Teacher,’ for you have only one teacher, the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: And do not be called leaders; for only One is your Leader, that is, Christ.
verses.textEn: <red>Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们中间最大的，必作你们的仆人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们中间最大的，必作你们的仆人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们中间谁为大，谁就要作你们的用人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The greatest among you will be your servant.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: The greatest among you must be a servant.
verses.textEnNasb: But the greatest of you shall be your servant.
verses.textEn: <red>The greatest among you will be your servant.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡高抬自己的，必被降卑；凡自己谦卑的，必被升高。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡高抬自己的，必被降卑；凡自己谦卑的，必被升高。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever exalts himself shall be humbled, and whoever humbles himself shall be exalted.
verses.textEn: <red>For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们在人面前关了天国的门，自己不进去，连正要进去的人，你们也不准他们进去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们在人面前关了天国的门，自己不进去，连正要进去的人，你们也不准他们进去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们正当人前，把天国的门关了，自己不进去，正要进去的人，你们也不容他们进去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the door of the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you shut the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces. For you neither enter yourselves nor allow those who would enter to go in.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men; for you neither go in yourselves, nor do you allow those who are entering to go in.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you shut the door of the Kingdom of Heaven in people’s faces. You won’t go in yourselves, and you don’t let others enter either.
verses.textEnNasb: "But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you shut the kingdom of heaven in front of people; for you do not enter it yourselves, nor do you allow those who are entering to go in.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the door of the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.</red>

verses.textZh: "虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们走遍海洋陆地，要使一个人入教；当他入了教，你们却使他沦为地狱之子，比你们更甚。
verses.textZhCnvs: "虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们走遍海洋陆地，要使一个人入教；当他入了教，你们却使他沦为地狱之子，比你们更甚。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们走遍洋海陆地，勾引一个人入教，既入了教，却使他作地狱之子，比你们还加倍。
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel across sea and land to make a single proselyte, and when he becomes a proselyte, you make him twice as much a child of hell as yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you cross land and sea to make one convert, and then you turn that person into twice the child of hell you yourselves are!
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you travel around on sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.
verses.textEn: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.

verses.textZh: <red>"你们这些瞎眼的向导有祸了！你们说：‘凡指着圣所而起的誓，是没有用的；但指着圣所的金子而起的誓，就必须遵守。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们这些瞎眼的向导有祸了！你们说：‘凡指着圣所而起的誓，是没有用的；但指着圣所的金子而起的誓，就必须遵守。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们这瞎眼领路的有祸了！你们说：『凡指着殿起誓的，这算不得什么；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就该谨守。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it is nothing, but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel land and sea to win one proselyte, and when he is won, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: "Blind guides! What sorrow awaits you! For you say that it means nothing to swear ‘by God’s Temple,’ but that it is binding to swear ‘by the gold in the Temple.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, that is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple is obligated.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们这些瞎眼的愚昧人哪，到底是金子大，还是使金子成圣的圣所大呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们这些瞎眼的愚昧人哪，到底是金子大，还是使金子成圣的圣所大呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这无知瞎眼的人哪，什么是大的？是金子呢？还是叫金子成圣的殿呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gold of the temple is bound by that oath.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that has made the gold sacred?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obliged to perform it.’
verses.textEnNlt: Blind fools! Which is more important—the gold or the Temple that makes the gold sacred?
verses.textEnNasb: You fools and blind men! Which is more important, the gold or the temple that sanctified the gold?
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gold of the temple is bound by that oath.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们又说：‘凡指着祭坛所起的誓，是没有用的；但指着坛上的祭物所起的誓，就必须遵守。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们又说：‘凡指着祭坛所起的誓，是没有用的；但指着坛上的祭物所起的誓，就必须遵守。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们又说：『凡指着坛起誓的，这算不得什么；只是凡指着坛上礼物起誓的，他就该谨守。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it is nothing, but if anyone swears by the gift that is on the altar, he is bound by his oath.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Fools and blind! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
verses.textEnNlt: And you say that to swear ‘by the altar’ is not binding, but to swear ‘by the gifts on the altar’ is binding.
verses.textEnNasb: And you say, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, that is nothing; but whoever swears by the offering that is on it is obligated.’
verses.textEn: <red>You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>瞎眼的人哪！到底是祭物大，还是使祭物成圣的祭坛大呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>瞎眼的人哪！到底是祭物大，还是使祭物成圣的祭坛大呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这瞎眼的人哪，什么是大的？是礼物呢？还是叫礼物成圣的坛呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You also say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gift on the altar is bound by that oath.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You blind men! For which is greater, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
verses.textEnNkjv: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obliged to perform it.’
verses.textEnNlt: How blind! For which is more important—the gift on the altar or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
verses.textEnNasb: You blind men, which is more important, the offering or the altar that sanctifies the offering?
verses.textEn: <red>You also say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gift on the altar is bound by that oath.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，凡指着祭坛起誓的，他就是指着祭坛和坛上的一切起誓；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，凡指着祭坛起誓的，他就是指着祭坛和坛上的一切起誓；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，人指着坛起誓，就是指着坛和坛上一切所有的起誓；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So whoever swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fools and blind! For which is greater, the gift or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
verses.textEnNlt: When you swear ‘by the altar,’ you are swearing by it and by everything on it.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, the one who swears by the altar, swears both by the altar and by everything on it.
verses.textEn: <red>You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>指着圣所起誓的，就是指着圣所和住在那里的神起誓；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>指着圣所起誓的，就是指着圣所和住在那里的神起誓；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人指着殿起誓，就是指着殿和那住在殿里的起誓；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore, anyone who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever swears by the temple swears by it and by him who dwells in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he who swears by the altar, swears by it and by all things on it.
verses.textEnNlt: And when you swear ‘by the Temple,’ you are swearing by it and by God, who lives in it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the one who swears by the temple, swears both by the temple and by Him who dwells in it.
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore, anyone who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>指着天起誓的，就是指着神的宝座和坐在宝座上的起誓。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>指着天起誓的，就是指着神的宝座和坐在宝座上的起誓。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人指着天起誓，就是指着神的宝座和那坐在上面的起誓。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And anyone who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever swears by heaven swears by the throne of God and by him who sits upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by Him who dwells in it.
verses.textEnNlt: And when you swear ‘by heaven,’ you are swearing by the throne of God and by God, who sits on the throne.
verses.textEnNasb: And the one who swears by heaven, swears both by the throne of God and by Him who sits upon it.
verses.textEn: <red>And anyone who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们把薄荷、茴香、芹菜，献上十分之一，却忽略律法上更重要的，就如正义、怜悯和信实；这些更重要的是你们应当作的，但其他的也不可忽略。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们把薄荷、茴香、芹菜，献上十分之一，却忽略律法上更重要的，就如正义、怜悯和信实；这些更重要的是你们应当作的，但其他的也不可忽略。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、茴香、芹菜献上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公义、怜悯、信实，反倒不行了。这更重的是你们当行的；那也是不可不行的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And anyone who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the one who sits on it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint and dill and cumin, and have neglected the weightier matters of the law: justice and mercy and faithfulness. These you ought to have done, without neglecting the others.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by Him who sits on it.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you are careful to tithe even the tiniest income from your herb gardens, but you ignore the more important aspects of the law—justice, mercy, and faith. You should tithe, yes, but do not neglect the more important things.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint and dill and cumin, and have neglected the weightier provisions of the Law: justice and mercy and faithfulness; but these are the things you should have done without neglecting the others.
verses.textEn: <red>And anyone who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the one who sits on it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们这些瞎眼的向导啊，你们把蚊虫滤出来，却把骆驼吞下去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们这些瞎眼的向导啊，你们把蚊虫滤出来，却把骆驼吞下去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这瞎眼领路的，蠓虫你们就滤出来，骆驼你们倒吞下去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices—mint, dill and cumin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You blind guides, straining out a gnat and swallowing a camel!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have neglected the weightier matters of the law: justice and mercy and faith. These you ought to have done, without leaving the others undone.
verses.textEnNlt: Blind guides! You strain your water so you won’t accidentally swallow a gnat, but you swallow a camel!
verses.textEnNasb: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat and swallow a camel!
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices—mint, dill and cumin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们洗净杯盘的外面，里面却装满了抢夺和放荡。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们洗净杯盘的外面，里面却装满了抢夺和放荡。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们洗净杯盘的外面，里面却盛满了勒索和放荡。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and the plate, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blind guides, who strain out a gnat and swallow a camel!
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you are so careful to clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside you are filthy—full of greed and self-indulgence!
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside they are full of robbery and self-indulgence.
verses.textEn: <red>You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>瞎眼的法利赛人哪，先把杯和盘的里面洗净，好使外面也可以干净。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>瞎眼的法利赛人哪，先把杯和盘的里面洗净，好使外面也可以干净。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你这瞎眼的法利赛人，先洗净杯盘的里面，好叫外面也干净了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and the plate, that the outside also may be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you cleanse the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of extortion and self-indulgence.
verses.textEnNlt: You blind Pharisee! First wash the inside of the cup and the dish, and then the outside will become clean, too.
verses.textEnNasb: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the dish, so that the outside of it may also become clean.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们好象粉饰了的坟墓，外面好看，里面却装满了死人的骨头和各样的污秽；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们好象粉饰了的坟墓，外面好看，里面却装满了死人的骨头和各样的污秽；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们好像粉饰的坟墓，外面好看，里面却装满了死人的骨头和一切的污秽。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but within are full of dead people’s bones and all uncleanness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blind Pharisee, first cleanse the inside of the cup and dish, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs—beautiful on the outside but filled on the inside with dead people’s bones and all sorts of impurity.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs which on the outside appear beautiful, but inside they are full of dead men’s bones and all uncleanness.
verses.textEn: <red>Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>照样，你们外面看来像义人，里面却充塞着虚伪和不法。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>照样，你们外面看来像义人，里面却充塞着虚伪和不法。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们也是如此，在人前，外面显出公义来，里面却装满了假善和不法的事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So you also outwardly appear righteous to others, but within you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs which indeed appear beautiful outwardly, but inside are full of dead men’s bones and all uncleanness.
verses.textEnNlt: Outwardly you look like righteous people, but inwardly your hearts are filled with hypocrisy and lawlessness.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, outwardly appear righteous to people, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们建造先知的墓，修饰义人的碑，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"虚伪的经学家和法利赛人哪，你们有祸了！你们建造先知的墓，修饰义人的碑，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们建造先知的坟，修饰义人的墓，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous,
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you teachers of religious law and you Pharisees. Hypocrites! For you build tombs for the prophets your ancestors killed, and you decorate the monuments of the godly people your ancestors destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous,
verses.textEn: <red>In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>并且说：‘我们若活在我们祖先的时代，决不会与他们一同流先知的血。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>并且说：‘我们若活在我们祖先的时代，决不会与他们一同流先知的血。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>『若是我们在我们祖宗的时候，必不和他们同流先知的血。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you build the tombs of the prophets and adorn the monuments of the righteous,
verses.textEnNlt: Then you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would never have joined them in killing the prophets.’
verses.textEnNasb: and you say, ‘If we had been living in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，你们就指证自己是杀害先知的人的子孙了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，你们就指证自己是杀害先知的人的子孙了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这就是你们自己证明是杀害先知者的子孙了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Thus you witness against yourselves that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But in saying that, you testify against yourselves that you are indeed the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: So you testify against yourselves, that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
verses.textEn: <red>And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那么，去完成你们祖先的罪孽吧！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那么，去完成你们祖先的罪孽吧！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们去充满你们祖宗的恶贯吧！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you are witnesses against yourselves that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: Go ahead and finish what your ancestors started.
verses.textEnNasb: Fill up, then, the measure of the guilt of your fathers.
verses.textEn: <red>So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们这些蛇，这些毒蛇所生的啊，你们怎能逃脱地狱的刑罚呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们这些蛇，这些毒蛇所生的啊，你们怎能逃脱地狱的刑罚呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这些蛇类、毒蛇之种啊，怎能逃脱地狱的刑罚呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You serpents, you brood of vipers, how are you to escape being sentenced to hell?
verses.textEnNkjv: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers’ guilt.
verses.textEnNlt: Snakes! Sons of vipers! How will you escape the judgment of hell?
verses.textEnNasb: You snakes, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the sentence of hell?
verses.textEn: <red>Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此，我差派先知、智慧人和经学家到你们那里；有些你们要杀害又钉在十字架上，有些你们要在会堂里鞭打，从一个城赶逐到另一个城。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此，我差派先知、智慧人和经学家到你们那里；有些你们要杀害又钉在十字架上，有些你们要在会堂里鞭打，从一个城赶逐到另一个城。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以我差遣先知和智慧人并文士到你们这里来，有的你们要杀害，要钉十字架；有的你们要在会堂里鞭打，从这城追逼到那城，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I send you prophets and wise men and scribes, some of whom you will kill and crucify, and some you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town,
verses.textEnNkjv: Serpents, brood of vipers! How can you escape the condemnation of hell?
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers of religious law. But you will kill some by crucifixion, and you will flog others with whips in your synagogues, chasing them from city to city.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, behold, I am sending you prophets and wise men and scribes; some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will flog in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city,
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，从义人亚伯的血起，到巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止，他就是你们在圣所和祭坛中间所杀的，所有义人在地上所流的血，都要归在你们身上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，从义人亚伯的血起，到巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止，他就是你们在圣所和祭坛中间所杀的，所有义人在地上所流的血，都要归在你们身上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>叫世上所流义人的血都归到你们身上，从义人亚伯的血起，直到你们在殿和坛中间所杀的巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore I am sending you prophets and sages and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah the son of Barachiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, indeed, I send you prophets, wise men, and scribes: some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, you will be held responsible for the murder of all godly people of all time—from the murder of righteous Abel to the murder of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you killed in the Temple between the sanctuary and the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: so that upon you will fall the guilt of all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore I am sending you prophets and sages and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必临到这个世代。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必临到这个世代。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切的罪都要归到这世代了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, all these things will come upon this generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah, son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, this judgment will fall on this very generation.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, all these things will come upon this generation.
verses.textEn: <red>And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"耶路撒冷，耶路撒冷啊，你杀害先知，又用石头把奉派到你们那里的人打死。我多次想招聚你的儿女，好象母鸡招聚小鸡到翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"耶路撒冷，耶路撒冷啊，你杀害先知，又用石头把奉派到你们那里的人打死。我多次想招聚你的儿女，好象母鸡招聚小鸡到翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷啊，你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to it! How often would I have gathered your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you were not willing!
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, all these things will come upon this generation.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones God’s messengers! How often I have wanted to gather your children together as a hen protects her chicks beneath her wings, but you wouldn’t let me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who have been sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, the way a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were unwilling.
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你看，你们的家必成为荒场，留给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你看，你们的家必成为荒场，留给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Jerusalem,p Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: See, your house is left to you desolate.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the one who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!
verses.textEnNlt: And now, look, your house is abandoned and desolate.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, your house is being left to you desolate!
verses.textEn: <red>“Jerusalem,p Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后，你们一定见不到我，直等到你们说：‘奉主名来的，是应当称颂的。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后，你们一定见不到我，直等到你们说：‘奉主名来的，是应当称颂的。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后，你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：『奉主名来的是应当称颂的。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Look, your house is left to you desolate.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you, you will not see me again, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: See! Your house is left to you desolate;
verses.textEnNlt: For I tell you this, you will never see me again until you say, ‘Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord !’ "
verses.textEnNasb: For I say to you, from now on you will not see Me until you say, ‘Blessed is the One who comes in the name of the Lord!’ "
verses.textEn: <red>Look, your house is left to you desolate.</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣出了圣殿，往前走的时候，门徒前来把圣殿的建筑指给他看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣出了圣殿，往前走的时候，门徒前来把圣殿的建筑指给他看。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出了圣殿，正走的时候，门徒进前来，把殿宇指给他看。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus left the temple and was going away, when his disciples came to point out to him the buildings of the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus went out and departed from the temple, and His disciples came up to show Him the buildings of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was leaving the Temple grounds, his disciples pointed out to him the various Temple buildings.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus left the temple area and was going on His way when His disciples came up to point out the temple buildings to Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.

verses.textZh: <red>他对门徒说："你们不是看见了这一切吗？我实在告诉你们，将来在这里必没有一块石头留在另一块石头上面，每一块都要拆下来。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他对门徒说："你们不是看见了这一切吗？我实在告诉你们，将来在这里必没有一块石头留在另一块石头上面，每一块都要拆下来。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>你们不是看见这殿宇吗？我实在告诉你们，将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Do you see all these things?”</red> he asked. <red>“Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered them, "You see all these, do you not? Truly, I say to you, there will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to them, "Do you not see all these things? Assuredly, I say to you, not one stone shall be left here upon another, that shall not be thrown down."
verses.textEnNlt: But he responded, "Do you see all these buildings? I tell you the truth, they will be completely demolished. Not one stone will be left on top of another!"
verses.textEnNasb: But He responded and said to them, "Do you not see all these things? Truly I say to you, not one stone here will be left upon another, which will not be torn down."
verses.textEn: <red>“Do you see all these things?”</red> he asked. <red>“Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣坐在橄榄山上，门徒暗中前来问他："请告诉我们，甚么时候会有这些事呢？你的降临和这世代的终结，有甚么预兆呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣坐在橄榄山上，门徒暗中前来问他："请告诉我们，甚么时候会有这些事呢？你的降临和这世代的终结，有甚么预兆呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在橄榄山上坐着，门徒暗暗地来说：「请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事？你降临和世界的末了有什么预兆呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. "Tell us," they said, "when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"
verses.textEnEsv: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, "Tell us, when will these things be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as He sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, "Tell us, when will these things be? And what willbe the sign of Your coming, and of the end of the age?"
verses.textEnNlt: Later, Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives. His disciples came to him privately and said, "Tell us, when will all this happen? What sign will signal your return and the end of the world? "
verses.textEnNasb: And as He was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, "Tell us, when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming, and of the end of the age?"
verses.textEn: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. "Tell us," they said, "when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答他们："你们要小心，不要被人迷惑；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答他们："你们要小心，不要被人迷惑；
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered: <red>“Watch out that no one deceives you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answered them, "See that no one leads you astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to them: "Take heed that no one deceives you.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told them, "Don’t let anyone mislead you,
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus answered and said to them, "See to it that no one misleads you.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered: <red>“Watch out that no one deceives you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为许多人要假冒我的名而来，说：‘我就是基督’，并且要迷惑许多的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为许多人要假冒我的名而来，说：‘我就是基督’，并且要迷惑许多的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是基督』，并且要迷惑许多人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and they will lead many astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
verses.textEnNlt: for many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah.’ They will deceive many.
verses.textEnNasb: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and they will mislead many people.
verses.textEn: <red>For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要听见战争，也听见战争的风声；你们要小心，不要惊慌，因为这是免不了的，不过结局还没有到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要听见战争，也听见战争的风声；你们要小心，不要惊慌，因为这是免不了的，不过结局还没有到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们也要听见打仗和打仗的风声，总不要惊慌；因为这些事是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for this must take place, but the end is not yet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not troubled; for allthese things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.textEnNlt: And you will hear of wars and threats of wars, but don’t panic. Yes, these things must take place, but the end won’t follow immediately.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will be hearing of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for those things must take place, but that is not yet the end.
verses.textEn: <red>You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>一个民族要起来攻打另一个民族，一个国家要起来攻打另一个国家，到处都有饥荒和地震，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>一个民族要起来攻打另一个民族，一个国家要起来攻打另一个国家，到处都有饥荒和地震，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>民要攻打民，国要攻打国；多处必有饥荒、地震。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
verses.textEnNkjv: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there will be famines, pestilences, and earthquakes in various places.
verses.textEnNlt: Nation will go to war against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in many parts of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
verses.textEn: <red>Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这一切不过是痛苦的开始。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这一切不过是痛苦的开始。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这都是灾难 的起头。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All these are the beginning of birth pains.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All these are but the beginning of the birth pains.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
verses.textEnNlt: But all this is only the first of the birth pains, with more to come.
verses.textEnNasb: But all these things are merely the beginning of birth pains.
verses.textEn: <red>All these are the beginning of birth pains.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时人要把你们送去受苦，也要杀害你们，你们要因我的名被万民恨恶。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时人要把你们送去受苦，也要杀害你们，你们要因我的名被万民恨恶。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，人要把你们陷在患难里，也要杀害你们；你们又要为我的名被万民恨恶。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Then they will deliver you up to tribulation and put you to death, and you will be hated by all nations for my name’s sake.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then they will deliver you up to tribulation and kill you, and you will be hated by all nations for My name’s sake.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you will be arrested, persecuted, and killed. You will be hated all over the world because you are my followers.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then they will hand you over to tribulation and kill you, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时许多人会失去信仰，彼此出卖，互相恨恶；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时许多人会失去信仰，彼此出卖，互相恨恶；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，必有许多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨恶；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And then many will fall away and betray one another and hate one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And then many will be offended, will betray one another, and will hate one another.
verses.textEnNlt: And many will turn away from me and betray and hate each other.
verses.textEnNasb: And at that time many will fall away, and they will betray one another and hate one another.
verses.textEn: <red>At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>也有许多假先知出现，要迷惑许多人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>也有许多假先知出现，要迷惑许多人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>且有好些假先知起来，迷惑多人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And many false prophets will arise and lead many astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then many false prophets will rise up and deceive many.
verses.textEnNlt: And many false prophets will appear and will deceive many people.
verses.textEnNasb: And many false prophets will rise up and mislead many people.
verses.textEn: <red>and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为不法的事增加，许多人的爱心就冷淡了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为不法的事增加，许多人的爱心就冷淡了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只因不法的事增多，许多人的爱心才渐渐冷淡了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And because lawlessness will be increased, the love of many will grow cold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And because lawlessness will abound, the love of many will grow cold.
verses.textEnNlt: Sin will be rampant everywhere, and the love of many will grow cold.
verses.textEnNasb: And because lawlessness is increased, most people’s love will become cold.
verses.textEn: <red>Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>唯有坚忍到底的，必然得救。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>唯有坚忍到底的，必然得救。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who endures to the end shall be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who endures to the end is the one who will be saved.
verses.textEn: <red>but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这天国的福音要传遍天下，向万民作见证，然后结局才来到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这天国的福音要传遍天下，向万民作见证，然后结局才来到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这天国的福音要传遍天下，对万民作见证，然后末期才来到。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And this gospel of the kingdom will be proclaimed throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a witness to all the nations, and then the end will come.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.
verses.textEnNasb: This gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
verses.textEn: <red>And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"当你们看见但以理先知所说的‘那造成荒凉的可憎者’，站在圣地的时候 ，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"当你们看见但以理先知所说的‘那造成荒凉的可憎者’，站在圣地的时候 ，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们看见先知但以理所说的『那行毁坏可憎的』站在圣地（读这经的人须要会意）。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Sop when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel—let the reader understand—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "So when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place ( let the reader understand),
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore when you see the ‘abomination of desolation,’ spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place" (whoever reads, let him understand),
verses.textEnNlt: "The day is coming when you will see what Daniel the prophet spoke about—the sacrilegious object that causes desecration standing in the Holy Place." (Reader, pay attention!)
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore when you see the abomination of desolation which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place— let the reader understand—
verses.textEn: <red>“Sop when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel—let the reader understand—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，住在犹太的应当逃到山上；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，住在犹太的应当逃到山上；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: "then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then those in Judea must flee to the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: then those who are in Judea must flee to the mountains.
verses.textEn: <red>then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在房顶的不要下来拿家里的东西；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在房顶的不要下来拿家里的东西；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在房上的，不要下来拿家里的东西；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Let the one who is on the housetop not go down to take what is in his house,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take anything out of his house.
verses.textEnNlt: A person out on the deck of a roof must not go down into the house to pack.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever is on the housetop must not go down to get things out of his house.
verses.textEn: <red>Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在田里的也不要回去取衣服。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在田里的也不要回去取衣服。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and let the one who is in the field not turn back to take his cloak.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let him who is in the field not go back to get his clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: A person out in the field must not return even to get a coat.
verses.textEnNasb: And whoever is in the field must not turn back to get his cloak.
verses.textEn: <red>Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和乳养孩子的有祸了！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和乳养孩子的有祸了！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And alas for women who are pregnant and for those who are nursing infants in those days!
verses.textEnNkjv: But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing babies in those days!
verses.textEnNlt: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and for nursing mothers in those days.
verses.textEnNasb: But woe to those women who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing babies in those days!
verses.textEn: <red>How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们应当祈求，叫你们逃难的时候，不是在冬天或安息日，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们应当祈求，叫你们逃难的时候，不是在冬天或安息日，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们应当祈求，叫你们逃走的时候，不遇见冬天或是安息日。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Pray that your flight may not be in winter or on a Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: And pray that your flight may not be in winter or on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: And pray that your flight will not be in winter or on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, pray that when you flee, it will not be in the winter, or on a Sabbath.
verses.textEn: <red>Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为那时必有大灾难，这是从世界的开始到现在未曾有过的，以后也必不会再有。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为那时必有大灾难，这是从世界的开始到现在未曾有过的，以后也必不会再有。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为那时必有大灾难，从世界的起头直到如今，没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now—and never to be equaled again.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, and never will be.
verses.textEnNkjv: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not been since the beginning of the world until this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.textEnNlt: For there will be greater anguish than at any time since the world began. And it will never be so great again.
verses.textEnNasb: For then there will be a great tribulation, such as has not occurred since the beginning of the world until now, nor ever will again.
verses.textEn: <red>For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now—and never to be equaled again.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果那些日子不减少，没有一个人可以存活；但是为了选民，那些日子必会减少。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果那些日子不减少，没有一个人可以存活；但是为了选民，那些日子必会减少。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若不减少那日子，凡有血气的总没有一个得救的；只是为选民，那日子必减少了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ifp those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if those days had not been cut short, no human being would be saved. But for the sake of the elect those days will be cut short.
verses.textEnNkjv: And unless those days were shortened, no flesh would be saved; but for the elect’s sake those days will be shortened.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, unless that time of calamity is shortened, not a single person will survive. But it will be shortened for the sake of God’s chosen ones.
verses.textEnNasb: And if those days had not been cut short, no life would have been saved; but for the sake of the elect those days will be cut short.
verses.textEn: <red>“Ifp those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，如果有人对你们说：‘看哪，基督在这里！’或说：‘他在那里！’你们不要信，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，如果有人对你们说：‘看哪，基督在这里！’或说：‘他在那里！’你们不要信，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，若有人对你们说：『基督在这里』，或说：『基督在那里』，你们不要信！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There!’ do not believe it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah,’ or ‘There he is,’ don’t believe it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then if anyone says to you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or ‘He is over here,’ do not believe him.
verses.textEn: <red>At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为必有假基督和假先知出现，显大神迹和奇事；如果可以的话，他们连选民也要迷惑。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为必有假基督和假先知出现，显大神迹和奇事；如果可以的话，他们连选民也要迷惑。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为假基督、假先知将要起来，显大神迹、大奇事，倘若能行，连选民也就迷惑了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For false christs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
verses.textEnNkjv: For false christs and false prophets will rise and show great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
verses.textEnNlt: For false messiahs and false prophets will rise up and perform great signs and wonders so as to deceive, if possible, even God’s chosen ones.
verses.textEnNasb: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will provide great signs and wonders, so as to mislead, if possible, even the elect.
verses.textEn: <red>For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们看！我已经事先告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们看！我已经事先告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，我预先告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>See, I have told you ahead of time.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: See, I have told you beforehand.
verses.textEnNkjv: See, I have told you beforehand.
verses.textEnNlt: See, I have warned you about this ahead of time.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I have told you in advance.
verses.textEn: <red>See, I have told you ahead of time.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果他们对你们说：‘看！基督在旷野里。’你们不要出去；或说：‘看！他在内室里。’也不要相信。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果他们对你们说：‘看！基督在旷野里。’你们不要出去；或说：‘看！他在内室里。’也不要相信。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若有人对你们说：『看哪，基督在旷野里』，你们不要出去！或说：『看哪，基督在内屋中』，你们不要信！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Sop if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So, if they say to you, ‘Look, he is in the wilderness,’ do not go out. If they say, ‘Look, he is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore if they say to you, ‘Look, He is in the desert!’ do not go out; or ‘Look, He is in the inner rooms!’ do not believe it.
verses.textEnNlt: "So if someone tells you, ‘Look, the Messiah is out in the desert,’ don’t bother to go and look. Or, ‘Look, he is hiding here,’ don’t believe it!
verses.textEnNasb: So if they say to you, ‘Behold, He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Behold, He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe them.
verses.textEn: <red>“Sop if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>电光怎样从东方闪出来，一直照到西方，人子降临的时候，也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>电光怎样从东方闪出来，一直照到西方，人子降临的时候，也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>闪电从东边发出，直照到西边。人子降临也要这样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as the lightning comes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the lightning comes from the east and flashes to the west, so also will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.textEnNlt: For as the lightning flashes in the east and shines to the west, so it will be when the Son of Man comes.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.textEn: <red>For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在那里。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Wherever the corpse is, there the vultures will gather.
verses.textEnNkjv: For wherever the carcass is, there the eagles will be gathered together.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as the gathering of vultures shows there is a carcass nearby, so these signs indicate that the end is near.
verses.textEnNasb: Wherever the corpse is, there the vultures will gather.
verses.textEn: <red>Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"那些日子的灾难刚过去： 太阳就变黑了， 月亮也不发光， 众星从天坠落， 天上的万象震动。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"那些日子的灾难刚过去： 太阳就变黑了， 月亮也不发光， 众星从天坠落， 天上的万象震动。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「那些日子的灾难一过去， 日头就变黑了， 月亮也不放光， 众星要从天上坠落， 天势都要震动。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Immediatelyp after the distress of those days “ ‘thepn sun will be darkened, andld the moon will not give its light; theln stars will fall from the sky, andld the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNlt: "Immediately after the anguish of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will give no light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: "But immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEn: <red>“Immediatelyp after the distress of those days “ ‘thepn sun will be darkened, andld the moon will not give its light; theln stars will fall from the sky, andld the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"那时，人子的征兆要显在天上，地上的万族都要哀号，并且看见人子带着能力，满有荣耀，驾着天上的云降临。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"那时，人子的征兆要显在天上，地上的万族都要哀号，并且看见人子带着能力，满有荣耀，驾着天上的云降临。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，人子的兆头要显在天上，地上的万族都要哀哭。他们要看见人子，有能力，有大荣耀，驾着天上的云降临。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then will appear in heaven the sign of the Son of Man, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.textEnNlt: And then at last, the sign that the Son of Man is coming will appear in the heavens, and there will be deep mourning among all the peoples of the earth. And they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.textEnNasb: And then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当号筒发出响声，他要差派使者，把他的选民从四方，从天这边到天那边都招聚来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当号筒发出响声，他要差派使者，把他的选民从四方，从天这边到天那边都招聚来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他要差遣使者，用号筒的大声，将他的选民，从四方 ，从天这边到天那边，都招聚了来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he will send out his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will send His angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together His elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.textEnNlt: And he will send out his angels with the mighty blast of a trumpet, and they will gather his chosen ones from all over the world —from the farthest ends of the earth and heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will send forth His angels with a great trumpet blast, and they will gather together His elect from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
verses.textEn: <red>And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们应该从无花果树学个功课：树枝长出嫩芽生出叶子的时候，你们就知道夏天近了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们应该从无花果树学个功课：树枝长出嫩芽生出叶子的时候，你们就知道夏天近了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nowp learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now learn this parable from the fig tree: When its branch has already become tender and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now learn a lesson from the fig tree. When its branches bud and its leaves begin to sprout, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch has become tender and sprouts its leaves, you know that summer is near;
verses.textEn: <red>“Nowp learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>同样，当你们看见这一切，就知道人子已经近在门口了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>同样，当你们看见这一切，就知道人子已经近在门口了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，你们看见这一切的事，也该知道人子近了，正在门口了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So also, when you see all these things, you know that he is near, at the very gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near—at the doors!
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, when you see all these things, you can know his return is very near, right at the door.
verses.textEnNasb: so you too, when you see all these things, recognize that He is near, right at the door.
verses.textEn: <red>Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必要发生，然后这世代才会过去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必要发生，然后这世代才会过去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things take place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, this generation will by no means pass away till all these things take place.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass from the scene until all these things take place.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things take place.
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>天地都要过去，但我的话决不会废去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>天地都要过去，但我的话决不会废去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.
verses.textEnNlt: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will not pass away.
verses.textEn: <red>Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"至于那日子和时间，没有人知道，连天上的使者和子也不知道，只有父知道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"至于那日子和时间，没有人知道，连天上的使者和子也不知道，只有父知道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟独父知道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But concerning that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father only.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, but My Father only.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, no one knows the day or hour when these things will happen, not even the angels in heaven or the Son himself. Only the Father knows.
verses.textEnNasb: "But about that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father alone.
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>挪亚的时代怎样，人子降临的时候也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>挪亚的时代怎样，人子降临的时候也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>挪亚的日子怎样，人子降临也要怎样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as the days of Noah were, so also will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Son of Man returns, it will be like it was in Noah’s day.
verses.textEnNasb: For the coming of the Son of Man will be just like the days of Noah.
verses.textEn: <red>As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>洪水之前的时代，人们吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进入方舟的那一天；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>洪水之前的时代，人们吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进入方舟的那一天；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进方舟的那日；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day when Noah entered the ark,
verses.textEnNkjv: For as in the days before the flood, they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark,
verses.textEnNlt: In those days before the flood, the people were enjoying banquets and parties and weddings right up to the time Noah entered his boat.
verses.textEnNasb: For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark,
verses.textEn: <red>For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>等到洪水来到，把他们冲去，他们才明白过来；人子降临的时候也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>等到洪水来到，把他们冲去，他们才明白过来；人子降临的时候也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不知不觉洪水来了，把他们全都冲去。人子降临也要这样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and they were unaware until the flood came and swept them all away, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: and did not know until the flood came and took them all away, so also will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.textEnNlt: People didn’t realize what was going to happen until the flood came and swept them all away. That is the way it will be when the Son of Man comes.
verses.textEnNasb: and they did not understand until the flood came and took them all away; so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.textEn: <red>and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，两个人在田里工作，一个被接去，一个撇下来；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，两个人在田里工作，一个被接去，一个撇下来；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，两个人在田里，取去一个，撇下一个。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then two men will be in the field; one will be taken and one left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
verses.textEnNlt: "Two men will be working together in the field; one will be taken, the other left.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time there will be two men in the field; one will be taken and one will be left.
verses.textEn: <red>Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>两个女人在磨坊推磨，一个被接去，一个撇下来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>两个女人在磨坊推磨，一个被接去，一个撇下来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>两个女人推磨，取去一个，撇下一个。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Two women will be grinding at the mill; one will be taken and one left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
verses.textEnNlt: Two women will be grinding flour at the mill; one will be taken, the other left.
verses.textEnNasb: Two women will be grinding at the mill; one will be taken and one will be left.
verses.textEn: <red>Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因此，你们要警醒，因为不知道你们的主甚么时候要来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此，你们要警醒，因为不知道你们的主甚么时候要来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们要警醒，因为不知道你们的主是哪一天来到。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thereforep keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, stay awake, for you do not know on what day your Lord is coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch therefore, for you do not know what hour your Lord is coming.
verses.textEnNlt: "So you, too, must keep watch! For you don’t know what day your Lord is coming.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore be on the alert, for you do not know which day your Lord is coming.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thereforep keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们都知道，家主若晓得窃贼晚上甚么时候会来，就会提高警觉，不让他摸进屋里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们都知道，家主若晓得窃贼晚上甚么时候会来，就会提高警觉，不让他摸进屋里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>家主若知道几更天有贼来，就必警醒，不容人挖透房屋；这是你们所知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what part of the night the thief was coming, he would have stayed awake and would not have let his house be broken into.
verses.textEnNkjv: But know this, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.textEnNlt: Understand this: If a homeowner knew exactly when a burglar was coming, he would keep watch and not permit his house to be broken into.
verses.textEnNasb: But be sure of this, that if the head of the house had known at what time of the night the thief was coming, he would have been on the alert and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.textEn: <red>But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你们也要准备妥当，因为在想不到的时候，人子就来了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你们也要准备妥当，因为在想不到的时候，人子就来了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们也要预备，因为你们想不到的时候，人子就来了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you also must be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you also be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect.
verses.textEnNlt: You also must be ready all the time, for the Son of Man will come when least expected.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason you must be ready as well; for the Son of Man is coming at an hour when you do not think He will.
verses.textEn: <red>So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"谁是忠心和精明的仆人，被主人指派管理全家，按时分派粮食的呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"谁是忠心和精明的仆人，被主人指派管理全家，按时分派粮食的呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「谁是忠心有见识的仆人，为主人所派，管理家里的人，按时分粮给他们呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whop then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his master has set over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his master made ruler over his household, to give them food in due season?
verses.textEnNlt: "A faithful, sensible servant is one to whom the master can give the responsibility of managing his other household servants and feeding them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who then is the faithful and sensible slave whom his master put in charge of his household slaves, to give them their food at the proper time?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whop then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人来到，看见他这样作，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人来到，看见他这样作，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人来到，看见他这样行，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is that servant whom his master will find so doing when he comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is that servant whom his master, when he comes, will find so doing.
verses.textEnNlt: If the master returns and finds that the servant has done a good job, there will be a reward.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is that slave whom his master finds so doing when he comes.
verses.textEn: <red>It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，主人要指派他管理自己的一切财产。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，主人要指派他管理自己的一切财产。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，主人要派他管理一切所有的。</red>
