verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, he will set him over all his possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you that he will make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, the master will put that servant in charge of all he owns.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you that he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果他是个坏的仆人，心里说‘我的主人不会那么快回来’，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果他是个坏的仆人，心里说‘我的主人不会那么快回来’，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>倘若那恶仆心里说：『我的主人必来得迟』，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if that wicked servant says to himself, ‘My master is delayed,’
verses.textEnNkjv: But if that evil servant says in his heart, ‘My master is delaying his coming,’
verses.textEnNlt: But what if the servant is evil and thinks, ‘My master won’t be back for a while,’
verses.textEnNasb: But if that evil slave says in his heart, ‘My master is not coming for a long time,’
verses.textEn: <red>But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>就动手打其他的仆人，又和醉酒的人吃喝。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>就动手打其他的仆人，又和醉酒的人吃喝。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就动手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and begins to beat his fellow servants and eats and drinks with drunkards,
verses.textEnNkjv: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and to eat and drink with the drunkards,
verses.textEnNlt: and he begins beating the other servants, partying, and getting drunk?
verses.textEnNasb: and he begins to beat his fellow slaves, and he eats and drinks with those habitually drunk;
verses.textEn: <red>and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在他想不到的日子，不知道的时间，那仆人的主人要来，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在他想不到的日子，不知道的时间，那仆人的主人要来，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在想不到的日子，不知道的时辰，那仆人的主人要来，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: the master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he does not know
verses.textEnNkjv: the master of that servant will come on a day when he is not looking for him and at an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.textEnNlt: The master will return unannounced and unexpected,
verses.textEnNasb: then the master of that slave will come on a day that he does not expect, and at an hour that he does not know,
verses.textEn: <red>The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>严厉地处罚他，使他和虚伪的人同在一起；在那里必要哀哭切齿。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>严厉地处罚他，使他和虚伪的人同在一起；在那里必要哀哭切齿。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>重重地处治他 ，定他和假冒为善的人同罪；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and will cut him in pieces and put him with the hypocrites. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and will cut him in two and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: and he will cut the servant to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEnNasb: and he will cut him in two and assign him a place with the hypocrites; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEn: <red>He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"那时，天国好象十个童女，拿着她们的灯出去迎接新郎。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"那时，天国好象十个童女，拿着她们的灯出去迎接新郎。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「那时，天国好比十个童女拿着灯出去迎接新郎。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Atp that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Then the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went to meet the bridegroom.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the kingdom of heaven shall be likened to ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten bridesmaids who took their lamps and went to meet the bridegroom.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the kingdom of heaven will be comparable to ten virgins, who took their lamps and went out to meet the groom.
verses.textEn: <red>“Atp that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>她们中间有五个是愚蠢的，五个是聪明的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>她们中间有五个是愚蠢的，五个是聪明的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>其中有五个是愚拙的，五个是聪明的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Five of them were foolish and five were wise.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.textEnNlt: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.textEnNasb: Five of them were foolish, and five were prudent.
verses.textEn: <red>Five of them were foolish and five were wise.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那些愚蠢的拿着灯，却没有带油；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那些愚蠢的拿着灯，却没有带油；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>愚拙的拿着灯，却不预备油；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For when the foolish took their lamps, they took no oil with them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who were foolish took their lamps and took no oil with them,
verses.textEnNlt: The five who were foolish didn’t take enough olive oil for their lamps,
verses.textEnNasb: For when the foolish took their lamps, they did not take extra oil with them;
verses.textEn: <red>The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但那些聪明的拿着灯，也把油装在瓶里带来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但那些聪明的拿着灯，也把油装在瓶里带来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>聪明的拿着灯，又预备油在器皿里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but the wise took flasks of oil with their lamps.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.textEnNlt: but the other five were wise enough to take along extra oil.
verses.textEnNasb: but the prudent ones took oil in flasks with their lamps.
verses.textEn: <red>The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>新郎很晚还没有到，她们都打瞌睡，而且睡着了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>新郎很晚还没有到，她们都打瞌睡，而且睡着了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>新郎迟延的时候，她们都打盹，睡着了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and slept.
verses.textEnNkjv: But while the bridegroom was delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.textEnNlt: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while the groom was delaying, they all became drowsy and began to sleep.
verses.textEn: <red>The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>半夜，有人喊叫：‘新郎来了，快出来迎接他。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>半夜，有人喊叫：‘新郎来了，快出来迎接他。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>半夜有人喊着说：『新郎来了，你们出来迎接他！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Atp midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And at midnight a cry was heard: ‘Behold, the bridegroom is coming; go out to meet him!’
verses.textEnNlt: "At midnight they were roused by the shout, ‘Look, the bridegroom is coming! Come out and meet him!’
verses.textEnNasb: But at midnight there finally was a shout: ‘Behold, the groom! Come out to meet him.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Atp midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那些童女都醒过来，整理她们的灯。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那些童女都醒过来，整理她们的灯。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那些童女就都起来收拾灯。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then all those virgins rose and trimmed their lamps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their lamps.
verses.textEnNlt: "All the bridesmaids got up and prepared their lamps.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all those virgins got up and trimmed their lamps.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>愚蠢的对聪明的说：‘请把你们的油分一点给我们，我们的灯快要灭了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>愚蠢的对聪明的说：‘请把你们的油分一点给我们，我们的灯快要灭了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>愚拙的对聪明的说：『请分点油给我们，因为我们的灯要灭了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the five foolish ones asked the others, ‘Please give us some of your oil because our lamps are going out.’
verses.textEnNasb: But the foolish virgins said to the prudent ones, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.’
verses.textEn: <red>The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>聪明的回答：‘这些恐怕不够我们大家用，不如你们自己到卖油的地方去买吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>聪明的回答：‘这些恐怕不够我们大家用，不如你们自己到卖油的地方去买吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>聪明的回答说：『恐怕不够你我用的；不如你们自己到卖油的那里去买吧。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘No,’p they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the wise answered, saying, ‘Since there will not be enough for us and for you, go rather to the dealers and buy for yourselves.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the wise answered, saying, ‘No, lest there should not be enough for us and you; but go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But the others replied, ‘We don’t have enough for all of us. Go to a shop and buy some for yourselves.’
verses.textEnNasb: However, the prudent ones answered, ‘No, there most certainly would not be enough for us and you too; go instead to the merchants and buy some for yourselves.’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘No,’p they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>她们去买油的时候，新郎来了；准备好了的童女就和他一同进去参加婚筵，门就关上了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>她们去买油的时候，新郎来了；准备好了的童女就和他一同进去参加婚筵，门就关上了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>她们去买的时候，新郎到了。那预备好了的，同他进去坐席，门就关了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And while they were going to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was shut.
verses.textEnNkjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding; and the door was shut.
verses.textEnNlt: "But while they were gone to buy oil, the bridegroom came. Then those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was locked.
verses.textEnNasb: But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the groom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast; and the door was shut.
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>后来，其余的童女也来到，说：‘主啊，主啊，给我们开门吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>后来，其余的童女也来到，说：‘主啊，主啊，给我们开门吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>其余的童女随后也来了，说：『主啊，主啊，给我们开门！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Laterp the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward the other virgins came also, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Afterward the other virgins came also, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when the other five bridesmaids returned, they stood outside, calling, ‘Lord! Lord! Open the door for us!’
verses.textEnNasb: Yet later, the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open up for us.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Laterp the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>新郎却回答：‘我实在告诉你们，我不认识你们。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>新郎却回答：‘我实在告诉你们，我不认识你们。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他却回答说：『我实在告诉你们，我不认识你们。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I don’t know you.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered, ‘Truly, I say to you, I do not know you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But he answered and said, ‘Assuredly, I say to you, I do not know you.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But he called back, ‘Believe me, I don’t know you!’
verses.textEnNasb: But he answered, ‘Truly I say to you, I do not know you.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I don’t know you.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你们要警醒，因为不知道那日子和那时间。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你们要警醒，因为不知道那日子和那时间。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们要警醒；因为那日子，那时辰，你们不知道。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thereforep keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hourin which the Son of Man is coming.
verses.textEnNlt: "So you, too, must keep watch! For you do not know the day or hour of my return.
verses.textEnNasb: Be on the alert then, because you do not know the day nor the hour.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thereforep keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"天国又像一个人要出外远行，就叫自己的仆人来，把产业交给他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"天国又像一个人要出外远行，就叫自己的仆人来，把产业交给他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「天国又好比一个人要往外国去，就叫了仆人来，把他的家业交给他们，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Again,p it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his wealth to them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "For it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted to them his property.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the kingdom of heaven is like a man traveling to a far country, who called his own servants and delivered his goods to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven can be illustrated by the story of a man going on a long trip. He called together his servants and entrusted his money to them while he was gone.
verses.textEnNasb: "For it is just like a man about to go on a journey, who called his own slaves and entrusted his possessions to them.
verses.textEn: <red>“Again,p it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his wealth to them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他按照各人的才干，一个给三万个银币，一个给一万二千个银币，一个给六千个银币 ，然后就远行去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他按照各人的才干，一个给三万个银币，一个给一万二千个银币，一个给六千个银币 ，然后就远行去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>按着各人的才干给他们银子：一个给了五千，一个给了二千，一个给了一千，就往外国去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>To one he gave five bags of gold, to another two bags, and to another one bag, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his ability. Then he went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one, to each according to his own ability; and immediately he went on a journey.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave five bags of silver to one, two bags of silver to another, and one bag of silver to the last—dividing it in proportion to their abilities. He then left on his trip.
verses.textEnNasb: To one he gave five talents, to another, two, and to another, one, each according to his own ability; and he went on his journey.
verses.textEn: <red>To one he gave five bags of gold, to another two bags, and to another one bag, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那领了三万的马上去做生意，另外赚了三万。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那领了三万的马上去做生意，另外赚了三万。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那领五千的随即拿去做买卖，另外赚了五千。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The man who had received five bags of gold went at once and put his money to work and gained five bags more.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who had received the five talents went at once and traded with them, and he made five talents more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he who had received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
verses.textEnNlt: "The servant who received the five bags of silver began to invest the money and earned five more.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who had received the five talents immediately went and did business with them, and earned five more talents.
verses.textEn: <red>The man who had received five bags of gold went at once and put his money to work and gained five bags more.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那领了一万二千的也是这样，另赚了一万二千。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那领了一万二千的也是这样，另赚了一万二千。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那领二千的也照样另赚了二千。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So also he who had the two talents made two talents more.
verses.textEnNkjv: And likewise he who had received two gained two more also.
verses.textEnNlt: The servant with two bags of silver also went to work and earned two more.
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way the one who had received the two talents earned two more.
verses.textEn: <red>So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但那领了六千的，却去把地挖开，把主人的钱藏起来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但那领了六千的，却去把地挖开，把主人的钱藏起来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但那领一千的去掘开地，把主人的银子埋藏了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he who had received the one talent went and dug in the ground and hid his master’s money.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who had received one went and dug in the ground, and hid his lord’s money.
verses.textEnNlt: But the servant who received the one bag of silver dug a hole in the ground and hid the master’s money.
verses.textEnNasb: But he who received the one talent went away and dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
verses.textEn: <red>But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>过了很久，那些仆人的主人回来了，要和他们算帐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>过了很久，那些仆人的主人回来了，要和他们算帐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>过了许久，那些仆人的主人来了，和他们算帐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Afterp a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now after a long time the master of those servants came and settled accounts with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: After a long time the lord of those servants came and settled accounts with them.
verses.textEnNlt: "After a long time their master returned from his trip and called them to give an account of how they had used his money.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now after a long time the master of those slaves *came and *settled accounts with them.
verses.textEn: <red>“Afterp a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那领了三万个银币的，带着另外的三万前来，说：‘主啊，你交了三万给我，你看，我又赚了三万。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那领了三万个银币的，带着另外的三万前来，说：‘主啊，你交了三万给我，你看，我又赚了三万。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那领五千银子的又带着那另外的五千来，说：『主啊，你交给我五千银子。请看，我又赚了五千。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The man who had received five bags of gold brought the other five. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five bags of gold. See, I have gained five more.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he who had received the five talents came forward, bringing five talents more, saying, ‘Master, you delivered to me five talents; here, I have made five talents more.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "So he who had received five talents came and brought five other talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents; look, I have gained five more talents besides them.’
verses.textEnNlt: The servant to whom he had entrusted the five bags of silver came forward with five more and said, ‘Master, you gave me five bags of silver to invest, and I have earned five more.’
verses.textEnNasb: The one who had received the five talents came up and brought five more talents, saying, ‘Master, you entrusted five talents to me. See, I have earned five more talents.’
verses.textEn: <red>The man who had received five bags of gold brought the other five. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five bags of gold. See, I have gained five more.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人对他说：‘又良善又忠心的仆人哪，你作得好！你既然在不多的事上忠心，我要派你管理许多的事。进来，享受你主人的快乐吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人对他说：‘又良善又忠心的仆人哪，你作得好！你既然在不多的事上忠心，我要派你管理许多的事。进来，享受你主人的快乐吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人说：『好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理；可以进来享受你主人的快乐。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hisp master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a little; I will set you over much. Enter into the joy of your master.’
verses.textEnNkjv: His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant; you were faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The master was full of praise. ‘Well done, my good and faithful servant. You have been faithful in handling this small amount, so now I will give you many more responsibilities. Let’s celebrate together! ’
verses.textEnNasb: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful with a few things, I will put you in charge of many things; enter the joy of your master.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Hisp master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那领了一万二千的也前来，说：‘主啊，你交了一万二千给我，你看，我又赚了一万二千。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那领了一万二千的也前来，说：‘主啊，你交了一万二千给我，你看，我又赚了一万二千。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那领二千的也来，说：『主啊，你交给我二千银子。请看，我又赚了二千。』</red>

verses.textEnEsv: And he also who had the two talents came forward, saying, ‘Master, you delivered to me two talents; here, I have made two talents more.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He also who had received two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents; look, I have gained two more talents besides them.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The servant who had received the two bags of silver came forward and said, ‘Master, you gave me two bags of silver to invest, and I have earned two more.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Also the one who had received the two talents came up and said, ‘Master, you entrusted two talents to me. See, I have earned two more talents.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep man with two bags of gold also came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with two bags of gold; see, I have gained two more.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那领了六千的也前来，说：‘主啊，我知道你是个严厉的人，没有撒种的地方，你要收割；没有散播的地方，你要收聚。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那领了六千的也前来，说：‘主啊，我知道你是个严厉的人，没有撒种的地方，你要收割；没有散播的地方，你要收聚。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那领一千的也来，说：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp the man who had received one bag of gold came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He also who had received the one talent came forward, saying, ‘Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you scattered no seed,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then he who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you have not sown, and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the servant with the one bag of silver came and said, ‘Master, I knew you were a harsh man, harvesting crops you didn’t plant and gathering crops you didn’t cultivate.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now the one who had received the one talent also came up and said, ‘Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter seed.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp the man who had received one bag of gold came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，我就害怕起来，去把你的钱藏在地里。你看，你的钱还在这里。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，我就害怕起来，去把你的钱藏在地里。你看，你的钱还在这里。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我就害怕，去把你的一千银子埋藏在地里。请看，你的原银子在这里。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so I was afraid, and I went and hid your talent in the ground. Here, you have what is yours.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the ground. Look, there you have what is yours.’
verses.textEnNlt: I was afraid I would lose your money, so I hid it in the earth. Look, here is your money back.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I was afraid, so I went away and hid your talent in the ground. See, you still have what is yours.’
verses.textEn: <red>So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是主人对他说：‘你这个又可恶又懒惰的仆人，你既然知道我要在没有撒种的地方收割，在没有散播的地方收聚，</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hisp master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But his master answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant! You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I scattered no seed?
verses.textEnNkjv: "But his lord answered and said to him, ‘You wicked and lazy servant, you knew that I reap where I have not sown, and gather where I have not scattered seed.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the master replied, ‘You wicked and lazy servant! If you knew I harvested crops I didn’t plant and gathered crops I didn’t cultivate,
verses.textEnNasb: "But his master answered and said to him, ‘You worthless, lazy slave! Did you know that I reap where I did not sow, and gather where I did not scatter seed?
verses.textEn: <red>“Hisp master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那你就应该把我的钱存入银行，到我回来的时候，可以连本带利收回。</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>就当把我的银子放给兑换银钱的人，到我来的时候，可以连本带利收回。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then you ought to have invested my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received what was my own with interest.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you ought to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I would have received back my own with interest.
verses.textEnNlt: why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank? At least I could have gotten some interest on it.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then you ought to have put my money in the bank, and on my arrival I would have received my money back with interest.
verses.textEn: <red>Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore take the talent from him, and give it to him who has ten talents.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then he ordered, ‘Take the money from this servant, and give it to the one with the ten bags of silver.

verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Sop take the bag of gold from him and give it to the one who has ten bags.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为凡是有的，还要给他，他就充足有余；凡是没有的，就算他有甚么也要拿去。</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For to everyone who has will more be given, and he will have an abundance. But from the one who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For to everyone who has, more will be given, and he will have abundance; but from him who does not have, even what he has will be taken away.
verses.textEnNlt: To those who use well what they are given, even more will be given, and they will have an abundance. But from those who do nothing, even what little they have will be taken away.
verses.textEnNasb: "For to everyone who has, more shall be given, and he will have an abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he does have shall be taken away.
verses.textEn: <red>For whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>把这没有用的仆人丢在外面的黑暗里，在那里必要哀哭切齿。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>把这没有用的仆人丢在外面的黑暗里，在那里必要哀哭切齿。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>把这无用的仆人丢在外面黑暗里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And cast the worthless servant into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And cast the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.textEnNlt: Now throw this useless servant into outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.textEnNasb: And throw the worthless slave into the outer darkness; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.textEn: <red>And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>「当人子在他荣耀里、同着众天使降临的时候，要坐在他荣耀的宝座上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his glorious throne.</red>

verses.textEnNasb: "But when the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, then He will sit on His glorious throne.

verses.textZh: <red>万族要聚集在他面前，他要把他们彼此分开，好象牧羊人把绵羊和山羊分开一样：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>万族要聚集在他面前，他要把他们彼此分开，好象牧羊人把绵羊和山羊分开一样：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>万民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他们分别出来，好像牧羊的分别绵羊山羊一般，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Before him will be gathered all the nations, and he will separate people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats.
verses.textEnNlt: All the nations will be gathered in his presence, and he will separate the people as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the nations will be gathered before Him; and He will separate them from one another, just as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats;
verses.textEn: <red>All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>把绵羊放在右边，山羊放在左边。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>把绵羊放在右边，山羊放在左边。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>把绵羊安置在右边，山羊在左边。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he will place the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will set the sheep on His right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.textEnNlt: He will place the sheep at his right hand and the goats at his left.
verses.textEnNasb: and He will put the sheep on His right, but the goats on the left.
verses.textEn: <red>He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，王要对右边的说：‘蒙我父赐福的，来承受创世以来为你们预备好的国吧。</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是王要向那右边的说：『你们这蒙我父赐福的，可来承受那创世以来为你们所预备的国；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the King will say to those on His right hand, ‘Come, you blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

verses.textEnNasb: "Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我饿了，你们给我吃；我渴了，你们给我喝；我作旅客，你们接待我；</red>

verses.textEnNasb: For I was hungry, and you gave Me something to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave Me something to drink; I was a stranger, and you invited Me in;
verses.textEn: <red>For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>我赤身露体，你们给我穿；我病了，你们看顾我；我在监里，你们来看我。』</red>

verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: Or when did we see You sick, or in prison, and come to You?’

verses.textEnNasb: And when did we see You sick, or in prison, and come to You?’

verses.textZh: <red>王要回答他们：‘我实在告诉你们，你们所作的，只要是作在我一个最小的弟兄身上，就是作在我的身上了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>王要回答他们：‘我实在告诉你们，你们所作的，只要是作在我一个最小的弟兄身上，就是作在我的身上了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>王要回答说：『我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the King will answer them, ‘Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the King will answer and say to them, ‘Assuredly, I say to you, inasmuch as you did it to one of the least of these My brethren, you did it to Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And the King will say, ‘I tell you the truth, when you did it to one of the least of these my brothers and sisters, you were doing it to me!’
verses.textEnNasb: And the King will answer and say to them, ‘Truly I say to you, to the extent that you did it for one of the least of these brothers or sisters of Mine, you did it for Me.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"王也要对左边的说：‘你们这被咒诅的，离开我，到为魔鬼和他的使者所预备的永火里去吧！</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>王又要向那左边的说：『你们这被咒诅的人，离开我！进入那为魔鬼和他的使者所预备的永火里去！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: "Then He will also say to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from Me, you cursed, into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the King will turn to those on the left and say, ‘Away with you, you cursed ones, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his demons.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then He will also say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you accursed people, into the eternal fire which has been prepared for the devil and his angels;
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我饿了，你们没有给我吃；我渴了，你们没有给我喝；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我饿了，你们没有给我吃；我渴了，你们没有给我喝；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我饿了，你们不给我吃，渴了，你们不给我喝；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I was hungry and you gave me no food, I was thirsty and you gave me no drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: for I was hungry and you gave Me no food; I was thirsty and you gave Me no drink;
verses.textEnNlt: For I was hungry, and you didn’t feed me. I was thirsty, and you didn’t give me a drink.
verses.textEnNasb: for I was hungry, and you gave Me nothing to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave Me nothing to drink;
verses.textEn: <red>For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我作旅客，你们没有接待我；我赤身露体，你们没有给我衣服穿；我病了，我在监里，你们没有看顾我。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我作旅客，你们没有接待我；我赤身露体，你们没有给我衣服穿；我病了，我在监里，你们没有看顾我。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我作客旅，你们不留我住；我赤身露体，你们不给我穿；我病了，我在监里，你们不来看顾我。』</red>

verses.textEnEsv: I was a stranger and you did not welcome me, naked and you did not clothe me, sick and in prison and you did not visit me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, naked and you did not clothe Me, sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: I was a stranger, and you didn’t invite me into your home. I was naked, and you didn’t give me clothing. I was sick and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
verses.textEnNasb: I was a stranger, and you did not invite Me in; naked, and you did not clothe Me; sick, and in prison, and you did not visit Me.’
verses.textEn: <red>I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们就回答：‘主啊，我们甚么时候见你饿了、渴了、作旅客、赤身露体、病了，或在监里，却没有服事你呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们就回答：‘主啊，我们甚么时候见你饿了、渴了、作旅客、赤身露体、病了，或在监里，却没有服事你呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们也要回答说：『主啊，我们什么时候见你饿了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露体，或病了，或在监里，不伺候你呢？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Theyp also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?’</red>

verses.textEnNlt: "Then they will reply, ‘Lord, when did we ever see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and not help you?’
verses.textEnNasb: Then they themselves also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry, or thirsty, or as a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not take care of You?’
verses.textEn: <red>“Theyp also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>王要回答他们：‘我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既然没有作在一个最小的身上，就是没有作在我的身上了。’</red>

verses.textEn: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, "Surely you don’t mean me, Lord?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："那和我一同把手蘸在盘子里的人，他要出卖我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："那和我一同把手蘸在盘子里的人，他要出卖我。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「同我蘸手在盘子里的，就是他要卖我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "He who has dipped his hand in the dish with me will betray me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said, "He who dipped his hand with Me in the dish will betray Me.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "One of you who has just eaten from this bowl with me will betray me.
verses.textEnNasb: And He answered, "He who dipped his hand with Me in the bowl is the one who will betray Me.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正如经上指着人子所说的，他固然要离世，但出卖人子的那人有祸了！他没有生下来倒好。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正如经上指着人子所说的，他固然要离世，但出卖人子的那人有祸了！他没有生下来倒好。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子必要去世，正如经上指着他所写的；但卖人子的人有祸了！那人不生在世上倒好。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The Son of Man goes as it is written of him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Son of Man indeed goes just as it is written of Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good for that man if he had not been born."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Son of Man must die, as the Scriptures declared long ago. But how terrible it will be for the one who betrays him. It would be far better for that man if he had never been born!"
verses.textEnNasb: The Son of Man is going away just as it is written about Him; but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good for that man if he had not been born."
verses.textEn: <red>The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那出卖耶稣的犹大说："<red>拉比，是我吗？</red>"他说："<red>这是你说的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那出卖耶稣的犹大说："<red>拉比，是我吗？</red>"他说："<red>这是你说的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 卖耶稣的犹大问他说：「<red>拉比，是我吗？</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你说的是。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you don’t mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, <red>“You have said so.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Judas, who would betray him, answered, "Is it I, Rabbi?" He said to him, "You have said so."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judas, who was betraying Him, answered and said, "Rabbi, is it I?" He said to him, "You have said it."
verses.textEnNlt: Judas, the one who would betray him, also asked, "Rabbi, am I the one?" And Jesus told him, "You have said it."
verses.textEnNasb: And Judas, who was betraying Him, said, "Surely it is not I, Rabbi?" Jesus *said to him, "You have said it yourself."
verses.textEn: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you don’t mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, <red>“You have said so.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了就擘开，递给门徒，说："<red>你们拿去吃吧，这是我的身体。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了就擘开，递给门徒，说："<red>你们拿去吃吧，这是我的身体。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝福，就擘开，递给门徒，说：「<red>你们拿着吃，这是我的身体</red>」；
verses.textEnNiv: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, <red>“Take and eat; this is my body.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and after blessing it broke it and gave it to the disciples, and said, "Take, eat; this is my body."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to the disciples and said, "Take, eat; this is My body."
verses.textEnNlt: As they were eating, Jesus took some bread and blessed it. Then he broke it in pieces and gave it to the disciples, saying, "Take this and eat it, for this is my body."
verses.textEnNasb: Now while they were eating, Jesus took some bread, and after a blessing, He broke it and gave it to the disciples, and said, "Take, eat; this is My body."
verses.textEn: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, <red>“Take and eat; this is my body.”</red>

verses.textEnEsv: And he took a cup, and when he had given thanks he gave it to them, saying, "Drink of it, all of you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of you.
verses.textEnNlt: And he took a cup of wine and gave thanks to God for it. He gave it to them and said, "Each of you drink from it,
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had taken a cup and given thanks, He gave it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of you;
verses.textEn: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, <red>“Drink from it, all of you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这是我的血，是为立约的，为许多人流出来，使罪得赦。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这是我的血，是为立约的，为许多人流出来，使罪得赦。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为这是我立约的血，为多人流出来，使罪得赦。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is My blood of the new covenant, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.textEnNlt: for this is my blood, which confirms the covenant between God and his people. It is poured out as a sacrifice to forgive the sins of many.
verses.textEnNasb: for this is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many for forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEn: <red>This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后我必不再喝这葡萄酒，直到我和你们在我父的国里喝新酒的那一天。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后我必不再喝这葡萄酒，直到我和你们在我父的国里喝新酒的那一天。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在我父的国里同你们喝新的那日子。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, I will not drink from this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you I will not drink again of this fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in My Father’s kingdom."
verses.textEnNlt: Mark my words—I will not drink wine again until the day I drink it new with you in my Father’s Kingdom."
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it with you, new, in My Father’s kingdom."
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, I will not drink from this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们唱完了诗，就出来往橄榄山去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们唱完了诗，就出来往橄榄山去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们唱了诗，就出来往橄榄山去。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNasb: And after singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEn: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶稣对他们说："<red>今天晚上，你们因我的缘故都要后退，因为经上记着： ‘我要击打牧人， 羊群就分散了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶稣对他们说："<red>今天晚上，你们因我的缘故都要后退，因为经上记着： ‘我要击打牧人， 羊群就分散了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，耶稣对他们说：「今夜，你们为我的缘故都要跌倒。因为经上记着说： 我要击打牧人， 羊就分散了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus told them, <red>“This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: “ ‘Ipn will strike the shepherd, andld the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus said to them, "You will all fall away because of me this night. For it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "All of you will be made to stumble because of Me this night, for it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, And the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.textEnNlt: On the way, Jesus told them, "Tonight all of you will desert me. For the Scriptures say, ‘God will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus *said to them, "You will all fall away because of Me this night, for it is written: ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.textEn: Then Jesus told them, <red>“This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: “ ‘Ipn will strike the shepherd, andld the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我复活以后，要比你们先到加利利去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我复活以后，要比你们先到加利利去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Butp after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But after I am raised up, I will go before you to Galilee."
verses.textEnNkjv: But after I have been raised, I will go before you to Galilee."
verses.textEnNlt: But after I have been raised from the dead, I will go ahead of you to Galilee and meet you there."
verses.textEnNasb: But after I have been raised, I will go ahead of you to Galilee."
verses.textEn: <red>Butp after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得对他说："就算所有的人都因你的缘故后退，我却永不后退。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对他说："就算所有的人都因你的缘故后退，我却永不后退。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「众人虽然为你的缘故跌倒，我却永不跌倒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter replied, "Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will."
verses.textEnEsv: Peter answered him, "Though they all fall away because of you, I will never fall away."
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter answered and said to Him, "Even if all are made to stumble because of You, I will never be made to stumble."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter declared, "Even if everyone else deserts you, I will never desert you."
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter replied to Him, "Even if they all fall away because of You, I will never fall away!"
verses.textEn: Peter replied, "Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："我实在告诉你，今天晚上鸡叫以前，你会三次不认我。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："我实在告诉你，今天晚上鸡叫以前，你会三次不认我。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我实在告诉你，今夜鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Trulyp I tell you,”</red> Jesus answered, <red>“this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Truly, I tell you, this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you that this night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, Peter—this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny three times that you even know me."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to him, "Truly I say to you that this very night, before a rooster crows, you will deny Me three times."
verses.textEn: <red>“Trulyp I tell you,”</red> Jesus answered, <red>“this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得对他说："就算必须与你一同死，我也决不会不认你。"门徒也都这样说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对他说："就算必须与你一同死，我也决不会不认你。"门徒也都这样说。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。」众门徒都是这样说。
verses.textEnNiv: But Peter declared, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the other disciples said the same.
verses.textEnEsv: Peter said to him, "Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you!" And all the disciples said the same.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter said to Him, "Even if I have to die with You, I will not deny You!" And so said all the disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: "No!" Peter insisted. "Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny you!" And all the other disciples vowed the same.
verses.textEnNasb: Peter *said to Him, "Even if I have to die with You, I will not deny You!" All the disciples said the same thing as well.
verses.textEn: But Peter declared, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the other disciples said the same.

verses.textZh: 耶稣和门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对门徒说："<red>你们坐在这里，我要到那边去祷告。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对门徒说："<red>你们坐在这里，我要到那边去祷告。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣同门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对他们说：「<red>你们坐在这里，等我到那边去祷告。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, <red>“Sit here while I go over there and pray.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to his disciples, "Sit here, while I go over there and pray."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to the disciples, "Sit here while I go and pray over there."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus went with them to the olive grove called Gethsemane, and he said, "Sit here while I go over there to pray."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus *came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and *told His disciples, "Sit here while I go over there and pray."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, <red>“Sit here while I go over there and pray.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他带了彼得和西庇太的两个儿子一起去，心里忧愁难过，

verses.textEnNiv: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.
verses.textEnEsv: And taking with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, he began to be sorrowful and troubled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and He began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
verses.textEnNlt: He took Peter and Zebedee’s two sons, James and John, and he became anguished and distressed.
verses.textEnNasb: And He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with Him, and began to be grieved and distressed.
verses.textEn: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："<red>我的心灵痛苦得快要死了；你们留在这里，与我一同警醒吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："<red>我的心灵痛苦得快要死了；你们留在这里，与我一同警醒吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 便对他们说：「<red>我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，和我一同警醒。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them, <red>“My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to them, "My soul is very sorrowful, even to death; remain here, and watch with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with Me."
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "My soul is crushed with grief to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He *said to them, "My soul is deeply grieved, to the point of death; remain here and keep watch with Me."
verses.textEn: Then he said to them, <red>“My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他稍往前走，把脸俯伏在地上，祷告说："<red>我的父啊！可能的话，求你使这杯离开我；但不要照我的意思，只要照你的旨意。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他稍往前走，把脸俯伏在地上，祷告说："<red>我的父啊！可能的话，求你使这杯离开我；但不要照我的意思，只要照你的旨意。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，祷告说：「<red>我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫这杯离开我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, <red>“My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And going a little farther he fell on his face and prayed, saying, "My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as you will."
verses.textEnNkjv: He went a little farther and fell on His face, and prayed, saying, "O My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as You will."
verses.textEnNlt: He went on a little farther and bowed with his face to the ground, praying, "My Father! If it is possible, let this cup of suffering be taken away from me. Yet I want your will to be done, not mine."
verses.textEnNasb: And He went a little beyond them, and fell on His face and prayed, saying, "My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me; yet not as I will, but as You will."
verses.textEn: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, <red>“My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>来到门徒那里，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说：「怎么样？你们不能同我警醒片时吗？</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, "What! Could you not watch with Me one hour?
verses.textEnNlt: Then he returned to the disciples and found them asleep. He said to Peter, "Couldn’t you watch with me even one hour?
verses.textEnNasb: And He *came to the disciples and *found them sleeping, and He *said to Peter, "So, you men could not keep watch with Me for one hour?
verses.textEn: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. <red>“Couldn’t you men keep watch with me for one hour?”</red> he asked Peter.

verses.textZh: <red>应当警醒、祷告，免得陷入试探；你们心灵虽然愿意，肉体却是软弱的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>应当警醒、祷告，免得陷入试探；你们心灵虽然愿意，肉体却是软弱的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>总要警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."
verses.textEnNlt: Keep watch and pray, so that you will not give in to temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak!"
verses.textEnNasb: Keep watching and praying, so that you do not come into temptation; the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
verses.textEn: <red>“Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他又再次走开，祷告说："<red>我的父啊！如果这杯不能离开我，一定要我喝，就愿你的旨意成全。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又再次走开，祷告说："<red>我的父啊！如果这杯不能离开我，一定要我喝，就愿你的旨意成全。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 第二次又去祷告说：「<red>我父啊，这杯若不能离开我，必要我喝，就愿你的意旨成全。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He went away a second time and prayed, <red>“My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Again, for the second time, he went away and prayed, "My Father, if this cannot pass unless I drink it, your will be done."
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, a second time, He went away and prayed, saying, "O My Father, if this cup cannot pass away from Me unless I drink it, Your will be done."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus left them a second time and prayed, "My Father! If this cup cannot be taken away unless I drink it, your will be done."
verses.textEnNasb: He went away again a second time and prayed, saying, "My Father, if this cup cannot pass away unless I drink from it, Your will be done."
verses.textEn: He went away a second time and prayed, <red>“My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他再回来的时候，看见门徒睡着了，因为他们十分疲倦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他再回来的时候，看见门徒睡着了，因为他们十分疲倦。
verses.textZhCuv: 又来，见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛困倦。
verses.textEnNiv: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.
verses.textEnEsv: And again he came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He came and found them asleep again, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.textEnNlt: When he returned to them again, he found them sleeping, for they couldn’t keep their eyes open.
verses.textEnNasb: Again He came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.textEn: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

verses.textZh: 他又离开他们，第三次去祷告，说的也是同样的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又离开他们，第三次去祷告，说的也是同样的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又离开他们去了。第三次祷告，说的话还是与先前一样。
verses.textEnNiv: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.
verses.textEnEsv: So, leaving them again, he went away and prayed for the third time, saying the same words again.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He left them, went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.textEnNlt: So he went to pray a third time, saying the same things again.
verses.textEnNasb: And He left them again, and went away and prayed a third time, saying the same thing once more.
verses.textEn: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

verses.textZh: 然后，他回到门徒那里，对他们说："<red>你们还在睡觉休息吗？看哪，时候到了，人子要被交在罪人的手里了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，他回到门徒那里，对他们说："<red>你们还在睡觉休息吗？看哪，时候到了，人子要被交在罪人的手里了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是来到门徒那里，对他们说：「现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧 ！时候到了，人子被卖在罪人手里了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, <red>“Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour has come, and the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then he came to the disciples and said to them, "Sleep and take your rest later on. See, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came to His disciples and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he came to the disciples and said, "Go ahead and sleep. Have your rest. But look—the time has come. The Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He *came to the disciples and *said to them, " Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand and the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEn: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, <red>“Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour has come, and the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>起来，我们走吧！出卖我的人来了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>起来，我们走吧！出卖我的人来了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>起来！我们走吧。看哪，卖我的人近了！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Rise, let us be going; see, my betrayer is at hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Rise, let us be going. See, My betrayer is at hand."
verses.textEnNlt: Up, let’s be going. Look, my betrayer is here!"
verses.textEnNasb: Get up, let’s go; behold, the one who is betraying Me is near!"
verses.textEn: <red>Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣还在说话的时候，十二门徒中的犹大，带着一大群拿着刀棒的人来到，他们是祭司长和民间的长老派来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还在说话的时候，十二门徒中的犹大，带着一大群拿着刀棒的人来到，他们是祭司长和民间的长老派来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说话之间，那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和民间的长老那里与他同来。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking, Judas came, one of the twelve, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the elders of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And while He was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, with a great multitude with swords and clubs, came from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: And even as Jesus said this, Judas, one of the twelve disciples, arrived with a crowd of men armed with swords and clubs. They had been sent by the leading priests and elders of the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And while He was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came accompanied by a large crowd with swords and clubs, who came from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.

verses.textZh: 出卖耶稣的人给他们一个暗号，说："我跟谁亲吻，谁就是他；你们可以抓住他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 出卖耶稣的人给他们一个暗号，说："我跟谁亲吻，谁就是他；你们可以抓住他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那卖耶稣的给了他们一个暗号，说：「我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们可以拿住他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, "The one I will kiss is the man; seize him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now His betrayer had given them a sign, saying, "Whomever I kiss, He is the One; seize Him."
verses.textEnNlt: The traitor, Judas, had given them a prearranged signal: "You will know which one to arrest when I greet him with a kiss."
verses.textEnNasb: Now he who was betraying Him gave them a sign previously, saying, "Whomever I kiss, He is the one; arrest Him."
verses.textEn: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him."

verses.textZh: 他立刻前来对耶稣说："拉比，你好。"跟着就与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他立刻前来对耶稣说："拉比，你好。"跟着就与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大随即到耶稣跟前，说：「请拉比安」，就与他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he came up to Jesus at once and said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" And he kissed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately he went up to Jesus and said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Judas came straight to Jesus. "Greetings, Rabbi!" he exclaimed and gave him the kiss.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately Judas went up to Jesus and said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed Him.
verses.textEn: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>朋友，你来要作的事，快作吧！</red>"于是那些人上前来，动手拿住耶稣，逮捕了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>朋友，你来要作的事，快作吧！</red>"于是那些人上前来，动手拿住耶稣，逮捕了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>朋友，你来要做的事，就做吧。</red>」于是那些人上前，下手拿住耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Do what you came for, friend.”</red> Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Friend, do what you came to do." Then they came up and laid hands on Jesus and seized him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Friend, why have you come?" Then they came and laid hands on Jesus and took Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "My friend, go ahead and do what you have come for." Then the others grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, "Friend, do what you have come for." Then they came and laid hands on Jesus and arrested Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Do what you came for, friend.”</red> Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.

verses.textZh: 有一个与耶稣在一起的人，伸手拔出刀来，砍了大祭司的仆人一刀，削掉他的一只耳朵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个与耶稣在一起的人，伸手拔出刀来，砍了大祭司的仆人一刀，削掉他的一只耳朵。
verses.textZhCuv: 有跟随耶稣的一个人伸手拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。
verses.textEnNiv: With that, one of Jesus’ companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And suddenly, one of those whowere with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.textEnNlt: But one of the men with Jesus pulled out his sword and struck the high priest’s slave, slashing off his ear.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, one of those who were with Jesus reached and drew his sword, and struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his ear.
verses.textEn: With that, one of Jesus’ companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："把你的刀收回原处！凡动刀的必死在刀下。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："把你的刀收回原处！凡动刀的必死在刀下。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「收刀入鞘吧！凡动刀的，必死在刀下。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Putp your sword back in its place,”</red> Jesus said to him, <red>“for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus said to him, "Put your sword back into its place. For all who take the sword will perish by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Put your sword in its place, for all who take the sword will perish by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: "Put away your sword," Jesus told him. "Those who use the sword will die by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus *said to him, "Put your sword back into its place; for all those who take up the sword will perish by the sword.
verses.textEn: <red>“Putp your sword back in its place,”</red> Jesus said to him, <red>“for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你以为我不能求我的父，他就马上给我派十二营以上的天使下来吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你以为我不能求我的父，他就马上给我派十二营以上的天使下来吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你想，我不能求我父现在为我差遣十二营多天使来吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do you think that I cannot appeal to my Father, and he will at once send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you think that I cannot now pray to My Father, and He will provide Me with more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that I could ask my Father for thousands of angels to protect us, and he would send them instantly?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you think that I cannot appeal to My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.textEn: <red>Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果这样，经上预言这事必须发生，怎能应验呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果这样，经上预言这事必须发生，怎能应验呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若是这样，经上所说，事情必须如此的话怎么应验呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But how then should the Scriptures be fulfilled, that it must be so?"
verses.textEnNkjv: How then could the Scriptures be fulfilled, that it must happen thus?"
verses.textEnNlt: But if I did, how would the Scriptures be fulfilled that describe what must happen now?"
verses.textEnNasb: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled, which say that it must happen this way?"
verses.textEn: <red>But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”</red>

verses.textZh: 那时，耶稣对众人说："<red>你们带着刀棒出来，把我当作强盗捉拿吗？我天天坐在殿里教导人，你们却没有逮捕我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶稣对众人说："<red>你们带着刀棒出来，把我当作强盗捉拿吗？我天天坐在殿里教导人，你们却没有逮捕我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当时，耶稣对众人说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？我天天坐在殿里教训人，你们并没有拿我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: In that hour Jesus said to the crowd, <red>“Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: At that hour Jesus said to the crowds, "Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs to capture me? Day after day I sat in the temple teaching, and you did not seize me.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to take Me? I sat daily with you, teaching in the temple, and you did not seize Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to the crowd, "Am I some dangerous revolutionary, that you come with swords and clubs to arrest me? Why didn’t you arrest me in the Temple? I was there teaching every day.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Jesus said to the crowds, "Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would against a man inciting a revolt? Every day I used to sit within the temple grounds teaching, and you did not arrest Me.
verses.textEn: In that hour Jesus said to the crowd, <red>“Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但这整件事的发生，是要应验先知书上的话。"那时，门徒都离开他逃跑了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但这整件事的发生，是要应验先知书上的话。"那时，门徒都离开他逃跑了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但这一切的事成就了，为要应验先知书上的话。」当下，门徒都离开他，逃走了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.”</red> Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.
verses.textEnEsv: But all this has taken place that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled." Then all the disciples left him and fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: But all this was done that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled." Then all the disciples forsook Him and fled.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is all happening to fulfill the words of the prophets as recorded in the Scriptures." At that point, all the disciples deserted him and fled.
verses.textEnNasb: But all this has taken place so that the Scriptures of the prophets will be fulfilled." Then all the disciples left Him and fled.
verses.textEn: <red>But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.”</red> Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.

verses.textZh: 那些逮捕了耶稣的人，把他押去见大祭司该亚法。那时经学家和长老已经聚集在那里了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些逮捕了耶稣的人，把他押去见大祭司该亚法。那时经学家和长老已经聚集在那里了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿耶稣的人把他带到大祭司该亚法那里去；文士和长老已经在那里聚会。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.
verses.textEnEsv: Then those who had seized Jesus led him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had gathered.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who had laid hold of Jesus led Him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people who had arrested Jesus led him to the home of Caiaphas, the high priest, where the teachers of religious law and the elders had gathered.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
verses.textEn: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.

verses.textZh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的官邸。他进到里面，和差役坐在一起，要看事情怎样了结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的官邸。他进到里面，和差役坐在一起，要看事情怎样了结。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的院子，进到里面，就和差役同坐，要看这事到底怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter was following him at a distance, as far as the courtyard of the high priest, and going inside he sat with the guards to see the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter followed Him at a distance to the high priest’s courtyard. And he went in and sat with the servants to see the end.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Peter followed him at a distance and came to the high priest’s courtyard. He went in and sat with the guards and waited to see how it would all end.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter was following Him at a distance, as far as the courtyard of the high priest, and he came inside and sat down with the officers to see the outcome.
verses.textEn: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.

verses.textZh: 祭司长和公议会全体都想找假证供来控告耶稣，好把他处死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和公议会全体都想找假证供来控告耶稣，好把他处死；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和全公会寻找假见证控告耶稣，要治死他。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the chief priests and the whole council were seeking false testimony against Jesus that they might put him to death,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the chief priests, the elders, and all the council sought false testimony against Jesus to put Him to death,
verses.textEnNlt: Inside, the leading priests and the entire high council were trying to find witnesses who would lie about Jesus, so they could put him to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the chief priests and the entire Council kept trying to obtain false testimony against Jesus, so that they might put Him to death.
verses.textEn: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.

verses.textZh: 虽然有许多人前来作假证供，却找不着证据。最后有两个人前来说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然有许多人前来作假证供，却找不着证据。最后有两个人前来说：
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有好些人来作假见证，总得不着实据。末后有两个人前来，说：
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward
verses.textEnEsv: but they found none, though many false witnesses came forward. At last two came forward
verses.textEnNkjv: but found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
verses.textEnNlt: But even though they found many who agreed to give false witness, they could not use anyone’s testimony. Finally, two men came forward
verses.textEnNasb: They did not find any, even though many false witnesses came forward. But later on two came forward,
verses.textEn: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

verses.textZh: "这人说过：‘我可以拆毁神的圣所，三日之内又把它建造起来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "这人说过：‘我可以拆毁神的圣所，三日之内又把它建造起来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「这个人曾说：『我能拆毁神的殿，三日内又建造起来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: and declared, "This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to rebuild it in three days.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and to build it in three days.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: who declared, "This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the Temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and said, "This man stated, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and to rebuild it in three days.’ "
verses.textEn: and declared, "This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ "

verses.textEnNkjv: And the high priest arose and said to Him, "Do You answer nothing? What isit these men testify against You?"

verses.textEn: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣却不作声。大祭司又对他说："我指着永生的神要你起誓，告诉我们你是不是基督、神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却不作声。大祭司又对他说："我指着永生的神要你起誓，告诉我们你是不是基督、神的儿子。"

verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, "I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God."
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus remained silent. And the high priest said to him, "I adjure you by the living God, tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God."

verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to him, "I demand in the name of the living God—tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus kept silent. And the high priest said to Him, "I place You under oath by the living God, to tell us whether You are the Christ, the Son of God."
verses.textEn: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, "I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："你已经说了 ；但我告诉你们： 从今以后，你们要看见人子， 坐在权能者的右边， 驾着天上的云降临。"</red>

verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "You have said it. And in the future you will see the Son of Man seated in the place of power at God’s right hand and coming on the clouds of heaven."
