verses.textEn: Then he went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, "This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth."

verses.textZh: "我有罪了！我出卖了无辜的人 ！"他们说："这是你的事，跟我们有甚么关系？"

verses.textEnNiv: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
verses.textEnEsv: So they took counsel and bought with them the potter’s field as a burial place for strangers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they consulted together and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
verses.textEnNlt: After some discussion they finally decided to buy the potter’s field, and they made it into a cemetery for foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: And they conferred together and with the money bought the Potter’s Field as a burial place for strangers.
verses.textEn: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.

verses.textZhCnvs: 所以那田称为"血田"，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以那块田直到今日还叫做「血田」。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the field is still called the Field of Blood.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
verses.textEn: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

verses.textEnNiv: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me."

verses.textEnNkjv: and gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord directed me."
verses.textEnNlt: and purchased the potter’s field, as the Lord directed. "

verses.textEn: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me."

verses.textZh: 耶稣站在总督面前，总督问他："<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>这是你说的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣站在总督面前，总督问他："<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>这是你说的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣站在巡抚面前；巡抚问他说：「<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你说的是。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” <red>“Youp have said so,”</red> Jesus replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" Jesus said, "You have said so."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus stood before the governor. And the governor asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" Jesus said to him, "It is as you say."
verses.textEnNlt: Now Jesus was standing before Pilate, the Roman governor. "Are you the king of the Jews?" the governor asked him. Jesus replied, "You have said it."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor questioned Him, saying, "So You are the King of the Jews?" And Jesus said to him, "It is as you say."
verses.textEn: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” <red>“Youp have said so,”</red> Jesus replied.

verses.textZh: 祭司长和长老控告他的时候，他却不回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和长老控告他的时候，他却不回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被祭司长和长老控告的时候，什么都不回答。
verses.textEnNiv: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.
verses.textEnEsv: But when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he gave no answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And while He was being accused by the chief priests and elders, He answered nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the leading priests and the elders made their accusations against him, Jesus remained silent.
verses.textEnNasb: And while He was being accused by the chief priests and elders, He did not offer any answer.
verses.textEn: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多又问他："他们作证指控你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多又问他："他们作证指控你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多就对他说：「他们作见证告你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pilate asked him, "Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pilate said to him, "Do you not hear how many things they testify against you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate said to Him, "Do You not hear how many things they testify against You?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t you hear all these charges they are bringing against you?" Pilate demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pilate *said to Him, "Do You not hear how many things they are testifying against You?"
verses.textEn: Then Pilate asked him, "Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣一句话也不回答他，令总督非常惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一句话也不回答他，令总督非常惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣仍不回答，连一句话也不说，以致巡抚甚觉希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.
verses.textEnEsv: But he gave him no answer, not even to a single charge, so that the governor was greatly amazed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered him not one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus made no response to any of the charges, much to the governor’s surprise.
verses.textEnNasb: And still He did not answer him in regard to even a single charge, so the governor was greatly amazed.
verses.textEn: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.

verses.textZh: 每逢这节期，总督有一个惯例，就是给群众释放一个他们要求释放的囚犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢这节期，总督有一个惯例，就是给群众释放一个他们要求释放的囚犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚有一个常例，每逢这节期，随众人所要的释放一个囚犯给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now it was the governor’s custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release for the crowd any one prisoner whom they wanted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to releasing to the multitude one prisoner whom they wished.
verses.textEnNlt: Now it was the governor’s custom each year during the Passover celebration to release one prisoner to the crowd—anyone they wanted.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at the Passover Feast the governor was accustomed to release for the people any one prisoner whom they wanted.
verses.textEn: Now it was the governor’s custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

verses.textZh: 那时，有个声名狼藉的囚犯，名叫耶数．巴拉巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有个声名狼藉的囚犯，名叫耶数．巴拉巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时有一个出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.
verses.textEnEsv: And they had then a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at that time they had a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.
verses.textEnNlt: This year there was a notorious prisoner, a man named Barabbas.
verses.textEnNasb: And at that time they were holding a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.
verses.textEn: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.

verses.textZh: 群众聚集的时候，彼拉多问他们："你们要我给你们释放谁？耶数．巴拉巴或是称为基督的耶稣呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众聚集的时候，彼拉多问他们："你们要我给你们释放谁？耶数．巴拉巴或是称为基督的耶稣呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人聚集的时候，彼拉多就对他们说：「你们要我释放哪一个给你们？是巴拉巴呢？是称为基督的耶稣呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?"
verses.textEnEsv: So when they had gathered, Pilate said to them, "Whom do you want me to release for you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when they had gathered together, Pilate said to them, "Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"
verses.textEnNlt: As the crowds gathered before Pilate’s house that morning, he asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you—Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?"
verses.textEnNasb: So when the people gathered together, Pilate said to them, "Whom do you want me to release for you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"
verses.textEn: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?"

verses.textZh: 他知道他们是因为嫉妒才把耶稣交了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他知道他们是因为嫉妒才把耶稣交了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚原知道他们是因为嫉妒才把他解了来。
verses.textEnNiv: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.
verses.textEnEsv: For he knew that it was out of envy that they had delivered him up.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he knew that they had handed Him over because of envy.
verses.textEnNlt: (He knew very well that the religious leaders had arrested Jesus out of envy.)
verses.textEnNasb: For he knew that it was because of envy that they had handed Him over.
verses.textEn: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多坐在审判台上的时候，他的夫人派人来说："你不要干涉这个义人的事，因为昨夜我在梦中因他受了很多的苦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多坐在审判台上的时候，他的夫人派人来说："你不要干涉这个义人的事，因为昨夜我在梦中因他受了很多的苦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 正坐堂的时候，他的夫人打发人来说：「这义人的事，你一点不可管，因为我今天在梦中为他受了许多的苦。」
verses.textEnNiv: While Pilate was sitting on the judge’s seat, his wife sent him this message: "Don’t have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him."
verses.textEnEsv: Besides, while he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent word to him, "Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered much because of him today in a dream."
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, "Have nothing to do with that just Man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of Him."
verses.textEnNlt: Just then, as Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him this message: "Leave that innocent man alone. I suffered through a terrible nightmare about him last night."
verses.textEnNasb: And while he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him a message, saying, "See that you have nothing to do with that righteous Man; for last night I suffered greatly in a dream because of Him."
verses.textEn: While Pilate was sitting on the judge’s seat, his wife sent him this message: "Don’t have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him."

verses.textZh: 祭司长和长老怂恿群众，叫他们去要求释放巴拉巴，除掉耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和长老怂恿群众，叫他们去要求释放巴拉巴，除掉耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和长老挑唆众人，求释放巴拉巴，除灭耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitudes that they should ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the leading priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas to be released and for Jesus to be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas, and to put Jesus to death.
verses.textEn: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.

verses.textZh: 总督问他们："这两个人，你们要我给你们释放哪一个？"他们说："巴拉巴！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 总督问他们："这两个人，你们要我给你们释放哪一个？"他们说："巴拉巴！"
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚对众人说：「这两个人，你们要我释放哪一个给你们呢？」他们说：「巴拉巴。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" asked the governor. "Barabbas," they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: The governor again said to them, "Which of the two do you want me to release for you?" And they said, "Barabbas."
verses.textEnNkjv: The governor answered and said to them, "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" They said, "Barabbas!"
verses.textEnNlt: So the governor asked again, "Which of these two do you want me to release to you?" The crowd shouted back, "Barabbas!"
verses.textEnNasb: And the governor said to them, "Which of the two do you want me to release for you?" And they said, "Barabbas."
verses.textEn: "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" asked the governor. "Barabbas," they answered.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多对他们说："那么，我怎样处置那称为基督的耶稣呢？"他们齐声说："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多对他们说："那么，我怎样处置那称为基督的耶稣呢？"他们齐声说："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「这样，那称为基督的耶稣我怎么办他呢？」他们都说：「把他钉十字架！」
verses.textEnNiv: "What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?" Pilate asked. They all answered, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate said to them, "Then what shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?" They all said, "Let him be crucified!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate said to them, "What then shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?" They all said to him, "Let Him be crucified!"
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate responded, "Then what should I do with Jesus who is called the Messiah?" They shouted back, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate *said to them, "Then what shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?" They all *said, " Crucify Him!"
verses.textEn: "What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?" Pilate asked. They all answered, "Crucify him!"

verses.textZh: 彼拉多说："为甚么呢？他作了甚么恶事呢？"众人更加大声喊叫："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多说："为甚么呢？他作了甚么恶事呢？"众人更加大声喊叫："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Why? What evil has he done?" But they shouted all the more, "Let him be crucified!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the governor said, "Why, what evil has He done?" But they cried out all the more, saying, "Let Him be crucified!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why?" Pilate demanded. "What crime has he committed?" But the mob roared even louder, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Why, what evil has He done?" Yet they kept shouting all the more, saying, " Crucify Him!"
verses.textEn: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

verses.textZh: 彼拉多见无济于事，反会引起骚动，就拿水在群众面前洗手，说："流这人的血，与我无关，你们自己负责吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多见无济于事，反会引起骚动，就拿水在群众面前洗手，说："流这人的血，与我无关，你们自己负责吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多见说也无济于事，反要生乱，就拿水在众人面前洗手，说：「流这义人的血，罪不在我，你们承当吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am innocent of this man’s blood," he said. "It is your responsibility!"
verses.textEnEsv: So when Pilate saw that he was gaining nothing, but rather that a riot was beginning, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd, saying, "I am innocent of this man’s blood; see to it yourselves."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Pilate saw that he could not prevail at all, but rather that a tumult was rising, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, "I am innocent of the blood of this just Person. You see toit."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate saw that he wasn’t getting anywhere and that a riot was developing. So he sent for a bowl of water and washed his hands before the crowd, saying, "I am innocent of this man’s blood. The responsibility is yours!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but rather that a riot was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd, saying, "I am innocent of this Man’s blood; you yourselves shall see."
verses.textEn: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am innocent of this man’s blood," he said. "It is your responsibility!"

verses.textZh: 群众回答："流他的血的责任，归在我们和我们子孙的身上吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众回答："流他的血的责任，归在我们和我们子孙的身上吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都回答说：「他的血归到我们和我们的子孙身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the people answered, "His blood is on us and on our children!"
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people answered, "His blood be on us and on our children!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people answered and said, "His blood be on us and on our children."
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people yelled back, "We will take responsibility for his death—we and our children!"
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people replied, "His blood shall be on us and on our children!"
verses.textEn: All the people answered, "His blood is on us and on our children!"

verses.textZh: 于是彼拉多给他们释放了巴拉巴；他把耶稣鞭打了，就交给他们钉十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是彼拉多给他们释放了巴拉巴；他把耶稣鞭打了，就交给他们钉十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是彼拉多释放巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he released for them Barabbas, and having scourged Jesus, delivered him to be crucified.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he released Barabbas to them; and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered Him to be crucified.
verses.textEnNlt: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. He ordered Jesus flogged with a lead-tipped whip, then turned him over to the Roman soldiers to be crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he released Barabbas for them; but after having Jesus flogged, he handed Him over to be crucified.
verses.textEn: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

verses.textZh: 总督的士兵把耶稣带到总督府，召集全队士兵到他面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总督的士兵把耶稣带到总督府，召集全队士兵到他面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚的兵就把耶稣带进衙门，叫全营的兵都聚集在他那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the governor’s headquarters, and they gathered the whole battalion before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole garrison around Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into their headquarters and called out the entire regiment.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole Roman cohort to Him.
verses.textEn: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

verses.textZh: 他们脱去他的衣服，给他披上朱红色的外袍，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们脱去他的衣服，给他披上朱红色的外袍，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们给他脱了衣服，穿上一件朱红色袍子，
verses.textEnNiv: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
verses.textEnEsv: And they stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they stripped Him and put a red cloak on Him.
verses.textEn: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

verses.textZh: 又用荆棘编成冠冕，戴在他的头上，把一根芦苇放在他的右手，跪在他面前讥笑他说："犹太人的王万岁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用荆棘编成冠冕，戴在他的头上，把一根芦苇放在他的右手，跪在他面前讥笑他说："犹太人的王万岁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 用荆棘编做冠冕，戴在他头上，拿一根苇子放在他右手里，跪在他面前，戏弄他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」
verses.textEnNiv: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt in front of him and mocked him. "Hail, king of the Jews!" they said.
verses.textEnEsv: and twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on his head and put a reed in his right hand. And kneeling before him, they mocked him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had twisted a crown of thorns, they put it on His head, and a reed in His right hand. And they bowed the knee before Him and mocked Him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
verses.textEnNlt: They wove thorn branches into a crown and put it on his head, and they placed a reed stick in his right hand as a scepter. Then they knelt before him in mockery and taunted, "Hail! King of the Jews!"
verses.textEnNasb: And after twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on His head, and put a reed in His right hand; and they knelt down before Him and mocked Him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
verses.textEn: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt in front of him and mocked him. "Hail, king of the Jews!" they said.

verses.textZh: 然后向他吐唾沫，又拿起芦苇打他的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后向他吐唾沫，又拿起芦苇打他的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 又吐唾沫在他脸上，拿苇子打他的头。
verses.textEnNiv: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.
verses.textEnEsv: And they spit on him and took the reed and struck him on the head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they spat on Him, and took the reed and struck Him on the head.
verses.textEnNlt: And they spit on him and grabbed the stick and struck him on the head with it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they spit on Him, and took the reed and beat Him on the head.
verses.textEn: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

verses.textZh: 戏弄完了，就脱下他的外袍，给他穿回自己的衣服，带去钉十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 戏弄完了，就脱下他的外袍，给他穿回自己的衣服，带去钉十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had mocked him, they stripped him of the robe and put his own clothes on him and led him away to crucify him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had mocked Him, they took the robe off Him, put His own clothes on Him, and led Him away to be crucified.
verses.textEnNlt: When they were finally tired of mocking him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him again. Then they led him away to be crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: And after they had mocked Him, they took the cloak off Him and put His own garments back on Him, and led Him away to crucify Him.
verses.textEn: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.

verses.textZh: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就强迫他背耶稣的十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就强迫他背耶稣的十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.
verses.textEnEsv: As they went out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name. They compelled this man to carry his cross.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name. Him they compelled to bear His cross.
verses.textEnNlt: Along the way, they came across a man named Simon, who was from Cyrene, and the soldiers forced him to carry Jesus’ cross.
verses.textEnNasb: As they were coming out, they found a man of Cyrene named Simon, whom they compelled to carry His cross.
verses.textEn: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

verses.textZh: 到了一个地方，名叫各各他，就是"髑髅地"的意思，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了一个地方，名叫各各他，就是"髑髅地"的意思，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了一个地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髅地」。
verses.textEnNiv: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to a place called Golgotha (which means Place of a Skull),
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had come to a place called Golgotha, that is to say, Place of a Skull,
verses.textEnNlt: And they went out to a place called Golgotha (which means "Place of the Skull").
verses.textEnNasb: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means Place of a Skull,
verses.textEn: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").

verses.textZh: 他们把苦胆调和的酒给他喝，他尝了却不肯喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把苦胆调和的酒给他喝，他尝了却不肯喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 兵丁拿苦胆调和的酒给耶稣喝；他尝了，就不肯喝。
verses.textEnNiv: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.
verses.textEnEsv: they offered him wine to drink, mixed with gall, but when he tasted it, he would not drink it.
verses.textEnNkjv: they gave Him sour wine mingled with gall to drink. But when He had tasted it, He would not drink.
verses.textEnNlt: The soldiers gave Jesus wine mixed with bitter gall, but when he had tasted it, he refused to drink it.
verses.textEnNasb: they gave Him wine mixed with bile to drink; and after tasting it, He was unwilling to drink it.
verses.textEn: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

verses.textZh: 士兵把他钉了十字架，就抽签分他的衣服，
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵把他钉了十字架，就抽签分他的衣服，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们既将他钉在十字架上，就拈阄分他的衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had crucified him, they divided his garments among them by casting lots.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they crucified Him, and divided His garments, casting lots, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet: "They divided My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots."
verses.textEnNlt: After they had nailed him to the cross, the soldiers gambled for his clothes by throwing dice.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they had crucified Him, they divided His garments among themselves by casting lots.
verses.textEn: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

verses.textZh: 然后坐在那里看守他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后坐在那里看守他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又坐在那里看守他。
verses.textEnNiv: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they sat down and kept watch over him there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they sat around and kept guard as he hung there.
verses.textEnNasb: And sitting down, they began to keep watch over Him there.
verses.textEn: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.

verses.textZh: 他们在耶稣的头以上，钉了一块牌子，写着他的罪状："这是犹太人的王耶稣"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在耶稣的头以上，钉了一块牌子，写着他的罪状："这是犹太人的王耶稣"。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他头以上安一个牌子，写着他的罪状，说：「这是犹太人的王耶稣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews.
verses.textEnEsv: And over his head they put the charge against him, which read, "This is Jesus, the King of the Jews."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they put up over His head the accusation written against Him: THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.textEnNlt: A sign was fastened above Jesus’ head, announcing the charge against him. It read: "This is Jesus, the King of the Jews."
verses.textEnNasb: And above His head they put up the charge against Him which read, "THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS."
verses.textEn: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews.

verses.textZh: 当时，有两个强盗和他一同钉十字架，一个在右，一个在左。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，有两个强盗和他一同钉十字架，一个在右，一个在左。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，有两个强盗和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。
verses.textEnNiv: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
verses.textEnEsv: Then two robbers were crucified with him, one on the right and one on the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then two robbers were crucified with Him, one on the right and another on the left.
verses.textEnNlt: Two revolutionaries were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time two rebels *were being crucified with Him, one on the right and one on the left.
verses.textEn: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

verses.textZh: 过路的人嘲笑他，摇着头说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 过路的人嘲笑他，摇着头说：
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里经过的人讥诮他，摇着头，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads
verses.textEnEsv: And those who passed by derided him, wagging their heads
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads
verses.textEnNlt: The people passing by shouted abuse, shaking their heads in mockery.
verses.textEnNasb: And those passing by were speaking abusively to Him, shaking their heads,
verses.textEn: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads

verses.textZh: "你这个想拆毁圣所，三日之内又把它建造起来的，救救自己吧！如果你是神的儿子，从十字架上下来吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你这个想拆毁圣所，三日之内又把它建造起来的，救救自己吧！如果你是神的儿子，从十字架上下来吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你这拆毁圣殿、三日又建造起来的，可以救自己吧！你如果是神的儿子，就从十字架上下来吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!"
verses.textEnEsv: and saying, "You who would destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross."
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, "You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at you now!" they yelled at him. "You said you were going to destroy the Temple and rebuild it in three days. Well then, if you are the Son of God, save yourself and come down from the cross!"
verses.textEnNasb: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross."
verses.textEn: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!"

verses.textZh: 祭司长、经学家和长老也同样讥笑他，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长、经学家和长老也同样讥笑他，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和文士并长老也是这样戏弄他，说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.
verses.textEnEsv: So also the chief priests, with the scribes and elders, mocked him, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise the chief priests also, mocking with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.textEnNlt: The leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders also mocked Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way the chief priests also, along with the scribes and elders, were mocking Him and saying,
verses.textEn: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.

verses.textZh: "他救了别人，却不能救自己。如果他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他救了别人，却不能救自己。如果他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他救了别人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。
verses.textEnNiv: "He saved others," they said, "but he can’t save himself! He’s the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.
verses.textEnEsv: "He saved others; he cannot save himself. He is the King of Israel; let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He saved others; Himself He cannot save. If He is the King of Israel, let Him now come down from the cross, and we will believe Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "He saved others," they scoffed, "but he can’t save himself! So he is the King of Israel, is he? Let him come down from the cross right now, and we will believe in him!
verses.textEnNasb: "He saved others; He cannot save Himself! He is the King of Israel; let Him now come down from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
verses.textEn: "He saved others," they said, "but he can’t save himself! He’s the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

verses.textZh: 他信靠神；如果神喜悦他，就让神现在救他吧，因为他说自己是神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他信靠神；如果神喜悦他，就让神现在救他吧，因为他说自己是神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他倚靠神，神若喜悦他，现在可以救他；因为他曾说：『我是神的儿子。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: He trusts in God; let God deliver him now, if he desires him. For he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: He trusted in God; let Him deliver Him now if He will have Him; for He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He trusted God, so let God rescue him now if he wants him! For he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: He has trusted in God; let God rescueHim now, if He takes pleasure in Him; for He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ "
verses.textEn: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ "

verses.textZh: 和他一同钉十字架的强盗也都这样侮辱他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和他一同钉十字架的强盗也都这样侮辱他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那和他同钉的强盗也是这样地讥诮他。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the robbers who were crucified with him also reviled him in the same way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even the robbers who were crucified with Him reviled Him with the same thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the revolutionaries who were crucified with him ridiculed him in the same way.
verses.textEnNasb: And the rebels who had been crucified with Him were also insulting Him in the same way.
verses.textEn: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

verses.textZh: 从正午到下午三点钟，遍地都黑暗了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从正午到下午三点钟，遍地都黑暗了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
verses.textEnNiv: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now from the sixth hour until the ninth hour there was darkness over all the land.
verses.textEnNlt: At noon, darkness fell across the whole land until three o’clock.
verses.textEnNasb: Now from the sixth hour darkness fell upon all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.textEn: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.

verses.textZh: 大约三点钟，耶稣大声呼叫："<red>以利，以利，拉马撒巴各大尼？</red>"意思是"<red>我的神，我的神，你为甚么离弃我？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大约三点钟，耶稣大声呼叫："<red>以利，以利，拉马撒巴各大尼？</red>"意思是"<red>我的神，我的神，你为甚么离弃我？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 约在申初，耶稣大声喊着说：「<red>以利！以利！拉马撒巴各大尼？</red>」就是说：「<red>我的神！我的神！为什么离弃我？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli,*ir Eli,*ir lema*ir sabachthani?”*ir (which means <red>“My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?" that is, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?" that is, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: At about three o’clock, Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?" which means "My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?"
verses.textEnNasb: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lema sabaktanei?" that is, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
verses.textEn: About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli,*ir Eli,*ir lema*ir sabachthani?”*ir (which means <red>“My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).</red>

verses.textZh: 有几个站在那里的人，听见了就说："这个人在呼叫以利亚呢。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个站在那里的人，听见了就说："这个人在呼叫以利亚呢。"
verses.textZhCuv: 站在那里的人，有的听见就说：「这个人呼叫以利亚呢！」
verses.textEnNiv: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He’s calling Elijah."
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the bystanders, hearing it, said, "This man is calling Elijah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Some of those who stood there, when they heard that, said, "This Man is calling for Elijah!"
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the bystanders misunderstood and thought he was calling for the prophet Elijah.
verses.textEnNasb: And some of those who were standing there, when they heard it, said, "This man is calling for Elijah."
verses.textEn: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He’s calling Elijah."

verses.textZh: 有一个人马上跑去拿海绵蘸满了酸酒，用芦苇递给他喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人马上跑去拿海绵蘸满了酸酒，用芦苇递给他喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有一个人赶紧跑去，拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: And one of them at once ran and took a sponge, filled it with sour wine, and put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with sour wine and put it on a reed, and offered it to Him to drink.
verses.textEnNlt: One of them ran and filled a sponge with sour wine, holding it up to him on a reed stick so he could drink.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately one of them ran, and taking a sponge, he filled it with sour wine and put it on a reed, and gave Him a drink.
verses.textEn: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.

verses.textZh: 但其他的人说："等一等，我们看看以利亚来不来救他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但其他的人说："等一等，我们看看以利亚来不来救他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的人说：「且等着，看以利亚来救他不来。」
verses.textEnNiv: The rest said, "Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him."
verses.textEnEsv: But the others said, "Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him."
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest said, "Let Him alone; let us see if Elijah will come to save Him."
verses.textEnNlt: But the rest said, "Wait! Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him."
verses.textEnNasb: But the rest of them said, " Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him ."
verses.textEn: The rest said, "Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him."

verses.textZh: 耶稣再大声呼叫，气就断了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣再大声呼叫，气就断了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又大声喊叫，气就断了。
verses.textEnNiv: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus cried out again with a loud voice and yielded up his spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus cried out again with a loud voice, and yielded up His spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus shouted out again, and he released his spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus cried out again with a loud voice, and gave up His spirit.
verses.textEn: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

verses.textZh: 忽然，圣所里的幔子从上到下裂成两半；地面震动，石头崩裂；
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然，圣所里的幔子从上到下裂成两半；地面震动，石头崩裂；
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，殿里的幔子从上到下裂为两半，地也震动，磐石也崩裂，
verses.textEnNiv: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom. And the earth shook, and the rocks were split.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom; and the earth quaked, and the rocks were split,
verses.textEnNlt: At that moment the curtain in the sanctuary of the Temple was torn in two, from top to bottom. The earth shook, rocks split apart,
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom; and the earth shook and the rocks were split.
verses.textEn: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split

verses.textZh: 而且坟墓开了，许多睡了的圣徒的身体也复活了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且坟墓开了，许多睡了的圣徒的身体也复活了，
verses.textZhCuv: 坟墓也开了，已睡圣徒的身体多有起来的。
verses.textEnNiv: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.
verses.textEnEsv: The tombs also were opened. And many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised,
verses.textEnNkjv: and the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
verses.textEnNlt: and tombs opened. The bodies of many godly men and women who had died were raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
verses.textEn: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

verses.textZh: 从坟墓里出来；到了耶稣复活之后，他们进到圣城向许多人显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从坟墓里出来；到了耶稣复活之后，他们进到圣城向许多人显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 到耶稣复活以后，他们从坟墓里出来，进了圣城，向许多人显现。
verses.textEnNiv: They came out of the tombs after Jesus’ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.
verses.textEnEsv: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection they went into the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.textEnNkjv: and coming out of the graves after His resurrection, they went into the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.textEnNlt: They left the cemetery after Jesus’ resurrection, went into the holy city of Jerusalem, and appeared to many people.
verses.textEnNasb: and coming out of the tombs after His resurrection, they entered the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.textEn: They came out of the tombs after Jesus’ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

verses.textZh: 百夫长和跟他一起看守耶稣的士兵，看见了地震和所发生的事情，就十分惧怕，说："这个人真是神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 百夫长和跟他一起看守耶稣的士兵，看见了地震和所发生的事情，就十分惧怕，说："这个人真是神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百夫长和一同看守耶稣的人看见地震并所经历的事，就极其害怕，说：「这真是神的儿子了！」
verses.textEnNiv: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, "Surely he was the Son of God!"
verses.textEnEsv: When the centurion and those who were with him, keeping watch over Jesus, saw the earthquake and what took place, they were filled with awe and said, "Truly this was the Son of God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the centurion and those with him, who were guarding Jesus, saw the earthquake and the things that had happened, they feared greatly, saying, "Truly this was the Son of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: The Roman officer and the other soldiers at the crucifixion were terrified by the earthquake and all that had happened. They said, "This man truly was the Son of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the centurion and those who were with him keeping guard over Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the other things that were happening, they became extremely frightened and said, "Truly this was the Son of God!"
verses.textEn: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, "Surely he was the Son of God!"

verses.textZh: 有许多妇女在那里远远地观看；她们是从加利利开始跟随耶稣服事他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多妇女在那里远远地观看；她们是从加利利开始跟随耶稣服事他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有好些妇女在那里，远远地观看；她们是从加利利跟随耶稣来服事他的。
verses.textEnNiv: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.
verses.textEnEsv: There were also many women there, looking on from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And many women who followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to Him, were there looking on from afar,
verses.textEnNlt: And many women who had come from Galilee with Jesus to care for him were watching from a distance.
verses.textEnNasb: And many women were there watching from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee while caring for Him.
verses.textEn: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.

verses.textZh: 她们中间有抹大拉的马利亚、雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，以及西庇太的儿子的母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们中间有抹大拉的马利亚、雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，以及西庇太的儿子的母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有西庇太两个儿子的母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
verses.textEnEsv: among whom were Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James and Joseph and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.textEnNkjv: among whom were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary (the mother of James and Joseph), and the mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee.
verses.textEnNasb: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.textEn: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，有一个亚利马太的富翁来到，他名叫约瑟，是耶稣的门徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，有一个亚利马太的富翁来到，他名叫约瑟，是耶稣的门徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，有一个财主，名叫约瑟，是亚利马太来的，他也是耶稣的门徒。
verses.textEnNiv: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who also was a disciple of Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when evening had come, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who himself had also become a disciple of Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: As evening approached, Joseph, a rich man from Arimathea who had become a follower of Jesus,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when it was evening, a rich man from Arimathea came, named Joseph, who himself had also become a disciple of Jesus.
verses.textEn: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 这个人去见彼拉多，请求领取耶稣的身体，彼拉多就吩咐给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个人去见彼拉多，请求领取耶稣的身体，彼拉多就吩咐给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体；彼拉多就吩咐给他。
verses.textEnNiv: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
verses.textEnEsv: He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate ordered it to be given to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given to him.
verses.textEnNlt: went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. And Pilate issued an order to release it to him.
verses.textEnNasb: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate ordered it to be given to him.
verses.textEn: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

verses.textZh: 约瑟领了耶稣的身体，用干净的细麻布裹好，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟领了耶稣的身体，用干净的细麻布裹好，
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟取了身体，用干净细麻布裹好，
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen shroud
verses.textEnNkjv: When Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a long sheet of clean linen cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.textEn: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

verses.textZh: 放在自己的新坟墓里，就是在盘石里凿出来的。他辊了一块大石头来挡住墓门，然后才离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 放在自己的新坟墓里，就是在盘石里凿出来的。他辊了一块大石头来挡住墓门，然后才离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 安放在自己的新坟墓里，就是他凿在磐石里的。他又把大石头滚到墓门口，就去了。
verses.textEnNiv: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.
verses.textEnEsv: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut in the rock. And he rolled a great stone to the entrance of the tomb and went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: and laid it in his new tomb which he had hewn out of the rock; and he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
verses.textEnNlt: He placed it in his own new tomb, which had been carved out of the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance and left.
verses.textEnNasb: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock; and he rolled a large stone against the entrance of the tomb and went away.
verses.textEn: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

verses.textZh: 抹大拉的马利亚和另一个马利亚都在那里，对着坟墓坐着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抹大拉的马利亚和另一个马利亚都在那里，对着坟墓坐着。
verses.textZhCuv: 有抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚在那里，对着坟墓坐着。
verses.textEnNiv: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: Both Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting across from the tomb and watching.
verses.textEnNasb: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.textEn: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

verses.textZh: 第二天，就是过了"预备日"的那一天，祭司长和法利赛人去见彼拉多，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，就是过了"预备日"的那一天，祭司长和法利赛人去见彼拉多，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，就是预备日的第二天，祭司长和法利赛人聚集来见彼拉多，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day, that is, after the day of Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate
verses.textEnNkjv: On the next day, which followed the Day of Preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees gathered together to Pilate,
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, on the Sabbath, the leading priests and Pharisees went to see Pilate.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the next day, that is, the day which is after the preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered together with Pilate,
verses.textEn: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.

verses.textZh: "大人，我们想起那个骗子，生前说过：‘三天之后，我要复活。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "大人，我们想起那个骗子，生前说过：‘三天之后，我要复活。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「大人，我们记得那诱惑人的还活着的时候曾说：『三日后我要复活。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Sir," they said, "we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Sir, we remember how that impostor said, while he was still alive, ‘After three days I will rise.’
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Sir, we remember, while He was still alive, how that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise.’
verses.textEnNlt: They told him, "Sir, we remember what that deceiver once said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise from the dead.’
verses.textEnNasb: and they said, "Sir, we remember that when that deceiver was still alive, He said, ‘After three days I am rising.’
verses.textEn: "Sir," they said, "we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’

verses.textZh: 所以请你下令把坟墓严密看守，直到第三天，免得他的门徒来把他偷去，然后对民众说：‘他从死人中复活了。’这样，日后的骗局比起初的就更大了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以请你下令把坟墓严密看守，直到第三天，免得他的门徒来把他偷去，然后对民众说：‘他从死人中复活了。’这样，日后的骗局比起初的就更大了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，请吩咐人将坟墓把守妥当，直到第三日，恐怕他的门徒来，把他偷了去，就告诉百姓说：『他从死里复活了。』这样，那后来的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」
verses.textEnNiv: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore order the tomb to be made secure until the third day, lest his disciples go and steal him away and tell the people, ‘He has risen from the dead,’ and the last fraud will be worse than the first."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore command that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest His disciples come by night and steal Him away, and say to the people, ‘He has risen from the dead.’ So the last deception will be worse than the first."
verses.textEnNlt: So we request that you seal the tomb until the third day. This will prevent his disciples from coming and stealing his body and then telling everyone he was raised from the dead! If that happens, we’ll be worse off than we were at first."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, give orders for the tomb to be made secure until the third day; otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him, and say to the people, ‘He has risen from the dead,’ and the last deception will be worse than the first."
verses.textEn: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多对他们说："你们带着卫兵，尽你们所能的去严密看守吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多对他们说："你们带着卫兵，尽你们所能的去严密看守吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「你们有看守的兵，去吧！尽你们所能的把守妥当。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Take a guard," Pilate answered. "Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how."
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard of soldiers. Go, make it as secure as you can."
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard; go your way, make it as secure as you know how."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate replied, "Take guards and secure it the best you can."
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard; go, make it as secure as you know how."
verses.textEn: "Take a guard," Pilate answered. "Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how."

verses.textZh: 他们就去把墓前的石封好，又派卫兵把守，严密地守住坟墓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就去把墓前的石封好，又派卫兵把守，严密地守住坟墓。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就带着看守的兵同去，封了石头，将坟墓把守妥当。
verses.textEnNiv: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went and made the tomb secure by sealing the stone and setting a guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone and setting the guard.
verses.textEnNlt: So they sealed the tomb and posted guards to protect it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went and made the tomb secure with the guard, sealing the stone.
verses.textEn: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.

verses.textZh: 过了安息日，在礼拜日天亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和另一个马利亚来看坟墓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了安息日，在礼拜日天亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和另一个马利亚来看坟墓。
verses.textZhCuv: 安息日将尽，七日的头一日，天快亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚来看坟墓。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: Now after the Sabbath, toward the dawn of the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the Sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: Early on Sunday morning, as the new day was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went out to visit the tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to look at the tomb.
verses.textEn: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

verses.textZh: 忽然，地震得很厉害；主的使者从天上下来，把石头辊开，坐在上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然，地震得很厉害；主的使者从天上下来，把石头辊开，坐在上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，地大震动；因为有主的使者从天上下来，把石头滚开，坐在上面。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came and rolled back the stone and sat on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly there was a great earthquake! For an angel of the Lord came down from heaven, rolled aside the stone, and sat on it.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, a severe earthquake had occurred, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
verses.textEn: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.

verses.textZh: 他的样子好象闪电，衣服洁白如雪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的样子好象闪电，衣服洁白如雪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的相貌如同闪电，衣服洁白如雪。
verses.textEnNiv: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
verses.textEnEsv: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
verses.textEnNkjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his clothing as white as snow.
verses.textEnNlt: His face shone like lightning, and his clothing was as white as snow.
verses.textEnNasb: And his appearance was like lightning, and his clothing as white as snow.
verses.textEn: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

verses.textZh: 看守的人因为害怕他，就浑身战抖，好象死了一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看守的人因为害怕他，就浑身战抖，好象死了一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 看守的人就因他吓得浑身乱战，甚至和死人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.
verses.textEnEsv: And for fear of him the guards trembled and became like dead men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the guards shook for fear of him, and became like dead men.
verses.textEnNlt: The guards shook with fear when they saw him, and they fell into a dead faint.
verses.textEnNasb: The guards shook from fear of him and became like dead men.
verses.textEn: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

verses.textZh: 那使者对妇女们说："你们不要怕，我知道你们在找被钉十字架的耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那使者对妇女们说："你们不要怕，我知道你们在找被钉十字架的耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使对妇女说：「不要害怕！我知道你们是寻找那钉十字架的耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
verses.textEnEsv: But the angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the angel answered and said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel spoke to the women. "Don’t be afraid!" he said. "I know you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: And the angel said to the women, " Do not be afraid; for I know that you are looking for Jesus who has been crucified.
verses.textEn: The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

verses.textZh: 他不在这里，已经照他所说的复活了。你们来看安放他的地方吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不在这里，已经照他所说的复活了。你们来看安放他的地方吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不在这里，照他所说的，已经复活了。你们来看安放主的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
verses.textEnEsv: He is not here, for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.textEnNlt: He isn’t here! He is risen from the dead, just as he said would happen. Come, see where his body was lying.
verses.textEnNasb: He is not here, for He has risen, just as He said. Come, see the place where He was lying.
verses.textEn: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

verses.textZh: 快去告诉他的门徒：‘他已经从死人中复活了。他会比你们先到加利利去，你们在那里必看见他。’现在我已经告诉你们了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 快去告诉他的门徒：‘他已经从死人中复活了。他会比你们先到加利利去，你们在那里必看见他。’现在我已经告诉你们了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 快去告诉他的门徒，说他从死里复活了，并且在你们以先往加利利去，在那里你们要见他。看哪，我已经告诉你们了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then go quickly and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead, and behold, he is going before you to Galilee; there you will see him. See, I have told you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And go quickly and tell His disciples that He is risen from the dead, and indeed He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see Him. Behold, I have told you."
verses.textEnNlt: And now, go quickly and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead, and he is going ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there. Remember what I have told you."
verses.textEnNasb: And go quickly and tell His disciples that He has risen from the dead; and behold, He is going ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see Him; behold, I have told you."
verses.textEn: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you."

verses.textZh: 她们立刻离开坟墓，又害怕，又十分欢喜，跑去告诉耶稣的门徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们立刻离开坟墓，又害怕，又十分欢喜，跑去告诉耶稣的门徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇女们就急忙离开坟墓，又害怕，又大大地欢喜，跑去要报给他的门徒。
verses.textEnNiv: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: So they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring His disciples word.
verses.textEnNlt: The women ran quickly from the tomb. They were very frightened but also filled with great joy, and they rushed to give the disciples the angel’s message.
verses.textEnNasb: And they left the tomb quickly with fear and great joy, and ran to report to His disciples.
verses.textEn: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

verses.textZh: 忽然，耶稣向她们迎面而来，说："<red>你们好。</red>"她们就上前，抱住他的脚拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然，耶稣向她们迎面而来，说："<red>你们好。</red>"她们就上前，抱住他的脚拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，耶稣遇见她们，说：「<red>愿你们平安！</red>」她们就上前抱住他的脚拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: Suddenly Jesus met them. <red>“Greetings,”</red> he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, Jesus met them and said, "Greetings!" And they came up and took hold of his feet and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as they went to tell His disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Rejoice!" So they came and held Him by the feet and worshiped Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And as they went, Jesus met them and greeted them. And they ran to him, grasped his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, Jesus met them and said, " Rejoice!" And they came up and took hold of His feet, and worshiped Him.
verses.textEn: Suddenly Jesus met them. <red>“Greetings,”</red> he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她们说："<red>不要怕，去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们到加利利去，他们在那里必看见我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她们说："<red>不要怕，去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们到加利利去，他们在那里必看见我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对她们说：「<red>不要害怕！你们去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们往加利利去，在那里必见我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid; go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee, and there they will see me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell My brethren to go to Galilee, and there they will see Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to them, "Don’t be afraid! Go tell my brothers to leave for Galilee, and they will see me there."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus *said to them, " Do not be afraid; go, bring word to My brothers to leave for Galilee, and there they will see Me."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 她们去的时候，有些卫兵进了城，把一切所发生的事向祭司长报告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们去的时候，有些卫兵进了城，把一切所发生的事向祭司长报告。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们去的时候，看守的兵有几个进城去，将所经历的事都报给祭司长。
verses.textEnNiv: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
verses.textEnEsv: While they were going, behold, some of the guard went into the city and told the chief priests all that had taken place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests all the things that had happened.
verses.textEnNlt: As the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and told the leading priests what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while they were on their way, some of the men from the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
verses.textEn: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

verses.textZh: 祭司长就和长老聚集在一起商量，然后拿许多钱给士兵，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长就和长老聚集在一起商量，然后拿许多钱给士兵，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和长老聚集商议，就拿许多银钱给兵丁，说：
verses.textEnNiv: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had assembled with the elders and taken counsel, they gave a sufficient sum of money to the soldiers
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had assembled with the elders and consulted together, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,
verses.textEnNlt: A meeting with the elders was called, and they decided to give the soldiers a large bribe.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they had assembled with the elders and consulted together, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,
verses.textEn: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,

verses.textZh: 说："你们要这样说：‘他的门徒晚上来了，趁我们睡着的时候，把他偷走了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："你们要这样说：‘他的门徒晚上来了，趁我们睡着的时候，把他偷走了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要这样说：『夜间我们睡觉的时候，他的门徒来，把他偷去了。』
verses.textEnNiv: telling them, "You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Tell people, ‘His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Tell them, ‘His disciples came at night and stole Him away while we slept.’
verses.textEnNlt: They told the soldiers, "You must say, ‘Jesus’ disciples came during the night while we were sleeping, and they stole his body.’
verses.textEnNasb: and said, "You are to say, ‘His disciples came at night and stole Him while we were asleep.’
verses.textEn: telling them, "You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’

verses.textZh: 如果总督知道了这件事，我们会说服他，不会牵连你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果总督知道了这件事，我们会说服他，不会牵连你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若这话被巡抚听见，有我们劝他，保你们无事。」
verses.textEnNiv: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."
verses.textEnEsv: And if this comes to the governor’s ears, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if this comes to the governor’s ears, we will appease him and make you secure."
verses.textEnNlt: If the governor hears about it, we’ll stand up for you so you won’t get in trouble."
verses.textEnNasb: And if this comes to the governor’s ears, we will appease him and keep you out of trouble."
verses.textEn: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."

verses.textZh: 士兵收了钱，就照着祭司长和长老的指使去作。这种说法直到今日还流传在犹太人当中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵收了钱，就照着祭司长和长老的指使去作。这种说法直到今日还流传在犹太人当中。
verses.textZhCuv: 兵丁受了银钱，就照所嘱咐他们的去行。这话就传说在犹太人中间，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.
verses.textEnEsv: So they took the money and did as they were directed. And this story has been spread among the Jews to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took the money and did as they were instructed; and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So the guards accepted the bribe and said what they were told to say. Their story spread widely among the Jews, and they still tell it today.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took the money and did as they had been instructed; and this story was widely spread among the Jews and is to this day.
verses.textEn: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.

verses.textZh: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣指定的山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣指定的山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣约定的山上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain to which Jesus had directed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, to the mountain which Jesus had appointed for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the eleven disciples left for Galilee, going to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
verses.textEnNasb: But the eleven disciples proceeded to Galilee, to the mountain which Jesus had designated to them.
verses.textEn: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

verses.textZh: 他们看见耶稣就拜他，但仍然有些人怀疑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见耶稣就拜他，但仍然有些人怀疑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们见了耶稣就拜他，然而还有人疑惑。
verses.textEnNiv: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they saw him they worshiped him, but some doubted.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him; but some doubted.
verses.textEnNlt: When they saw him, they worshiped him—but some of them doubted!
verses.textEnNasb: And when they saw Him, they worshiped Him; but some were doubtful.
verses.textEn: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

verses.textZh: 耶稣上前来，对他们说："<red>天上地上一切权柄都赐给我了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上前来，对他们说："<red>天上地上一切权柄都赐给我了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣进前来，对他们说：「天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus came to them and said, <red>“All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus came and said to them, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, "All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus came and told his disciples, "I have been given all authority in heaven and on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus came up and spoke to them, saying, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus came to them and said, <red>“All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你们要去使万民作我的门徒，奉父子圣灵的名，给他们施洗 ，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你们要去使万民作我的门徒，奉父子圣灵的名，给他们施洗 ，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗 。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Go, therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我吩咐你们的一切，都要教导他们遵守。这样，我就常常与你们同在，直到这世代的终结。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我吩咐你们的一切，都要教导他们遵守。这样，我就常常与你们同在，直到这世代的终结。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡我所吩咐你们的，都教训他们遵守，我就常与你们同在，直到世界的末了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."
verses.textEnNkjv: teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age." Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach these new disciples to obey all the commands I have given you. And be sure of this: I am with you always, even to the end of the age."
verses.textEnNasb: teaching them to follow all that I commanded you; and behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."
verses.textEn: <red>and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”</red>
